chapters.title: Chapter 4351: Flame Skin Race
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

Unfortunately, after consuming all the Nine Vines Fire Origin Fruits, Ling Han’s cultivation level only stopped at the late stage of Third Change. He was still some distance away from breaking through to Fourth Change.

“However, my battle prowess—” Ling Han casually did a sweep with his fingers, as if there was a harp in front of him. Pa, pa, pa! The Regulations circulated between his fingers, and power was exploding, which was indescribably terrifying.
“Now, even if it was a Sixth Change Silver Generation elite, I have the confidence to take him down!”

Ling Han broke into a smile. Furthermore, this was still because the Imperial Son had the Great Emperor-level means that could defend against spiritual attacks. Otherwise, if he used the murderous aura attack and the black light of illusion as support, it would probably be no problem for him to defeat even a Seventh Change.
He naturally had to thank “Cousin Lian” for this. Without his hard work, how could Ling Han have possibly obtained the Nine Vines Fire Origin Fruit?
After all, a wild beast that was comparable to the level of Ninth Change was too terrifying. At that time, Ling Han, who had only been at Second Change, would definitely have to turn around and run.

When they finished refining the Nine Vine Fire Origin Fruit, the people who had gone to the palace to search also returned one after another. They were all frowning slightly, appearing very despondent.
This was natural. Everyone had spent months here, but what had they gained?
Zero!

They had harbored boundless hopes, and wanted to obtain the inheritance of the True Phoenix, yet in the end, it was all for naught. This kind of contrast between their expectations and reality was too strong.
These people naturally did not know that the little red bird had long since returned with the third key.
Ling Han definitely wouldn’t make a fuss. After excusing himself, he left with the others.
Chi Menghan was naturally with them, so even though Lian Yutang’s expression was slightly dark, he still followed.

They set out to search for the fourth palace that could possibly exist. On their way, they also discovered a Five Star Celestial medicine. Unfortunately, the fruits that the Celestial medicine had borne had already been harvested.
There was nothing else that could be done, so they could only continue their journey.
After spending a few days, they indeed discovered the fourth palace.
However, what surprised Ling Han was that though this palace was practically the same as the previous three, there were not many people waiting at the plaza.
That was because the doors to the palace were wide open.
Yi?
Ling Han looked at the little red bird, and asked, “Do you have any other siblings?”
“Humph, I am the only one of my kind!” The little red bird was very proud.
Then who had opened this palace?
“Those people... didn’t come in with us,” Chi Menghan quickly said.

Ling Han nodded. Though there were also a few people standing in the plaza, they were not waiting, but rather sparring with each other. Surging power blasted past, yet it was difficult to injure a single floor tile.
Looking closely at their attire, it was a completely different style. Looking closely at their skin, there were fiery red veined patterns.
“Could it be—”
“Natives!”
Everyone was surprised. The other three palaces were all tightly shut, and natives had actually appeared here. Furthermore, they looked to be humans.

“Let’s go take a look,” Lian Yutang said. He was skilled and courageous, and had a high opinion of himself. He was completely unconcerned about the opinions of Ling Han and the others, and directly leaped out, heading towards the plaza.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before nodding at the empress and the others. He then walked out as well.
“Yi, more people have come.” When they saw Ling Han and his group, those natives that were sparring stopped.
“Beauty!” When one of them saw Chi Menghan’s features clearly, his eyes involuntarily lit up, and he hurriedly elbowed the person beside him.
“Mine!”
“No, mine!”
“I’m the first one to spot her, so she is naturally mine!”
There were a total of five of them, and they all called out, scrambling over one another, as if as long as they agreed, Chi Menghan would belong to one of them.
“Humph, how dare you!” Lian Yutang smirked coldly. A mere native actually dared to have designs on someone he had his eye on?
“You’ve come all the way here, and you still dare to be arrogant?” one of the natives sneered.
Lian Yutang couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. He was the Golden Generation, and now someone actually dared to reprimand him?
What a colossal joke!
“You are courting death!” He stretched out a hand, and delivered a palm strike at those five natives.
Boom, a terrifying power surged. The Golden Generation cultivated Body Art at the same time, and even if he didn’t use Regulations, his battle prowess was still chillingly strong.
The five natives joined forces to parry the attack, but as soon as their power came into contact, they all threw up blood, and were sent flying.
And this was still because Lian Yutang had held back. Otherwise, these five people would definitely have all died. The gap in abilities was too wide, and they could only be insta-killed.
After all, this was their territory, and Lian Yutang did not know what elites were hidden in this palace. Thus, he did not deliver a fatal strike, to avoid a life-or-death enmity.
He was indeed proud, but if he didn’t have a brain, how could he possibly become a Golden Generation?

“Hehe, daring to make trouble with our Fire Skin Race, you are really bold!” Amidst a cold laugh, a young man walked out, his arms crossed behind his back. He was tall and slender, his arms bared, and it could be seen that there were flame-shaped tattoos on his arms.
Ling Han swept an eye over it, and felt that this should have been natural, and not engraved afterwards.
Lian Yutang swept an eye over this young man, and smiled faintly, “You are no match for me. Go and switch with someone who can make decisions.”
The young man exploded in anger, “I, Nalan Feiyue, am the second strongest elite of the younger generation of the Flame Skin Race, and you actually dare to look down on me?”
“Hehe, the second strongest elite?” Lian Yutang shook his head, “Go and switch to the top elite.”
He casually sent out a palm strike. Hong, Regulations intertwined, turning into a jade-coloured giant palm.
Nalan Feiyue’s expression involuntarily changed drastically. The other’s strength was too terrifying. He was definitely no match for him.
“There really is an elite.” Another voice rang out. Xiu, a figure seemed to have appeared out of thin air here.
It was also a young man, filled with heroic spirit. He was shirtless, and there were two tree-like tattoos on his arms.
Lian Yutang’s eyes narrowed slightly. This person was definitely not ordinary.
“I am Lian Yutang, how should I address you, sir?” he asked calmly.
“Nalan Huoshu.” This young man smiled, “The top elite of the younger generation of the Flame Skin Race.”

Lian Yutang didn’t dare to be careless. The top elite of the younger generation was Spirit Transformation Tier Eighth Change and above, so if a member of the older generation came, then what cultivation level would they be at?
Sect Master Tier?
Though he was the Golden Generation=, and was very awesome, it was still impossible for him to match Sect Masters, even if it was the weakest of Sect Masters.
“These people humiliated my companion, so I made a move to teach them a lesson.” It was rare for Lian Yutang to explain.
Nalan Huoshu looked at the five people from before, “What’s going on?”
The five of them spoke at once, and actually did not add or subtract the facts.

When Nalan Huoshu heard this, he couldn’t help but laugh, “Brother Lian, you don’t know much about our Flame Skin Race. In our race, women are a kind of wealth, so a woman without an owner naturally can be fought over by anyone.”
“However, since they are Brother Lian’s companions, then I am really sorry. I shall apologize to you on their behalf.”
Ling Han and the others exchanged looks. This Flame Skin Race was a little too primitive, weren’t they? They actually treated women like wealth?

chapters.title: Chapter 4352: Trump Card
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
However, since that was their custom, their previous offense could only be considered a clash of cultures, and could not be blamed on them.

What Ling Han did not understand was that the top elite of the younger generation was already so strong, and the older generation should be even more awesome. Why was this Nalan Huoshu so polite towards Lian Yutang?
He did not believe that this Flame Skin Race was a reasonable group. Faced with a group of strangers, strength was naturally the best intimidation.
“Where have you all come from? Have you ever seen a palace like this?” Nalan Huoshu asked, pointing at the palace behind him.
“We have come precisely from a palace.” Lian Yutang spoke as their representative, and it was naturally him who had bestowed the title on himself.

The eyes of the few members of the Flame Skin Race instantly lit up, revealing an obvious excitement. Even though Nalan Huoshu had hidden it very well, he still couldn’t help but look tempted, and asked, “You guys opened the doors to the palace?”
Lian Yutang nodded, “It would be a piece of cake.”
F***, how shameless.
The palace doors were clearly opened by Ling Han, so what did it have to do with him?
The little red bird was also disdainful. She was clearly the one who had opened it, yet the shameless Ling Han insisted on taking credit for it.
This time, Nalan Huoshu’s excitement could not be concealed, “Then did you guys find anything in the palace?”
Lian Yutang was no fool, and immediately countered with a question of his own, “Is there anything in the palace that is worthy of Brother Huoshu’s attention?”

Nalan Huoshu pondered for a moment, then said, “If Brother Lian can show me what you have obtained from the palace, I will be able to tell Brother Lian the method to obtain the inheritance of the True Phoenix and leave this place.”
These words directly struck Lian Yutang’s heart, and his expression also changed slightly.
Why had he come in?
Wasn’t it for the True Phoenix inheritance? Now that he had finally gotten a clue, his emotions fluctuated.
But the problem was, he had not obtained anything from the palace previously, so how was he supposed to get information out of him?
“Brother Lian, have you made your decision?” Nalan Huoshu asked, his eyes burning.
Lian Yutang smiled faintly, “It is of great importance, and I need to think about it some more.”

Though these words were meant to be a rejection, it was not an absolute refusal. Furthermore, these words also revealed a piece of information, and that was he actually had “that thing” in his possession.
Right now, he was actually trying to gain something without risking anything.
Meanwhile, a thought flashed in Ling Han’s mind. Since this palace had been opened, the corresponding key should be in the hands of the Flame Skin Race.
Negotiate with them?

Ling Han shook his head internally. Negotiations were based on the prerequisite that the abilities of both sides were equal. Otherwise, what was the point of negotiating? They could just directly make a move to snatch it.
You expect them to reason with you?
Hehe, even their wives had come from being snatched!
Ling Han decided to stay put for the moment. He would figure out the situation of the Flame Skin Race first.
Furthermore, with a fool like Lian Yutang standing in front of them to attract firepower, they should be very safe.
They did not rashly enter into the palace, but rather rested outside. In any case, they were all cultivators, so there was absolutely no need to be picky about the environment.
After staying for two days, they had more or less figured out the Flame Skin Race’s situation.
...It was unknown what the reason was. In this Mystery Realm, whether it was wild beasts or cultivators, the upper limit of cultivation was Spiritual Transformation Tier.
Thus, even the older generation of the Flame Skin Race was only in the Spiritual Transformation Tier, and did not have a Sect Master-level existence.
Because of this, Lian Yutang’s attitude immediately changed drastically, no longer being cautious.
He was the Golden Generation, a Spirit Transformation Tier elite. He was invincible in this cultivation level, and it was definitely no problem for him to fight against ten people alone.
He directly turned hostile, and demanded that the Flame Skin Race reveal all their secrets.
Of course, they couldn’t come to an agreement, and a battle immediately broke out.
Nalan Huoshu moved, exchanging blows with Lian Yutang.

This top elite of the younger generation of the Flame Skin Race was truly extraordinary. He was shockingly also a Spirit Transformation Tier Ninth Change—this was actually not difficult to achieve. As long as one could form nine True Selves in the True Self Tier, it would be much easier than reaching Eighth or Ninth Form.
However, the quality of the True Self also greatly affected the might of the spiritual body. Thus, even though they had both undergone Ninth Change, Nalan Huoshu was slightly weaker than Lian Yutang.
Added with the gap in the celestial technique, the battle prowess gap was even more disparate.

However, in a situation where battle prowess was at a disadvantage, the tattoo on Nalan Huoshu’s arm seemed to come to life, twisting and leaping. Boom, he shot out a punch, and blazing flames blazed, turning into a firebird.
The firebird flapped its wings, and charged towards Lian Yutang. The terrifying Regulations of Fire fluttered, even warping space.
Even Lian Yutang did not dare to be careless, and had no choice but to channel out the Imperial Technique, and just barely managed to match it.
Ling Han and the others were all surprised, shocked by the battle prowess of Nalan Huoshu.
To be able to match the Golden Generation in such a powerful manner, he was a little fierce.
However, this was only short-lived. Nalan Huoshu’s burst of power only lasted for less than half a minute, and his aura was completely exhausted.
Right at this moment, nine old men suddenly scuttled out of the palace. Without another word, they all brandished the walking sticks in their hands and struck out at Lian Yutang.
Boom, these walking sticks were obviously Spirit Tools, and were extremely powerful at that. As they waved their staffs, the whole sky was filled with dancing firebirds, covering heaven and earth.
This might was too great, that even Lian Yutang did not dare to oppose it. He had no choice but to retreat, temporarily dodging the attack.
“Kid, it’s better to follow the rules,” an elder said calmly.
Lian Yutang’s expression was tense, and it was clear that he was slightly hesitant. However, in the end, he did not make a move.

In a one-on-one battle, he could suppress any old man single-handedly. In fact, even if these nine old men joined forces, they would not be a match for him. The problem lay in the walking stick in their hands. It was definitely a Seven Star Spirit Tool. With the activation of their secret technique, it could unleash power on the level of Pseudo Sect Master-level.
This caused him to feel wary, especially when he was facing nine opponents at the same time, which made it inevitable that he would be in a dilemma.
“Apologies!” Lian Yutang clasped his hands in obeisance.
The reason why he had to use force was actually because he had no choice. That was because he had not obtained anything from the palace previously, so what could he use to exchange for information?
The storm had temporarily dispersed, but everyone knew that how could a gulf between the two sides be so easily resolved?
On the second day, Lian Yutang sought out Ling Han.
“Follow me!” he commanded directly. He did not say where he was going, nor did he say why he was to go with him.
“Why?” Ling Han naturally wouldn’t submit.
Lian Yutang looked impatient, “Of course to find the fifth palace.”
This time, he definitely had to obtain the item inside.
Ling Han shook his head and said, “Firstly, you’re no one to me, so you don’t have the right to command me. Secondly, just because of your attitude, hehe, you’d better find someone else.”
“Ling Han, don’t be ungrateful!” Lian Yutang said balefully.

It should be known that a great many Imperial Clans wanted Ling Han’s life. If he killed Ling Han, he would be able to trade for a considerable favor. Thus, the fact that he did not make a move to kill him was already giving Ling Han enough face.
What else do you want?

The storm had temporarily dispersed, but everyone knew that how could a gulf between the two sides be so easily resolved?
On the second day, Lian Yutang sought out Ling Han.
“Follow me!” he commanded directly.
He did not say where he was going, nor did he say why he was to go with him.
“Why?” Ling Han naturally wouldn’t submit.
Lian Yutang looked impatient, “Of course to find the fifth palace.”
This time, he definitely had to obtain the item inside.
Ling Han shook his head and said, “Firstly, you’re no one to me, so you don’t have the right to command me.
Secondly, just because of your attitude, hehe, you’d better find someone else.”
“Ling Han, don’t be ungrateful!” Lian Yutang said balefully.
It should be known that a great many Imperial Clans wanted Ling Han’s life.
If he killed Ling Han, he would be able to trade for a considerable favor.
Thus, the fact that he did not make a move to kill him was already giving Ling Han enough face.
What else do you want?

chapters.title: Chapter 4353: Forced
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han shook his head and said, “You can find someone else. I’m not interested.”
“I have already spoken, and you still have all kinds of excuses?” Lian Yutang humphed, and moved aggressively, grabbing out at Ling Han.
A mere Spirit Transformation Tier Second Change cultivator, was naturally someone he could take down with a stretch of his hand.
Ling Han’s eyes turned cold. He activated Destructive Energy, which transformed into a sharp sword that slashed over.

“Yi?” Lian Yutang couldn’t help but let out a muffled groan. A crack had actually appeared on the palm he had struck out. Though it was not ripped apart, it still stunned him. Furthermore, it had also caused a certain backlash to himself.
A mere Spirit Transformation Tier Second Change, he was actually this powerful?
He didn’t know that Ling Han had already advanced to the Third Change.
But even if it was the Third Change or even the Fourth Change, he shouldn’t have been so powerful. The gap in cultivation level was still as wide as the sky, and he was the Golden Generation!
No wonder this boy was called the Imperial Son Killer. He was truly extraordinary.

Lian Yutang felt that he had really underestimated Ling Han. It could not be helped. The Golden Generation had been wearing a brilliant halo since birth. They were the generation that had the highest hopes of becoming Emperor, so it was only natural that they would be proud.
Now, however, he finally realized that those who came later were launching powerful attacks at him and the Golden Generation.
If they were at the same cultivation level, would he be a match for Ling Han?
This caused him to become doubtful, and lose his confidence.
Lian Yutang took a deep breath. As a dignified Golden Generation, he actually did not have the conviction that he would definitely win at the same cultivation level?
Merely for this reason, he had already lost.

His desire to kill Ling Han intensified. As long as he had taken advantage of Ling Han’s value, he would make his move without hesitation. Whether it was because of Ling Han’s natural talent, or because of Chi Menghan.
“I have already made my move, and you still want to refuse?” Lian Yutang smirked coldly, and made another move.

Ling Han did not confront him head-on. Merely exchanging a single blow allowed him to know that Lian Yutang’s strength was still far superior to his. It was definitely not a good idea to confront him head-on.
He retreated, and definitely would not take it head-on.
However, the movement technique that Lian Yutang had grasped was superior to his. In such a short distance, Lian Yutang naturally had the complete upper hand, giving Ling Han great pressure.
“You don’t know how to appreciate kindness!” Lian Yutang humphed, and with a flash, his spiritual bodies appeared, one after another.
This was what it meant to be serious!
Previously, it had been a one-on-one battle, but now? Ten against one, it naturally could further increase his advantage.
“Cousin, what are you doing!” Chi Menghan’s voice rang out, and her figure appeared gracefully.
Lian Yutang forcefully stopped his movements, and smiled faintly at Chi Menghan, “I am sparring with him; what need is there for Cousin to be nervous?”
“I’ll find another chance next time.” After saying this, he turned around and left.
Ling Han stared at his receding figure, killing intent flashing in his eyes.
He definitely had to increase his cultivation level as soon as possible, and kill this guy.
“Cousin’s animosity towards you is very strong,” Chi Menghan said. She wasn’t stupid, so how could it be that she couldn’t tell after such a long time?
Ling Han cracked a smile, “If I kill him, you won’t blame me, right?”
Chi Menghan grimaced. This guy really didn’t take the Imperial Son seriously at all. He would kill and slaughter one at the drop of a hat.
“You decide for yourself,” she said. She would not deliberately influence the decision that Ling Han had made.
Ling Han laughed loudly. This Imperial Daughter did not have the proud personality of the other Imperial Sons and Imperial Daughters at all. She was really understanding.
Actually, this was only in relative terms. If it was someone else, just see how proud Chi Menghan would be.

However, he couldn’t stay here forever. Horses couldn’t grow fat without night grass, and without natural treasures, it would be a pipe dream for him to advance to the Spirit Transformation Tier Sixth Change and above in a short period of time.
He had to go out and search for opportunities. As long as he could get some honey, Nine Vines Fire Origin Fruit, and so on, his cultivation level would be able to soar again.
He discussed with the empress and the others, and decided to set out immediately.
After packing up a little, he was about to set out.
“Hold it right there!” Unexpectedly, before they could even move, they saw Nalan Feiyue running over with a few people, blocking their path.
“There’s no need to trouble you guys to send us off,” the large black dog said with a smile.
Nalan Feiyue ignored the large black dog’s ridicule, and said proudly, “You men can leave, but the women have to stay.”
In the Flame Skin Race, women were a kind of wealth, a tool to pass on their seeds and carry on the line!
This was just like how bandits blocked the way to rob others of their wealth. If they wanted to pass this path, they would have to leave some money behind to buy passage.
“Shameless, you dare to have designs on Niu?” Hu Niu placed her hands on her hips, her face filled with fury.
“Zhi, zhi, zhi, zhi!” The little red bird also called out excitedly. She was also a female.

Meanwhile, Ling Han asked curiously, “Is your ancestor the cook who fetched water and cooked for the True Phoenix? See, isn’t this deduction very logical? Firstly, your names sound similar, and secondly, it’s as if you’ve never seen a woman in eight lifetimes.1”
When these words fell, Nalan Feiyue and the others were all angered.
“You dare to mock us?” they shouted.
Ling Han smiled faintly and said, “It was you people who insulted my family first. It’s impolite not to reciprocate.”
“They’ve got big heads and thick necks, so they must be cooks,” the large black dog immediately concluded.
“Why don’t we capture one and bring him back? We’ll have someone to cook for us in the future,” the little azure dragon suggested.
How could Nalan Feiyue tolerate this? He immediately moved, and shot out a punch at Ling Han.
Ling Han humphed and replied with a punch of his own.
Peng!
A loud bang rang out, and the two of them exchanged a punch. Both of them trembled, and took a few steps back.

Nalan Feiyue was surprised. He was a Spirit Transformation Tier Seventh Change elite, and Ling Han’s aura was clearly inferior to his, but his power was actually not the slightest bit inferior, which surprised him.
However, after only a slight hesitation, he charged over again.

Previously, they had restrained themselves because they were wary of Lian Yutang, a Golden Generation of Spirit Transformation Tier Ninth Change. Only the elders of their clan could suppress him with the Firebird Staff, so they did not dare to cause too much offence.
However, Lian Yutang had already left, and he had also made it very clear that Chi Menghan was the only one who couldn’t be touched.

Thus, when they saw that Ling Han and the others were about to leave, Nalan Feiyue and the others immediately moved. They had not thought that Ling Han would be so troublesome, that they would not be able to deal with him in a short while.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The two of them battled fiercely, and very soon, all their ultimate moves were used. The battle had become incredibly dangerous.
“Humph!” Nalan Feiyue’s figure trembled, and multiple spiritual bodies walked out of his body. There were a total of seven, and added with him, there were eight of them.
Boom, the eight Nalan Feiyues attacked again, and their power naturally increased explosively.

Ling Han still didn’t use his spiritual body. He could disperse all attacks within six Heavens, and he had cultivated Body Arts as well. With the two combined, the strength of his defense was definitely freakish.
So what if it was one against eight? Though he was at a slight disadvantage, he could completely withstand it.
“See if I won’t beat you to death!” Nalan Feiyue roared. Boom, the flaming tattoos on his arms flickered, and his aura instantly increased greatly.

This was a technique similar to the Imperial Clan burning their Imperial Blood to increase their battle prowess. However, in comparison, whether it was in terms of duration or effects, this was far inferior to burning Imperial Blood.
It could not be helped. After all, he was the descendant of the cook.
Ling Han thought to himself, and directly shot out a murderous aura attack.
“Wu!” Nalan Feiyue immediately let out a muffled groan, looking like he was in pain.

chapters.title: Chapter 4354: Deal
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
As long as one didn’t possess a Great Emperor-level treasure, they would definitely be struck by the murderous aura. There was no exception.
Unless, that was, the other party had also grasped the barrage of murderous aura. Only then would they be able to clash with each other, and it would depend on whose Spiritual Power was stronger.

However, Nalan Feiyue was a Seventh Change elite, after all. Moreover, he was a prodigy, so his Spiritual Power was extremely powerful. After being affected for a short while, he recovered and didn’t immediately withdraw.
Ling Han charged over, and Destructive Energy surged, launching a powerful counterattack.

Nalan Feiyue had the help of the seven spiritual bodies, but the spiritual bodies were constructed from the soul as their main component, so they naturally had to suffer the barrage of murderous aura. Furthermore, the effects were especially great. The spiritual bodies could not even unleash 20-30% of their full battle prowess.
In just a few moves, he was completely at a disadvantage, and could only be trampled on by Ling Han.
The members of the Flame Skin Race were all transfixed with shock. They couldn’t believe their eyes.
The second strongest elite of their clan’s younger generation was actually inferior to Ling Han?
Were these outsiders all so awesome?

“Enough!” A cold humph rang out, and Nalan Huoshu appeared, directly interfering. Spirit Transformation Tier Ninth Change’s battle prowess surged out, and even Ling Han dared not face it head-on. He could only retreat.
He glanced at Nalan Feiyue in displeasure, with a hint of rebuke and disdain.
Then, he looked at Ling Han, and revealed a smile, “Brother Ling Han, right? You have already proven your strength, and can possess these women!”
In the Flame Skin Race, women were a kind of resource, and their ownership would be decided by strength.
Ling Han smiled faintly. Could it be that he still had to thank him?
He led the others away, heading to the next palace.
Probably, aside from the little red bird, no one else would be able to open the palace.
However, the main target of Ling Han’s trip was not the key to the fifth palace, but rather to find the Celestial medicine, so as to increase his cultivation level as soon as possible.

However, Celestial medicines could only be found by chance. Previously, he had only encountered the swarm of bees and the Flame-Winged Lion by chance. Now that he had taken the initiative to search for them, he had only wasted his energy.
“Can we do business with the Flame Skin Race?” the large black dog suggested.
“What is it? Do you want to buy their women?” the little azure dragon teased.

“Go away. When the adults speak, the kids should stay on the sidelines.” The large black dog kicked the little azure dragon first, then continued, “The Flame Skin Race is the local tyrant here. After so many years, they must have a considerable amount of savings.”
“En.” Everyone nodded.
Otherwise, with how young Nalan Feiyue and the others were, they should not have been able to reach the height of Spiritual Transformation Tier.
“However, we still have to go to a palace first and obtain that key. Otherwise, the fact that we obtained the keys in the palaces can’t be hidden any longer.”
They continued onwards, and when they arrived at the next palace, they saw that there were indeed a great many people standing guard here, just like before.
Ling Han stepped forwards, and used the little red bird to easily open the great doors. Naturally, he had also successfully obtained the key.
They returned, and a few days later, they returned to the Flame Skin Race.
Ling Han directly requested to see the nine elders, saying that he had obtained something from the palace.
Not long after, an elder appeared, and stood in front of Ling Han.
“Tell me first, what was that thing you obtained?” That elder was ranked fifth, and his upper body was bare. There was a large patch of tattoos on his back.

Ling Han now knew that the size of this tattoo directly determined the strength and time of the Flame Skin Race’s burst of power. Thus, though this old geezer might only be a Spirit Transformation Tier Seventh Change or Eighth Change, his burst of power might not be inferior to Nalan Huoshu.
He smiled faintly, “A key.”
When these words fell, the Fifth Elder immediately smiled, and nodded, “Very good. We can have a good talk. Young man, what do you need in exchange?”
“Firstly, I want to know the functions of the key.”
“Secondly, there is no problem for you to take the key. You can use celestial fruits to exchange for it.”
Ling Han made a condition. He really didn’t mind handing over the key, because he believed that just one key was useless. Otherwise, what need was there for the Flame Skin Race to have other keys?

Fifth Elder pondered for a moment, then said, “This is the lair of the True Phoenix. You naturally know about it already, and in the past, Lord True Phoenix had a total of nine generals under his command, and they were all Saint-level.”
“The Nine Generals live here with Lord True Phoenix and guard Lord True Phoenix.”
“Thus, the True Phoenix Palace is in the center of this place, and the Nine Great General Palaces are distributed in the surroundings.”
“Right now, the central area has been sealed off by the Great Emperor Formation. Only by opening the Nine Great General Places can we break through the formation.”
“Additionally, there is a key hidden in each palace. If you gather all nine keys, you would be able to open the True Phoenix Palace and obtain the inheritance of the True Phoenix.”
After saying this, Fifth Elder smiled slightly, “Young friend, are you satisfied?”
This was more or less the same as Ling Han’s deduction, but Ling Han was sure that this Fifth Elder would definitely not be so honest as to reveal all the information.
However, he naturally couldn’t know what the other party was hiding.
“All right, let’s talk about the deal.” Ling Han cracked a smile.

“We can provide you with three Crimson Ground Fruits,” Fifth Elder said. Seeing the puzzled look on Ling Han’s face, he explained, “Crimson Ground Fruit is a Five Star Celestial medicine, and is extremely beneficial to your cultivation level.”
“How great are the benefits?” Ling Han asked. If the growth of every spiritual body was divided into a hundred steps, how could a step be the same as a fifty steps?
Fifth Elder paused, then said, “Thirty Crimson Ground Fruits can increase one’s cultivation level by a minor level.”
Ling Han immediately shook his head, “Three is too little. Three hundred should be about enough.”
Fifth Elder almost spat out a mouthful of blood. ‘You’re really asking for an exorbitant price. 300? Why don’t you demand for all the wealth of the Flame Skin Race instead?’
“Impossible!” He shook his head resolutely. Even if he had lost his mind and agreed to Ling Han’s request, the Flame Skin Race would not be able to produce so many Crimson Ground Fruits.

“All right, we’ll each take a step back, 150,” Ling Han said with a smile. He naturally knew that his offer was something that the other party could not possibly accept, and was merely an exorbitant bid.
“Ten.” Fifth Elder also raised the bid. This was called bargaining.
“Show some sincerity,” Ling Han said with a smile.
The Fifth Elder humphed, “It should be known that there are a total of nine keys. Even if we obtain the one that you have, if we don’t gather all the other keys, it would be equivalent to useless.”
Ling Han nodded, “That’s right, but without this one from me, even if you get eight, it would be useless.”

This was the reason why Ling Han was willing to sell. In any case, there was already a key in the hands of the Flame Skin Race. Thus, he only had to ensure that he had a key in his possession, and he could still grasp the initiative.
Fifth Elder considered again. This time, he named a “high price”, “Fifty.”
Ling Han took a look, and felt that this was close to maximum that the Flame Skin Race was willing to offer.
“Eighty.” Of course, he still had to continue fighting for more.

“Thus, the True Phoenix Palace is in the center of this place, and the Nine Great General Palaces are distributed in the surroundings.”
“Right now, the central area has been sealed off by the Great Emperor Formation.
Only by opening the Nine Great General Places can we break through the formation.”
“Additionally, there is a key hidden in each palace.
If you gather all nine keys, you would be able to open the True Phoenix Palace and obtain the inheritance of the True Phoenix.”
After saying this, Fifth Elder smiled slightly, “Young friend, are you satisfied?”
This was more or less the same as Ling Han’s deduction, but Ling Han was sure that this Fifth Elder would definitely not be so honest as to reveal all the information.
However, he naturally couldn’t know what the other party was hiding.
“All right, let’s talk about the deal.” Ling Han cracked a smile.
“We can provide you with three Crimson Ground Fruits,” Fifth Elder said.
Seeing the puzzled look on Ling Han’s face, he explained, “Crimson Ground Fruit is a Five Star Celestial medicine, and is extremely beneficial to your cultivation level.”
“How great are the benefits?” Ling Han asked.
If the growth of every spiritual body was divided into a hundred steps, how could a step be the same as a fifty steps?
Fifth Elder paused, then said, “Thirty Crimson Ground Fruits can increase one’s cultivation level by a minor level.”
Ling Han immediately shook his head, “Three is too little.
Three hundred should be about enough.”
Fifth Elder almost spat out a mouthful of blood.
‘You’re really asking for an exorbitant price.
Why don’t you demand for all the wealth of the Flame Skin Race instead?’
“Impossible!” He shook his head resolutely.
Even if he had lost his mind and agreed to Ling Han’s request, the Flame Skin Race would not be able to produce so many Crimson Ground Fruits.
“All right, we’ll each take a step back, 150,” Ling Han said with a smile.
He naturally knew that his offer was something that the other party could not possibly accept, and was merely an exorbitant bid.
“Ten.” Fifth Elder also raised the bid.
This was called bargaining.
“Show some sincerity,” Ling Han said with a smile.
The Fifth Elder humphed, “It should be known that there are a total of nine keys.
Even if we obtain the one that you have, if we don’t gather all the other keys, it would be equivalent to useless.”
Ling Han nodded, “That’s right, but without this one from me, even if you get eight, it would be useless.”
This was the reason why Ling Han was willing to sell.
In any case, there was already a key in the hands of the Flame Skin Race.
Thus, he only had to ensure that he had a key in his possession, and he could still grasp the initiative.
Fifth Elder considered again.
This time, he named a “high price”, “Fifty.”
Ling Han took a look, and felt that this was close to maximum that the Flame Skin Race was willing to offer.
“Eighty.” Of course, he still had to continue fighting for more.

chapters.title: Chapter 4355: Sudden advance of cultivation level
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Finally, Ling Han and the Fifth Elder reached an agreement.
Seventy Crimson Ground Fruits.

For Ling Han, this was more or less enough to increase his cultivation level by two minor levels, and for Fifth Elder, though paying this amount of Crimson Ground Fruits was a little painful, it was not to the point of serious injury, and was within acceptable limits.
Thus, the two of them were very pleased.
Ling Han deliberately ran out for a while, pretending to retrieve the key. Then, he completed the deal with the Fifth Elder.
He held these Crimson Ground Fruits, and was very satisfied.

After refining and absorbing the medicinal effects of these celestial fruits, his cultivation level should be able to reach the peak stage of the Fifth Change or even the early stage of the Sixth Change.
If he could reach Sixth Change, then when he met Lian Yutang again, he would completely be able to compete.
Why could he be so strong?
That was because he was Tenth Form, which had never been seen before. The quality of the True Self was too high, so high that even the Ninth Form could not hope to catch up to him.
Thus, with every level that he advanced, the increase in strength would naturally be terrifying.
Of course, he was only in the late stage of the Third Change now, so it was a little too early to talk about this.
Ling Han didn’t distribute these Crimson Ground Fruits to the others.
Among them, there had to be one that could stand alone. Thus, Ling Han was determined to shoulder this responsibility.
He spoke with the empress and the others for a while, then went to find a place to refine the Crimson Ground Fruits.
He took out one, washed it with clear water, and began to gnaw on it.

The fruit wasn’t big, and it was completely swallowed in a few bites. Not long after, Ling Han felt a warm sensation in his body. There was a mysterious power taking effect, and the effects were somewhat similar to the Nine Vine Fire Origin Fruit, though it was much inferior.
This medicinal power did not surge out in a single breath, but was rather slowly, slowly released.
This also caused Ling Han to cultivate the Imperial Scroll for nothing; he could only let the medicinal effects to take effect slowly.
A whole day later, the medicinal effects of this Crimson Ground Fruit were finally fully unleashed. It was absorbed by Ling Han, allowing his cultivation level to improve slightly.
Going by that calculation, if he wanted to refine all these Crimson Ground Fruits completely, he would need seventy days.
All right, in this period of time, he would keep a low profile first.

Two days, three days, four days... Time passed quietly, and Ling Han’s cultivation level was also steadily improving. Eight days later, he finally reached the consummate level of Third Change. Without any need to settle down, he immediately began to break through to the Fourth Change.
And this had still taken Ling Han some time. Three days later, Ling Han finally managed to successfully cultivate the fourth spiritual body.
Spirit Transformation Tier Fourth Change.
Ling Han’s strength had improved greatly again. However, if he wanted to defeat Lian Yutang, this was still far from enough.
“Sixth Change, at least, I have to reach Sixth Change.”
Ling Han stayed patient, and began to eat the Crimson Ground Fruits again.

His cultivation level rapidly increased again. Not only was it an increase in terms of mystical power, but he also Body Arts. If he channeled the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique, he would also be able to absorb the medicinal effects of the Crimson Ground Fruits.
A month passed, and he cultivated his fourth spiritual body to consummate level.
After settling down for a few days, he began to break through to the Fifth Change.
This took him four days, and he successfully broke through to the Fifth Change.
“Fifth Change, I still have 31 Crimson Ground Fruits in my possession, so reaching the end of the Fifth Change is completely no problem.”
“With another Change, I would be qualified to stand against the strongest level.”
“The inheritance of the True Phoenix, hehe, I am finally no longer paving the way for others.”
Ling Han first went to see the empress and the others. He hadn’t seen them for quite a few days. Furthermore, he also wanted to share some good news with them.
However, when he arrived at where the empress and the others were, he saw that there were a few strangers here. They seemed to be guards, and were standing in different directions.
These were all members of the Flame Skin Race, and they all had flaming tattoos on their arms, which could be distinguished with a single glance.
“Stop right there!” Seeing Ling Han walk over, the person standing in his direction immediately stretched out a hand towards him, indicating for him to stop.
Yi, what was the meaning of this?
“Why?” Ling Han asked.
“Lord Huoshu has already taken a fancy to these two beauties, so if you don’t want to die, then get lost,” that person explained, but at the same time, he was also filled with threat.
Ling Han frowned upon hearing this. Again?
Previously, it was Nalan Feiyue who had blocked their way, preventing them from leaving, and now, it was Nalan Huoshu?
He smiled faintly, “Let me offer a compliment first. Nalan Huoshu has good taste. However, he has his eye on my women, and I have never liked others coveting my women.”
“Your women?” That person couldn’t help but laugh coldly, “Since Lord Huoshu has his eye on them, then they no longer have anything to do with you!”
“Whether there is relation or not, it’s up to me to decide!” Ling Han said. “Now, step aside. Don’t force me to kill someone!”
That person instantly looked scared. After all, he knew that Ling Han had defeated even Nalan Feiyue, and there was absolutely no way that he would be a match for him.
He stepped aside, but then added, “Don’t forget who you are competing with!”

Ling Han glanced at him coldly. If it was not for the fact that this person had obediently stepped out of the way, he would definitely have moved by now, and knocked out all the teeth in this guy’s mouth.
At this moment, the empress and the others also approached.
“Little Han, someone has designs on your wives,” the large black dog immediately said.
Ling Han nodded, “I knoe.”
“What do you plan to do?” the little azure dragon asked. “How about it? Should we make a big fuss?”
He knew that Ling Han had the Great Emperor Horn, so influencing the Flame Skin Race was naturally a piece of cake for him. Thus, there was absolutely no need to worry.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Don’t be rash. I’ll wait for him to deliver himself to me.”
Right now, he was only at the Fifth Change. If he could reach the Sixth Change, then whether it was Nalan Huoshu, or the nine elders, he would be able to rival or even suppress them.
Ling Han took out the Crimson Ground Fruit, and began to eat again.

Nalan Huoshu, on the other hand, was very patient. He actually did not appear, or perhaps he did not take Ling Han seriously at all. As long as the empress and the others had not left, he would not mind waiting a few more days.
For Ling Han, this was a good thing, giving him enough time to increase his cultivation level.
10 days, 20 days, 30 days!
Ling Han finally cultivated the fifth spiritual body to consummate level, but he was still a little bit away from breaking through.

He was stabilizing, and he was accumulating power. However, previously, he had relied on the celestial fruits to rapidly increase his cultivation level, breaking through repeatedly in a short period of time. Now, he actually couldn’t find the feeling of breaking through even after so long.
However, it was at this moment that Nalan Huoshu arrived.
“I’ll give you two choices. One, get lost! Two, die!” he said to Ling Han. “Choose for yourself.”
He was really arrogant.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “I’ll also give you two options. Firstly, get lost, and secondly, kneel on the ground and proclaim your defeat.”
“Haha, who do you think you are?” Nalan Huoshu laughed, “The Golden Generation?”
“Yo, you’re quite progressive with the times. You even know of the Golden Generation?” Ling Han said with a smile.
“Looks like you have chosen the path of death.” Nalan Huoshu shook his head, “How foolish.”
He had lost interest in speaking, and stretched out a hand to deliver a palm strike at Ling Han.

chapters.title: Chapter 4356: Battling Nalan Huoshu
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Nalan Huoshu was overbearing.

Previously, the Flame Skin Race didn’t know who had the palace key, so they were still quite polite to everyone. However, after Ling Han completed the transaction, his value for exploitation was also gone.
—Could it be that you have two keys?

Thus, Nalan Huoshu no longer concealed himself. However, after all, it was not the time to completely turn hostile yet. Thus, he only kept watch over the empress and the others, to prevent them from escaping.
When he obtained the inheritance of the True Phoenix and left this place, the empress and Hu Niu would be his best reward.
But now, Ling Han actually dared to provoke him?
What was this!
Boom! He launched a palm strike, and Regulations intertwined. Divine patterns lit up, and their might shook the heavens.
Ling Han also replied with a punch of his own. He wanted to test out Nalan Huoshu’s strength.
Peng!
In this exchange of blows, Ling Han’s figure trembled, and he took a few steps back.

He couldn’t help but feel surprised. This Nalan Huoshu was really quite awesome. He had probably cultivated to Seven Forms or even Eight Forms when he had been in the True Self Tier, and his power was really very strong.
However, his physique was extremely tough, and he was more so able to dissipate the power of attacks within six Heavens. Thus, this strike was only able to push him back.
However, in the eyes of Nalan Huoshu, Ling Han was naturally outmatched.
A haughty expression appeared on his face, and he immediately charged forward, saying, “I really don’t know where you got the courage to challenge me.”
Hong! Hong! Hong!
He was extremely domineering, and he unleashed all of his attacks, whether it was his fists, his palms, or his legs.
Ling Han was unafraid in the slightest. He moved casually, seeming to be indifferent, but the might was astonishing.
This was precisely because he had taken the first step to create his own path, so his battle prowess was naturally stronger.
After exchanging several dozen blows, Nalan Huoshu couldn’t help but frown.

Logically speaking, Ling Han having taken his attacks head-on every time, he would be sent flying every time. Ling Han’s battle prowess was far inferior to his, so after sustaining so many attacks, his internal organs should have long since exploded.
Why was this guy still able to hold on? Furthermore, he looked like he was completely fine. He was completely capable of continuing to hold on like this?
He didn’t understand, but a sense of urgency rose up in his heart. He couldn’t continue to tangle with Ling Han like this.
He would kill this opponent instantly in a single stroke.
Weng, nine spiritual bodies instantly walked out of his body, every spiritual body exuding seven colours.
Seven colours!
This meant that when he was in the True Self Tier, he had reached the height of Seven Forms or even Eight Forms.
In a Mystery Realm, there was actually such a prodigy?
No wonder Nalan Huoshu was so proud, and no wonder he could exchange a few blows with Lian Yutang. Indeed, his strength was really not weak.
Once the nine spiritual bodies appeared, it instantly became a battle of ten against one, causing Ling Han to be flustered.
With a thought from Ling Han, five spiritual bodies similarly walked out of his body.
“Fifth Change?” When Nalan Huoshu saw this, his expression involuntarily changed.
Just Fifth Change alone was enough to oppose him, a Ninth Change. Just how f freakish was this?

Of course, it was also possible that Ling Han was actually a Sixth Change, Seventh Change, Eighth Change or Ninth Change. It was just that he deliberately didn’t release the remaining spiritual bodies. He was just deliberately trying to scare him.
“You can’t possibly be a Fifth Change!” he immediately said. There was no such freak in this world!
He was already the strongest freak, so how could anyone surpass him?
“Frog at the bottom of a well!” Ling Han said calmly, bringing his five spiritual bodies with him as he launched a counterattack.

In terms of spiritual bodies, Ling Han was naturally no match for Nalan Huoshu. However, his spiritual body was superior in quality. Thus, even if it was a battle of six against ten, it still did not mean a one-sided defeat.
Of course, in terms of power, Nalan Huoshu was still superior. Ling Han and his spiritual bodies were all sent flying left and right.
After battling for so long, Ling Han had a complete understanding of Nalan Huoshu’s strength, and instantly lost his patience.
Weng, his spiritual bodies released a mysterious pulsation. The battle prowess of Nalan Huoshu and his nine spiritual bodies instantly dropped drastically, falling all the way by three Heavens.
What!

Nalan Huoshu paled in shock. How had his battle prowess suddenly fallen all the way by three Heavens? It should be known that though he was stronger than Ling Han, he was only stronger by four to five Heavens at most. Now that his battle prowess had been weakened by three Heavens, his advantage was very small.
Peng!
In this exchange of blows, he had only sent Ling Han flying a few meters away, and was no longer as powerful as before.
He paled in shock. What kind of monster was this?
“I can’t let you live!” he said balefully, leading the nine spiritual bodies to launch a fierce offensive against Ling Han’s main body.
Capture the ringleader before capturing the lackeys. As long as Ling Han was killed, what could his spiritual bodies do?
Ling Han smiled faintly, activating the barrage of murderous aura. Weng, Nalan Huoshu was instantly hit, revealing a pained expression, his expression becoming incredibly twisted.
His nine spiritual bodies were even weaker, and they all trembled lightly.

Ling Han took advantage of the opening to counterattack, especially the Spiritual Body of Destruction. As he shot out a punch, black-colored energy surged. This would also have terrifying destructive power on the spiritual body.

Nalan Huoshu’s cultivation was astonishing, and after crossing into the True Self Tier, the cultivator began to cultivate the soul. Thus, the strength of the soul was naturally greatly increased. Though he was affected by the barrage of the murderous aura, it only lasted for a while.
He immediately launched a counterattack.
However, the second wave of murderous aura assaulted him again, causing him to once again reveal an expression of pain.
Thankfully, he was already prepared. Though his mind was close to chaos, he still instinctively went into a defensive stance.
Peng!

Ling Han unleashed a mad barrage of attacks, especially when the Spiritual Body of Destruction targeted one of the spiritual bodies and attacked with all its might. Destructive Energy surged, posing a great threat to the spiritual body.
After a dozen over moves, Nalan Huoshu couldn’t hold on any longer.
One of his spiritual bodies had been blasted by Destructive Energy, and was severely injured, so he had no choice but to withdraw it back into his body.
His spiritual body had been damaged, and his own battle prowess had also declined greatly.
One had to realize that his battle prowess was only one or two Heavens above that of Ling Han’s. Now that his spiritual body had been wounded, his advantage was naturally further reduced.

He frowned. Previously, when he had been in his prime, he had still been unable to take down Ling Han. Now that a spiritual body had been damaged, if they continued to fight, wouldn’t he be at more and more of a disadvantage?
“Damn it!” he roared loudly. Boom, the fiery tree tattoos on his arms immediately released a blinding light.
He had exploded!

The most powerful trait of the Flame Skin Race was that they could activate their explosive power by combusting their tattoos. However, this was at the cost of sacrificing their lifespan. Even though their explosive power could only last for half a minute, the amount of lifespan they expended was in the hundreds of years.
Unless they had no other choice, the Flame Skin Race was naturally unwilling to do so.
But now, he definitely had to win!
Boom! His aura instantly soared, and he unleashed another palm strike. The Regulations transformed into a gigantic sword that slashed down at Ling Han.
Even Ling Han didn’t dare to face this attack head-on.

Under the explosive power, the battle prowess of Nalan Huoshu had already surpassed Ling Han by six Heavens. Thus, if he took this attack head-on, he would definitely be injured. In fact, it was not impossible that he would be insta-killed.
However, Ling Han had at least two ways to resolve this situation.
With a thought from Ling Han, the black light of illusion was unleashed.
Nalan Huoshu’s movements instantly paused, as he sank into his own beautiful dream. In this dream, he naturally had successfully killed Ling Han.

He was already the strongest freak, so how could anyone surpass him?
“Frog at the bottom of a well!” Ling Han said calmly, bringing his five spiritual bodies with him as he launched a counterattack.
In terms of spiritual bodies, Ling Han was naturally no match for Nalan Huoshu.
However, his spiritual body was superior in quality.
Thus, even if it was a battle of six against ten, it still did not mean a one-sided defeat.
Of course, in terms of power, Nalan Huoshu was still superior.
Ling Han and his spiritual bodies were all sent flying left and right.
After battling for so long, Ling Han had a complete understanding of Nalan Huoshu’s strength, and instantly lost his patience.
Weng, his spiritual bodies released a mysterious pulsation.
The battle prowess of Nalan Huoshu and his nine spiritual bodies instantly dropped drastically, falling all the way by three Heavens.
What!
Nalan Huoshu paled in shock.
How had his battle prowess suddenly fallen all the way by three Heavens?
It should be known that though he was stronger than Ling Han, he was only stronger by four to five Heavens at most.
Now that his battle prowess had been weakened by three Heavens, his advantage was very small.
Peng!
In this exchange of blows, he had only sent Ling Han flying a few meters away, and was no longer as powerful as before.
He paled in shock.
What kind of monster was this?
“I can’t let you live!” he said balefully, leading the nine spiritual bodies to launch a fierce offensive against Ling Han’s main body.
Capture the ringleader before capturing the lackeys.
As long as Ling Han was killed, what could his spiritual bodies do?
Ling Han smiled faintly, activating the barrage of murderous aura.
Weng, Nalan Huoshu was instantly hit, revealing a pained expression, his expression becoming incredibly twisted.
His nine spiritual bodies were even weaker, and they all trembled lightly.
Ling Han took advantage of the opening to counterattack, especially the Spiritual Body of Destruction.
As he shot out a punch, black-colored energy surged.
This would also have terrifying destructive power on the spiritual body.
Nalan Huoshu’s cultivation was astonishing, and after crossing into the True Self Tier, the cultivator began to cultivate the soul.
Thus, the strength of the soul was naturally greatly increased.
Though he was affected by the barrage of the murderous aura, it only lasted for a while.
He immediately launched a counterattack.
However, the second wave of murderous aura assaulted him again, causing him to once again reveal an expression of pain.
Thankfully, he was already prepared.
Though his mind was close to chaos, he still instinctively went into a defensive stance.
Peng!
Ling Han unleashed a mad barrage of attacks, especially when the Spiritual Body of Destruction targeted one of the spiritual bodies and attacked with all its might.
Destructive Energy surged, posing a great threat to the spiritual body.
After a dozen over moves, Nalan Huoshu couldn’t hold on any longer.
One of his spiritual bodies had been blasted by Destructive Energy, and was severely injured, so he had no choice but to withdraw it back into his body.
His spiritual body had been damaged, and his own battle prowess had also declined greatly.
One had to realize that his battle prowess was only one or two Heavens above that of Ling Han’s.
Now that his spiritual body had been wounded, his advantage was naturally further reduced.
He frowned.
Previously, when he had been in his prime, he had still been unable to take down Ling Han.
Now that a spiritual body had been damaged, if they continued to fight, wouldn’t he be at more and more of a disadvantage?
“Damn it!” he roared loudly.
Boom, the fiery tree tattoos on his arms immediately released a blinding light.
He had exploded!
The most powerful trait of the Flame Skin Race was that they could activate their explosive power by combusting their tattoos.
However, this was at the cost of sacrificing their lifespan.
Even though their explosive power could only last for half a minute, the amount of lifespan they expended was in the hundreds of years.
Unless they had no other choice, the Flame Skin Race was naturally unwilling to do so.
But now, he definitely had to win!
Boom!
His aura instantly soared, and he unleashed another palm strike.
The Regulations transformed into a gigantic sword that slashed down at Ling Han.
Even Ling Han didn’t dare to face this attack head-on.
Under the explosive power, the battle prowess of Nalan Huoshu had already surpassed Ling Han by six Heavens.
Thus, if he took this attack head-on, he would definitely be injured.
In fact, it was not impossible that he would be insta-killed.
However, Ling Han had at least two ways to resolve this situation.
With a thought from Ling Han, the black light of illusion was unleashed.
Nalan Huoshu’s movements instantly paused, as he sank into his own beautiful dream.
In this dream, he naturally had successfully killed Ling Han.

chapters.title: Chapter 4357: Another Deal
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han was in no hurry. He knew that the burst of power from Nalan Huoshu could only last for a while, so he only had to drag things out for half a minute.
As expected, after only a while, the tattoos burning fiercely on Nalan Huoshu’s arms dimmed, as if dead silent.
The burst of power had ended.
Ling Han smiled, and threw a punch.
Peng!
The danger was close at hand, and Nalan Huoshu instinctively parried. Then, he broke out of the illusion.
“You dare to trick me!” he roared in fury, appearing to be extremely furious.
A hundred years of lifespan had actually been wasted just like that.
Ling Han’s eyes turned cold, and he said calmly, “Scram immediately. Otherwise, I will definitely kill you!”
Nalan Huoshu gritted his teeth, his whole body trembling.

He wanted so much to kill Ling Han, but he no longer had any explosive power. If he forced himself to face it head-on, the result could possibly be his spiritual bodies being destroyed one after another, and finally, it would be the main body’s turn.
He had to endure this humiliation.
Nalan Huoshu took a deep breath, turned around abruptly, and left angrily.
Killing intent flashed across Ling Han’s eyes, but he didn’t give chase.

It wasn’t that he didn’t want to kill Nalan Huoshu, but that he was presently in the territory of the Flame Skin Race. If he really killed him, would those elders of the Flame Skin Race sit by and watch?

Though the battle prowess of these elders themselves was not all that impressive, the walking sticks in their hands were very frightening. They could blast out power on the level of Pseudo Sect Master, and even Lian Yutang did not dare to trifle with them.
Ling Han was only at the peak stage of the Fifth Change. If he were to face battle prowess of such levels now, he would be at a huge disadvantage.
Thus, he decided to endure for a while, because after this battle, he suddenly gained inspiration for breaking through.
He immediately sat down in a cross-legged position, attempting to break through to Sixth Change.
—Others would definitely not think that he was presently breaking through to Sixth Change.
Who would be so bold, and so rash?
They would assume that he was recovering. After all, he had just experienced a great battle.
He had made the right bet. No one from the Flame Skin Race came out to provoke him, as if he and Nalan Huoshu had only had a small conflict.
However, the empress and the others were very familiar with Ling Han. They all sat around him, protecting him in the center.
Five days later, the sixth spiritual body had already formed into an embryonic form, and developed into a mist-like shape.
Sixth Change!

Ling Han’s eyes snapped open, and two streaks of divine light shot out. It was as if they could penetrate the heavens, but it was only an instant. All the divine light had disappeared, and his eyes had returned to normal. They were very ordinary, and looked no different from any ordinary person’s. There was only a hint of gentleness in them.
“Ling Han, you’ve broken through?” Hu Niu asked.
“En.” Ling Han nodded, “Sixth Change.”
“That’s great!” Hu Niu clapped her hands, “Let’s go fight, and beat those b@stards to death!”
“That’s right! Kill them! They’re far too arrogant!” the large black dog roared.
Ling Han waved his hand dismissively, and said, “Don’t be anxious. Let’s go and discuss a business deal first.”
The large black dog’s eyes immediately lit up. With his understanding of Ling Han, this was Ling Han trying to scam others again.
“Alright, alright, alright.”
Ling Han stood up and left. The large black dog hurriedly followed him. The little azure dragon naturally wouldn’t miss out on this kind of excitement, so it hurriedly followed behind him.
They walked to the entrance of the palace, and Ling Han casually found a member of the Flame Skin Race, and said, “I want to see your elder.”
That member of the Flame Skin Race had witnessed the battle between Ling Han and Nalan Huoshu, so he naturally didn’t dare to be negligent. He hurriedly ran into the palace.

Ling Han and the others didn’t enter. They naturally knew that there was a Saint-level formation in the palace. If they entered, their lives would be in the hands of the person controlling the formation.
Not long after, an old man whose upper body was bare walked out with a cane in hand.
It was still Fifth Elder.
“Young friend, come in for a chat,” Fifth Elder said with a wave and a smile, looking very gentle.

How could Ling Han possibly agree? Previously, there was no animosity between them, and the other wanted to obtain the key from the palace, so he naturally wouldn’t do anything to him before he obtained it.
It was different now. He would definitely not walk right into a trap.
“The ventilation indoors isn’t good, so let’s just walk outside and chat,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“Young friend, you are really careful!” Fifth Elder shook his head, “What is it? Are you still worried that I will harm you?”
Ling Han merely smiled, and did not continue the conversation.
Thus, they casually strolled around the plaza, admiring the scenery, and had some meaningless chatter.
“Young friend, what are you trying to say to me?” In the end, Fifth Elder couldn’t take it anymore. This guy clearly looked to be only in his twenties, but why was he so calm?
Ling Han smiled, and said, “I want to do another business deal with Fifth Elder.”
“Oh, could it be that you have another key?” Fifth Elder also said with a smile. This naturally was a teasing remark.

He refused to believe that Ling Han’s luck would be so good. One had to realize that Ling Han definitely couldn’t be regarded as the number one elite among those who entered this Mystery Realm. In fact, it was already extremely difficult for him to enter the top 10. And this was due to him having obtained Crimson Ground Fruits at that.
Ling Han spread open his hand, and there was an ancient-looking key in his palm.
This!
Fifth Ekder instantly looked surprised. Wasn’t this the key that they had been searching for all this while?
This brat was really amazing. He had actually obtained two keys.
“Same old rules, seventy Crimson Ground Fruits,” Ling Han said with a smile.
Fifth Elder gritted his teeth, feeling a deep pain in his balls.
Actually, as long as all the keys had not been gathered, there was not much difference between having one or eight.
Thus, if Ling Han had taken out two keys before, he would probably only be willing to give out 70 Crimson Ground Fruits, at most.
This guy clearly had two keys, yet sold one at a time. Wasn’t this clearly trying to screw him over?
“Young friend, this is a little inappropriate of you.” Fifth Elder shook his head, a hint of displeasure on his face.
He wanted Ling Han to know.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t give in just because of this, and he asked, “What’s inappropriate?”

“Young friend, you should also know that there is not much difference between possessing one key and two keys.” Fifth Elder said, “Thus, to sell two keys for the same high price, there is naturally a lack of fairness.”
Ling Han nodded, “If that’s the case, then fine. Let’s go.”
He nodded at the large black dog and the little azure dragon.
“Yi, where are you guys going?” Fifth Elder hurriedly asked.
“Of course I’m going to find someone who can afford the price,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“Someone not so stingy,” the large black dog added.
Fifth Elder instantly wanted to slap someone. Was this called being stingy?
You guys screwed us over first, all right?
He humphed, and said, “Young friend, don’t refuse a toast only to be forced to drink a forfeit!”
“What is it? Want to turn hostile and make a move?” Ling Han asked with a smile.

Fifth Elder smiled faintly, “These few days, you are all trying to probe our background, but aren’t we the same? Young friend Ling, I have heard that you are not very well-liked in the Ancestral King Academy.”
“Is that so?” Ling Han pretended to be surprised, and looked towards the large black dog, “Old Black, what do you think?”

“How could that be!” The large black dog’s expression was filled with anger, “Our Little Han is too popular, and is loved by everyone. Where did this rumor come from? This is practically a serious slander against our Little Han.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4358: Falling Out
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Hearing these words, Fifth Elder did not know how to complain.
Slander?
Was everyone slandering them?
It was fine if only one or two of them said this, but more importantly, everyone was saying the same thing. How could it be faked?

Fifth Elder forced out a smile, and said, “Young friend Ling, a person should still have some principles. Hand the key over to me, and it can be considered that our clan owes you a favour, all right? At that time, when the Palace of the True Phoenix opens, there will be no shortage of benefits for you.”

Ling Han also smiled, “Then why don’t Fifth Elder give me the keys that your Flame Skin Race have? At that time, when I return from the Palace of the True Phoenix, I will definitely give you all some benefits.”
‘Holy f*ck!’
The Fifth Elder finally couldn’t laugh anymore. Why was this brat so stubborn?
“Young friend, are you forcing me to make a move?” He revealed a baleful expression.
“Finally showing your true colours?” Ling Han said with a smile. “Come, I also want to see how strong you are.”
He gave a signal with his eyes, and the large black dog and little azure dragon immediately retreated.
They were too weak, and could not help Ling Han. Instead, they would only be a burden.

The Fifth Elder did not stop them. In his eyes, Ling Han was the real thorn in his side. As for the others? Hehe, their abilities were too weak, and he could easily capture them with a stretch of his hand.
“Young friend, you’re a little arrogant,” the old geezer said slowly.
“Old geezer, you’re taking advantage of your seniority a bit,” Ling Han retorted.
Fifth Elder was taken aback. He had not thought that Ling Han would be so rude. He humphed, and directly brandished his walking stick, which swept towards Ling Han.
He knew himself well. His own strength was far inferior to Nalan Huoshu. Thus, even Nalan Huoshu had been defeated by Ling Han, so he was naturally even less of a match for Ling Han.
However, this didn’t matter. The walking stick in his hand was a Six Star Spirit Tool, and could unleash the might of Pseudo Sect Master-levl.
Could it be that it was still unable to suppress Ling Han?
Boom, this walking stick glowed all over, and as it shot out an attack, a firebird flew out, blasting towards Ling Han.
Pseudo Sect Master-level!
Ling Han was eager to give it a try, and greeted it with a punch.
“You’re seeking death!” Fifth Elder couldn’t help but scoff.
Peng!
A punch landed on the firebird, and Ling Han instantly felt a strong burning pain rise up in his fist. A massive power assailed him, causing him to be sent flying into the air.
He spat out a mouthful of blood, then straightened his back and stood firmly.
F***, he was still unable to withstand a Pseudo Sect Master-level attack.
Ling Han looked at his right hand. There was a burnt mark on his fist, and under the shockwave of power, the skin on his arm and chest also cracked, with blood seeping out.
“Young friend, why are you so stubborn?” Fifth Elder asked hypocritically, as he once again brandished his walking stick to strike Ling Han.
Since he had already made his move, he naturally would not show any mercy.

With the two of them fighting, the people in the surroundings also came closer to watch the battle, but they did not dare to get too close. The power of Pseudo Sect Master-level, was too terrifying. If they came into contact with that, they would definitely be out of luck.
Hence, it was fine to watch the show, but no one wanted to be implicated.
“As expected, it’s Ling Han again!”
“I say, who would be so outrageously bold to dare oppose Pseudo Sect Master-level? Aside from Ling Han, who else could it be?”
“However, I can’t help but admire this guy’s courage. He really dares to trifle with anyone.”
Everyone discussed spiritedly. While they were hostile towards Ling Han, they had no choice but to show some respect.
However, how could Ling Han get through this?
Without another word, Ling Han immediately turned around and fled.
“Trying to escape?” Fifth Elder humphed. Since he had made a move, he would definitely capture Ling Han — the key was still in Ling Han’s hands.
One fled, while the other pursued. Very soon, they had disappeared from the plaza.
At this time, another eight old men leaped out of the palace, looking towards where Ling Han and the Fifth Elder had disappeared.
“There’s no problem with Old Fifth, right?” an elder asked.
“Though that brat is very strong, Old Fifth has the Firebird Staff in hand. In this place, he is invincible,” another old man said.
“We only need to wait for a while, and Old Fifth will return with that brat’s head.”
Ling Han ran like crazy, seeming to be in a panic, scrambling towards places with complicated terrain.
The Fifth Elder naturally pursued him relentlessly. This involved the inheritance of the True Phoenix. No matter what, he would not allow Ling Han to escape.
After chasing for a very, very long time, he discovered that Ling Han had suddenly stopped, and had even turned around.

“Ha, now that you know that it is impossible for you to escape, you want to fight to the death?” Fifth Elder asked smilingly, but he did not dare to be careless. After all, his own strength was not very strong. He had to guard against Ling Han’s dying counterattack, and himself being dragged down with him.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “There is no one here, so it would be convenient for me to make a move.”
If the large black dog was here, he would definitely know Ling Han’s intentions. This was obviously Ling Han hiding his strength, so that he could screw others over in future.
“I really don’t know where you get your confidence from.” Fifth Elder humphed, and waved his walking stick again. Hong, a firebird flew out, pouncing towards Ling Han.
Weng, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower suddenly appeared, floating above Ling Han’s head.
Peng!
The firebird struck, causing the precious tower to tremble slightly, but that was the extent of it.
“What!” Fifth Elder instantly revealed an expression of shock.
What kind of precious tool was this, that it could actually withstand an attack from the Firebird Staff?
“You’re not the only one with a Spirit Tool,” Ling Han said with a smile. “How about it? This Spirit Tool of mine is kickass, right?”

The Fifth Elder frowned. Merely this attack was not enough to explain the might of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. However, this precious tower was exuding an aura of Primal Chaos, and there were flashes of lightning flickering on the body of the tower, giving him a supreme pressure.
It should be known that even the Firebird Staff could not be so awesome.
“What kind of weapon is this Spirit Tool?” he couldn’t help but ask.
“This...” Ling Han paused for a moment before continuing, “This is a Spirit Tool forged from Origin Gold. In other words, it’s a future Imperial Weapon!”
Pu!
The Fifth Elder instantly spluttered. What, Imperial Weapon!
No, no, no, this wasn’t an Imperial Weapon. It was only forged from the Origin Gold, but what grade of material was the Origin Gold? No wonder it gave him such a solid feeling of majesty.
All of a sudden, greed rose up in his heart.

The inheritance of the True Phoenix was only a legend. It had been talked about for generations, but they had never seen it until now. On the other hand, the Flame Skin Race had been trapped here for generations, and it was unknown when they would be able to leave.
However, the precious tool in front of him was real.
“Give it to me, and I can spare your life,” Fifth Elder said.

Ling Han laughed loudly, and said, “Do you think I’m stupid? I give it to you, and then you turn around and kill me? Heh, do you think I summoned the Imperial Weapon to beg you for mercy? Wrong, I only don’t want others to know that I have an Imperial Weapon.”

As long as others saw it, it would expose the fact that the Nine Mountains Saint didn’t actually possess an Imperial Weapon. Then, whether it was him or the Nine Mountains Saint, or even the Nine Suns Holy Land, they would all be in danger.

Thus, since Ling Han was going to use the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, he definitely couldn’t use it in front of everyone else. Moreover, since he was going to use it, he definitely had to kill him to keep him from leaking the secret.
“Come battle!” Ling Han commanded the Pseudo Imperial Weapon, blasting it towards Fifth Elder.
