He humphed, and directly brandished his walking stick, which swept towards Ling Han.
He knew himself well.
His own strength was far inferior to Nalan Huoshu.
Thus, even Nalan Huoshu had been defeated by Ling Han, so he was naturally even less of a match for Ling Han.
However, this didn’t matter.
The walking stick in his hand was a Six Star Spirit Tool, and could unleash the might of Pseudo Sect Master-levl.
Could it be that it was still unable to suppress Ling Han?
Boom, this walking stick glowed all over, and as it shot out an attack, a firebird flew out, blasting towards Ling Han.
Pseudo Sect Master-level!
Ling Han was eager to give it a try, and greeted it with a punch.
“You’re seeking death!” Fifth Elder couldn’t help but scoff.
Peng!
A punch landed on the firebird, and Ling Han instantly felt a strong burning pain rise up in his fist.
A massive power assailed him, causing him to be sent flying into the air.
He spat out a mouthful of blood, then straightened his back and stood firmly.
F***, he was still unable to withstand a Pseudo Sect Master-level attack.
Ling Han looked at his right hand.
There was a burnt mark on his fist, and under the shockwave of power, the skin on his arm and chest also cracked, with blood seeping out.
“Young friend, why are you so stubborn?” Fifth Elder asked hypocritically, as he once again brandished his walking stick to strike Ling Han.
Since he had already made his move, he naturally would not show any mercy.
With the two of them fighting, the people in the surroundings also came closer to watch the battle, but they did not dare to get too close.
The power of Pseudo Sect Master-level, was too terrifying.
If they came into contact with that, they would definitely be out of luck.
Hence, it was fine to watch the show, but no one wanted to be implicated.
“As expected, it’s Ling Han again!”
“I say, who would be so outrageously bold to dare oppose Pseudo Sect Master-level?
Aside from Ling Han, who else could it be?”
“However, I can’t help but admire this guy’s courage.
He really dares to trifle with anyone.”
Everyone discussed spiritedly.
While they were hostile towards Ling Han, they had no choice but to show some respect.
However, how could Ling Han get through this?
Without another word, Ling Han immediately turned around and fled.
“Trying to escape?” Fifth Elder humphed.
Since he had made a move, he would definitely capture Ling Han — the key was still in Ling Han’s hands.
One fled, while the other pursued.
Very soon, they had disappeared from the plaza.
At this time, another eight old men leaped out of the palace, looking towards where Ling Han and the Fifth Elder had disappeared.
“There’s no problem with Old Fifth, right?” an elder asked.
“Though that brat is very strong, Old Fifth has the Firebird Staff in hand.
In this place, he is invincible,” another old man said.
“We only need to wait for a while, and Old Fifth will return with that brat’s head.”
Ling Han ran like crazy, seeming to be in a panic, scrambling towards places with complicated terrain.
The Fifth Elder naturally pursued him relentlessly.
This involved the inheritance of the True Phoenix.
No matter what, he would not allow Ling Han to escape.
After chasing for a very, very long time, he discovered that Ling Han had suddenly stopped, and had even turned around.
“Ha, now that you know that it is impossible for you to escape, you want to fight to the death?” Fifth Elder asked smilingly, but he did not dare to be careless.
After all, his own strength was not very strong.
He had to guard against Ling Han’s dying counterattack, and himself being dragged down with him.
Ling Han cracked a smile, “There is no one here, so it would be convenient for me to make a move.”
If the large black dog was here, he would definitely know Ling Han’s intentions.
This was obviously Ling Han hiding his strength, so that he could screw others over in future.
“I really don’t know where you get your confidence from.” Fifth Elder humphed, and waved his walking stick again.
Hong, a firebird flew out, pouncing towards Ling Han.
Weng, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower suddenly appeared, floating above Ling Han’s head.
Peng!
The firebird struck, causing the precious tower to tremble slightly, but that was the extent of it.
“What!” Fifth Elder instantly revealed an expression of shock.
What kind of precious tool was this, that it could actually withstand an attack from the Firebird Staff?
“You’re not the only one with a Spirit Tool,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“How about it?
This Spirit Tool of mine is kickass, right?”
The Fifth Elder frowned.
Merely this attack was not enough to explain the might of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
However, this precious tower was exuding an aura of Primal Chaos, and there were flashes of lightning flickering on the body of the tower, giving him a supreme pressure.
It should be known that even the Firebird Staff could not be so awesome.
“What kind of weapon is this Spirit Tool?” he couldn’t help but ask.
“This...” Ling Han paused for a moment before continuing, “This is a Spirit Tool forged from Origin Gold.
In other words, it’s a future Imperial Weapon!”
Pu!
The Fifth Elder instantly spluttered.
What, Imperial Weapon!
No, no, no, this wasn’t an Imperial Weapon.
It was only forged from the Origin Gold, but what grade of material was the Origin Gold?
No wonder it gave him such a solid feeling of majesty.
All of a sudden, greed rose up in his heart.
The inheritance of the True Phoenix was only a legend.
It had been talked about for generations, but they had never seen it until now.
On the other hand, the Flame Skin Race had been trapped here for generations, and it was unknown when they would be able to leave.
However, the precious tool in front of him was real.
“Give it to me, and I can spare your life,” Fifth Elder said.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and said, “Do you think I’m stupid?
I give it to you, and then you turn around and kill me?
Heh, do you think I summoned the Imperial Weapon to beg you for mercy?
Wrong, I only don’t want others to know that I have an Imperial Weapon.”
As long as others saw it, it would expose the fact that the Nine Mountains Saint didn’t actually possess an Imperial Weapon.
Then, whether it was him or the Nine Mountains Saint, or even the Nine Suns Holy Land, they would all be in danger.
Thus, since Ling Han was going to use the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, he definitely couldn’t use it in front of everyone else.
Moreover, since he was going to use it, he definitely had to kill him to keep him from leaking the secret.
“Come battle!” Ling Han commanded the Pseudo Imperial Weapon, blasting it towards Fifth Elder.

chapters.title: Chapter 4359: Killed
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
In terms of the might of a Spirit Tool, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was actually no match for the Firebird Staff.
After all, the Firebird Staff was Six Stars, while the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was linked to Ling Han’s cultivation level, and could only be considered Five Stars.

However, Fifth Elder was only Spirit Transformation Tier. He couldn’t unleash the full might of the Firebird Staff, while Ling Han could maximize the might of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower and completely unleash it.
Moreover, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was forged from Origin Gold, after all, and was the emperor of all weapons. It naturally countered all Spirit Tools that weren’t Imperial Weapons.
As time passed, the might of the Firebird Staff was no stronger than the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Then would Ling Han still be at a disadvantage?
Peng! Peng! Peng!
The firebird attacked, and it was all blocked by the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Moreover, under the Origin Gold’s suppression, the firebird’s power was greatly decreased.
Meanwhile, Ling Han bombarded Fifth Elder madly. Without the Firebird Staff, this old geezer’s strength was only on the level of Nalan Feiyue, so how could he possibly be a match for him?
However, after only a few moves, a punch landed on Fifth Elder’s chest, causing him to throw up blood madly. All his organs had turned into pieces, spluttering out together.
Fifth Elder paled in shock. He had never imagined that he would fall into such a dangerous situation.
But at this time and place, who could he ask for help from?
He could only depend on himself.
He roared loudly, and instantly, the flaming tattoo burned fiercely. He directly unleashed a hundred years of lifespan in exchange for a burst of power.
‘Die!’
Brandishing the Firebird Staff, he charged towards Ling Han.
But Ling Han had already advanced into Sixth Change, and completely overwhelmed him in terms of strength. So what if you got a burst of power?
Boom!
Ling Han forcefully suppressed him. Fifth Elder was no match for him at all, and his injuries continued to worsen.
And this was still because Fifth Elder had the Firebird Staff. Otherwise, in a battle that was completely based on his own strength, he would probably be insta-killed.
“Damn it!”

Half a minute’s time passed very quickly. Fifth Elder’s burst of power had passed. He cursed lowly, but without the slightest hesitation, seven figures darted out of his body, and together with his main body, fled in eight different directions.

The strength of Spirit Transformation Tier lay in the fact that even if they were killed, as long as they left behind a spiritual body, they could still live as long as they found another host to possess.
Of course, this would definitely be a serious injury, and there would be no possibility of further improvement in the future.
But now, the most important thing was to stay alive.
Ling Han smiled faintly. He wanted to flee?
Weng, the barrage of murderous aura activated, and the movements of the eight Fifth Elders faltered at the same time, as an expression of pain appeared on their faces.
Ling Han also summoned his spiritual bodies. The six spiritual bodies charged out, channeling Destructive Energy and beginning a massacre.

Pa, pa, pa! One after another, spiritual bodies were instantly destroyed. When Fifth Elder recovered from the barrage of murderous aura, there were already four spiritual bodies that had been destroyed, causing him to pale in shock.
This was too fast, wasn’t it?
However, he didn’t have the time to worry about this, and he and the remaining spiritual bodies hurriedly continued to flee for their lives.
Ling Han did not use the murderous aura to attack again. Instead, three spiritual bodies pursued the three spiritual bodies of Fifth Elder respectively, while he himself pursued Fifth Elder himself.
Fifth Elder brandished the Firebird Staff, struggling at death’s door, but in only a few breaths’ time, he sensed that his spiritual bodies had been destroyed.
Not one, but all the three that had escaped.
If he was also killed, then he would be completely done for.
When he thought of this, Fifth Elder became even crazier.
He did not want to die. He did not want to die at all.
However, this was only his unrealistic fantasy. Ling Han’s every move was swift and fierce. In just a few moves, Fifth Elder was killed with a single punch.
Right at this moment, another spiritual body shot out from Fifth Elder’s body, rushing out in the instant before his mind was destroyed.
As it turned out, Fifth Elder was not a Seventh Change, but rather an Eighth Change!
He had deliberately hidden a spiritual body in order to lull Ling Han into a false sense of security. If Ling Han was caught off guard, he might be able to escape.

“As expected!” Ling Han said with a smile. Eighth Change wasn’t Eight Forms, and those who could reach Eight Forms had to be the Golden Generation or the most outstanding of the Silver Generation. However, in the case of Eight Forms, hehe, one only had to form eight True Selves in the True Self Tier.
As long as one was a prodigy, they would basically be able to achieve this.

Thus, when Ling Han saw that Fifth Elder only had seven spiritual bodies, he had already begun to wonder if the latter had deliberately hidden one or two spiritual bodies. By the looks of it now, that was indeed the case.
Ling Han stretched out a hand, as fast as lightning, and instantly grabbed the last spiritual body of Fifth Elder.
“Don’t kill me!” Fifth Elder begged, “As long as you spare my life, you can do whatever you want.”
“Crimson Ground Fruits, as many as you want!”
Ling Han shook his head, “No need!”
His fingers tightened. Peng! The last spiritual body of Fifth Elder was also forcefully crushed.
“Should I lure out a few more elders to kill?” Ling Han thought for a moment, then shook his head. This was very difficult.
Because only he had returned, yet Fifth Elder had disappeared. Everyone would be suspicious, right?
If that was all, then so be it. Most importantly, there were Saint-level formations in every palace. Ling Han did not dare to enter. If he was targeted, he would die a very tragic death.
“I’d better meet up with Old Black and the others first.”

Ling Han had already discussed this with the large black dog and the others. Thus, he didn’t return to the Flame Skin Race. After collecting all of the treasures from Fifth Elder, he set off to look for the empress and the others.
Very quickly, he found the empress and the others, and the two sides successfully reunited.
He explained what had happened, then took out the Spirit Tool that he had obtained from Fifth Elder. Previously, he had not had the time to examine it.
With this look, he revealed a smile.
There were nineteen Crimson Ground Fruits inside.

Ling Han thought for a moment, then distributed the Crimson Ground Fruits to the empress and the others. It wasn’t that he didn’t need them, but rather firstly, this number was too small, and it wouldn’t increase his cultivation level much. Secondly, the speed of his cultivation level increasing in a short period of time was too fast, so he had to slow it down a bit to avoid spoiling things and damaging his foundations.
“Let’s go find the sixth palace?”
“M-hm.”
Ling Han nodded. Only after opening all the palace halls would the True Phoenix Mystery Realm truly open. Only then would the eight elders of the Flame Skin Race come out of the palace halls.

The empress and the others continued to advance as they ate the Crimson Ground Fruits. Because the medicinal effects of this fruit were relatively weak, they didn’t need to channel the cultivation technique to refine it. Thus, absorbing the medicinal effects as they traveled didn’t affect them at all.
Several days later, they arrived at the fifth palace, but this place had already been visited by Ling Han and the little red bird. Thus, they did not stop here, and continued onwards.
Another four days later, they found the sixth palace.
This was a familiar scene. Many people were standing in the plaza, studying the method to open the palace doors.
Ling Han’s eyes swept over the surroundings, and saw a few familiar faces here, such as Lian Yutang.
“Let’s go.”

Ling Han brought the little red bird with him, and walked over very quietly. He opened the main doors, and then had the little red bird retrieve the key. The whole process took less than five minutes.
Then, he quietly returned, and set out once more with the others, heading towards the seventh palace.

chapters.title: Chapter 4360: Big Loss
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The journey was very smooth. After the seventh palace hall opened, it was the eighth. Then, they arrived at the ninth palace hall.
After opening this palace, according to the words of the Flame Skin Race, the invisible barrier in front of them would disappear, and they would be able to advance into the True Phoenix Palace.
Of course, if one wanted to open the True Phoenix Palace, he still needed to gather all nine keys.
—This was the theory of the Flame Skin Race, but who knew how much of it was true.
Ling Han and the others opened the ninth palace. After opening the doors and obtaining the key, they quickly left, going against the flow of the lava river.
True enough, they did not encounter that invisible barrier again.
Calculating the distance, they should have encountered it long ago, but their path was smooth and unobstructed, which meant that the barrier from before must have disappeared.
The group set out on their journey at full speed. Perhaps, the Flame Skin Race had concealed some important information, so it was best that they were in place to observe the situation first.
Huala, the river of lava surged, seals rising, then rapidly shattering, exuding an indescribable might.

Though Ling Han’s cultivation level had greatly improved, he still did not have the slightest bit of confidence to touch this lava — even if it could not insta-kill him, it would at least cause serious injury.
A thought flashed in his mind. He had already used up his Heavenly Dao Flames, so could he collect some lava?
This might not be as awesome as the Heavenly Dao Flames, but its might was at least on the level of Sect Master, or even more terrifying.
He summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, beginning to collect the lava.
However, it was as if this lava had a life of its own. If one wanted to suck up a little, there would be endless lava pulling at it, not allowing that little bit of separation.
After trying many times, Ling Han didn’t gain anything at all.
“Yi, what is that?” The large black dog pointed ahead.
Everyone looked over, only to see what looked like a floating island floating down from the upper reaches of the lava river.
“Fire turtle!” Yet Ling Han’s eyes lit up. He had seen it before.
“Let’s fight it!” Ling Han rolled up his sleeves. Previously, he was no match for it, but now that he had advanced into Sixth Change, who among Spirit Transformation Tiers could not be touched?
“You guys step back a little, or you’ll be hurt by the lava,” he said to the empress and the others.
The might of this lava was too terrifying. If one was splashed by it, that would definitely not be a joke.
Ling Han charged forwards, his speed increasing, getting closer and closer to that “floating island”.
“Old fire turtle, come, let’s have another battle!” He laughed loudly, and took the initiative to attack, throwing out a punch.
Hua!
The lava broke apart, and a massive turtle emerged. The shell of the turtle was covered with dark red veined patterns.
Yi, there seemed to be something off?
Ling Han thought internally, but he had already shot out a punch, so how could he withdraw it?
The fire turtle seemed to have been angered. It raised a giant foot and stomped down on Ling Han. Hong long long, it was extremely terrifying.
‘Holy f*ck!’
The moment this fire turtle made its move, Ling Han knew what was off.
It was not the same one at all!
This one was larger, and its cultivation level was naturally higher.
Not just a little bit higher, but a whole lot higher!
Sect Master-level.

It should be known that this place restricted the cultivation level of those who entered, and the creatures inside were only Spirit Transformation Tier. It seemed like there was a strange power restriction, and it was impossible for creatures that surpassed Spirit Transformation Tier to appear.
Who would have thought that a living being on the level of Sect Master would suddenly appear?
He understood now. This was the world behind the barrier, so it was completely different.
First impressions killed people!
Ling Han sighed as he hurriedly unleashed his full power.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! The six spiritual bodies all appeared. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower also appeared. The Ice Moon Saber slashed out, and Destructive Energy surged.
He had used all of his trump cards at this moment, such as the barrage of murderous aura, the black light of illusion, and the horn of the Great Emperor.
It couldn’t be helped. Who asked him to launch a charge of death at a creature on the level of Sect Master?
Now, he had to do his best to save his life!
Peng!

The fire turtle stomped down, and Ling Han’s resistance was like a mantis trying to stop a chariot. He couldn’t even withstand a single blow, and without a doubt, he was stomped down, instantly disappearing without a trace.
“Ling Han!” everyone shouted.
What was going on here? Ling Han had charged out so confidently, yet in the end, he had been defeated with a single move?
At this time, the fire turtle also raised its giant foot. Xiu, a figure quickly scuttled out.
It was Ling Han.

However, though he hadn’t been killed by this attack, he still looked extremely miserable. The six spiritual bodies were all extremely dispirited, and the main body was also covered in blood. In fact, even his eerie white bones could be seen. Clearly, he had been severely injured.
However, his life was more important at this moment, so Ling Han immediately started to flee.

Fortunately, they hadn’t come too close before. Now that they saw Ling Han fleeing, how could they hesitate any longer? They immediately turned around and fled as well. However, they maintained a fair distance from Ling Han, lest the fire turtle suddenly turn around to pursue them.

Ling Han continuously blew the horn of the Great Emperor, blocking the fire turtle’s pursuit time and time again. After about an hour, the fire turtle finally stopped its pursuit, turned around and returned.
Pa, Ling Han flopped onto the ground, baring his teeth, feeling extremely terrible.
At this moment, the empress and the others also ran over and stepped forward to ask.

Ling Han was truly severely wounded. Several of his bones were broken, and his internal injuries were quite severe. His spiritual bodies were also greatly damaged. However, he didn’t die in the end, and he wasn’t left with any irrecoverable dao injuries either.
That was good.
Everyone breathed a sigh of relief, and then began to tease him.
“What’s wrong with you?” The large black dog pretended to be curious, and asked, “Weren’t you going to beat the turtle? Why were you almost trampled to death by the turtle?”
The little azure dragon laughed loudly, and said, “This is called being struck by lightning for showing off too much.”
“Hahaha!” Everyone laughed loudly. All of them were delighting at his misfortune, causing Ling Han to feel gloomy. These bad friends!
“I won’t allow you guys to bully Niu’s Ling Han!” Hu Niu placed her hands on her hips, furious.
Ling Han felt greatly gratified. His beautiful wife was still the best.
“Ling Han can only be bullied by Niu alone!” Hu Niu continued.
Ling Han: “...”
Sigh, his image had really been ruined this time.
He had been brilliant and mighty all his life, yet in the end, his reputation was completely ruined just because of an old turtle. How depressing, how very depressing.
“All right, I’ll remember this, you guys,” Ling Han said.
“Hahaha.” Everyone laughed loudly.
Ling Han immediately began to ingest alchemical pills. Then, he channelled the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique. This was Body Arts, which was also extremely helpful in healing injuries.
At this moment, everyone naturally wouldn’t laugh at Ling Han anymore. Instead, they would stand guard nearby for him.
A whole five days passed, and Ling Han had finally recovered more than half, but if he wanted to completely recover, it was impossible without two to three months.

“It’s all right. I can at least battle now,” Ling Han said. Though Ling Han could only unleash 50% of his battle prowess, as long as he did not encounter a Golden Generation like Lian Yutang, the rest were mediocre, and he would be able to sweep aside all opposition.
“Is there really no problem?” the large black dog asked seriously.
“Of course.”
Everyone set out and continued to advance. However, after suffering a loss once, they naturally didn’t dare to approach the lava river again.
He had actively provoked a Sect Master-level existence, yet he had actually not died. This was really good luck, but one could only have so much good luck, so he had best behave himself.

After the seventh palace hall opened, it was the eighth.
Then, they arrived at the ninth palace hall.
After opening this palace, according to the words of the Flame Skin Race, the invisible barrier in front of them would disappear, and they would be able to advance into the True Phoenix Palace.
Of course, if one wanted to open the True Phoenix Palace, he still needed to gather all nine keys.
—This was the theory of the Flame Skin Race, but who knew how much of it was true.
Ling Han and the others opened the ninth palace.
After opening the doors and obtaining the key, they quickly left, going against the flow of the lava river.
True enough, they did not encounter that invisible barrier again.
Calculating the distance, they should have encountered it long ago, but their path was smooth and unobstructed, which meant that the barrier from before must have disappeared.
The group set out on their journey at full speed.
Perhaps, the Flame Skin Race had concealed some important information, so it was best that they were in place to observe the situation first.
Huala, the river of lava surged, seals rising, then rapidly shattering, exuding an indescribable might.

Though Ling Han’s cultivation level had greatly improved, he still did not have the slightest bit of confidence to touch this lava — even if it could not insta-kill him, it would at least cause serious injury.
A thought flashed in his mind.
He had already used up his Heavenly Dao Flames, so could he collect some lava?
This might not be as awesome as the Heavenly Dao Flames, but its might was at least on the level of Sect Master, or even more terrifying.
He summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, beginning to collect the lava.
However, it was as if this lava had a life of its own.
If one wanted to suck up a little, there would be endless lava pulling at it, not allowing that little bit of separation.
After trying many times, Ling Han didn’t gain anything at all.
“Yi, what is that?” The large black dog pointed ahead.
Everyone looked over, only to see what looked like a floating island floating down from the upper reaches of the lava river.
“Fire turtle!” Yet Ling Han’s eyes lit up.
He had seen it before.
“Let’s fight it!” Ling Han rolled up his sleeves.
Previously, he was no match for it, but now that he had advanced into Sixth Change, who among Spirit Transformation Tiers could not be touched?
“You guys step back a little, or you’ll be hurt by the lava,” he said to the empress and the others.
The might of this lava was too terrifying.
If one was splashed by it, that would definitely not be a joke.
Ling Han charged forwards, his speed increasing, getting closer and closer to that “floating island”.
“Old fire turtle, come, let’s have another battle!” He laughed loudly, and took the initiative to attack, throwing out a punch.
Hua!
The lava broke apart, and a massive turtle emerged.
The shell of the turtle was covered with dark red veined patterns.
Yi, there seemed to be something off?
Ling Han thought internally, but he had already shot out a punch, so how could he withdraw it?
The fire turtle seemed to have been angered.
It raised a giant foot and stomped down on Ling Han.
Hong long long, it was extremely terrifying.
‘Holy f*ck!’
The moment this fire turtle made its move, Ling Han knew what was off.
It was not the same one at all!
This one was larger, and its cultivation level was naturally higher.
Not just a little bit higher, but a whole lot higher!
Sect Master-level.
It should be known that this place restricted the cultivation level of those who entered, and the creatures inside were only Spirit Transformation Tier.
It seemed like there was a strange power restriction, and it was impossible for creatures that surpassed Spirit Transformation Tier to appear.
Who would have thought that a living being on the level of Sect Master would suddenly appear?
He understood now.
This was the world behind the barrier, so it was completely different.
First impressions killed people!
Ling Han sighed as he hurriedly unleashed his full power.
Xiu, xiu, xiu!
The six spiritual bodies all appeared.
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower also appeared.
The Ice Moon Saber slashed out, and Destructive Energy surged.
He had used all of his trump cards at this moment, such as the barrage of murderous aura, the black light of illusion, and the horn of the Great Emperor.
It couldn’t be helped.
Who asked him to launch a charge of death at a creature on the level of Sect Master?
Now, he had to do his best to save his life!
Peng!
The fire turtle stomped down, and Ling Han’s resistance was like a mantis trying to stop a chariot.
He couldn’t even withstand a single blow, and without a doubt, he was stomped down, instantly disappearing without a trace.
“Ling Han!” everyone shouted.
What was going on here?
Ling Han had charged out so confidently, yet in the end, he had been defeated with a single move?
At this time, the fire turtle also raised its giant foot.
Xiu, a figure quickly scuttled out.
It was Ling Han.
However, though he hadn’t been killed by this attack, he still looked extremely miserable.
The six spiritual bodies were all extremely dispirited, and the main body was also covered in blood.
In fact, even his eerie white bones could be seen.
Clearly, he had been severely injured.
However, his life was more important at this moment, so Ling Han immediately started to flee.
Fortunately, they hadn’t come too close before.
Now that they saw Ling Han fleeing, how could they hesitate any longer?
They immediately turned around and fled as well.
However, they maintained a fair distance from Ling Han, lest the fire turtle suddenly turn around to pursue them.
Ling Han continuously blew the horn of the Great Emperor, blocking the fire turtle’s pursuit time and time again.
After about an hour, the fire turtle finally stopped its pursuit, turned around and returned.
Pa, Ling Han flopped onto the ground, baring his teeth, feeling extremely terrible.
At this moment, the empress and the others also ran over and stepped forward to ask.
Ling Han was truly severely wounded.
Several of his bones were broken, and his internal injuries were quite severe.
His spiritual bodies were also greatly damaged.
However, he didn’t die in the end, and he wasn’t left with any irrecoverable dao injuries either.
That was good.
Everyone breathed a sigh of relief, and then began to tease him.
“What’s wrong with you?” The large black dog pretended to be curious, and asked, “Weren’t you going to beat the turtle?
Why were you almost trampled to death by the turtle?”
The little azure dragon laughed loudly, and said, “This is called being struck by lightning for showing off too much.”
“Hahaha!” Everyone laughed loudly.
All of them were delighting at his misfortune, causing Ling Han to feel gloomy.
These bad friends!
“I won’t allow you guys to bully Niu’s Ling Han!” Hu Niu placed her hands on her hips, furious.
Ling Han felt greatly gratified.
His beautiful wife was still the best.
“Ling Han can only be bullied by Niu alone!” Hu Niu continued.
Ling Han: “...”
Sigh, his image had really been ruined this time.
He had been brilliant and mighty all his life, yet in the end, his reputation was completely ruined just because of an old turtle.
How depressing, how very depressing.
“All right, I’ll remember this, you guys,” Ling Han said.
“Hahaha.” Everyone laughed loudly.
Ling Han immediately began to ingest alchemical pills.
Then, he channelled the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique.
This was Body Arts, which was also extremely helpful in healing injuries.
At this moment, everyone naturally wouldn’t laugh at Ling Han anymore.
Instead, they would stand guard nearby for him.
A whole five days passed, and Ling Han had finally recovered more than half, but if he wanted to completely recover, it was impossible without two to three months.
“It’s all right.
I can at least battle now,” Ling Han said.

Though Ling Han could only unleash 50% of his battle prowess, as long as he did not encounter a Golden Generation like Lian Yutang, the rest were mediocre, and he would be able to sweep aside all opposition.
“Is there really no problem?” the large black dog asked seriously.
“Of course.”
Everyone set out and continued to advance.
However, after suffering a loss once, they naturally didn’t dare to approach the lava river again.
He had actively provoked a Sect Master-level existence, yet he had actually not died.
This was really good luck, but one could only have so much good luck, so he had best behave himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 4361: Kidnap?
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
If they didn’t walk along the river, they would definitely have to enter the primitive forest.

Actually, this place was not necessarily safe either. Multiple great trees rose from the ground, their leaves like fire, and there were firebirds perched on them. The slightest movement would alert them, and they would pounce over in large groups.

The battle prowess of the firebird itself was not strong, but after it was killed, it would self-explode. That was no joke. Probably, even great Sect Master elites would have to avoid it, and would rather encounter the great fire turtle.
Ling Han and the others were all cautious, not wanting to alert these firebirds in the slightest.
They continued to advance, and after a few days, they discovered that the firebirds had disappeared.
The trees were still the same trees, but the firebirds were gone.
At first, they did not dare to be careless, but as they walked, they discovered that the firebirds had really all disappeared.
However, Ling Han frowned upon seeing this.
“Little Han, why do you look so distressed?” the large black dog asked with a smile.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “The firebirds have disappeared, so it’s extremely likely that there’s an even more terrifying existence here.”
“Hey, don’t scare me!” The large black dog shuddered.
The perverted pig squeaked even louder, meaning that if he had known this earlier, Grandpa Pig should have stayed in the academy to court girls, b@stard.
“Didn’t you already know how to talk? Why are you pretending to be mute?!” The large black dog kicked him.
“Be careful, I am not mistaken,” Ling Han said solemnly.
Thinking about Ling Han’s words, they did indeed make sense. Furthermore, there was nothing wrong with being careful. It was ultimately better than regretting if something happened.
After walking for a while, Ling Han heard the rustling of tree leaves.
He stretched out a hand and pressed down, indicating for everyone to stop.
“What did you discover?” Chi Menghan asked.
Ling Han looked upwards, “There seems to be something up there.”
“What is it?” Hu Niu was curious, “Can it be eaten?”
Ling Han activated his eye technique, allowing his vision to see through the leaves. After a thorough search, he revealed an astounded expression.
“Monkey,” he said.
Monkey?
Everyone looked at each other. Would monkeys be very scary?

Right at this moment, sha, sha, the sound of leaves rubbing against each other was even louder. Then, a monkey’s head stretched out. It was small, only the size of a fist. Its fur was as red as fire, and the color of its eyes was similar. They were looking this way and that quickly, and it appeared extremely lively.
Because of Brother Monkey, Ling Han had an automatic favorable impression of monkeys. Hence, he broke into a smile and waved at the little monkey.
The little monkey imitated him and waved its hand at Ling Han.
“Little monkey, this is for you.” Hu Niu took out a chicken drumstick, and pa, threw it at the little monkey.

However, the little monkey didn’t take the chicken drumstick. Instead, it seemed to have been angered. It hugged the branch and began to shake it. Hua, hua, hua! The fiery red leaves instantly fell like rain.
These were no ordinary leaves, but rather burning flames!
Ling Han hurriedly spread out the Starlight Screen, protecting everyone within.
The leaves fell, hong, hong, hong. The Starlight Screen continued to explode with light, and there were even signs of melting.
What a terrifying melting power!
Hua, hua, hua! The little monkey was still shaking, and more leaves fell.
‘F*ck! Are you done yet?’
Ling Han immediately shot out a murderous aura attack. Weng, the little monkey’s movements suddenly stopped, and it directly fell down from the tree.
Hu Niu’s eyes were sharp and her hands were quick. With a scoop, she had already grabbed the little monkey.
“Hehe, fun,” she said with a smile, her eyes crinkling into crescent moons.

“It’s truly dangerous here,” Chi Menghan said with emotion. This monkey was only at the Core Formation Tier, yet it could pose a great threat to them. If they were careless, they might even be wounded by it.
Sha, sha, sha! The sound of tree leaves rubbing against each other rang out again, causing everyone to tense.
“Not good!” Ling Han’s gaze swept over, and couldn’t help but pale in shock. “A group of monkeys has come!”
This monkey’s individual battle prowess was not strong, but just like how the firebird would self-explode, when the monkey shook the leaves, it could also pose a great threat.
With a thought from Ling Han, he used his palm like a saber, and delivered a slash at the large tree beside him.
A terrifying power swept past, and the great tree was instantly severed in half, collapsing with a loud rumble.
When everyone saw this, they immediately understood, and began to make a move on the large tree beside them.
After a few times, the nearby trees had all fallen, clearing out a large area of empty land.
In this way, the monkeys would not be able to shake off the tree leaves to attack them.
On the surrounding trees, monkeys crouched on the branches, all of them squeaking at Ling Han and the others, baring their fangs, looking extremely unfriendly.
These monkeys were probably also very depressed. They hadn’t even launched an attack, and their offensive weapon was already gone.
These monkeys were slightly bigger, and with the comparison, it was clear that the little monkey just now was really a little guy. It was a baby monkey.
No wonder the monkey army was alerted.
“Why don’t we return the little monkey to them?” the little red bird suggested.
Hu Niu instantly hugged the little monkey tightly, “No, Niu wants to play!”
“Zhi!” The little monkey was originally in a coma, but after being strangled too tightly by her, it instantly woke up. It stuck out its tongue, looking like it was about to die.
This enraged the monkeys, and they all shook their branches, releasing squeaking sounds.
The sky was filled with fiery red leaves, balls of blazing flames. Though they were incredibly dangerous, they also had an indescribable beauty to them.

Fortunately, Ling Han and the others had already cleared the nearby fire trees in advance. Although the range of these flaming leaves was very large, there were only a limited number of them that could approach Ling Han and the others, so dealing with them was easy.
Xiu, at this moment, a monkey leaped down from the tree. One front paw gripped tightly, while the other three paws supported themselves on the ground, as it walked towards Ling Han and the others.
This monkey was clearly larger than the other monkeys, exuding the aura of a Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator. Moreover, it was an extremely powerful one at that.
It was probably at the level of Ninth Change.
Monkey King?
This giant monkey stopped in front of Ling Han and the others. Then, it spread open its tightly clenched claw, and in its palm, there was actually a light yellow fruit.
Yi, as expected of a monkey. Even if it was a ferocious beast, it actually knew how to negotiate.
His meaning was very clear. He wanted to use the fruit to exchange for the little monkey.
Ling Han hadn’t planned to kidnap him in the first place. Thus, he smiled at Hu Niu and said, “Niu, return the little monkey to him.”
“No, Niu wants to play!” Hu Niu couldn’t bear to. The little monkey was so cute.
“Be good,” Ling Han advised.
Hu Niu pouted, then her eyes lit up, “Unless you agree to have another child with Niu.”
Pu!
The large black dog and little azure dragon both spluttered in laughter. Meanwhile, Chi Menghan covered her beautiful face, feeling a little embarrassed.
This was Hu Niu, doing whatever she liked, upright and frank from the start.
Ling Han couldn’t help but smile. “Alright.”
Hearing Ling Han agree, Hu Niu finally revealed a happy smile, and tossed the little monkey over to Ling Han.
Ling Han walked forwards, and completed the transaction with the Monkey King. Er, one handed over the monkey, and one handed over the fruit.
The Monkey King immediately brought the little monkey back. After climbing onto a tree, a female monkey came over and carried the little monkey away.
However, the monkeys didn’t retreat. Instead, they stared at Ling Han and the others, revealing their ferocious nature.
C

chapters.title: Chapter 4362: Killing a bird
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The matter was not so easily resolved.
By the looks of it, now that the problem of the hostage was resolved, the monkeys were about to launch a revengeful offensive.
However, the nearby fire trees had already been cleared, and there were no weapons that could be used for attack. Thus, these monkeys only glared at them angrily, but did not immediately attack.
It was also because of this that Ling Han didn’t pay much attention to them. He simply looked at the fruit in his hand.

“Luan Xing, here.” He stuffed the fruit into the empress’ hands. Because this was a Four Star Celestial medicine, it could benefit a True Self Tier, but the effects would be much worse for a Spiritual Transformation Tier.
Hence, to make the most of it, it must be given to the empress or Hu Niu.
“Since these monkeys can bring a celestial fruit, I believe that they can bring a second and third celestial fruit.” Ling Han’s eyes shone, “Who knows, there may even be Five Star celestial fruits!”
If it was five stars, then he, the large black dog, Chi Menghan and the others would be able to consume it.
He strode forward, planning to rob a few more “monkeys”.

The large black dog and little azure dragon followed. The perverted pig naturally wouldn’t do anything dangerous even if he was beaten to death. Meanwhile, Chi Menghan stayed behind to guard the main camp, preventing the monkeys from turning the tables and taking a hostage themselves.
Ling Han had already walked to the tree. At this moment, with a command from the Monkey King, the monkeys in the vicinity immediately began to shake their branches.
The fiery leaves fell, and it was as if the whole world were on fire.
Ling Han smiled faintly as he unleashed his murderous aura into the sky.
Pa, pa, pa! Like raindrops, the monkeys instantly fell from the trees.
Most of these monkeys were at the True Self Tier, so how could they possibly block the murderous aura’s attack? Upon contact, they naturally fell unconscious.
This time, the monkeys were dumbfounded.
Er, just now, only one of his companions had fallen into Ling Han’s hands, but now, there were as many as... ithey could not be counted on one hand.
Ling Han returned with his “trophies”, then crooked a finger at the Monkey King.
‘Come, go and get some fruits to trade.’
If the fierce beasts he was facing were like the firebirds, they would definitely not know what he meant, but monkeys were different. They were very smart.
The Monkey King let out a sharp cry, and instantly, all the monkeys retreated one after another like birds startled by a bowstring.
It could be clearly seen that there was a commotion on the treetops, which was rapidly disappearing into the distance.
Like the firebirds, these monkeys were naturally immune to fire attacks.
Not long after, the monkeys had already returned.
This time, not only did the Monkey King land, but there were also seven giant monkeys following behind it. All of them were walking on three paws.
Coming close, the monkeys spread out their tightly clenched claws one after another. As expected, there was a fruit in every claw.

After completing the transaction again, Ling Han was very satisfied. Though the fruits he had traded were still only Four Star-level, it was still profitable to gain something without risking anything.
This time, after returning the “monkey hostages”, the monkeys no longer wanted to take revenge. With a whistle, they left one after another.
They couldn’t afford another loss.
Ling Han chuckled, and said, “This kind of monkey is indeed cute, so there’s no harm in giving me more.”
Everyone laughed as well. This time, it was a close call, and they had even earned a few Four Star celestial fruits.
They advanced very carefully, because the monkeys lived on the trees. If they were deliberately lying in ambush, it was really possible that they would catch them off guard.
After walking for a while, they heard a sharp whistle. A black dot appeared in the skies, and was presently moving rapidly.
Very quickly, the black dot enlarged. It was actually a giant bird with fiery red feathers. Its tail was extraordinarily long, and was at least four times the length of its body.
This giant bird descended rapidly, then stretched out its claws, and suddenly stopped on the tree trunk.

After the fiery tree trembled violently, a monkey appeared in the giant bird’s claws. It screamed a few times, and its body was pierced through by claws like Divine Metal. Its limbs instantly drooped.

All around them, the monkeys were in an uproar, screaming endlessly. However, the giant bird raised its head, looked around for a while, then lowered its head and used its sharp beak to tear open the monkey’s body, beginning to eat.
“Monkeys are so cute, why do you have to eat them!” Hu Niu called out from below.
Ling Han sighed. This girl was the least qualified to say such words. Along the way, who knew how many types of vicious beasts had been eaten by this little girl.
Now, it was rare for her to find a conscience.

Although the monkeys were furious, it was meaningless for them to charge forward to fight, whether it was because they were afraid of the giant bird or because their companion was already dead. Thus, they only let out sharp cries, but not one of them rushed over to fight.
“Ling Han, Niu wants to eat bird meat!” Hu Niu said as she pointed at the large bird, drooling. In the next instant, she returned to her gluttonous nature.
“All right.” Ling Han nodded. Relatively speaking, he was definitely more inclined towards the monkeys, even if the monkeys had made a move on him previously.
He leaped up, and xiu, he had already arrived at the top of the tree.
The giant bird stopped for a moment, and glanced at him. Then, it ignored him and began to eat on its own.
“Big bird... ptui!” Ling Han felt that this name was a little dirty, so he simply didn’t say anything else, and directly rushed up to make a move.
The giant bird stopped eating, opened its mouth, and hong, a flame shot out, turning into a spirit snake that pounced towards Ling Han.
Ling Han didn’t stop. Starlight Screen spread out. Peng, the flames hit him, yet they spread out in all directions, unable to wound him in the slightest.
In an instant, he had arrived in front of the giant bird, and brandished his fist in a punch.
They were both in the Spiritual Transformation Tier, so Ling Han was naturally unafraid of any opponent.
The large bird seemed to be shocked. Its attack was actually ineffective?
This time, it didn’t spit fire anymore. Instead, it directly pecked at Ling Han’s fist.
Spirit Transformation Tier vicious beasts didn’t have spiritual bodies, but in comparison, their own attacks were extremely powerful.
The sharpness of its beak was completely not inferior to a Celestial Tool of the same level!
“Heh, let’s compete.” Ling Han naturally wouldn’t cower, and he faced it head-on.
Peng!
The beak of the bird landed on the fist, and a blazing light exploded. Then, the giant bird was sent flying. Its beak was crooked, and blood was gushing out.
Ling Han smiled faintly. Though he had not recovered yet, and could only unleash half of his battle prowess, suppressing this giant bird was a piece of cake for him.
The large bird was shocked, and hurriedly flapped its wings. It did not even want its food anymore, and only wanted to leave this place.

However, the nearby fire trees had already been cleared, and there were no weapons that could be used for attack.
Thus, these monkeys only glared at them angrily, but did not immediately attack.
It was also because of this that Ling Han didn’t pay much attention to them.
He simply looked at the fruit in his hand.
“Luan Xing, here.” He stuffed the fruit into the empress’ hands.
Because this was a Four Star Celestial medicine, it could benefit a True Self Tier, but the effects would be much worse for a Spiritual Transformation Tier.
Hence, to make the most of it, it must be given to the empress or Hu Niu.
“Since these monkeys can bring a celestial fruit, I believe that they can bring a second and third celestial fruit.” Ling Han’s eyes shone, “Who knows, there may even be Five Star celestial fruits!”
If it was five stars, then he, the large black dog, Chi Menghan and the others would be able to consume it.
He strode forward, planning to rob a few more “monkeys”.
The large black dog and little azure dragon followed.

Ling Han smiled faintly as he unleashed his murderous aura into the sky.
Pa, pa, pa!
Like raindrops, the monkeys instantly fell from the trees.
Most of these monkeys were at the True Self Tier, so how could they possibly block the murderous aura’s attack?
Upon contact, they naturally fell unconscious.

Er, just now, only one of his companions had fallen into Ling Han’s hands, but now, there were as many as... ithey could not be counted on one hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 4363: Strange Pearl
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The monkeys had come again. Furthermore, the majority of them had brought celestial fruits.
Oh, he had wronged them.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t be reserved. He accepted all of them, and took all of the celestial fruits.
The monkeys thanked him again before leaving.
“Sigh, even fierce beasts know how to repay kindness better than some that have developed intelligence,” Ling Han said, sweeping an eye over the perverted pig.
The perverted pig humphed. So what if I am lazy and gluttonous? In the past, you have used me quite a few times like a shield, and I have yet to call you to account, b@stard.

There were indeed a lot of celestial fruits this time. Though most of them were Four Star celestial fruits, there were still three that were Five Stars. Their effects were about the same as Crimson Ground Fruit, and Ling Han distributed them to Chi Menghan, the large black dog, and the others.
As the main force, he had already matured, and he was now able to arm others.
He was responsible for cooking. There was a lot of bird meat. One portion was used to make soup, while another was used for barbeque. There was still a lot left over.
When the meat was ready, the monkeys also ate happily.
This was their mortal enemy, and who knew how many of their companions he had eaten. Now that they were eating bird meat, they were naturally venting his anger.

After eating and drinking to their heart’s content, Ling Han and the others continued on their way. Meanwhile, the monkeys escorted them off from the trees. After escorting them out for 50km, they let out another sharp cry and turned around to return.
Ahead of them was no longer their territory, but belonged to another group of monkeys.

Ling Han and the others were relatively low-key, and after walking for another dozen over days, they finally walked out of this massive forest. A lake appeared ahead of them. The lake waters were dark green, and calm and without ripples, like a piece of agate.
This surprised everyone. There were flames everywhere in this place, and even the flowing river was filled with lava. Now, a lake had actually appeared. How could this not be strange?
“Is it really a lake, and not a massive agate?”
They walked forwards, and arrived at the banks of the lake. True enough, this was really a lake.

They hadn’t seen water for so many days, and the appearance of the lake energized them. They all took off their shoes and placed their feet in the lake. A coldness assaulted them, and they felt indescribably comfortable.
As their feet moved, the lake water also rippled, spreading into the distance. Clear layers could be seen.

“Hopefully, there won’t be any monsters in the water.” The little red bird didn’t go into the water. She was completely fire-element, and bathing in the flames was the most comfortable thing for her. For her to go into the water?
Hehe.

Boom, a loud bang rang out, and the surface of the lake split open. A colossal lobster floated up, its body as long as three hundred meters, and its two massive pincers were also three hundred meters long. It was completely dark green in colour, the same colour as the lake.
“You jinx!” Ling Han slanted a look at her.
The little red bird was dumbfounded. She had only spoken casually, and had not thought that a ferocious beast would actually appear. Was this going to confirm her identity as a bringer of misfortune?
“Haha, there’s lobster to eat again!” Hu Niu’s reaction was the complete opposite, as she began to drool.
“Charge!” Chi Menghan, the large black dog, and the little azure dragon charged out to battle the giant lobster.

Though this giant lobster was also a Spiritual Transformation Tier, it had reached Seventh Change or Eighth Change, so its battle prowess was quite astonishing. Chi Menghan, the large black dog, and the little azure dragon were only barely able to match it when they joined forces.
That was because Ling Han did not make a move. He couldn’t possibly be the one to take care of everything, right?
He was not a babysitter, and everyone would have to stand alone in future.

Under their combined attacks, the giant lobster was still unable to escape death. Its mind was shattered, and just as its massive body was about to sink, the large black dog and little azure dragon dragged it onto the shore.
“Why is there a lake in this place?” Everyone was curious.
This place was extraordinarily hot, and the plants that grew here were all fire trees. The river was also surging with lava, and a real lake had suddenly appeared here. This was too strange.
“Could it be that there is some kind of treasure underground that is incredibly cold?”
“Let’s go down and take a look.”
The True Self Tier cultivators were responsible for cooking, while the others all jumped into the lake and searched everywhere.
The lake water was warm, with a slight chill. In such a hot environment, it could be said to be very comfortable.
The visibility of the lake was very high, and added with the fact that everyone was in the Spiritual Transformation Tier, they could naturally see further.
Ling Han activated his eye technique, allowing him to see through the ground layer and search at a deeper level.
The lake was huge, so the speed of searching was naturally a little slow. Two days later, Ling Han suddenly made a discovery.
He arrived at the bottom of the lake, then dived downwards.
Not long after, he surfaced, and a jade bead appeared in his hand. It was only the size of a longan, exuding a cool feeling.
When he returned to the shore, a change immediately took place.

The entire lake began to boil, with steam rising from it. Furthermore, the water level was also rapidly falling. Going by the look of things, in less than a day, the whole lake would be completely evaporated.
All this was because of this pearl?
Ling Han was surprised. This bead seemed to be very ordinary, and it wasn’t extremely cold either. It was just very cool, so how could it form such a large lake?
“What’s going on?”
“Why is the lake water starting to evaporate?”
Chi Menghan and the others all returned to the shore, extremely confused.
Ling Han spread open his palm, and said, “Here, it’s because of this thing.”
Everyone took it over, and looked at it, but they did not discover anything amazing.
After a round, the bead returned to Ling Han’s hand.
“Forget about it for now. Let’s continue on our way.”
Xiu!
They were just about to set out, when they saw a figure sweep past, and then descend from the skies.
Lian Yutang.
“Yo, Cousin Lian,” the large black dog immediately said.
“Hello, cousin.” The little azure dragon was also very polite.
“Hello, cousin.” The pervert pig also joined in on the excitement.
Lian Yutang’s expression instantly darkened. To be addressed as cousin by a dog, a snake, and a pig, how could he accept this?
‘You people must have done this on purpose.’
“Cousin, I’ve been looking everywhere for you,” he forced out a smile and said to Chi Menghan.
Chi Menghan merely smiled faintly, “When I left, Cousin wasn’t here, and I was in a rush, so I had no choice but to leave without saying goodbye.”
It was inevitable that Lian Yutang would suffer another blow. He paused for a moment, then said, “All right. Now that we’ve met, come with me.”
“There’s no need for Cousin to worry. I can take care of myself,” Chi Menghan refused.
“It’s too dangerous here, so it’s better for me to protect you,” Lian Yutang emphasized.

Ling Han couldn’t bear it any longer, and interrupted, “You’re really quite shameless. She already said she didn’t want to, so why are you still blabbering? Do you think you can definitely succeed just by pestering her? Heh, I really don’t know what third-grade novel you’ve read.”
Lian Yutang was already filled with anger after being rejected by Chi Menghan. Now that Ling Han was mocking him, he naturally couldn’t control his anger any longer.
“You’re seeking death!” He no longer had any reservations, and stretched out a hand to grab Ling Han.
Previously, he had been tolerant because he wanted to maintain his demeanor in front of Chi Menghan. Now, however, he couldn’t hold back any longer.
Kill, kill this damn guy.
He smirked coldly. With his own strength, wouldn’t it be a piece of cake for him to kill Ling Han?
Boom!

chapters.title: Chapter 4364: Reversal
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han approached.
Peng!
In this exchange of blows, Ling Han’s body involuntarily trembled, and he stumbled backwards.
It couldn’t be helped. His injuries hadn’t healed completely, so he could only unleash half of his battle prowess. It was normal that he was no match for Lian Yutang.

Lian Yutang, meanwhile, looked surprised. Previously, when he had been battling with Ling Han, he had possessed a crushing advantage, but now, he had actually only managed to force Ling Han to retreat?
This was inconceivable.
How terrifying had this guy’s cultivation level increased in a short few months’ time?
A sliver of regret flashed through his mind. If he had known this would happen, he wouldn’t have cared about Chi Menghan at all. He would have killed this freak no matter what.
Thankfully, it was not too late now. He was still on the upper hand.
‘Die!’
Hong, killing intent boiled within his body, and there was a seven-coloured brilliance flickering.
Ling Han swept an eye over it with his eye technique, and nodded internally. This was not Lian Yutang’s true body, but rather a spiritual body.
True, he was presently searching for Chi Menghan. He must have projected his spiritual bodies to increase the efficiency of his search.

But even if it was only a spiritual body, Lian Yutang’s battle prowess was still incredibly terrifying. Though he was a seven-coloured spiritual body, when he was in the True Self Tier, he had cultivated to Eight Forms, so the spiritual body he formed was naturally of extremely high quality.
The spiritual body and the main body were practically equal in battle prowess. Thus, Lian Yutang was so confident that he could kill Ling Han.
“Cousin, stop!” Chi Menghan hurriedly shouted. She was naturally on Ling Han’s side.
How could Lian Yutang possibly reply? Ling Han gave him a strong feeling of pressure and threat, so he definitely had to kill Ling Han.
If he didn’t kill him now, there would be endless trouble in the future.
“An ant is an ant after all,” Lian Yutang said disdainfully. “What Imperial Son Killer? Humph, in front of a true Imperial Son, what are you worth?”
Seeing Lian Yutang act so arrogantly, everyone was indignant.
“What’s so great about bullying others with your high cultivation level?”
“I really don’t know where this feeling of superiority comes from.”
“Golden Generation? More like a generation of eating sh*t.”
The little azure dragon and the large black dog exchanged a few words. If they were talking about bickering, who would they be afraid of?

This caused Lian Yutang’s expression to turn livid, but this was indeed the truth. Though the two of them were both Spirit Transformation Tier, one of them was Spirit Transformation Tier Ninth Change, and the other?

In the first place, the Golden Generation should be able to defeat those at a higher cultivation level. Now, the cultivation level of the Golden Generation elite was clearly at an advantage, but in terms of battle prowess, the Golden Generation elite was only barely on the upper hand. This was indeed embarrassing.
He simply chose not to speak any further, and merely used the Imperial Technique, wanting to kill Ling Han.
No matter what, he had to kill Ling Han’s main body, so that he would hurt his dao foundations.
After Ling Han exchanged a few blows, he felt that his internal injuries were showing signs of worsening.

He had also battled before, but his opponents were too weak. He had practically insta-killed all of them, so he was naturally unconcerned. However, it was different now. His opponent’s battle prowess was even slightly stronger than his, so he was naturally under great pressure.
He couldn’t continue playing like this.
Using his spiritual body?
He only had to summon one spiritual body, and it would be a two-on-one battle. If all six of them were summoned, it would be a seven-on-one battle. He didn’t believe that he couldn’t defeat this guy.
Or?
With a thought from Ling Han, the murderous aura activated.
“Wu!” Lian Yutang’s expression immediately became twisted. In fact, even his body started to undulate like water.
As expected.
Ling Han smiled internally. At present, Lian Yutang was only a spiritual body, and would a spiritual body still have the precious tool of a Great Emperor to resist soul-level attacks?
How could there be so many rare treasures!
Thus, the moment he used the murderous aura to attack, he immediately succeeded.

Lian Yutang was a Golden Generation after all, and he recovered in an instant. However, how could a battle between elites afford such a mistake? The power of his attack was instantly weakened by a significant amount.
“You...” There was a hint of surprise in his eyes as he looked at Ling Han. Ling Han had actually mastered the technique of spiritual attack?
More importantly, he was actually affected!

It should be known that the spiritual body was with the True Self as the bones, and his True Self had undergone eight evolutions, so how tough was it? It could be said that the spiritual body’s resistance against spiritual attacks was far stronger than the main body.
However, he had still been hit.
Just how terrifying was this guy’s secret spiritual attack technique?
“Damn it!” he cursed lowly, and charged over again. Endless Regulations surged, their might shocking the heavens.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and shot out another murderous aura attack. Weng, Lian Yutang was hit again. His body trembled like water, almost about to collapse.

chapters.title: Chapter 4365: Amazing Use of the Bead
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han activated the Great Emperor Horn. Weng, a soundless wave rippled out, blasting towards Lian Yutang.
“Ao!” Lian Yutang immediately began to howl like a wolf, completely unable to control himself.
Ling Han caught up to him, and shot out a punch with his right fist.
Die!
Destructive Energy surged, and even Lian Yutang was instantly severely injured. He opened his mouth and spat out a mouthful of blood, which immediately turned into pure energy that dissipated.
The spiritual body wasn’t made of flesh and blood, so the blood he spat out was actually his spiritual power.
Ling Han continued to attack, and under the endless barrage of blows, Lian Yutang was finally unable to hold on any longer. This spiritual body was forcefully destroyed.
“This enmity... is huge!” Chi Menghan said solemnly.
One could imagine how furious Lian Yutang would be after having one of his spiritual bodies destroyed. He would definitely fight Ling Han to the death.
Ling Han smiled calmly and said, “Even if I don’t destroy his spiritual body, he won’t be polite to me either. So, why hold back?”

Everyone nodded. Lian Yutang had obviously realized how freakish Ling Han was. Next, he would definitely kill Ling Han at all costs. Thus, it was naturally fine for Ling Han to destroy a spiritual body of his first. Furthermore, it could weaken Lian Yutang’s strength.
“Let’s go.”
If he continued to stay here, Lian Yutang’s main body would probably charge over.
If Ling Han hadn’t been injured, he would naturally be unafraid. Now, however, it was best for him to avoid this battle for the moment. Once his wounds healed, who would he need to fear?
Everyone left, while Ling Han played with that pearl.
What in the world was this?
He tried to inject mystical power into it. Weng, the bead instantly lit up, forming a ball that wrapped around him. It was clear and cool, and very comfortable.
It should be known that because of this bead, a large lake had been formed in this perilous land.
With a thought, Ling Han leaned towards the lava river.
In the end... he didn’t feel any heat at all.
This emboldened him, and he reached a hand into the lava river.
He was still unaffected.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and his whole person jumped in.
This gave the empress and the others a scare, but when they saw that the orb of light formed by the bead had not broken through, they were relieved.
Ling Han swam freely in the lava river, as if this was an ordinary river.
Very quickly, he leaped out.
“This bead is too awesome!” the large black dog said. He took the bead, and after activating it, he proudly said to the little dragon, “Come, beat Grandpa Dog.”
The little azure dragon raised its paw and swatted at the orb of light. Peng! The orb of light instantly shattered, and the large black dog was also sent flying.
Pu!
The large black dog vomited blood, and he was also dumbfounded.
What was going on?
This shield of light managed to block even the terrifying might of the lava, yet was unable to block a casual attack from the little azure dragon?
Ling Han also gave it a try, and discovered that it really was so.
The light shield formed by this bead could resist the waves of heat, but it was completely ineffective against attacks that were launched.
“Could it be that it can only resist natural threats?” Ling Han guessed.
For example, the waves of heat and cold that were naturally formed by heaven and earth. However, as long as an external force was added in, the defensive shield would be ineffective.
“Even so, this is already good enough.” Everyone nodded. If it could block all attacks, how amazing would it be?
They went up the river, believing that the True Phoenix Palace was at the end of the lava river.
A day later.
Xiu, a figure streaked through the air.
Ling Han’s eyes swept over, and he said, “Lian Yutang is about to arrive.”
“Was that one of his spiritual bodies just now?” the empress asked.
Ling Han nodded. Though it was only an instant, he had activated his eye technique and seen it clearly.
“Then what do we do?” Chi Menghan was a little nervous. Ling Han’s injuries hadn’t recovered yet, so if they started fighting, he would definitely be at a disadvantage.
“It’s fine,” Ling Han said with a smile. “I have this thing now. If I can’t beat him, I’ll just run. I really want to see if he dares to chase me into the lava.” He tossed the bead in his hand.
Everyone nodded. Once this powerful move was unleashed, it was guaranteed that even Lian Yutang would not dare to face it head-on.
And as long as Ling Han recovered from his injuries, what would he have to fear from Lian Yutang?
In just a short while, xiu, another figure streaked past in the skies, and then swooped downwards.
It was Lian Yutang!
Without another word, he directly used the Imperial Technique, which blasted towards Ling Han.
Ling Han let out a battle cry, and charged forwards.
The two of them battled fiercely. In just a few moves, they had both used powerful moves.
Lian Yutang’s eight spiritual bodies all shot out, launching a bombardment of attacks at Ling Han.

Ling Han also summoned his six spiritual bodies. However, even when he was at his best condition, his abilities were only on par with Lian Yutang. Now that he was severely wounded, not only was he affected, but even his spiritual bodies were affected.
This caused him to be at a complete disadvantage.
He unleashed a murderous aura attack, but this time, it was completely ineffective.
“Humph!” Lian Yutang sneered, “The Great Emperor Spirit Tool on me can also protect my spiritual bodies. However, it was too far last time, so I fell into your trap.”
Oh, so that was the case.
“Ling Han, I will send you on your way to the afterlife today!” Lian Yutang said harshly, “To dare damage one of my spiritual bodies, I will grind your bones into dust!”

This would directly affect his battle prowess after he became a Sect Master, and would be a destructive blow to his future attempt to break through to Emperor Tier. He would have to re-cultivate True Self Tier again. Not only would that need a great amount of time, he might not even be able to succeed.
“Die! Die! Die!” He was incredibly furious.

Ling Han didn’t try to be brave. Instead, he turned around to flee. He had already reached an agreement with the empress and the others. They didn’t need to worry about him, and they could directly meet up at the True Phoenix Palace.
“Where do you think you’re going!” Lian Yutang immediately set off in pursuit. His hatred for Ling Han was bone-deep, and had completely surpassed his desire for Chi Menghan.

The movement technique he cultivated was Emperor Tier-level. Especially after advancing into Spiritual Transformation Tier, the gap between Emperor Tier-level and Saint Tier-level cultivation technique further widened, and in a few steps, he caught up to Ling Han.
Ling Han could only turn around to face this attack. Boom, boom, boom! After exchanging a few blows, he turned around to flee again.
Lian Yutang chased after him, catching up with him in a few steps, and another battle ensued.
One ran, while the other pursued, repeating the process endlessly.

“Ling Han, even if you flee to the ends of the world, I will not let you go,” Lian Yutang said. “So, you had best resign yourself to your fate. Let us have a vigorous battle, so that you can die with more dignity.”
“Alright, let’s have a battle here. Let’s see if you dare!” Ling Han laughed loudly, and with a leap, tong, he had leaped into the lava river.
F***, what was going on?
Lian Yutang faltered for a moment before immediately stopping in his tracks.
He had not lost his reason, and would leap into the river with him. That would be courting death.
As he saw it, though Ling Han was in an extremely poor situation, it was not to the extent that he would jump into the river and commit suicide.
However, he had seen Ling Han jump into the river with his own eyes. Furthermore, that was definitely not a spiritual body.
Thus, Ling Han was definitely going to die. There was no doubt about this.
He couldn’t figure it out, but it didn’t matter. It was fine as long as Ling Han died.
Lian Yutang glared hatefully at the river. It was a pity that he hadn’t been able to kill Ling Han with his own hands.
“I definitely have to obtain the inheritance of the True Phoenix!” he muttered. “Perhaps it can heal my Dao injury. Otherwise, I would definitely have no chance of becoming the Emperor.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4366: True Phoenix Palace
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Lian Yutang left very quickly.
After a long time, further down the lava river, Ling Han floated out of the boiling lava.
Of course, there was a shield of light around him, blocking the lava from his body.
With a light leap, he had already arrived on the bank.
“Hehe, the next time you see me, you’ll probably be shocked,” Ling Han murmured to himself. “Not only will a ‘dead’ person come back to life, but my battle prowess will also give you a scare.”
He continued to advance, worried that Lian Yutang would cause harm to them if he caught up to the empress and the others.
However, he was sure that with the large black dog’s experience, he would definitely find a place to hide. He would rather take a detour than follow the lava river.
Ling Han, on the other hand, went against the flow of the river. He had to save time, so he could reach the True Phoenix Palace as soon as possible.
This trip was a long one.
After a whole 39 days, Ling Han finally saw the end of the lava river.
Gazing into the distance, he could see that nine surging rivers of lava were all converging at one place, and the source of this was a massive palace in the shape of a phoenix.

This palace had been built in the shape of a phoenix that spread its wings and flew high. Not only was it lifelike, there was also a powerful pressure that made people want to kneel down and worship it.
The True Phoenix Palace.

When he got closer, he could see that there was also a massive plaza in front of the True Phoenix Palace. A great many people were standing there, and because the doors to the palace were not open, they could only wait here.

At this moment, Ling Han’s injuries had already recovered, so he was naturally unafraid. Even if he encountered Lian Yutang or the elders of the Flame Skin Race, he was confident that he could still fight.
He strode forward and arrived at the plaza.
Yi, Lian Yutang wasn’t here?
Ling Han’s eyes swept over the surroundings, and did not find any trace of Lian Yutang. Instead, there were a lot of people from the Flame Skin Race.

“Ling, Ling Han!” A Flame Skin Race member discovered Ling Han’s presence, and his face was filled with surprise. This was because both of them had disappeared after Fifth Elder set off to pursue Ling Han.

In everyone’s minds, Ling Han must have fled, and Fifth Elder was chasing after him. That was why he had not returned for so long. They had not even considered the possibility that Fifth Elder would die.

“Where’s Fifth Elder?” he couldn’t help but ask.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Oh, he’s complaining about the bad air here, so he’s gone somewhere else for a holiday.”
The Flame Skin Race cultivator was instantly stupefied. A holiday? What holiday?
After being stunned for a moment, he finally came to his senses. Hurriedly, he faced the sky and roared, sending out a signal.
Instantly, the nearby Flame Skin Race members all leaped over, including Nalan Feiyue.
“Ling Han!” He was also startled, “Where is Fifth Elder?”
“Oh, he’s gone on a holiday,” Ling Han said with a smile.
“Nonsense!” Nalan Feiyue immediately rebuked.
“Sigh, I can’t deceive you,” Ling Han said with a smile. “Then I’ll just tell the truth. I killed him.”

“Bullsh*t!” Nalan Feiyue was even more disbelieving. Fifth Elder who possessed the Firebird Staff had battle prowess of Pseudo Sect Master-level. It wasn’t like he didn’t know Ling Han’s strength. It was absolutely impossible for him to match a Pseudo Sect Master.
