“You still dare to be angry?” Nalan Feiyue said with a cold smile. “You already have no more value to be exploited, yet you still come here to seek death.”
He moved aggressively. This was the territory of the Flame Skin Race, so even if his abilities were inferior to Ling Han’s, what did he have to fear?
The elders would immediately arrive.
Ling Han shook his head, and threw a punch.
Peng!
Those Flame Skin Race beings could all see clearly. When this punch landed, Nalan Feiyue’s whole person exploded, turning into a shower of blood.
“You, you, you—” They pointed at Ling Han, not knowing whether they should be shocked by Ling Han’s battle prowess, or his outrageous boldness.
Xiu, another figure flew over.
Nalan Huoshu.
He didn’t see the scene of Nalan Feiyue being obliterated, but he could sense the blood in the air, which made him frown. “What’s going on?”
“Feiyue, Feiyue was killed by him!” The members of the Flame Skin Race all pointed at Ling Han.
“How bold you are!” Nalan Huoshu said coldly.
“So-so.” Ling Han shrugged, “Are you dissatisfied? I can kill you too, believe it or not?”
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Another member of the Flame Skin Race arrived. This time, it was the elders. One or two... Very soon, all eight elders had arrived.
“Where’s Old Fifth?” an elder asked, his eyes fixed on Ling Han.
“Is this the attitude of asking questions?” Ling Han shook his head, “I am very displeased.”
“You’re just a caged bird. Is there any need to be concerned about you?” Fourth Elder humphed, “Tell me quickly, where is Old Fifth!”
“Killed him,” Ling Han said. “Given your attitude, I’ve decided to send you to reunite with Old Fifth.”
“Haha, what a great joke.” Fourth Elder nodded at Nalan Huoshu, “Kill him!”
“Understood!” Nalan Huoshu nodded, and immediately charged towards Ling Han.
With the eight senior elders keeping watch, suppressing Ling Han’s battle prowess, he would definitely be able to kill Ling Han.
“Die!” He launched a palm strike at Ling Han.
Ling Han brandished his fists, and a terrifying power surged. This time, he did not hold anything back, and released all his power.
Peng!

The two of them exchanged a blow, and Nalan Huoshu instantly stumbled back in retreat. When he retreated to the seventh step, one of his arms exploded, followed by the other. Then, his left leg exploded, his right leg exploded, and he collapsed onto the ground.

“Huoshu!” the eight senior elders exclaimed in unison. They knew that Ling Han’s battle prowess was formidable, and were already prepared to summon the Firebird Staff to suppress Ling Han’s battle prowess.
However, they had never imagined that Ling Han’s strength would actually be so strong. With a single punch, he had severely injured Nalan Huoshu.
F***, they had not managed to make their move in time.
“Die!” The eight senior elders attacked at the same time, brandishing the Firebird Staff and attacking Ling Han.
One after another, firebirds flew out, pouncing towards Ling Han.

Ling Han tried to use the bead to form a shield, but in front of the firebird, this shield was practically useless. It would be shattered with a single strike, and would not have the slightest defensive effect at all.
As expected, this could only block the power naturally formed by heaven and earth.

Ling Han sighed, and directly took out the Great Emperor Horn. Weng, a soundless wave rippled out. All of a sudden, everyone in the vicinity, including the eight senior elders, all raised their heads and howled like wolves.
In this way, the attacks they shot out were naturally a mess, and the threat that they posed to Ling Han decreased drastically.

However, Pseudo Sect Master-level attacks were still quite sharp. Furthermore, after the firebirds shot out, they possessed a certain level of self-attack ability, and was not affected by the Great Emperor’s horn, which made Ling Han feel very troubled, and he had no choice but to soar through the air to dodge.

There were too many people here. Unless Ling Han planned to kill all of them to keep the secret, the moment he summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, that would definitely leak the secret.
This was far too important, and it also involved the Nine Mountains Saint and the Nine Suns Holy Land. Thus, Ling Han didn’t dare to act recklessly.
“Ling Han!” With a loud roar, Lian Yutang arrived through the air, his face filled with shock.
‘You’re actually still alive?’

chapters.title: Chapter 4367: Opening of the Palace doors
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Lian Yutang had finally arrived.
He was extremely stunned. He had clearly seen with his own eyes how Ling Han had “died” in the lava, so how had he now reappeared completely unscathed?
This, this, this, he practically could not believe his own eyes.
But in the next instant, his killing intent immediately became severe.
Since that was the case, he would kill him again. This time, he was definitely going to blow up Ling Han’s head with his own hands.
Boom, he joined the battle.

Ling Han was already struggling to fight against the eight elders all by himself. After all, the Firebird Staff was extremely powerful. If it weren’t for the fact that he had the Great Emperor Horn that could affect the eight elders, without using the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, he would have no option but to turn around and flee.
And now, there was Lian Yutang?
It should be known that Lian Yutang’s strength was not the slightest bit inferior to his.
Lian Yutang’s attack arrived, yet Ling Han was unafraid as he faced it head-on. ‘Do you really think you’re that awesome?’
Peng!
In this exchange of blows, the two of them trembled at the same time, and were both sent flying backwards.
“What?!” Lian Yutang exclaimed in astonishment. He had actually tied with Ling Han?
How was this possible?
Ling Han’s aura clearly hadn’t changed at all, so why had his abilities suddenly improved by so much?
Could it be that Ling Han had deliberately concealed his abilities during their last battle?
But why?
And he would rather jump into the river than reveal his strength?
Or had this guy gotten a fortuitous encounter after jumping into the lava river, which allowed his strength to have such an inconceivable increase?
Yet Ling Han was in an incredibly sorry state, because the eight senior elders were not just standing at the sidelines and watching the show, but were also attacking.

If it was only Lian Yutang, then he would not be afraid at all, and would be able to match them. And if it was only the eight senior elders, then he could use the Great Emperor’s Horn, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to stand against them. In fact, he could even achieve victory in this battle.
However, with these two factors added together, Ling Han really couldn’t do anything.

The murderous aura activated. Weng, weng, weng! The eight senior elders groaned at the same time, their faces twisting. This was still because their cultivation levels were higher than Ling Han’s. Otherwise, if they were struck by the murderous aura, all of them would die immediately.

The eight senior elders were completely caught off guard, and naturally suffered a great loss. Thankfully, they did not release their spiritual bodies, which acted as defense in their minds, cancelling out a portion of the impact.

Ling Han was just about to take advantage of the opening to make a move on the eight senior elders, but how could Lian Yutang possibly allow him to do as he wished? He immediately intercepted him and launched a fierce offensive at him.

His strength was not inferior to Ling Han at all. After channelling the Imperial Technique, his attack power was incredibly frightening. Even Ling Han did not dare to be careless. He could only give up on his counterattack, and disperse Lian Yutang’s attack.
After this attack, the eight senior elders also recovered, and launched another attack. It became nine against one again.

Ling Han unleashed his full abilities, yet Lian Yutang was no weaker than him. The Firebird Staff in the hands of the eight senior elders was even more terrifying. If Ling Han was struck by it, even his freakish physique would be severely wounded.
After a few moves, Ling Han was completely at a disadvantage.
However, whether it was the eight senior elders or Lian Yutang, none of them could laugh.

Ordinarily, any one of them would be able to easily suppress Ling Han, but the present situation was that with the nine of them working together, Ling Han could still resist tenaciously, which made their jaws drop, and at the same time, they inhaled sharply.
This guy was too freakish, wasn’t he?
They definitely had to kill him!
The killing intent of the nine people intensified. The more freakishly Ling Han behaved, the more they wanted to kill him.

Their attacks became even more rapid. Though they had not worked together previously, and Lian Yutang had even fought a battle with the nine senior elders previously, but now, for the sake of a common goal, they resolutely worked together. Furthermore, as time passed, they gradually developed coordination, and showed more and more tacit understanding.

The pressure on Ling Han became greater and greater. If it was not for the fact that his physique was astonishingly strong, and could disperse the attacks of power within six Heavens, he would probably be lying on the ground by now.
Even so, he was still under great pressure.
“Hehe, do you think I don’t have a Spirit Tool?” Ling Han took out the Firebird Staff.
“What!” When the eight senior elders saw this, they all looked shocked.
It was the Firebird Staff!
There were a total of nine Firebird Staffs, one for each of the nine senior elders, no more and no less.
But now, one of the Firebird Staffs had appeared in Ling Han’s hands. What did this mean?
The odds were against Fifth Elder.
Thinking back to what Ling Han had previously said, the Flame Skin Race was all shocked. How could it be that Ling Han had not lied? Had he really killed Fifth Elder?
Heavens, how had he done it?
With the Firebird Staff in hand, shouldn’t he be invincible in this place?
“What did you do to Old Fifth?” After the eight senior elders faltered for a moment, they immediately launched another powerful offensive.
“The Firebird Staff has already fallen into my hands. Is there any need to ask further?” Ling Han asked calmly.
“How is this possible!” The eight senior elders were still unwilling to believe it.
This was the battle prowess of Pseudo Sect Master, so how could you match it?
“Nothing is impossible!” Ling Han brandished the Firebird Staff. Unfortunately, this required a special technique to be able to control it. Thus, though he brandished it, no firebird flew out.
“Haha, it was a mistake, a mistake. Please don’t take it to heart.” He smiled at everyone.

The eight senior elders were already prepared to flee. They were the standard example of being strong in attack and weak in defense. If they were faced with the attack of a Pseudo Sect Master, they definitely wouldn’t be able to block it like Ling Han.
‘Are you f*cking toying with me?!’
The eight old geezers flew into a humiliated rage, and brandished their walking sticks towards Ling Han again.
Pu, pu, pu! The firebirds pounced.
Ling Han had no choice but to turn around and flee.
This battle of nine against one was too disadvantageous.
“Don’t even think of running!” The eight senior elders and Lian Yutang immediately set off in pursuit.
However, right at this moment, the bricks in the plaza lit up one after another. A red halo of light soared into the sky, like flames.
This change was too sudden, and everyone stopped.
A Mystery Realm was filled with danger.

Pa! Ling Han suddenly discovered that one of his Spatial Spirit Tools had suddenly shattered. Meanwhile, the items inside it hadn’t been annihilated into the Void. Instead, they rose up and shot toward the palace gates like a sharp arrow.
The keys from the palaces!
Not only him, but two other keys also flew out from the eight senior elders’ hands, and similarly shot towards the great doors of the palace.
One, two, three... eight, nine.
The nine keys were all here.
These nine keys were all stabbed into the doors of the palace. There were nine holes on them, which corresponded to each of them.
Yi, why had there suddenly been a change?
Ling Han’s eyes swept over the surroundings, and caught sight of a few familiar auras.
—The empress, Hu Niu, the large black dog and the others.
Ling Han finally understood why there was such a sudden change. That was because the little red bird had arrived, and her bloodline had caused an unforeseen event here.
The nine keys were set at the same time, and they automatically inserted themselves into the corresponding positions. Then, they all began to turn.
Ka, ka, ka! The sound was transmitted.
Everyone stopped what they were doing, and looked towards the main doors.
Was it about to be opened?
The inheritance of the True Phoenix was about to appear?
The keys spun, and finally stopped. Then, the great doors slowly opened, and a dark and eerie entrance appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 4368: I have returned
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The palace had opened!
Everyone’s eyes were burning. The inheritance of the True Phoenix was hidden inside.

Imperial Technique, Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, the most awesome movement technique in the world. It was rumored that a great many Great Emperors wanted to study it, but they were ultimately unable to find the secret lair of the True Phoenix. Unexpectedly, they encountered such a great opportunity.

Everyone was incredibly excited, and at the same time, their killing intent was also firm. A deadly weapon quietly appeared in their hands. There was naturally nothing else left to say, and the only thing left was battle.
Faced with this kind of Imperial Technique, even blood brothers could possibly become enemies.
Lian Yutang no longer attacked. He looked towards the main doors of the palace, and the strong longing in his eyes could not be concealed.

As he saw it, in terms of individual battle prowess alone, he was undoubtedly the top elite. Thus, his only worry was the eight elders. After all, they had a deadly weapon like the Firebird Staff, which could deliver a Pseudo Sect Master-level attack.
He had to be on guard against them, and the others were all mediocre, and he did not take them to heart.
Ka, ka, ka! The doors to the palace were completely open, but the contents could not be seen at all. There was only complete darkness.
“Die!”
It was unknown who was the first to rush out, and run towards the palace.
It was inevitable that a chaotic battle would break out. They pushed one another, and attacked one another. All of them wanted to be the first person to charge into the palace.

“F*ck off! This is the great opportunity that our Flame Skin Race has painstakingly waited for countless years for!” The eight senior elders couldn’t care less about Ling Han anymore, and they all charged toward the large hall.
They brandished the Firebird Staff, and began to attack indiscriminately.
—The members of the Flame Skin Race had long since retreated out. Thus, no matter how reckless they were, the ones they injured were still outsiders.
This time, the scene was extremely chaotic.
Pseudo Sect Master-level attacks were too domineering. As the firebirds pounced, masses of people collapsed one after another, completely unable to withstand a single blow.

Dao Child, Imperial Son, and even Silver Generation were really too fragile in the face of a Pseudo Sect Master-level attack. If it wasn’t for the fact that a great many people still had Substitution Seals, the mortality rate would have been at least three times higher by now.
This caused great shock to the Imperial Sons. Though an Imperial Technique was good, if they were not alive to enjoy it, then wouldn’t that be all for naught?
They regained their senses, and retreated outside.

At present, only the eight senior elders were still barraging the main doors, Lian Yutang and also another Golden Generation called Shi Ze, who was also respectfully addressed as Imperial Son Ze. Additionally, Ling Han was slightly behind. He did not think that simply charging in would allow one to obtain the inheritance of the True Phoenix.
The nine palace halls had been opened by the little red bird, so how could it be that it had nothing to do with the little red bird now?
Thus, he had the little red bird come over, and the man and bird chose to watch from the sidelines.
‘You guys can just fight to your heart’s content.’
At this time, because the number of people had further decreased, the situation had also become clearer.
The eight senior elders teamed up to battle Lian Yutang and Imperial Son Ze.

These two people were the only two in the Golden Generation that were still stuck at the Spiritual Transformation Tier. However, it wasn’t that their natural talent was slightly weaker and they couldn’t advance into the Minor Advanced Tier. Rather, it was because they wanted to cultivate their cultivation level to perfection, so they suppressed their cultivation level and didn’t break through.
The two Imperial Sons joined forces, exchanging blows with the eight senior elders.

In terms of strength of attack, it was definitely the eight senior elders that had the upper hand. The Firebird Staff could unleash the might of Pseudo Sect Master-level, and this was something that even the Golden Generation could not match. However, Lian Yutang and Shi Ze had the advantage in their individual battle prowess, so their movements were more agile.
Thus, one side’s attack power was strong, while the other side’s movement was agile. They both had an advantage, and it was just enough for them to fight to a tie.

The problem now was whether the eight senior elders would be unable to activate the Firebird Staff first, or Lian Yutang and Shi Ze would be exhausted first. After all, the pressure on both sides was extraordinarily great.

When the battle became intense, both sides summoned all their spiritual bodies. It was clearly a battle of ten people, but there were about a hundred people on the scene, which became incredibly lively.
“Come, come, come. Who wants to place a bet? Bet on the side that wins.” The large black dog immediately said, “One to three on the Imperial Sons’ side, and one to four on the old geezers’ side.”
“Pei, despicable dog, then wouldn’t it be a sure win and no loss if I place a bet on both sides?” An Imperial Son immediately rebuked, “You are clearly trying to get out of paying up.”
This was indeed a very simple logic. The large black dog’s loss was assured, so why did he still want to open a round of gambling?
He was clearly trying to scam them out of their money.
“How despicable!”
“How despicable!”
Everyone shook their heads. If it was not for the fact that Ling Han was still beside him, they would definitely rush forwards and smack the large black dog to death.
The large black dog felt gloomy. Since when had these guys become smarter?
Sigh, there were too few fools these days. It was so difficult to earn money.

Weng, right at this moment, an aura suddenly surged out of the palace, spreading out in all directions. With a boom, everyone felt a powerful sense of helplessness rise up from the depths of their hearts.
Instantly, a great many people looked shocked.
This aura was too powerful, far surpassing their level of being. At least, it had to be a Venerate Tier-level existence.
A Venerate Tier elite had appeared in this place?
Just the thought of it was terrifying.

The battle between the eight senior elders, Lian Yutang and Imperial Son Ze naturally came to an abrupt halt. They were fighting for the inheritance of the True Phoenix, but now that a variable had clearly appeared, they were naturally apprehensive, and could no longer bother about the battle.
Nothing was as important as their lives.
Weng, at this moment, that aura fluctuated again, like a ripple.
“He’s become stronger!”
“This aura has become stronger!”
“Heavens!”
Everyone exclaimed in shock. This was too obvious. It was clearly the same aura, but it had become stronger.
Weng, that aura came again.
Ling Han frowned. The strength of this aura had indeed increased further, and what made him feel even more uneasy was the fact that the frequency of these ripples was also becoming faster.
This was like waking up from a deep slumber. There was a process from sleep to awakening, and in this process, one’s aura would naturally become stronger and stronger.
The problem was this was the True Phoenix Palace.
There was an existence inside that was at least Venerate Tier-level, so who could it be?
‘True Phoenix?’
Impossible!

Firstly, even if the True Phoenix was a Great Emperor, it could not possibly live for so long. Furthermore, the Great Emperor was so strong that even the Regulations of heaven and earth could not suppress it. THey could not possibly suppress its life force, and have endless years pass.
Secondly, if it was the True Phoenix, this aura wouldn’t only be Venerate Tier-level, right?
He had not even finished the thought, when weng, that aura came again. It had clearly strengthened further.
No one made a sound, nor did anyone move. They were all looking in the direction of the palace, feeling an indescribable fear.
Weng, weng, weng! The fluctuation of this aura became more and more rapid, and also stronger. Finally, it broke through to Saint Tier in a single leap.
Saint Tier!

Everyone’s feeling of unease became even stronger. Now that a Saint had appeared, even the Imperial Clans would have to be polite. If a Saint suddenly appeared here, and killed all of them, then even the Imperial Clans would not know whom they should seek out for revenge.
Boom, this aura rippled out like an ocean, causing everyone to feel suffocated.
“I, have returned!” A voice suddenly rang out in everyone’s hearts.

chapters.title: Chapter 4369: Remnant Soul of the True Phoenix
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
‘I’ve returned?’
Who was this “I”?
At the entrance of the palace, a shadow walked out.
This was the True Phoenix!
Everyone could clearly see that this was a phoenix. It was indescribably gorgeous, but this phoenix’s body was almost transparent, and completely did not seem like a real entity.
“This isn’t the True Phoenix, but the remnant soul of the True Phoenix!”
The Imperial Son Ze said darkly. As expected of the Golden Generation. Even at this moment, he still maintained a considerable amount of composure.

Ling Han also had the same feeling. This was definitely not the Divine Beast, True Phoenix, that had commanded the whole world in the ancient times. That was too unrealistic. Furthermore, it was definitely not a complete soul. When the Great Emperor died, the soul would be assimilated by the heaven and earth. This was inevitable.
However, the Great Emperor’s methods were extraordinary. It was still very possible that he had retained behind a tiny bit of his remnant soul.
Even so, this was still extremely terrifying.
The True Phoenix actually left behind a remnant soul, and the fluctuation exuding from it was as strong as Saint Tier!
Everyone was speechless. They still wanted the inheritance of the True Phoenix?
The True Phoenix hadn’t died at all, so how could anyone obtain it?
“After slumbering for so long, I’ve finally waited until today!” The True Phoenix’s remnant soul stared directly at the little red bird.
Yi?
“Come!” The True Phoenix’s remnant soul flapped its phoenix wings, and the little red bird flew out uncontrollably.

Ling Han wanted to make a move, but he had just taken a step, when he felt a terrifying aura pressing down on him, causing him to throw up a mouthful of blood. It was indescribably painful, and he was completely unable to make another move.
“Save me!” the little red bird screamed. No matter how it thought about it, this was not a good thing.
“You bear my will, and you are my manifestation. What do you have to fear?” the True Phoenix’s remnant soul said. With a xiu, he turned into a streak of light that shot towards the little red bird.
Like a clay ox sinking into water, this soul immediately sank into the little red bird’s body.
Seeing this, how could everyone not understand?

It was unknown what method that True Phoenix from the ancient times had used, but there was actually a remnant soul that had not died. It had slumbered in this True Phoenix Palace for countless years, and only awoke at this moment.
And he had spent so many years with only one purpose, and that was to find a body that could bear his soul.

The little red bird was a descendant of the Vermillion Bird and possessed the bloodline of a Divine Beast. Moreover, it was also a bird and a fire-element beast, so it was naturally the best container.
No wonder when the little red bird arrived, the nine palaces immediately opened up without any effort.
This was practically a trap!
It was at this moment that Ling Han’s thoughts drifted for a moment.
Why did the Genesis World also have True Dragons and True Phoenixes?
Judging by the current situation, the Genesis World was like a miniature version of this great world, but the problem was, why would so many races appear in the Genesis World?
Unknowingly, could it be that there was a force controlling and influencing it?

Looking at the appearances of the Four-Legged Snake, the little red bird, and the True Phoenix’s remnant soul, they were all the same as the Dragons, Vermillion Birds, and Phoenixes that corresponded in the Genesis World. What was going on here?

Ling Han was certain that the Genesis World was definitely not a Mystery Realm like the lair of the True Phoenix. Instead, it was a real world with its own independent and complete Regulations of heaven and earth. However, in terms of level, the Genesis World’s Regulations were much, much lower.
After letting his thoughts drift for a while, Ling Han hurriedly came back to his senses. Was this the time to think about these things?
However, the remnant soul of the True Phoenix had returned after countless years, and its power was as high as Saint Tier. Was this something that Ling Han could stand against?
No matter how he thought about it, this was like a mantis trying to stop a chariot.
What could he do? What could he do?
Ling Han frowned deeply. Although the little red bird had a toxic tongue and always complained that it wanted to run when there was trouble, since it had joined his team, it was one of them.
—He had never watched his own people suffer!

If the True Phoenix entered the body, then it would definitely be the True Phoenix’s remnant soul taking the initiative. The little red bird’s soul would definitely be destroyed. Thus, the little red bird was equivalent to dead, and all that was left was her body.
Weng!
Right at this moment, a sudden change took place.
Ling Han felt as if the Firebird Staff in his hand was actually glowing. Its whole body was blazingly bright. Xiu, then it shot up into the skies on its own.
Not only that, but the Spatial Spirit Tool also shattered on its own. The bead of unknown origin also floated up, and fled with the Firebird Staff.
Yi?
In the area where the eight senior elders were, the other eight Firebird Staffs were no longer under their control, and floated into the air.

Then, the nine Firebird Staffs were all gathered, and actually fused into one. That mysterious bead was also embedded, and fused into a completely new staff. However, unlike its original blazing red colour, this staff was now completely dark blue in colour, exuding a warm and cool feeling.

“True Phoenix, I submitted to you as my master, and followed you everywhere you go. However, when you arrived, you mercilessly killed your nine brothers for the sake of your own reincarnation!” A shadowy figure walked out of the staff. This was a human figure. Although he was also a remnant soul, he could be seen clearly. His arms were bare, and there were flame-shaped tattoos on his arms.

“Ancestor!” Seeing this figure, the eight senior elders and the Flame Skin Race were all excited. This was their ancestor, and he had always been worshipped in the Flame Skin Palace. Who hadn’t seen him before?
But who would have thought that this ancestor was actually still alive!

Just listen to him. At that time, it seemed like the nine Great Generals had been personally killed by the True Phoenix. Meanwhile, the Flame Skin Race’s ancestor had had a backup plan. He had actually left behind a remnant soul that was revived today.
Ling Han gritted his teeth. Just how many years had this enmity spanned?
The remnant soul of the Flame Skin Race’s ancestor gripped the staff and pounced at the little red bird. The top of the staff glowed, and a Saint-level aura surged.
This was a Saint Tool!

If the True Phoenix was at its prime, it naturally wouldn’t need to worry about this at all. A single breath from the Great Emperor would be enough to kill a Saint a few times over. Now, however, the True Phoenix was only left with a wisp of its soul. Moreover, it was at the most critical moment of fusing with the little red bird!
The timing that the Flame Skin Race’s ancestor chose to attack could be considered just right.

The little red bird flapped its wings and shot out a ray of light that transformed into countless divine patterns. Peng! The staff was instantly sent flying, and the remnant soul of the Flame Skin Race’s ancestor also swayed like a candle in the wind.
After all, he had only been a Saint in his prime, and now he was only left with a remnant soul. How much might could he still have left?

However, the ancestor of the Flame Skin Race laughed loudly, and said, “True Phoenix, oh, True Phoenix, you didn’t expect this, did you? You’ve schemed for millions and millions of years, yet all your efforts have come to nothing. Your heart must be filled with bitterness, right? That’s right, I want you to have a taste of despair and betrayal!”

“Sigh!” With a soft sigh, the remnant soul of the True Phoenix floated out of the little red bird’s body. It had clearly become slightly more transparent. He looked at the Flame Skin Race’s ancestor, and shook his head. “Old friend, you’ve misunderstood me.”

“Misunderstanding?” The ancestor of the Flame Skin Race sneered, and said, “Could it be that when I personally witnessed you killing the nine of us, that was a misunderstanding? Fortunately, I had a premonition and made preparations in advance. Otherwise, I would truly be dying with a grudge and wouldn’t have gotten my revenge today.”

The True Phoenix’s remnant soul threw its head back and roared with laughter. “Heavens, heavens, I wanted to create the Rising From The Ashes Technique to live a second life. However, I was rendered divine punishment, and suffered a fatal dao injury. Before I died, I made arrangements for the overall situation, hoping to find someone with a bloodline connection in this world to inherit my will and start a new life.”
“Who would’ve thought? It’s all for naught!”

The top of the staff glowed, and a Saint-level aura surged.
This was a Saint Tool!
If the True Phoenix was at its prime, it naturally wouldn’t need to worry about this at all.
A single breath from the Great Emperor would be enough to kill a Saint a few times over.
Now, however, the True Phoenix was only left with a wisp of its soul.
Moreover, it was at the most critical moment of fusing with the little red bird!
The timing that the Flame Skin Race’s ancestor chose to attack could be considered just right.
The little red bird flapped its wings and shot out a ray of light that transformed into countless divine patterns.
Peng!
The staff was instantly sent flying, and the remnant soul of the Flame Skin Race’s ancestor also swayed like a candle in the wind.
After all, he had only been a Saint in his prime, and now he was only left with a remnant soul.
How much might could he still have left?
However, the ancestor of the Flame Skin Race laughed loudly, and said, “True Phoenix, oh, True Phoenix, you didn’t expect this, did you?
You’ve schemed for millions and millions of years, yet all your efforts have come to nothing.
Your heart must be filled with bitterness, right?
That’s right, I want you to have a taste of despair and betrayal!”
“Sigh!” With a soft sigh, the remnant soul of the True Phoenix floated out of the little red bird’s body.
It had clearly become slightly more transparent.
He looked at the Flame Skin Race’s ancestor, and shook his head.
“Old friend, you’ve misunderstood me.”
“Misunderstanding?” The ancestor of the Flame Skin Race sneered, and said, “Could it be that when I personally witnessed you killing the nine of us, that was a misunderstanding?
Fortunately, I had a premonition and made preparations in advance.
Otherwise, I would truly be dying with a grudge and wouldn’t have gotten my revenge today.”
The True Phoenix’s remnant soul threw its head back and roared with laughter.
“Heavens, heavens, I wanted to create the Rising From The Ashes Technique to live a second life.
However, I was rendered divine punishment, and suffered a fatal dao injury.
Before I died, I made arrangements for the overall situation, hoping to find someone with a bloodline connection in this world to inherit my will and start a new life.”
“Who would’ve thought?
It’s all for naught!”

chapters.title: Chapter 4370: All for naught
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations

The ancestor of the Flame Skin Race delivered an attack at the most crucial moment, completely interrupting the fusion of the True Phoenix’s remnant soul and the little red bird. There was only one chance, and it was also the only chance that the True Phoenix’s remnant soul had obtained in millions and millions of years to deceive the heavens.
If he missed this opportunity, there would be no next time.
“Man proposes, God disposes,” the True Phoenix’s remnant soul said with a sigh. There was an indescribably tragic expression on his face.

“Hahahaha, you’ve finally tasted the bitter fruit, haven’t you?!” The Flame Skin Race’s ancestor laughed loudly, and said, “Come, kill me. In any case, I’ve already ruined your plans to reincarnate, so I can leave with no worries. I’m going to meet my eight old brothers!”
They were both damaged souls, and he was only a manifestation of a Saint. How could he compare to the True Phoenix? He naturally couldn’t withstand a single blow.
However, the True Phoenix’s remnant soul didn’t attack. Instead, it simply shook its head.

“What is it? Still hypocritical?” The Flame Skin Race’s ancestor scoffed. “Or are you thinking about how you’re going to torture me? It doesn’t matter. Right now, my only feelings are happiness and pleasure.”

“Old friend!” The True Phoenix’s remnant soul shook its head, “You have misunderstood me! Years ago, I wanted to rise from the ashes, but was interrupted by the heavens, so I began to lay out plans for my next life. I am 100% sure that I can create it successfully in my next life, and in order for you all to return to glory with me, I have taken away your souls, so that you can once again battle the world with me.”
“Hahaha!” The ancestor of the Flame Skin Race laughed loudly. “You still want to lie at a time like this? This has no meaning, not the slightest bit!”
The True Phoenix’s remnant soul wasn’t angered. With a flap of its wings, nine almost transparent figures immediately appeared beside him. They were humanoid, but the majority of them were bird-like.
This time, the ancestor of the Flame Skin Race was instantly dumbfounded.

He naturally recognized that eight of these nine figures were his companions who had fought alongside him, and one of them was his own soul. However, these soul fragments were presently rapidly dying.

The True Phoenix was right. He had indeed preserved the souls of the nine Great Generals, but now, the True Phoenix’s attempt to snatch the little red bird’s physical body had failed. The remnant soul did not have a physical body to bear, and would die not long after. Naturally, it was impossible for the souls of the nine Great Generals to remain alive.
How could this be?

The ancestor of the Flame Skin Race was rendered speechless. He had always harbored a grudge against the True Phoenix, and he believed that the True Phoenix had betrayed them and mercilessly slaughtered his loyal subordinates. Thus, he had also laid out plans to deal with this.
He had never imagined that the truth would actually be like this!

It couldn’t be helped. This remnant soul of his had always been hidden inside that pearl. In fact, in order not to let the True Phoenix discover any clues, he had even severed this part of his memory from the main body.

It was possible that in the end, the main body had long since known about the plans of the True Phoenix, but because he had thought himself clever, not only had he killed himself, he had also caused his eight companions to lose the chance to come back to life forever.
It was not that the True Phoenix had betrayed them, but rather that he had caused their deaths!
The ancestor of the Flame Skin Race gaped, completely at a loss for words.
“I, I, I—” He suddenly knelt down, and howled loudly.

At present, he was only a remnant soul, and could not shed any tears. However, his voice was incredibly shrill, and reverberated in everyone’s minds. A boundless sense of grief rose up in them, and they could feel his pain deeply.
He had killed himself and his companion with his own hands. What kind of feeling of self-criticism was this? Who could understand that?

“Old friend, don’t be sad, and don’t blame yourself.” The True Phoenix’s remnant soul was much more carefree, “Fighting with the heavens is filled with variables in the first place. If I win, we will restart our second life, and if I lose, everything will be for naught.”
“Old friend, let’s die together.”

The Flame Skin Race’s ancestor had only managed to survive for millions and millions of years thanks to the support of hatred, yet now, it had become endless self-criticism. How could it be resolved just because of a few words from the True Phoenix?

He continued to kowtow to the True Phoenix’s remnant soul and the nine remnant souls of his brothers that were about to disappear. It was as if doing so would diminish that piercing self-blame just a little.

However, as he continued to kowtow, his soul began to fade, and finally, it completely disappeared. Only that endless feeling of regret still reverberated in everyone’s hearts, and could not dissipate for a long time.

The True Phoenix’s remnant soul also shook its head and sighed. The nine souls around it had more or less dissipated, and he was only forcefully holding on with the cultivation level of Great Emperor of ancient times. He wouldn’t be able to maintain it for long.

He looked at the little red bird, and smiled faintly, “Descendant of Vermillion Bird, though you have suffered a little, my martial intent has also been passed on to you, so it can be considered that our grievances have been settled.”
At this moment, the little red bird was in a coma, so it naturally couldn’t respond to him.
“How lamentable, detestable, and pitiful!” The True Phoenix’s remnant soul sighed repeatedly, and its figure gradually faded. In the end, it could no longer be seen.
Boom, that powerful aura also receded like floodwaters.
All of a sudden, the eight senior elders of the Flame Skin Race, Lian Yutang and Imperial Son Ze all looked at the little red bird with heated gazes.

Just now, the True Phoenix’s remnant soul had clearly said that its inheritance had already been obtained by the little red bird. Thus, as long as they captured the little red bird and searched its soul, they would naturally be able to obtain the True Phoenix’s inheritance.

This was really an unexpected turn of events. At first, they had thought that when the True Phoenix’s remnant soul appeared, everyone would only have come up empty-handed. It would be good enough if they could keep their lives, but they had never imagined that things would develop to this extent.

Since the True Phoenix’s remnant soul had already disappeared, there was no longer any overwhelming existence. Whoever could obtain the True Phoenix’s inheritance would naturally have to depend on their own abilities.
Ling Han humphed and leaped out, greeting Lian Yutang and the others.
The murderous aura charged onwards!

Boom, the eight senior elders all grabbed their heads and screamed in pain. Without the Firebird Staff, they were actually far inferior to even the Silver Generation, so how could they possibly match Ling Han?

However, Lian Yutang and Imperial Son Ze couldn’t be ignored, especially Imperial Son Ze. He hadn’t had a spiritual body destroyed, and his battle prowess was at its peak. When he used the Imperial Technique, it was incredibly terrifying.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Ling Han exchanged a few blows with the two Imperial Sons, creating a boundless shockwave of energy.
The little red bird finally came back to its senses after being shaken. With a cry, it hurriedly flapped its wings and fled.
Though she had obtained the inheritance of the True Phoenix, her cultivation level had not increased in the slightest, so how could she possibly match the might of Imperial Sons?
However, before she could even take two steps, she saw that the eight senior elders had already charged back. Moreover, they were carrying that blue staff with them.
At this moment, she faltered for a moment before pointing at the senior elder who was wielding the staff and saying, “Go.”
A strange scene appeared. The senior elder’s whole person suddenly disappeared into thin air, leaving only the staff that fell from midair onto the ground with a pa.
Yi, what was going on here?
The remaining seven senior elders, including the Silver Generation elites that were rushing over, were all shocked. This was too bizarre.
The little red bird laughed loudly, “Get lost, get lost, get lost!”
With a tap of a finger, the seven senior elders disappeared into thin air.
Everyone was astounded. Had they been teleported to a certain place, or had their bodies and souls been directly destroyed?

Though the little red bird was only in the True Self Tier, she had obtained the inheritance of the True Phoenix, which was equivalent to becoming the owner of this place. Then, with the Great Emperor-level formation, it would be easy for her to kill a few Spirit Transformation Tiers.

chapters.title: Chapter 4371: Going all out in battle
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han looked at the little red bird, and asked through divine sense, “You can control the formations here?”
“En, I can throw people out of the Mystery Realm.” The little red bird nodded, and also replied via divine sense.
Ling Han pondered for a moment, then said, “Aside from this person, throw everyone else out.”
He was referring to Lian Yutang.
“All right,” the little red bird nodded without hesitation. Before she had fallen unconscious, she had seen Ling Han rush out to save her.
The request of a friend naturally had to be fulfilled.
With a thought from her, xiu, xiu, xiu, everyone here disappeared, aside from Lian Yutang.
Yi?
Lian Yutang frowned. Why had the others all disappeared?
He was a little nervous, but there was also a burning desire in his heart.

He was the only one left. This was naturally a little strange, but at the same time, without a powerful competitor like Imperial Son Ze, he only had to kill Ling Han, and the inheritance of the True Phoenix would naturally be obtained by him.
Ling Han strode towards Lian Yutang and said, “Come, let’s have a great battle.”
“All right. I’ll kill you first, then take the True Phoenix inheritance.” Lian Yutang smiled.
“In your dreams!” Ling Han charged over, unleashing his full battle prowess.
Boom!
Lian Yutang’s expression changed drastically when he saw this.
So strong.

Previously, though he had also battled with Ling Han before, with the help of the eight senior elders at that time, Ling Han was obstructed and unable to unleash his full abilities. However, it was a different story now. Ling Han was completely free of pressure, so he naturally could unleash his full abilities.

Peng, peng, peng! The two of them continued to exchange blows. In terms of power, it was still Lian Yutang who was slightly superior. However, his superiority was truly limited. Meanwhile, Ling Han’s physique was tough, and his advantage of being able to disperse attacks automatically was clear for all to see. He was not the slightest bit inferior.
In fact, he didn’t even need to rest and reorganize at all. He pursued closely with every move, and his attacks surged forth like a flood.
Lian Yutang didn’t cower either. He had also cultivated Body Art, and his physique was extremely tough. He was completely capable of withstanding such an exchange of blows.
However, the toughness of his physique did not mean that his body was indestructible. After several hundred moves, traces of blood appeared on his skin. That was blood vessels bursting.

It could not be helped. He was unable to disperse the attack within six Heavens. In this aspect, he was at too much of a disadvantage. As a result, he had naturally sustained some injuries from the prolonged battle. Thankfully, this was only a superficial wound, and would not affect his battle prowess at all. It was just that it looked a little ugly.
What depressed Lian Yutang was the fact that Ling Han was actually unscathed.
This was a huge blow to him.

He could accept being injured, but that was under the condition that he had an advantage, and the other party’s injuries were heavier than his. But now? Ling Han was completely unwounded, which was something he could not accept.
Ling Han was stronger than him?
This meant that if the battle continued, he would lose, or even die!
How could that be allowed?
He humphed as he retrieved his Spirit Tool.

Before this, he couldn’t even be bothered to use his Spirit Tool, believing that he was invincible among his peers. Now, however, it was clear that he was no match for Ling Han. This caused him to swallow his pride.
Kill the enemy, and snatch the inheritance.
Boom, he brandished a crimson long sword. As he slashed out with the sword, Sword Qi was three thousand meters long, bringing with it a fierce light, as it slashed out towards Ling Han.

This was a Six Star Spirit Tool, and could blast out Sect Master-level power. However, limited by Lian Yutang’s cultivation level, the upper limit of attack power had dropped to Pseudo Sect Master-level. However, was Pseudo Sect Master-level battle prowess not enough to kill Ling Han?
The Sword Qi slashed over, extremely terrifying.
Ling Han humphed and said, “Do you think you’re the only one with a Spirit Tool?”
Weng, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower appeared above his head.

The Sword Qi slashed over, and was naturally blocked by the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Endless power and Regulations landed on the tower, causing the precious tower to tremble slightly, but that was it.
“En?” Lian Yutang couldn’t help but be startled. What was going on here?
This tower?
He focused his gaze, and suddenly paled in shock, “Imperial Weapon!”

The moment these words left his mouth, he immediately shook his head. This wasn’t the Imperial Weapon. It was far from having the domineering aura of the Imperial Weapon that could crush all life, but from a certain aspect, this was no different from the Imperial Weapon.
He understood now, and his eyes burned with desire. “A precious tool forged from Origin Gold!”
“You’re envious, right?” Ling Han said with a smile. “Unfortunately, not only will you not be able to obtain it, you’ll even be killed by me here.”

Lian Yutang immediately came to a realization. “As it turned out, the Nine Mountains Saint doesn’t possess the Imperial Weapon. Instead, he possessed this Spirit Tool that was forged from Origin Gold!”

All the Imperial Clans had been deceived. What a joke, they had actually been deceived by a paper tiger for so long. If they had known this earlier, the Imperial Clans would have launched an attack. Whether it was the Nine Suns Holy Land, or Ling Han, they would have become history long ago.
It didn’t matter. When he killed Ling Han and obtained this Pseudo-Imperial Weapon, he would be able to gain a lot.

“You’re still daydreaming,” Ling Han said with a shake of his head. He had the little red bird send everyone away, only leaving Lian Yutang behind. This would make it easier for him to silence Lian Yutang.
“It’s only forged from Origin Gold, and it’s not a real Imperial Weapon. What do I have to fear?” Lian Yutang charged over, the sword in his hand slashing repeatedly, Sword Qi soaring into the sky.
He still had his trump card, so he was filled with confidence.

Ling Han controlled the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to resist the Sword Qi. Meanwhile, he brandished his fists and clashed head-on with Lian Yutang. He was going to exhaust Lian Yutang to death no matter what.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
The battle continued, and after half a day, Lian Yutang’s battle prowess started to decline.

In such a fierce battle, his reserves of mystical power could no longer keep up. On the other hand, Ling Han’s mystical power stores were the dimensions in his body. It could be said that they were as vast as the universe, and there was absolutely no need to worry that it would be exhausted.
Lian Yutang also realized that Ling Han was far too freakish. Not only was Ling Han’s physique even more freakish than his, but his mystical power was also endless and boundless.
If this continued, he would be exhausted to death.
He could only use his trump card!
“Ling Han, you forced me to do this,” he said balefully. Boom! A powerful aura suddenly surged from his body.
This wasn’t because he had ignited his Imperial Blood, but rather... because he had broken through!
Minor Advanced Tier, Sect Master!
Ling Han was astounded. Breaking through here? Could he do it?

Lian Yutang was a member of the Golden Generation, and Ling Han believed that he had the aptitude and ability to break through in battle. However, this was the Mystery Realm, and the Regulations of heaven and earth were incomplete. How could it be that Lian Yutang wasn’t affected?
However, sensing Lian Yutang’s aura, there was indeed an earth-shattering change. It was definitely not something that a Spiritual Transformation Tier cultivator could compare to.
It could only be said that the Imperial Clan’s methods were nature-defying.

“Hahaha, there is no way that you would know. I have long since had one foot into Sect Master Tier, but for the sake of pursuing perfection in Spirit Transformation Tier, I forcibly suppressed it.” Lian Yutang said proudly, “Thus, I can also advance into this cultivation level at any time, but after this, I will no longer be able to suppress it.”
This was the strength and background of the Imperial Clan. If this were an ordinary person, this would be completely unimaginable.
The current him was already a Pseudo Sect Master, so he could completely activate the precious tool in his hand to unleash the true might of Sect Master-level. How could Ling Han block this?
No matter how rare and precious the Origin Gold was, without being refined by an elite, it was ultimately unable to unleash its full might.
“Ling Han, do you... regret it now?” Lian Yutang asked, looking down at Ling Han with disdain.
The present him had indeed grasped an absolute advantage.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said to the little red bird, “We should leave.”

Ling Han was stronger than him?
This meant that if the battle continued, he would lose, or even die!
How could that be allowed?
He humphed as he retrieved his Spirit Tool.
Before this, he couldn’t even be bothered to use his Spirit Tool, believing that he was invincible among his peers.
Now, however, it was clear that he was no match for Ling Han.
This caused him to swallow his pride.
Kill the enemy, and snatch the inheritance.
Boom, he brandished a crimson long sword.
As he slashed out with the sword, Sword Qi was three thousand meters long, bringing with it a fierce light, as it slashed out towards Ling Han.
This was a Six Star Spirit Tool, and could blast out Sect Master-level power.
However, limited by Lian Yutang’s cultivation level, the upper limit of attack power had dropped to Pseudo Sect Master-level.
However, was Pseudo Sect Master-level battle prowess not enough to kill Ling Han?
The Sword Qi slashed over, extremely terrifying.
Ling Han humphed and said, “Do you think you’re the only one with a Spirit Tool?”
Weng, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower appeared above his head.
The Sword Qi slashed over, and was naturally blocked by the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Endless power and Regulations landed on the tower, causing the precious tower to tremble slightly, but that was it.
“En?” Lian Yutang couldn’t help but be startled.
What was going on here?
This tower?
He focused his gaze, and suddenly paled in shock, “Imperial Weapon!”
The moment these words left his mouth, he immediately shook his head.
This wasn’t the Imperial Weapon.
It was far from having the domineering aura of the Imperial Weapon that could crush all life, but from a certain aspect, this was no different from the Imperial Weapon.
He understood now, and his eyes burned with desire.
“A precious tool forged from Origin Gold!”
“You’re envious, right?” Ling Han said with a smile.
“Unfortunately, not only will you not be able to obtain it, you’ll even be killed by me here.”
Lian Yutang immediately came to a realization.
“As it turned out, the Nine Mountains Saint doesn’t possess the Imperial Weapon.
Instead, he possessed this Spirit Tool that was forged from Origin Gold!”
All the Imperial Clans had been deceived.
What a joke, they had actually been deceived by a paper tiger for so long.
If they had known this earlier, the Imperial Clans would have launched an attack.
Whether it was the Nine Suns Holy Land, or Ling Han, they would have become history long ago.
It didn’t matter.
When he killed Ling Han and obtained this Pseudo-Imperial Weapon, he would be able to gain a lot.
“You’re still daydreaming,” Ling Han said with a shake of his head.
He had the little red bird send everyone away, only leaving Lian Yutang behind.
This would make it easier for him to silence Lian Yutang.
“It’s only forged from Origin Gold, and it’s not a real Imperial Weapon.
What do I have to fear?” Lian Yutang charged over, the sword in his hand slashing repeatedly, Sword Qi soaring into the sky.
He still had his trump card, so he was filled with confidence.
Ling Han controlled the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to resist the Sword Qi.
Meanwhile, he brandished his fists and clashed head-on with Lian Yutang.
He was going to exhaust Lian Yutang to death no matter what.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
The battle continued, and after half a day, Lian Yutang’s battle prowess started to decline.
In such a fierce battle, his reserves of mystical power could no longer keep up.
On the other hand, Ling Han’s mystical power stores were the dimensions in his body.
It could be said that they were as vast as the universe, and there was absolutely no need to worry that it would be exhausted.
Lian Yutang also realized that Ling Han was far too freakish.
Not only was Ling Han’s physique even more freakish than his, but his mystical power was also endless and boundless.
If this continued, he would be exhausted to death.
He could only use his trump card!
“Ling Han, you forced me to do this,” he said balefully.
Boom!
A powerful aura suddenly surged from his body.
This wasn’t because he had ignited his Imperial Blood, but rather... because he had broken through!
Minor Advanced Tier, Sect Master!
Ling Han was astounded.
Breaking through here?
Could he do it?
Lian Yutang was a member of the Golden Generation, and Ling Han believed that he had the aptitude and ability to break through in battle.
However, this was the Mystery Realm, and the Regulations of heaven and earth were incomplete.
How could it be that Lian Yutang wasn’t affected?
However, sensing Lian Yutang’s aura, there was indeed an earth-shattering change.
It was definitely not something that a Spiritual Transformation Tier cultivator could compare to.
It could only be said that the Imperial Clan’s methods were nature-defying.
“Hahaha, there is no way that you would know.

I have long since had one foot into Sect Master Tier, but for the sake of pursuing perfection in Spirit Transformation Tier, I forcibly suppressed it.” Lian Yutang said proudly, “Thus, I can also advance into this cultivation level at any time, but after this, I will no longer be able to suppress it.”
This was the strength and background of the Imperial Clan.
If this were an ordinary person, this would be completely unimaginable.
The current him was already a Pseudo Sect Master, so he could completely activate the precious tool in his hand to unleash the true might of Sect Master-level.
How could Ling Han block this?
No matter how rare and precious the Origin Gold was, without being refined by an elite, it was ultimately unable to unleash its full might.
“Ling Han, do you... regret it now?” Lian Yutang asked, looking down at Ling Han with disdain.
The present him had indeed grasped an absolute advantage.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said to the little red bird, “We should leave.”

chapters.title: Chapter 4372: Banished Forever
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Leave?
‘What do you mean?’
Lian Yutang faltered upon hearing this. However, Ling Han, the little red bird, the large black dog, and the others all disappeared without a trace.
Now, he was the only one left standing all alone in the secret lair of the True Phoenix.
He was shocked, and then became anxious.
He was trapped here!
Now that he could unleash the battle prowess of a Sect Master, he should be invincible in this place, but what was the use?
Fight with the firebirds? Or fight with the fire turtle?

This was the Mystery Realm, and there was a shortage of Regulations. The reason why he could ascend to Sect Master-level was because he had long since entered into this cultivation level and forcibly exited. Thus, even if he advanced into the Minor Advanced Tier, there was no special requirement for the environment.
However, if one wanted to reach the level of Venerate Tier, they would definitely need the complete Regulations of heaven and earth.
If he was trapped here, he would only be able to hover around the level of Sect Master for the rest of his life, never to cross over to the next level.
“Ling Han, come out! Come out!” he shouted loudly.
However, only his echo reverberated in the surroundings.
Lian Yutang revealed a terrified expression. He had really been abandoned here. He was all alone, yet this kind of perception was even worse than killing him.

He was the Golden Generation, an existence that wanted to contend for the position of Emperor. Even if he died, he should have died on the Imperial Path, and not be trapped in this place, idling around and living out the rest of his life in a mediocre manner.
As Sect Master, he could live for about 40,000 years. Now, his long lifespan had only passed over a hundred years. The rest of his life was so long, and he had to spend it here?
He would go crazy. He would definitely go crazy.
“Ah, Ling Han, I’m going to tear you into pieces!”
“Come out, come out!”
“Let us have a vigorous battle. Do you dare?”
“Coward! Coward!”
However, the only response he received was an echo.
With Ling Han’s reminder, the little red bird teleported everyone out of the lair of the True Phoenix and into a remote galaxy.
Ling Han immediately took out the Void Beast hide, covering everyone inside.
“Banish this lair, and never let anyone find it again,” Ling Han said.
“All right,” the little red bird agreed happily. With a thought, this lair of the True Phoenix disappeared into the Void. Unless she took the initiative to summon it, it would never appear again.

—Either a Great Emperor would appear, and conduct a search in a specific location. It was also possible that they would find the lair of the True Phoenix. Aside from that, it was absolutely impossible.
“Haha, Cousin Lian is going to stay in the Mystery Realm forever just like that?” The large black dog couldn’t help but laugh.
“Who asked him to be so determined to kill our Little Han? It’s already good enough that we didn’t kill him,” the little azure dragon said in an old-fashioned manner.
“Sister-in-law, you’re not feeling resentment, are you?” The large black dog turned to look at Chi Menghan.

Chi Menghan smiled faintly. She was very clear about the process of Ling Han and Lian Yutang becoming enemies. Though Ling Han’s words were indeed very infuriating at times, if others didn’t trifle with him, he wouldn’t take the initiative to trifle with anyone either.
Thus, Lian Yutang had brought this upon himself.
Ling Han had the large black dog connect to the Galaxy Network and communicate with the Nine Mountains Saint to help them return.

It could be imagined that by now, everyone knew that the little red bird had obtained the inheritance of the True Phoenix. Thus, next, it would be the Imperial Clans that would not be able to hold back, and search everywhere for the little red bird, so that they could force out the secret of the inheritance of the True Phoenix.
True enough, after a few days, a Saint appeared, sweeping his powerful divine sense over the Void, searching for the whereabouts of Ling Han and the others.

If they were not too far away from each other, the hide of the Void Beast would definitely not be able to deceive the eyes or divine sense of a Saint. But now, the distance was really too far, and even Saints had their limitations.
Thus, the Saints came and went, one after another. None of them discovered Ling Han and the others.
On the seventeenth day, the Nine Mountains Saint finally arrived.
The old man waved his hand, and immediately brought Ling Han and the others back to Nine Suns Holy Land.
In this way, the trip to the lair of the True Phoenix could be considered to have concluded completely.
After learning of the fateful encounters of Ling Han and the others, the Nine Mountains Saint couldn’t help but sigh with emotion. Ling Han was truly a man of great fortune.

If it was not for the fact that he had entered into the Ancestral King Academy, he would not have been able to encounter the little red bird, and without the little red bird, it would be useless even if he entered into the lair of the True Phoenix. Everyone would only be trapped inside.
With this thought, everyone broke out in a cold sweat. They had almost been eternally trapped in the lair of the True Phoenix, just like Lian Yutang.
“Thank me!” The little red bird acted like a savior.
Peng!
The consequence of being too smug was naturally to be harshly taught a lesson.

However, the little red bird had also formed a strong friendship with Ling Han and the others, and very readily handed over the inheritance of the True Phoenix, sharing it with Ling Han and the others.
Imperial Technique, Phoenix Wings Divine Flight!

None of the first-generation Divine Beasts had the Imperial Scroll. They had been nurtured by heaven and earth, and lacked the experience of advancing step by step towards the strongest. Thus, they were also unable to leave behind the Imperial Scroll. For example, the fact that the True Dragon could create the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique was proof that he really lived up to the title of the strongest Divine Beast.

Everyone immediately began to cultivate. This could be said to be the strongest movement technique in the world. Even the Great Emperors of the past era all wanted to study it. After all, this was an ability bestowed by heaven and earth on the True Phoenix.
The Ancestral King was indeed powerful, but was he more powerful than the heavens?
If he was really stronger than the heavens, then wouldn’t the Ancestral King be able to live forever?

Ling Han handed the combined staff over to the Nine Mountains Saint and asked him to study it. This was a valuable item, and the little red bird naturally wouldn’t forget to take it with them when it teleported them away.

The Nine Mountains Saint agreed. He was already a Saint now, and had a very long life ahead of him. Furthermore, it would be extremely difficult for him to take another step further. He had a lot of time to study other things.
Moreover, comprehending by analogy might give him inspiration, right?
Ling Han immediately started to cultivate Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
This movement technique was extremely mysterious. Even with Ling Han’s comprehension ability, he was still unable to comprehend it in a short period of time.
Three months later, everyone did not make much progress. Even the genuine successor, the little red bird, had made very little progress.
“Let’s return to the Ancestral King Academy first,” Ling Han decided.

“Why?” the large black dog asked. “Aren’t you afraid that they’ll come and demand forcefully we hand over the inheritance of the True Phoenix? This is the secret technique of the Great Emperor, the strongest movement technique in the world. I’m sure that even if a Great Emperor appears, they’ll still be interested to read it.”

Ling Han smiled and said, “That’s indeed the case. However, as long as we don’t bring Little Red with us, it’s fine as long as we deny it. After all, we still have the old man’s intimidation, and added with the potential threat of Buddha Doga, I’m sure they won’t dare to do anything to us.”
“This is still a little risky,” the large black dog said.
“It can’t be helped. I have to get some cultivation resources.” Ling Han spread out his hands.
“Brat, you’re really going all out,” the large black dog said with a shake of his head.
After some discussion, they all agreed to return to the Ancestral King Academy.

If he wanted to eternally rid himself of the threat posed by the Imperial Clans, he could only improve his cultivation level as soon as possible, and the Ancestral King Academy was undoubtedly a very good choice. With Ling Han’s present battle prowess, he was already qualified to aim for the strongest of Spirit Transformation Tier.
Led by the Nine Mountains Saint, they soon returned to the Ancestral King Academy. Meanwhile, the little red bird stayed behind at the Nine Suns Holy Land.

chapters.title: Chapter 4373: Top of Spirit Transformation Tier
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han and the others entered the academy, attracting the attention of many people along the way.
Hiss, this guy still dared to return to the academy?
Not long after, a Venerate Tier appeared, and found Ling Han.
“Ling Han, hand over the inheritance of the True Phoenix.” This Venerate had the title of Heavenly Stone, and went straight to the point.
A Venerate Tier versus a Spirit Transformation Tier... was there any need to beat around the bush?

Ling Han pretended to be surprised, and said, “Senior Heavenly Stone, everyone knows that the inheritance of the True Phoenix was obtained by a little red bird. Why are you asking me for the inheritance of the True Phoenix?”
“Humph, aren’t you on the same side as it?” Venerate Heavenly Stone asked coldly.

Ling Han smiled and shook his head, saying, “Senior, you’re wrong to say this. We’re in the same group, so we should share it? Going by that logic, I’ll be able to force out the Imperial Technique and Imperial Scroll of your clan by simply capturing one of Senior Heavenly Stone’s clansmen?”
How was this possible!

The Imperial Technique, especially the Imperial Scroll, was the most core and most valuable inheritance of an Imperial Clan. Only the most core people could cultivate the Imperial Scroll, so how could any random person know it?
And what Ling Han said was precisely this logic. Even the Imperial Clans had such strict barriers, what more when he and the little red bird were not of the same race at all.

Venerate Heavenly Stone couldn’t help but feel stifled. Imperial Techniques were extremely valuable, especially when it was such an amazing technique like Phoenix Wings Divine Flight that even a Great Emperor wished to survey.
Who would teach it to outsiders?
“Then where’s the little red bird?” he asked.

Ling Han shook his head, and said, “I don’t know. I also want to find her! She ran off on her own after obtaining the True Phoenix inheritance. Who knows where she went to cultivate in seclusion. She’s so disloyal!”
‘You’re quite clean with your excuses!’

Venerate Heavenly Stone naturally didn’t believe Ling Han’s words. If it were any other person, he could have used torture to extract a confession, or even directly searched Ling Han’s soul. However, Ling Han was far too unique. He had a Saint standing behind him, and it was suspected that he also had a Pseudo-Emperor supporting him.
With such a background, who would dare to easily use force against Ling Han?

Unless he was absolutely certain that the inheritance of the True Phoenix was in Ling Han’s possession. Then, after he obtained it through interrogation, he would conceal his identity and roam the universe.
However, Ling Han’s words made some sense. The inheritance of the True Phoenix was extremely precious. If it was him, would he pass it on to those close to him?
Even if it was his own son.
“Humph!” With a flutter of his sleeve, he strode off.

After this Venerate Tier elite left, no other Venerate Tier elites came over to interrogate him. Presumably, when Venerate Heavenly Stone came, the other Venerate Tier elites were all watching from the shadows. If Ling Han handed over the inheritance of the True Phoenix, they would definitely jump out to share it.
However, Venerate Heavenly Stone had left empty-handed. If it were them, the situation wouldn’t change much, unless they were willing to go all out.
To throw everything on the line just for the slightest chance, they did not have such determination.
Soon, the monthly exam came again.
One cultivation level after another competed, and very soon, it was Ling Han’s turn.

With his current strength, he was naturally going to sweep aside all opposition in the knockout battles, and advance into the challenge group with an absolute advantage. Additionally, Origin had actually advanced into Spiritual Transformation Tier as well, and like Ding Shu , showed great might, similarly advancing into the challenge group.

After Ding Shu and Ling Han separated, Ding Shu also obtained a great opportunity. His cultivation level advanced rapidly, catching up to Ling Han. He similarly was Spirit Transformation Tier Sixth Change, and Origin was even more terrifyingly powerful. He was only a step behind, reaching Spirit Transformation Tier Fifth Change.
The challenge began.
Ling Han directly challenged Imperial Son Ze, who was ranked first.
“How dare you!” Imperial Son Ze smirked coldly, and slowly walked out. He crossed his arms behind his back, looking disdainfully at Ling Han.
“Enough with the nonsense. It’s better that you kneel down and proclaim your conquest,” Ling Han said as he lashed out at Imperial Son Ze.
The two of them battled fiercely, and very soon, powerful moves were used one after another. The situation immediately became tense and intense.
Everyone was watching in a daze.
How long had it been? Yet, Ling Han’s strength had already increased by such an astonishing amount.
In the lair of the True Phoenix, just how many natural treasures had this guy obtained? His improvement was practically soaring!

Imperial Son Ze’s battle prowess was truly no weaker than Ling Han’s. Moreover, the Golden Generation had also cultivated Body Art, and had continuous power with tough physique. Yet this was still not as awesome as Ling Han’s ability of neutralizing attacks within six Heavens of power.
In a head-on clash of blows, it wasn’t long before Imperial Son Ze fell into a disadvantage, throwing up blood continuously.
Everyone who saw this could not believe their eyes. Imperial Son Ze was from the Golden Generation.
What kind of concept was the Golden Generation?
Invincible among his peers!
But now? A Golden Generation was about to be defeated by Ling Han.
Did this signify that a new legendary star was about to rise?

After battling for a while longer, Imperial Son Ze could only helplessly admit defeat. Unless he broke through to Minor Advanced Tier, he would no longer be a match for Ling Han in this cultivation level.
Ling Han was ranked first!
Everyone was stunned for a long time. Just how long had passed? He had already defeated the Golden Generation?

Everyone frowned. If Ling Han was allowed to ascend to the throne, he would definitely settle the score. At that time, even if it was the Imperial Clans, so what? Would they be able to escape from this tribulation?
Ding Shu and Origin also shone brilliantly with iridescent light, taking third and fourth places respectively — the second place was still taken by Imperial Son Ze.
Everyone exclaimed in shock. Was a new era about to arrive?

A hundred years ago, the Golden Generation appeared out of nowhere, causing a great commotion. All the Imperial Clans were certain that their glory would rise to another level, breaking the curse that the Imperial Clan could not produce another Great Emperor,
But now, three great young prodigies had appeared, and it seemed like they all had the potential to surpass the Golden Generation.
Were they going to crush the Golden Generation into dust in this era that was rolling out?
Ling Han had obtained a large amount of cultivation resources, so he was naturally very happy.
As he refined these resources, he continued to cultivate Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
A month passed, and when Ling Han participated in the monthly exam again, he discovered that Imperial Son Ze was no longer here.
He had broken through to the level of Sect Master Tier.

Ling Han smiled. If it weren’t for him, Imperial Son Ze probably would have stayed in the Spiritual Transformation Tier for a while longer, cultivating his cultivation level to perfection as much as possible. However, after losing to Ling Han, he had probably felt humiliated, so he directly advanced into the Minor Advanced Tier.

However, it was also because he had defeated Imperial Son Ze that the Golden Generation was extremely displeased with him. They were a united force, and one of them had been defeated, which was a complete humiliation!
Yet Ling Han was completely unconcerned. If you can, come and bite me.

Ding Shu and Origin both issued challenges to him, but they were both easily defeated by him. He had once reached Ten Forms, and if one wanted to defeat him, even for freaks like Ding Shu and Origin, they would have to surpass him in terms of cultivation level.
A battle of equal cultivation levels?
Sorry, he was absolutely invincible.

One month after another, time passed very quickly. Ling Han kept occupying the throne of number one in the Spiritual Transformation Tier. A whole year had passed, and he had refined a great amount of cultivation resources, advancing into the Seventh Change.
And what made him the happiest was that he finally had a breakthrough in the cultivation of Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.

On a barren planet, Ling Han was presently advancing at a high speed. If he wanted to cultivate Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, he naturally could not possibly be seen by others. Otherwise, it would mean great trouble.
Boom, his figure actually sped up inconceivably, and the image of a fire phoenix appeared behind him, leaving behind endless flames.
