Hiss, this guy still dared to return to the academy?
Not long after, a Venerate Tier appeared, and found Ling Han.
“Ling Han, hand over the inheritance of the True Phoenix.” This Venerate had the title of Heavenly Stone, and went straight to the point.
A Venerate Tier versus a Spirit Transformation Tier... was there any need to beat around the bush?
Ling Han pretended to be surprised, and said, “Senior Heavenly Stone, everyone knows that the inheritance of the True Phoenix was obtained by a little red bird.
Why are you asking me for the inheritance of the True Phoenix?”
“Humph, aren’t you on the same side as it?” Venerate Heavenly Stone asked coldly.
Ling Han smiled and shook his head, saying, “Senior, you’re wrong to say this.
We’re in the same group, so we should share it?
Going by that logic, I’ll be able to force out the Imperial Technique and Imperial Scroll of your clan by simply capturing one of Senior Heavenly Stone’s clansmen?”
How was this possible!
The Imperial Technique, especially the Imperial Scroll, was the most core and most valuable inheritance of an Imperial Clan.
Only the most core people could cultivate the Imperial Scroll, so how could any random person know it?
And what Ling Han said was precisely this logic.
Even the Imperial Clans had such strict barriers, what more when he and the little red bird were not of the same race at all.
Venerate Heavenly Stone couldn’t help but feel stifled.
Imperial Techniques were extremely valuable, especially when it was such an amazing technique like Phoenix Wings Divine Flight that even a Great Emperor wished to survey.
Who would teach it to outsiders?
“Then where’s the little red bird?” he asked.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “I don’t know.
I also want to find her!
She ran off on her own after obtaining the True Phoenix inheritance.
Who knows where she went to cultivate in seclusion.
She’s so disloyal!”
‘You’re quite clean with your excuses!’
Venerate Heavenly Stone naturally didn’t believe Ling Han’s words.
If it were any other person, he could have used torture to extract a confession, or even directly searched Ling Han’s soul.
However, Ling Han was far too unique.
He had a Saint standing behind him, and it was suspected that he also had a Pseudo-Emperor supporting him.
With such a background, who would dare to easily use force against Ling Han?
Unless he was absolutely certain that the inheritance of the True Phoenix was in Ling Han’s possession.
Then, after he obtained it through interrogation, he would conceal his identity and roam the universe.
However, Ling Han’s words made some sense.
The inheritance of the True Phoenix was extremely precious.
If it was him, would he pass it on to those close to him?
Even if it was his own son.
“Humph!” With a flutter of his sleeve, he strode off.
After this Venerate Tier elite left, no other Venerate Tier elites came over to interrogate him.
Presumably, when Venerate Heavenly Stone came, the other Venerate Tier elites were all watching from the shadows.
If Ling Han handed over the inheritance of the True Phoenix, they would definitely jump out to share it.
However, Venerate Heavenly Stone had left empty-handed.
If it were them, the situation wouldn’t change much, unless they were willing to go all out.
To throw everything on the line just for the slightest chance, they did not have such determination.
Soon, the monthly exam came again.
One cultivation level after another competed, and very soon, it was Ling Han’s turn.
With his current strength, he was naturally going to sweep aside all opposition in the knockout battles, and advance into the challenge group with an absolute advantage.
Additionally, Origin had actually advanced into Spiritual Transformation Tier as well, and like Ding Shu , showed great might, similarly advancing into the challenge group.
After Ding Shu and Ling Han separated, Ding Shu also obtained a great opportunity.
His cultivation level advanced rapidly, catching up to Ling Han.
He similarly was Spirit Transformation Tier Sixth Change, and Origin was even more terrifyingly powerful.
He was only a step behind, reaching Spirit Transformation Tier Fifth Change.
The challenge began.
Ling Han directly challenged Imperial Son Ze, who was ranked first.
“How dare you!” Imperial Son Ze smirked coldly, and slowly walked out.
He crossed his arms behind his back, looking disdainfully at Ling Han.
“Enough with the nonsense.
It’s better that you kneel down and proclaim your conquest,” Ling Han said as he lashed out at Imperial Son Ze.
The two of them battled fiercely, and very soon, powerful moves were used one after another.
The situation immediately became tense and intense.
Everyone was watching in a daze.
How long had it been?
Yet, Ling Han’s strength had already increased by such an astonishing amount.
In the lair of the True Phoenix, just how many natural treasures had this guy obtained?
His improvement was practically soaring!
Imperial Son Ze’s battle prowess was truly no weaker than Ling Han’s.
Moreover, the Golden Generation had also cultivated Body Art, and had continuous power with tough physique.
Yet this was still not as awesome as Ling Han’s ability of neutralizing attacks within six Heavens of power.
In a head-on clash of blows, it wasn’t long before Imperial Son Ze fell into a disadvantage, throwing up blood continuously.
Everyone who saw this could not believe their eyes.
Imperial Son Ze was from the Golden Generation.
What kind of concept was the Golden Generation?
Invincible among his peers!
But now?
A Golden Generation was about to be defeated by Ling Han.
Did this signify that a new legendary star was about to rise?
After battling for a while longer, Imperial Son Ze could only helplessly admit defeat.
Unless he broke through to Minor Advanced Tier, he would no longer be a match for Ling Han in this cultivation level.
Ling Han was ranked first!
Everyone was stunned for a long time.
Just how long had passed?
He had already defeated the Golden Generation?
Everyone frowned.
If Ling Han was allowed to ascend to the throne, he would definitely settle the score.
At that time, even if it was the Imperial Clans, so what?
Would they be able to escape from this tribulation?
Ding Shu and Origin also shone brilliantly with iridescent light, taking third and fourth places respectively — the second place was still taken by Imperial Son Ze.
Everyone exclaimed in shock.
Was a new era about to arrive?
A hundred years ago, the Golden Generation appeared out of nowhere, causing a great commotion.
All the Imperial Clans were certain that their glory would rise to another level, breaking the curse that the Imperial Clan could not produce another Great Emperor,
But now, three great young prodigies had appeared, and it seemed like they all had the potential to surpass the Golden Generation.
Were they going to crush the Golden Generation into dust in this era that was rolling out?
Ling Han had obtained a large amount of cultivation resources, so he was naturally very happy.
As he refined these resources, he continued to cultivate Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
A month passed, and when Ling Han participated in the monthly exam again, he discovered that Imperial Son Ze was no longer here.
He had broken through to the level of Sect Master Tier.
Ling Han smiled.
If it weren’t for him, Imperial Son Ze probably would have stayed in the Spiritual Transformation Tier for a while longer, cultivating his cultivation level to perfection as much as possible.
However, after losing to Ling Han, he had probably felt humiliated, so he directly advanced into the Minor Advanced Tier.
However, it was also because he had defeated Imperial Son Ze that the Golden Generation was extremely displeased with him.
They were a united force, and one of them had been defeated, which was a complete humiliation!
Yet Ling Han was completely unconcerned.
If you can, come and bite me.
Ding Shu and Origin both issued challenges to him, but they were both easily defeated by him.
He had once reached Ten Forms, and if one wanted to defeat him, even for freaks like Ding Shu and Origin, they would have to surpass him in terms of cultivation level.
A battle of equal cultivation levels?
Sorry, he was absolutely invincible.
One month after another, time passed very quickly.
Ling Han kept occupying the throne of number one in the Spiritual Transformation Tier.
A whole year had passed, and he had refined a great amount of cultivation resources, advancing into the Seventh Change.
And what made him the happiest was that he finally had a breakthrough in the cultivation of Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
On a barren planet, Ling Han was presently advancing at a high speed.
If he wanted to cultivate Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, he naturally could not possibly be seen by others.
Otherwise, it would mean great trouble.
Boom, his figure actually sped up inconceivably, and the image of a fire phoenix appeared behind him, leaving behind endless flames.

chapters.title: Chapter 4374: Visitors from the Wolf Tribe
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han’s speed was already fast enough, but on this foundation, he had exploded ten times faster. What kind of concept was that?
Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, the world’s strongest movement technique.
Why was it that even the movement technique created by a Great Emperor couldn’t surpass it?

That was because the True Phoenix had been nurtured by heaven and earth. This was an ability that heaven and earth had bestowed on the True Phoenix. Just like how the True Dragon’s Body Art was naturally incomparable, and even a Great Emperor could not reach such heights.

Ling Han was clearly streaking through the skies, but his speed was so fast that it was as if he had teleported, appearing and disappearing in quick succession. If it was not for the fact that there was a brilliant flame left behind in the skies, one would not be able to tell that he was actually moving smoothly.
“As expected of the True Phoenix!”
Ling Han praised. Not only was his speed extraordinarily fast, but the flames that were left behind behind also had terrifying destructive power. It was not inferior to using his full strength.

It could be imagined that the True Phoenix had only needed to fly past at a high speed, and the flames would have been able to incinerate his enemies. There would have been no need for him to make another move.
Being able to stand side by side with the True Dragon, the True Phoenix was indeed outstanding.
“Now, I can only be considered to have just barely begun, and even if I continue to cultivate diligently, it is still impossible for me to reach the ultimate height.”

“Firstly, I’m not a True Phoenix, so I’m naturally limited. Secondly, it’s also because my cultivation level isn’t high enough. When I advance to Sect Master Tier, I’ll be able to break through to the next level and increase my speed again.”
Ling Han felt slightly regretful. This meant that even if he had reached the level of Great Emperor, he could not possibly possess the extreme speed that the True Phoenix had once possessed.
However, after a moment of disappointment, Ling Han became energized again.
If he became Emperor, then there would be no one in this world that could be his match. Would there still be anyone that could escape from his hands?
In this era, the Great Emperor was destined to be lonely.
Invincibility was also a kind of loneliness.
Ling Han returned to the Ancestral King Academy. Since he had already successfully cultivated Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, he was also thinking of going around somewhere.
Although he could also obtain a considerable amount of cultivation resources at the Ancestral King Academy, it was naturally incomparable to what he had obtained from the lair of the True Phoenix.
Thus, if such historical sites opened again, Ling Han was naturally willing to make a trip.
He searched on the Galaxy Network, but it seemed to have been especially peaceful recently. There was no news of such a thing happening anywhere, which made Ling Han feel very disappointed.

“If I stay here, I’ll need at least 10 years to reach the Ninth Change.” Ling Han counted on his fingers. “To my lifespan, this is really no big deal. However, a great era has already arrived, so perhaps I really can’t afford to miss out on these 10 years.”
However, there was no extra income to be made, so it was useless no matter how anxious he was.
Another month later, someone suddenly came to the Ancestral King Academy.
The Demon Wolf Imperial Clan!

A Saint had arrived, and there was also a Sect Master junior with him. He was only over 500 years old, and could be considered very young. His natural talent was astonishing, but in the case of the Ancestral King Academy, there were many hundred-year-old Sect Masters, and there were even Venerate Tier elites.
This junior’s name was Di Jia. He did not want to enter the Ancestral King Academy to become a disciple, but rather had other missions.

Ling Han was admiring the flowers in the courtyard. This was his daily routine. Cultivating the Dao of heaven and earth, he needed a heart that could accept the nature of heaven and earth. Unexpectedly, he felt a powerful pressure assault him.
Boom, in the courtyard, the trees, flowers, and grass, all the leaves wilted in an instant.
Ling Han frowned upon seeing this. He leaped up and stood atop the wall.
Outside, there was a grey-robed young man standing proudly. When he discovered that he had appeared, he immediately cast a baleful gaze filled with killing intent.
“Ling Han, I am Di Jia!” the young man said.
Ling Han humphed, and said, “Who cares who you are? Compensate me for my flowers!”
Di Jia faltered upon hearing this. ‘Are you stupid? Didn’t you realize that I’m at the level of Sect Master?’
He coughed and said, “I’m a Minor Advanced Tier!”
“So what?” Ling Han retorted.
Di Jia’s anger naturally rose. In the cultivation world, every gap of a major tier meant a world of difference.
“Humph, you are indeed as the legends say, having a stinky mouth!” he said balefully, and moved directly, grabbing out at Ling Han.
Boom! Even though he wasn’t the Imperial Son, just how powerful was the attack of the Sect Master?
He stretched out a hand, which seemed to have turned into a small mountain. Regulations were entwined around his fingers, which turned into multiple divine patterns.

Ling Han naturally wouldn’t fight him head-on. No matter how confident he was, there was no need for him to go head to head with a Sect Master when he was at the Spiritual Transformation Tier Seventh Change—no matter what, he had to wait until after Ninth Change to see if he was strong enough to stand against a Sect Master.
Boom, the large hand descended, and Ling Han’s courtyard was instantly shattered.
Di Ya withdrew his hand, and frowned. He could sense very clearly that he had not managed to smack Ling Han onto the ground.
Xiu, with a flash, Ling Han appeared once more.
He had used the Star Steps twice in a row. One time, he had left, and the other time, he had returned, so he naturally managed to dodge this attack from Di Jia.
This was not a sparring match, nor was it in a Mystery Realm like the lair of the True Phoenix. The Star Steps naturally could show its full might.
Astonishment flashed through his mind. Why was this Di Jia so insolent?

Firstly, this was the Ancestral King Academy, so there were still some rules that he had to adhere to. Secondly, the Nine Mountains Saint had already announced that if anyone dared to bully Ling Han with a higher cultivation level, he would bring the Imperial Weapon and pay them a visit.

Faced with this kind of threat, even the Imperial Clan elites would have to consider carefully. Then, even if Di Jia was rash, would the Saint from the Demon Race Imperial Clan not consider the consequences?
However, it just so happened that no one had stepped forward to stop him.

Could it be that... there were already members of Imperial Clans that were suspicious of the Nine Mountains Saint? This was a probe, so they had mobilized a clansman that was not too important like Di Jia.

Sigh, there was no concealing the truth. Ling Han knew that the fact that the Nine Mountains Saint didn’t actually have an Imperial Weapon would definitely be exposed, but the problem was that he hadn’t earned enough cultivation resources yet. It was really too early to expose the truth now.
“Ling Han, what tricks have you played, that you can actually affect the Imperial Son of our Clan!” Di Jia asked.
This was the mission of his trip, and that was to find out the truth behind how Di Luo was howling like a wolf and treated Ling Han as if he was his master.

To the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan, this was really too terrifying. It was equivalent to someone having hold of their lifeline. If even Saints would be affected, then wouldn’t the whole Imperial Clan have to bow down to Ling Han?
Thus, after much consideration, the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan finally decided to make a move on Ling Han. No matter what, they had to get to the bottom of this.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Are you talking about this thing?”
He took out the Great Emperor Horn, and spread it out in his hand.
“What is this thing?” Di Jia asked.
“You want to know?” Ling Han countered.
“Enough with the nonsense!” Di Jia said impatiently.

“All right, then I’ll let you know.” Ling Han blew the horn. Weng, a soundless ripple spread out, and instantly, Di Jia howled at the sky. His body uncontrollably sprawled out on the ground. Peng, his clothes were torn apart, and silver fur covered his entire body.
He transformed into his wolf form.
A conflicted look flashed across Di Jia’s eyes, but he still walked to Ling Han’s side. Sticking out his tongue, he licked the instep of Ling Han’s foot, as if he was a tame dog.
This crisis was easily resolved.

chapters.title: Chapter 4375: Demonic Mist Planet
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Hiss, higher-ups in the academy were secretly observing them, and they were all stunned upon seeing this scene.
What was going on?
He had only blown a horn, and Di Jia was as obedient as a dog?
There were a few Venerate Tiers that were burning with desire. If they could obtain this treasure, would they be able to command the entire Demon Wolf Imperial Clan?

With this in mind, they all felt an urge to charge out and snatch the treasure. However, they also recalled that if they had made a mistake in their estimation, and this would not affect the Saint at all, then, how badly would they be beaten by that Saint from the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan?
The Saint of the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan, Xuan Mo, also frowned slightly.
Should he step out?
He had reservations in his heart. If he was also affected, then it would be a big joke. The entire Demon Wolf Imperial Clan would be facing a great crisis.
At that time, it was very likely that the other Imperial Clans would also be fighting over this opportunity. The temptation of being able to control an Imperial Clan was far too great.
What did this signify?
They could obtain all the wealth of the other Imperial Clan, including the Imperial Scroll, the Imperial Technique, the Imperial Weapon, as well as endless resources.
Which Imperial Clan was capable of resisting this kind of temptation?
Even if they had reservations, they could only snatch the treasure and not kill anyone. How could it be that the Nine Mountains Saint and Buddha Doga would make a move because of this?
It was precisely because of such scruples that Saint Xuan Mo did not make a move. It was not that he was not resolute enough, but rather the consequences were really too serious.
“Here, go and play with the bone.” Ling Han tossed out the remaining chicken drumstick bone that he had eaten. Di Jia’s wolf form immediately pounced over, biting on the bone as it did so.
There was a strong fury and defiance in his eyes, but an instinctive obedience made it impossible for him to resist.
Ling Han called someone over to renovate the courtyard.
For cultivators, building a side courtyard was extremely easy.
Ling Han looked calm on the surface, but internally, alarm bells were already ringing loudly.

He had indeed survived this crisis, but it was obvious that the Imperial Clan would not spare him. That was because of the Great Emperor Horn in his hands. They would definitely probe him in every way possible. Next time, it would probably be a Venerate Tier.

As long as it was proven that a Venerate Tier elite would not be affected, or had a certain amount of resistance, the Saint of that clan would definitely make a move. They could not possibly allow this treasure that had such a great influence on the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan to fall into the hands of an outsider.

The Nine Mountains Saint definitely couldn’t make a move. He knew very well that the old man was truly a paper tiger. He was only a One Star Saint, and without an Imperial Weapon, how could he do anything?
At that time, the members of the Imperial Clans would all reveal twisted expressions.
Sigh!
Ling Han had the intention to leave. It was time for him to leave. If he stayed any longer, it would be too dangerous.
However, even if he left, he couldn’t leave in a panic. That would be a sign of guilt. Instead, it would speed up the Imperial Clans’ attack.

Now, even if there were suspicions, they would only be suspicions. There would always be misgivings like this and that. Moreover, the threat of Buddha Doga was genuine. He was a Pseudo-Emperor; what Imperial Clan would dare to face this kind of threat?
Ling Han immediately took action, informing the empress, the large black dog and the others. They really didn’t have much time left in the Ancestral King Academy.
He would find a chance to leave.

They had to let nature take its course. Otherwise, the academy would definitely think that they were fleeing for their lives. Then, with furhter thought, the truth of the matter would undoubtedly be exposed.
And this opportunity had really been encountered by them.
In the distant galaxy, a planet appeared out of thin air!
Was it a newly born planet?
No.

This was a planet that had existed for a long time. It was covered densely with vegetation. Some people easily found high-level Celestial medicines, and there was also a large number of fierce beasts. Their abilities varied greatly.
What was going on?
Had this planet been here all this while, just that it had not manifested previously? Or had it suddenly teleported here from somewhere else?
No one could answer this question. The answer might be on this planet, or it might never be found, because the ferocious beasts had not developed intelligence, so how could they answer?

But no matter what, this was a resource planet, and its grade was not low either. Taking advantage of the fact that no great force had announced that they were taking possession of it yet, various minor cultivators all moved out, wanting to get a share of the loot. If they could find a Great Herb, they would be rich.

Ling Han was already in Spirit Transformation Tier, so the requirement for the quality of the Celestial medicine was naturally extraordinarily high. He did not think that an ordinary resource planet could be of any help to him, but this was a reason for him to leave the academy in broad daylight.
Thus, he made some arrangements, and everyone set out on their way.
This did not arouse the suspicion of the Academy, because there were a great many disciples that had set out on their journey, and it was not just Ling Han and the others.
This group included Ling Han, the empress, Hu Niu, the large black dog, the little azure dragon, the perverted pig, and the seven babies. As for Ding Shu and Chi Menghan, Ling Han didn’t invite them.
That was because the two of them could completely stay in the academy, and would not have to be burdened by him.
Especially Chi Menghan, who was the daughter of an Imperial Clan. How could it be that she had to worry about other Imperial Clans harming her?

On the other hand, Lian Yutang’s disappearance caused a great commotion in theacademy. Someone had once suspected that Ling Han had assassinated him. After all, he had already proven his strength, and even Imperial Son Ze had been defeated.
However, Lian Yutang’s life token hadn’t shattered, which meant that he was still alive. Then, it should have nothing to do with Ling Han, right?
He was probably hiding somewhere to cultivate, waiting to return to amaze the world with a single feat.
Yet Ling Han knew that Lian Yutang would never be able to return.
Unless he committed suicide, this guy would have to spend about 40,000 years in the lair of the True Phoenix.

Halfway there, the empress, Hu Niu, and the babies turned towards the Nine Suns Holy Land. Ling Han, the little dragon, and the large black dog continued to head towards that newly appeared planet. Perhaps their gains wouldn’t be great, but there was no harm, so they might as well go and take a look.
This planet was named the Demonic Mist Planet, because there was a fog that enshrouded a certain part of this planet all year round. Up until now, no one had been able to enter or exit alive.
Aside from that, this planet was still quite safe.

After a month of intergalactic teleportation, they finally arrived at the Demonic Mist Planet. However, there was no Transfer Formation set up here yet, so they could only board a warship after arriving at a nearby planet.
Of course, there was no need for a Sect Master to go to so much trouble. He could directly tear a rip into the Void and arrive directly.
This made Ling Han very envious. To say nothing of convenience, the key was that he could save money. Did one think that the formation foundations were free?
Now, this planet was very lively, and as more and more news spread out, more and more cultivators came.
On the third day after Ling Han and the others came here, a huge piece of news appeared on the Galaxy Network.
Someone had discovered a Saintly medicine!
This was the Saintly medicine. There were not many such Great Herbs in the whole universe, and only the top grade mother tree could nurture such a Great Herb.

But since it was a Saintly medicine, it was naturally extraordinary. According to eyewitnesses, he had discovered this Saintly medicine near the demonic mist. It had taken the form of a white-bearded old man, and was presently inhaling and exhaling Earth Qi. After it was discovered, it immediately turned into a pony and fled.
Because the demonic mist was too dangerous, that person did not give chase.

Hiss, higher-ups in the academy were secretly observing them, and they were all stunned upon seeing this scene.
What was going on?
He had only blown a horn, and Di Jia was as obedient as a dog?
There were a few Venerate Tiers that were burning with desire.
If they could obtain this treasure, would they be able to command the entire Demon Wolf Imperial Clan?
With this in mind, they all felt an urge to charge out and snatch the treasure.

However, they also recalled that if they had made a mistake in their estimation, and this would not affect the Saint at all, then, how badly would they be beaten by that Saint from the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan?
The Saint of the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan, Xuan Mo, also frowned slightly.
Should he step out?
He had reservations in his heart.
If he was also affected, then it would be a big joke.
The entire Demon Wolf Imperial Clan would be facing a great crisis.
At that time, it was very likely that the other Imperial Clans would also be fighting over this opportunity.
The temptation of being able to control an Imperial Clan was far too great.
What did this signify?
They could obtain all the wealth of the other Imperial Clan, including the Imperial Scroll, the Imperial Technique, the Imperial Weapon, as well as endless resources.
Which Imperial Clan was capable of resisting this kind of temptation?
Even if they had reservations, they could only snatch the treasure and not kill anyone.
How could it be that the Nine Mountains Saint and Buddha Doga would make a move because of this?
It was precisely because of such scruples that Saint Xuan Mo did not make a move.
It was not that he was not resolute enough, but rather the consequences were really too serious.
“Here, go and play with the bone.” Ling Han tossed out the remaining chicken drumstick bone that he had eaten.
Di Jia’s wolf form immediately pounced over, biting on the bone as it did so.
There was a strong fury and defiance in his eyes, but an instinctive obedience made it impossible for him to resist.
Ling Han called someone over to renovate the courtyard.
For cultivators, building a side courtyard was extremely easy.
Ling Han looked calm on the surface, but internally, alarm bells were already ringing loudly.
He had indeed survived this crisis, but it was obvious that the Imperial Clan would not spare him.
That was because of the Great Emperor Horn in his hands.
They would definitely probe him in every way possible.
Next time, it would probably be a Venerate Tier.
As long as it was proven that a Venerate Tier elite would not be affected, or had a certain amount of resistance, the Saint of that clan would definitely make a move.
They could not possibly allow this treasure that had such a great influence on the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan to fall into the hands of an outsider.

He knew very well that the old man was truly a paper tiger.
He was only a One Star Saint, and without an Imperial Weapon, how could he do anything?
At that time, the members of the Imperial Clans would all reveal twisted expressions.
Sigh!

It was time for him to leave.
If he stayed any longer, it would be too dangerous.
However, even if he left, he couldn’t leave in a panic.
That would be a sign of guilt.
Instead, it would speed up the Imperial Clans’ attack.
Now, even if there were suspicions, they would only be suspicions.
There would always be misgivings like this and that.
Moreover, the threat of Buddha Doga was genuine.
He was a Pseudo-Emperor; what Imperial Clan would dare to face this kind of threat?
Ling Han immediately took action, informing the empress, the large black dog and the others.
They really didn’t have much time left in the Ancestral King Academy.
He would find a chance to leave.
They had to let nature take its course.
Otherwise, the academy would definitely think that they were fleeing for their lives.

And this opportunity had really been encountered by them.

Was it a newly born planet?
No.
This was a planet that had existed for a long time.
It was covered densely with vegetation.
Some people easily found high-level Celestial medicines, and there was also a large number of fierce beasts.
Their abilities varied greatly.

Had this planet been here all this while, just that it had not manifested previously?
Or had it suddenly teleported here from somewhere else?
No one could answer this question.
The answer might be on this planet, or it might never be found, because the ferocious beasts had not developed intelligence, so how could they answer?

chapters.title: Chapter 4376 Saintly medicine
paragraphs: When the news spread out, everyone was excited.
A Saint-level Great Herb, what kind of concept was that?

Saints would also be tempted, and if a Venerate Tier managed to obtain it, he may be able to break through the restriction on his cultivation level, and thus break through to Saint Tier in a single stroke.
There was even less need to mention the others. As long as they could eat a small piece, their improvement would be measured in leaps and bounds.
Instantly, a considerable number of people headed in the direction of the demonic mist.

Ling Han was also very surprised. He had come out this time mainly for the purpose of fleeing, and to earn some extra resources while he was at it. He had not thought that a Great Herb would actually appear here.
"Little Han!" The azure dragon and large black dog looked over, their eyes burning brightly.
Ling Han nodded, "Let's go and take a look, but it is best to be careful. After all, Saintly medicine has appeared, which would draw out Saints. Our abilities are really not enough."
"We still need to change our appearance," the little azure dragon said.
"What is it? Do you have too many enemies? Are you afraid of being hacked to death?" the large black dog teased.
The little azure dragon sneered, "Those who hope to kill you and eat your dog meat are definitely ten times more than Grandpa Dragon's enemies."
"Four-Legged Snake, your skill of speech has improved!" the large black dog said with a smile.
"Naturally."
The two of them started to bicker again. Ling Han shook his head, and said, "Disguise is fine; it can save us some trouble."
Di Jia moved. Though Ling Han had perfectly resolved the matter of his assault, the Nine Mountains Saint did not have any reaction at all. This naturally would cause suspicion.
Was it because Ling Han hadn't suffered any losses, so he couldn't be bothered to make a move? Or was it that the Nine Mountains Saint didn't have an Imperial Weapon in his possession?

These Imperial Clans all saw very clearly that the Nine Mountains Saint had never used the Imperial Weapon in the Mountain Sea Heaven. He would always use all kinds of excuses to avoid using it. Thus, once the number of times increased, it was naturally inevitable that it would draw suspicion.
That was why the Demon Wolf Imperial Clan had probed him. Firstly, it was because of the Great Emperor Horn in Ling Han's hand, and secondly, it was because they suspected the Nine Mountains Saint.
Under such circumstances, Ling Han didn't dare to bet on the reactions of the Imperial Clans.

In a battle of equal cultivation levels, or even against a Sect Master-level opponent, he could use the Star Steps to save his life. However, in the case of a Saint... he didn't have any confidence at all. A Saint was far too powerful.
Seeing that Ling Han had already agreed, the large black dog naturally wouldn't object anymore. The three of them changed their appearances one after another.

Ling Han and the little azure dragon were relatively normal. They were both youngsters who looked to be in their twenties. The large black dog was even more exaggerated. He looked like an extremely vulgar middle-aged man. One look and one could tell that he didn't look like a good person.
"As expected, a natural villain," the little azure dragon took the opportunity to tease him, "Old BLack, no wonder you rarely take human form. As it turned out, it is because you look too vulgar."
"Go to hell!" The large black dog humphed, "You have no taste!"
"All right, let's set out."
Ling Han interrupted the bickering of these two jokers, and the three of them set out, heading towards the area where the demonic mist was located.
This planet was very big, but Ling Han had already grasped the ley lines here. Thus, as he used the Star Steps, he soon arrived with the large black dog and the little azure dragon.
The area affected by the demonic mist was very large. Ling Han brought the little azure dragon and the large black dog to the border, but didn't dare to barge in rashly.
Even though this area was huge, there were still more people rushing over. In this place, Ling Han could still see a few people, though they were sparse and few in number.

Ling Han sensed for a while, but whether it was his divine sense or the ley lines, they all came to an abrupt stop when they arrived here. It was as if they had been cut by someone. After entering into the demonic mist, everything had been severed.

It should be known that he was presently in the Spiritual Transformation Tier. No matter where he was, he could be considered an elite, but he could not sense anything at all inside the demonic mist. Hiss, what level was this demonic mist?
As time passed, more and more people ran over, which also caused more and more people to gather in the vicinity.
Everyone knew that the demonic mist was extremely dangerous, so no one dared to take the risk of barging in.
Since this Saintly medicine had come out, they were sure that it would come out again.
They just had to wait for it.

Even if it was a Saintly medicine, it could not possibly have much battle prowess. Even a Foundation Building Tier cultivator could easily deal with it. The problem was that the Saintly medicine ran very fast, and that was the real difficulty.
Thus, everyone found a place to hide, planning to launch a sneak attack on the Saintly medicine.

After waiting for a long time, Ling Han and the others didn't discover anything. On the other hand, on the fifth day, they heard the people beside them say that the Saintly medicinehad really walked out of the demonic mist. However, after being attacked, it ran extremely quickly, and instantly fled into the demonic mist.
Some people could not hold back their greed, and rushed into the demonic mist, wanting to pursue the Saintly medicine, but in the end, they did not come out again.
Meanwhile, Ling Han continued to observe the demonic mist. Just what in the world was this?
Why could one be lost within? Or perhaps, there was some terrifying existence here that had swallowed all those who entered?
However, he did not manage to come up with anything.

"I wonder if the old man will come over?" Ling Han asked. To the Nine Mountains Saint, the effects of the Saintly medicine were immense. It was extremely likely that it would push him to the level of two stars, or even three stars.

Most importantly, the staff that he had previously obtained from the lair of the True Phoenix was also with the old man, and there was a mysterious bead in the staff. It had the effect of resisting the natural power of heaven and earth, and it was unknown whether it would have extraordinary effects here.
"If the old man gets the news, he should come over." The large black dog thought for a moment.
"En, let's get in touch with the old man."

They connected to the Galaxy Network, but were temporarily unable to contact the Nine Mountains Saint. The old man was either in seclusion, or hurrying through the Void, so he was unable to connect to the Galaxy Network.

After a few days, more and more elites arrived. The great elites of Sect Master and Venerate Tier all arrived, especially the Venerate Tier elites. Quite a few of them couldn't hold back and drew their Spirit Tools, forcefully barging into the area of the demonic mist.
They had to hurry. Otherwise, when the Saints arrived, would they still have a share of the Saintly medicine?
However, Venerate Tier elites entering would only lead to one result—no return.
This stunned everyone. Could it be that another deadly zone was about to appear?
Ling Han, meanwhile, felt a sense of deja vu, and couldn't help but think of the Yin River in the Dark Clouds Hell, as well as that sea of blood.
Hiss, could it be that there was also an incredible existence inside?
However, if such a being existed, why didn't they harvest the Saintly medicine?
"Let's walk around somewhere else first," Ling Han said.

At present, they were unable to enter into the area of the demonic mist, so they could only wait aimlessly here. They might as well go and try their luck. After all, this was a great planet that had suddenly appeared, and great opportunities were everywhere.

The three of them roamed around. Setting aside the area of demonic mist, it was still very safe here. The wild beasts that rampaged were mostly True Self Tier, and there were very few that were Spiritual Transformation Tier, and Sect Masters were even rarer.

Thus, Ling Han and the others were powerful enough to sweep aside all opposition. In just a few days, they had already obtained a considerable number of Celestial medicines. However, their grade wasn't very high.
In the blink of an eye, another seven days had passed, and finally, a Saint had arrived.

This was the leader of a Holy Land. He had just advanced into this level, and was respectfully called the Azure Wood Saint. The moment he appeared, he directly headed towards the demonic mist. He held a jade porcelain bottle in his hand, and there was a willow in it.

chapters.title: Chapter 4377 Saint suffers losses
paragraphs: The Azure Wood Saint took a step, and a green light surged out, turning into a streak of great dao that headed into the demonic mist.

This great dao of green light was incredibly sacred. Even the demonic mist could not suppress it. It could be clearly seen that there were rocks and trees in the demonic mist. That was not a desolate area.
"If Saint Master makes a move, the Saintly medicine will definitely fall into the hands of Saint Master."
"Aren't you guys going to disperse?"
"Let's go, let's go."
A dozen or so disciples arrived with the Azure Wood Saint. They were filled with confidence in their Saint, and looked down at the surrounding people.
Indeed, they had the backing of a Saint, so they were qualified to be so arrogant.
When Ling Han and the others heard that a Saint had come, they also rushed over to watch the excitement. They just happened to witness the arrogant scene of these juniors.

Most people remained silent, not bothering to drop down to their level. However, there were also some who wore expressions of disdain. It wasn't them that were awesome, so what was there to be proud of?
"What is it? Are you dissatisfied?" A disciple of the Azure Wood Sect suddenly walked in front of Ling Han and questioned him.
Yi, where had this sudden calamity come from?
Ling Han couldn't help but feel startled. Who had he offended?
Oh, he understood now.
These people from the Azure Wood Sect wanted to establish their might, and it was probably because of his poor standing that he had become the target of their might.
He shook his head. This was really an undeserved calamity.
"Are you deaf or mute?" That disciple was overbearing, and completely unreasonable.
He wanted to be as arrogant as possible. The Azure Wood Sect had a Saint in their ranks, so they were completely capable of being as domineering as this.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "To a Saint, I am naturally impressed. However, to you guys, hoho."
"What is the meaning of this?" That disciple humphed, "To look down on us is equivalent to looking down on Saint Master!"
The large black dog couldn't help but laugh in spite of himself, "You really dare to flatter yourself. Even you can represent a Saint?"
"You're seeking death!" The disciples of the Azure Wood Sect all walked over and surrounded Ling Han and the others.

It should be known that the Azure Wood Saint had only been Venerate Azure Wood Tier five years ago. Thus, having advanced from Venerate Tier to Saint Tier, the disciples of the Azure Wood Sect wanted nothing more than to show off their awesomeness in front of the whole world.
The Saintly medicine this time was just right. They could use this opportunity to publicize the Azure Wood Sect.
The three people in front of them were the best targets.
"Little Han, you truly have a halo of trouble," the large black dog delighted in his misfortune.
The little azure dragon also laughed loudly. This was a rare opportunity to tease Ling Han, so it naturally couldn't be missed.

Ling Han felt a little gloomy. This time, he really hadn't wanted to attract any animosity. He had only come to take a look at the situation of the Saint challenging the demonic mist, so why had he been targeted for no reason?
"Are you guys... sick?" he asked kindly. "If you're sick, hurry up and treat it. Don't drag it out, it'll harm others and yourself!"
"You f!" A disciple was immediately angered, and waved a hand to deliver a palm strike at Ling Han.
Boom, he should be a proud heir of the Azure Wood Sect. At such a young age, he was already a True Self Tier. He shot out a palm strike, his momentum vast and mighty.

"Watch Grandpa Dragon's Divine Dragon Tail Slash!" The little azure dragon was the first to move. Peng, a kick landed on the disciple's lower abdomen, and the disciple was sent flying like a cannonball.
Thankfully, the direction he flew out of was not in the area of the demonic mist. Otherwise, he probably would not have the chance to come out.
Even so, when this disciple fell onto the ground, his eyes closed, and he had passed out.
"Eldest Senior Brother!" The disciples of the Azure Wood Sect all called out, their faces filled with shock.
However, there was also a middle-aged man with baleful eyes that swept over Ling Han and the others.
This was a powerful Sect Master elite.
"How dare you hurt a disciple of our Azure Wood Sect!" This man said coldly. Sect Master-level aura fluctuated, and the air instantly seemed to boil, rippling out in waves.
"Reflect on yourself. Is it really good to be so arrogant?" Ling Han shook his head, "Even the Imperial Son would be killed, what more you guys."

However, the Saint-level elite who had been radiating with brilliance just now was now in an extremely sorry state. His hair was completely disheveled, and there was even a green-coloured handprint on his neck, but looking at the length of those five fingers, it did not look like something a normal person should have at all!
The willow in the porcelain vial that he was holding had also been broken in half. Its branches were drooping, and it was on the verge of death.

Not only that, but the Saint's clothes were also torn and tattered. It was as if he had just experienced a great battle. Furthermore, it was the kind of street brawl that involved hooligans. They would pull at his clothes around and beat him up, and that was why his clothes were torn.
"Saint Master!" the disciples of the Azure Wood Sect exclaimed in astonishment upon seeing the miserable state of the Azure Wood Saint.
They all knew that the porcelain vial that this Saint had held was a Saint Tool, yet half of the Saint Tool had already been destroyed. Just how terrifying was this?
Ling Han activated his eye technique, and saw even more than the others. He saw that there was shockingly a layer of black substance entwined around this Saint.
Was it the demonic mist?
In any case, Ling Han only took a glance at it, and felt so disgusted that he would never want to be touched by this thing again.
"Saint Master, what happened?" they all asked.
This was too terrifying, wasn't it? Now that there was no Emperor in this world, shouldn't Saints be the strongest?
Even their Saint had been wounded, so the members of the Azure Wood Sect naturally couldn't care less about Ling Han anymore. They all surrounded the Azure Wood Saint.
"Saint Master, what happened?" they all asked.
This was too terrifying, wasn't it? Now that there was no Emperor in this world, shouldn't Saints be the strongest?
But now, this confidence and superiority of theirs had been dealt a heavy blow, so it was naturally inevitable that a powerful panic would rise up in them.
The Azure Wood Saint did not speak. He merely stared at the area of demonic mist, his eyes filled with confusion and bafflement, as well as a sliver of indescribable fear.
"Let's go!" he said darkly, not bothering to explain at all.
"But, Saint Master—" All the disciples were surprised. Yi, hadn't they agreed to make use of this opportunity to spread the name of the Azure Wood Sect? Why had he given up just like that?
"En?" The Azure Wood Saint's eyes swept over them. Since the Saint had spoken, who would dare have any objections?
Instantly, everyone fell silent out of fear.
This Saint directly tore a rip into the Void, and led everyone away. He left very resolutely.
Seeing this scene, a great many people inhaled sharply.
What was going on here? Even a Saint had been scared off?

At present, the Azure Wood Saint was the only one who had managed to walk out alive after entering into the demonic mist. As expected of a Saint. He was really kickass. But what exactly had this Saint experienced? What kind of being had fought with him, causing this Saint to be in such a sorry state? Furthermore, he had left without a second thought. He did not even want the Saintly medicine anymore?
A great many people had dismissed the idea of obtaining the Saintly medicine. Even a Saint had returned in defeat. If they still did not dismiss this idea, wouldn't that be courting death?
At this moment, a message suddenly came from the large black dog's Galaxy Network connection device.
The Nine Mountains Saint had arrived.
"Come, let's go and meet the old man first." Ling Han and the others immediately set out, meeting up with the Nine Mountains Saint, before they made further plans.
At the same time, more Saints also appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 4378 Joint efforts
paragraphs: Ling Han and the others successfully reunited with the Nine Mountains Saint.
The Nine Mountains Saint frowned upon hearing them relate the present situation.

In terms of abilities, he should be stronger than the Azure Wood Saint. Firstly, he had advanced earlier, and secondly, he had cultivated the Imperial Scroll. However, with both of them being One Star Saints, the gap between them would not be too big.
Thus, he wouldn't be much better off than the Azure Wood Saint after entering the demonic mist zone.
"What about using the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower?" Ling Han asked.
The Nine Mountains Saint didn't know either.

If the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was an Imperial Weapon, then being activated by a Saint should be enough to protect them, and if it completely revived, it would be equivalent to a Great Emperor coming back to life, so they would naturally be unafraid of all enemies in the world.
Unfortunately, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower wasn't a real Imperial Weapon. It was only forged from Origin Gold, and there was still a large difference between the two.

"Oh, that's right," the Nine Mountains Saint said as he retrieved his staff. "I've already found out that the orb here is a natural treasure. It's called the Formless Pearl, and it's nurtured by heaven and earth. It can avoid all natural damage in the world."
"Of course, there is still an upper limit to this. It can only be Saint Tier."

Ling Han and the others all nodded. This was only normal. Otherwise, a Great Emperor would definitely snatch it at all costs. Then, when they went to the edge of the universe to seek the art of immortality, their chances of success would naturally be greatly increased.
In the case of Saints, they would be completely useless against this demonic mist, because even Saints would suffer misfortune.

"Take it." The Nine Mountains Saint handed the staff over to Ling Han. Firstly, this was Ling Han's staff in the first place, and he was only examining it on Ling Han's behalf. Secondly, he also had a Saint Tool in his possession, so wielding two Saint Tools might not increase his battle prowess much.
Ling Han didn't stand on ceremony and put the staff away.

This was a Saint Tool, and even if it couldn't unleash saintly might in his hands, it should be no problem for it to reach the level of Pseudo Sect Master. Moreover, after he advanced into the level of Sect Master, he should be able to unleash power on the level of Pseudo Venerate Tier.
Trump card, trump card.
"Then we can only try using the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower," Ling Han said.
The Nine Mountains Saint nodded as he accepted the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.

The Saintly medicine was really too valuable. Even with his temperament, he could not possibly say no so easily. No matter what, he had to give it a try. Whether he succeeded or not, he naturally would not have any regrets. Otherwise, every time he thought of it in future, he might be filled with regret. Why had he not persisted in the past?
He was just about to move, when he was startled, and looked towards his left.
Ling Han and the others also looked over, but they didn't see anything.
However, after only a while, the space was suddenly torn apart by a large hand, and an imposing old man walked out.
This elder stepped out, and there were three young people following behind him. They were two men and one woman, and they were all brimming with heroic spirit, exuding a captivating brilliance.
"Friend Nine Mountains!" The elder smiled, and nodded at the Nine Mountains Saint.
"Friend Black Flames." The Nine Mountains Saint also nodded.
Black Flames Saint!
Ling Han's eyes swept over them, and a smile appeared at the corners of his lips, because he recognized one of these three young people.
Niu Tengfei.

He was the Imperial Son of the Demon Ox Imperial Clan, and he had been beaten up by him before. However, because he had changed his appearance, the Imperial Son had not recognized him. Otherwise, Niu Tengfei's expression would probably be very awkward at this moment.
"Friend, have you just arrived?" the Black Flames Saint asked.
"Yes, I just arrived," the Nine Mountains Saint said. "Should we team up?"

"Sure," the Black Flames Saint said with a nod. He had seen very clearly that the Nine Mountains Saint had already unleashed his "Imperial Weapon". Although he hadn't released it, the might that radiated from it was clearly Emperor Tier-level.

This demonic mist was extremely strange, and it had already caused a Saint to return in defeat. Thus, he was naturally happy to team up with the Nine Mountains Saint. With two Imperial Weapons, was there anything in this world that couldn't be resolved?
Who said that the Imperial Weapon of the Nine Mountains Saint was fake?

This demonic mist was extremely strange, and it had already caused a Saint to return in defeat. Thus, he was naturally happy to team up with the Nine Mountains Saint. With two Imperial Weapons, was there anything in this world that couldn't be resolved?
The two Saints conversed, and Ling Han and the others also "met" Niu Tengfei and the others.
Aside from Niu Tengfei, the other two naturally belonged to the Demon Ox Imperial Clan. They were Niu Zhengzhi and Niu Feixu, while Ling Han and the others each gave a false name.
Niu Tengfei kept glancing at Ling Han, because he kept feeling that Ling Han looked familiar.

It had to be admitted that an Imperial Son's instincts were quite amazing, but for the moment, he still did not think of Ling Han. That was because the Nine Mountains Saint was just beside him, so what was there to be afraid of?
The two Saints unleashed their Imperial Weapon, which hovered above their heads and exuded a precious aura that protected them and the six juniors.

"Friend, this Imperial Weapon of yours is truly extraordinary," the Black Flames Saint praised. He naturally knew what it was. The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower exuded Primal Chaos Qi, while the tower was entwined with supreme lightning.
Getting one of the two was already terrifying enough, what more when it was a combination of both?
He was naturally fishing for information. How could a Saint-level force possibly possess an Imperial Weapon?
The Nine Mountains Saint merely smiled faintly, and did not reply.

He was a Saint, and he was more than powerful enough to unleash the might of the Origin Gold. Thus, as long as he didn't engage in battle, it would be extremely difficult for Saints to detect what was off about it.
The eight of them walked into the demonic mist. Even a Saint didn't dare to walk too fast.

This demonic mist was truly dense. Even the brilliance exuded by the Imperial Weapons could only penetrate a distance of about 30 meters. If one went any further, they would be enshrouded in fog, and would not be able to see anything clearly.
The environment was very oppressive. It was incredibly dark, and it was definitely difficult to feel happy.
"Yi?" The two Saints both exclaimed in shock, and then sped up slightly.
After walking for more than 30 meters, they saw a corpse lying on the ground.
Ling Han couldn't help but sigh internally. Saints were Saints, after all. His divine sense and vision had been completely limited to a range of 30 meters, and Saints could break through this limit.
With this thought in mind, he immediately turned his attention to the corpse in front of him.
This was actually a complete corpse, but it was even more terrifying than a shattered corpse.
—This corpse was covered with black palm imprints. The palm was normal size, but the fingers were astonishingly long, at least three times the size of the palm. This appeared very strange.
"His physical body is practically unharmed, but his mind has been obliterated," the Black Flames Saint replied.
The Nine Mountains Saint nodded in agreement. This was the conclusion that the two Saints had reached together, and the authority of their answer was naturally unquestionable.
However, this couldn't explain the black palm print.
Just what kind of existence did this belong to?

"By the looks of it, this person has been dead for a very long time. Moreover, he's only a Core Formation Tier cultivator. It's strange that his body hasn't decayed even after such a long time," the Nine Mountains Saint said with a frown.
Even if a Saint had died, his body would not be able to remain uncorroded through the ages. Only the corpse of a Great Emperor could do so.
Ling Han could see very clearly. There was a strong fear on the dead man's face, as if he had experienced something incredibly shocking before his death.
"Let's continue."
They temporarily set down this corpse, and continued onwards.

They had not walked too far, when they discovered another corpse. Similarly, the corpse was covered with black palm imprints, but there were no injuries all over the body. It was just that the mind had been shattered.
Similarly, this person had been dead for a very, very long time, not in terms of ten thousand years, but in terms of hundreds of millions of years.

chapters.title: Chapter 4379 Strange Appearance.
paragraphs: All the way forwards, there were corpses.

There were men and women among the corpses, old and young. The difference in cultivation level was also very wide. There were those who had just reached the Foundation Building Tier, and there were even mortals among them. And in the strongest case, there were even Sect Master-level corpses, but in this place, they all died the same way, regardless of status.
"This definitely wasn't a war."
"It's extremely likely that this demonic mist suddenly surged out and instantly covered the entire area. Thus, when these people fled, they were all hit and died on the ground."
The two Saints were deducing what had happened all those years ago. Perhaps this was the truth.
They walked for a while longer, when they suddenly heard a strange sound.
It was a little like the sound of grinding teeth, but also like a strange laugh. It could not be accurately described.

The Black Flames Saint humphed coldly, and said, "Who's playing tricks? Show yourself!" With a flutter of his sleeve, boom! Mist billowed into the surroundings, instantly clearing a 60-meter radius in front of him.
However, he couldn't see anything strange at all.
The two Saints frowned upon hearing this. They were certain that what they had heard wasn't an illusion. However, what kind of being was capable of playing tricks on them?
They continued onwards. They had not taken too many steps, when that strange sound rang out again.
This time, they were sure that this should be laughter, though they did not know what kind of monster could release it.
This mysterious being seemed to be toying with them. No matter how the two Saints searched, "he" would always be able to react in advance, and they would not be able to discover its presence at all.
Thus, it was unknown whether this was a man or a woman, or even a human.
The two Saints couldn't help but speed up involuntarily. What kind of existence were they? They were the strongest great elites in the world, so how could they accept such humiliation?
For Saints, they were only slightly faster, but for Ling Han and the others, it was very straining.
"So heavy!" Niu Feixu, the only woman among the eight of them, exclaimed.
The gravity fields here seemed to be extremely strong. Previously, she could still hold on, but if she had to travel quickly as well, she wouldn't be able to hold on any longer.
In truth, Ling Han and the others were the same as well. However, they were all men, so they were too embarrassed to speak up.
Hearing her say this, they all looked towards Niu Feixu.
And with this look, everyone felt their hair stand on end.

—On Niu Feixu's back, there was shockingly a black shadow lying there. When it saw everyone look over, it actually raised its head, and smiled at them, releasing a strange sound that sounded like it was grinding its teeth.

This smile was too terrifying, because it was a black shadow in the first place. It had no facial features, but when it smiled, it actually revealed a mouth. There were two rows of teeth that were triangular in shape, and there was a blank at the back of the mouth.
Ling Han noticed that the fingers of this black shadow were especially long, about three times the length of his palm.
Hiss, this guy was the murderer who had killed those people previously.

No, no, the two Saints had already said that these people had been dead for at least several hundred million years. If this black shadow was the culprit, it would be even more powerful than the Great Emperor. It was actually able to survive for so many years.
Like Buddha Doga, had he lived a second life? Or had he suppressed himself, and had only just been released recently?
It was also because of the appearance of this black shadow that this planet was no longer hidden and appeared in the world?
"Humph! Demons and monsters, you actually dare to commit violence!" the Black Flame Saint roared. He made a grabbing motion at the air.

"Zhi!" The black shadow instantly released a terrible scream. It was far from having the power of a Saint, and with this attack from the Saint, it was instantly shattered into pieces, turning into clouds of black mist that fused into the surrounding demonic mist.
Was this black shadow a part of the demonic mist?

Everyone shuddered in apprehension. This was far too uncanny! There were clearly Imperial Weapons here, and there were clearly two Saints standing guard here. Yet, this black shadow had snuck onto Niu Feixu's body without anyone noticing.
Hold on!
Everyone shivered, and looked at each other. They inhaled sharply again, breaking out in a cold sweat.
That was because there were black shadows lying on top of their bodies as well!
When had they lain on their backs? Why had they not sensed anything at all?
The two Saints moved at the same time, and killed the black shadows on everyone's bodies.
Though none of them had sustained any injuries, a black palm print had been left on their necks. The palm was very normal, but their fingers were frighteningly long, making one's hair stand on end.
"This thing isn't very powerful," the Nine Mountains Saint said.
"That's right. It's possible that they are only True Self Tier, but the strange thing is that they don't seem to exist at all. Even our divine senses have been deceived," the Black Flames Saint said.
And this was still the True Self Tier. If it was a Venerate Tier, or even a Saint Tier, then with such a sudden strike, even a Saint would probably be out of luck, right?

It was no wonder that the Azure Wood Saint, who had been the first to enter, could only flee in a sorry state. They had the Imperial Weapons protecting them, and it still happened to them, so it was naturally even worse for the Azure Wood Saint.

"Humph! Do you really think that I'm a weakling if I don't unleash my might?" the Black Flames Saint said coldly. Boom! He unleashed the unique aura of a Saint, and it instantly surged into the surroundings like a vast river.
Under the barrage of his aura, the demonic mist was instantly forced back.
Previously, it was only the Saint that had not wanted to waste his energy, but now that he had become serious, and unleashed the might of a Saint, that was no joke either.
However, even if the Saint unleashed its might, it could only push the demonic mist 300 meters away, and could not take another step further.

"Neigh!" Three hundred meters away, balls of black mist condensed, turning into multiple human figures. However, they were only human figures. Their facial features could not be seen, and their limbs were extraordinarily long, far from the proportions of ordinary people.
These black shadows stared at Ling Han and the others. Some opened their mouths, and their triangular teeth were incredibly sharp.
"Die!" the Black Flame Saint roared as he charged over and unleashed a palm strike. Saintly power surged into the surroundings.
Peng, with a palm strike, those black shadows all crumbled, fusing into the demonic mist.

A scene that shocked everyone appeared. A black shadow appeared behind the Black Flame Saint, then stretched out its astonishingly long five fingers, and slowly grabbed out at the Black Flame Saint's neck.
However, it was as if the Black Flames Saint hadn't noticed this. Even someone as powerful as the Saint hadn't noticed that a black shadow had appeared behind him.
This caused everyone's hair to stand on end. This was too shocking. How could it be that even the Saint did not react at all?
"Friend!" the Nine Mountains Saint hurriedly shouted. "Watch your back!"
The Black Flames Saint didn't turn around. Instead, he directly launched a palm strike behind him. The Regulations transformed into a supreme divine blade that could even sever the sun and moon.
Sure enough, the black shadow was obliterated. It was no match at all.
However, after this incident, the two Saints were also frowning deeply.

It was as if this black shadow had a unique ability that could cut off divine sense. It could only be seen directly by the naked eye. Thus, even Saints would be unable to guard against its stealthy appearance.
Were they going to go any deeper?

The two Saints hesitated. This area of demonic mist was really too big, and their divine sense could only cover a limited area. If they wanted to find the Saintly medicine in such a large place, that was practically looking for a needle in a haystack.
Furthermore, it was impossible to guard against the black shadows in the demonic mist. Who could guarantee that there would never be any mistakes?

chapters.title: Chapter 4380 Sparring
paragraphs: However, Saints naturally had their own pride. Were they going to retreat just like that without figuring out anything?
The two Saints both decided that they wanted to walk further ahead and see what secrets were hidden in this place.
They continued onwards, watching over each other's backs.
The black shadow here was really too strange. Even the divine sense of a Saint could not sense it, and it could only be seen with the naked eye.
They advanced step by step, and the strange black shadows continued to appear, crawling on everyone's backs.
Ling Han and the others looked after each other. The moment they discovered the appearance of the black shadow, they immediately launched an attack.
These black shadows appeared and disappeared unpredictably, but their abilities were not strong at all. They were only True Self Tier-level, and could very easily be destroyed.
However, as they ventured deeper and deeper, the situation became more and more strange.

The black shadow that appeared became stronger and stronger. Very soon, it had reached the Spiritual Transformation Tier. So be it. Ling Han was strong enough to destroy it, but the next to appear would be Sect Master-level. No junior would be able to stand against this.
The two Saints could only step forward to help them deal with this. This was no big deal. In front of a Saint, wasn't a Sect Master like an ant?
But soon after, a Venerate Tier black shadow appeared.
The two Saints finally stopped in their tracks.
They couldn't advance any further. Otherwise, it was hard to guarantee that there would not be Saint-level shadows appearing. At that time, they would be in big trouble.
Imperial Weapon?

The Imperial Weapon was indeed impressive, and could sweep aside all opposition. However, the problem was that the Saint couldn't keep the Imperial Weapon awakened forever. At that time, the issue of safety would become a great problem.

They could only turn back. First, they would bring Ling Han and the other juniors out of the area of the demonic mist, then the two Saints would enter into the demonic mist. Without any further worries, they may be able to barge into the depths of the demonic mist area with the help of the Imperial Weapons, and discover the secrets of this place.
After watching the two Saints enter into the zone of demonic mist, Ling Han and the others all sat down. Now, all they could do was wait.

Since they had nothing better to do, it was naturally inevitable that they would chat, and as cultivators, it was inevitable that they would talk about abilities. No one was convinced, so it was natural that they would be angered.

"Hehe, the Nine Suns Holy Land only produced a Nine Mountains Saint. Otherwise, they wouldn't even be considered a third-tier force," Niu Tengfei said calmly. This was beginning to attack indiscriminately.
This naturally made the little azure dragon and the large black dog extremely displeased. They all slanted their eyes at him.
"What is it? Are you all still unconvinced?" Niu Feixu asked disdainfully, "Come, I will give you a handicap of one hand. Whoever can last a hundred moves from me will be considered to have won."
This was truly an undeserved calamity.
The little azure dragon sneered, "Grandpa Dragon has never liked hitting women. However, being so ugly and having such a smelly mouth, hehe, looks like Grandpa Dragon is going to make an exception."
"How dare you!" Niu Feixu sneered, and immediately moved, blasting towards the little azure dragon.

She was actually more than seven hundred years old, and had cultivated to the Spiritual Transformation Tier. Wherever this natural talent went, she could be called a prodigy. Her battle prowess was indeed very strong, and among Spirit Transformation Tiers, she could be considered powerful.

However, the little azure dragon was a first-generation descendant of the True Dragon. Its bloodline was extremely pure, and could completely compare to, or even in fact surpass, the Golden Generation. How could Niu Feixu compare?

However, this guy was devious. It was clear that his abilities were far superior, but he did not use his full strength at all. He only maintained a battle prowess that was equal to Niu Feixu, or even slightly weaker.
In this way, Niu Feixu felt that it was completely possible to defeat the little azure dragon within a hundred moves, but as she used one move after another, she was still unable to succeed.
Very quickly, the hundred moves had finished.
"Hehe, Grandpa Dragon doesn't seem to have lost." The little azure dragon spread its hands, looking very despicable.
Ling Han sighed. In the past, the little azure dragon only had a bad mouth, but now, even its expression was like this. Clearly, it had been too deeply influenced by the large black dog.

Niu Feixu was seething with anger from the mockery, so how could she still bother with the boasts she had previously made? She stretched out both hands, unleashing her full battle prowess, which blasted towards the little azure dragon.

"Yi, can't hit me! Hey, you missed a bit! Hey, you missed again." The little azure dragon dodged left and right, dodging all of Niu Feixu's attacks, and if you dodged, that was fine, but as he dodged, he kept talking, which naturally made Niu Feixu even more furious.
"Feixu, step back. You are no match for him," Niu Tengfei said solemnly.
He was a Silver Generation elite, so his eyes were naturally sharp.

Previously, Niu Feixu had given way, and the little azure dragon was only at a slight disadvantage. Now that Niu Feixu was attacking with her full strength, the little azure dragon was able to fight her to a tie. This clearly meant that it had hidden a lot of its strength.
"Imperial Son!" Niu Feixu was unconvinced. She felt that as long as she exerted a little more force, she would be able to crush this despicable guy into dust.
"Zhengzhi, you go," Niu Tengfei said to Niu Zhengzhi.
Though they were both in Spiritual Transformation Tier, Niu Zhengzhi's strength was obviously superior.
"All right." Niu Zhengzhi nodded.
Niu Feixu had no choice but to withdraw from the battle, allowing Niu Zhengzhi to take her place.
However, so what if it was Niu Zhengzhi? In front of the little azure dragon, he couldn't even withstand a single blow. In less than ten moves, he was beaten to the ground.
The little azure dragon said proudly, "Grandpa Dragon doesn't hit women, but men... Hehe, forget it."
Niu Feixu was dumbfounded. As it turned out, the little azure dragon was actually this powerful. To think that she had thought that she was only slightly weaker.
However, you are really too despicable, aren't you? Your abilities are clearly so strong!
Niu Tengfei took a deep breath, his heart filled with shock. What was going on with the Nine Suns Holy Land? Aside from Ling Han, there actually appeared an incredibly freakish guy.
This clearly was not Ling Han, because though Ling Han was detestable, he was definitely not as despicable as this.
"So you are pretending to be a pig to eat a tiger!" He strode out, "Then allow me, the Imperial Son, to be your opponent."
The little azure dragon crooked a finger at him. "I'll let you have a handicap of one hand. If you can last a hundred moves, I'll count it as your victory."
F***, wasn't this what Niu Feixu had just said?
Niu Tengfei was instantly enraged.
He was a Silver Generation elite, and now, he was actually being looked down on like this. If this spread out, he would really be laughed at.
"You are really arrogant!" he said in a baleful voice.
"With strength, that's called confidence," the little azure dragon said proudly.
"Alright, then let me shatter your confidence," Niu Tengfei said with a humph. He then launched an attack at the little azure dragon.
The Imperial Son moved, and that was naturally out of the ordinary. The Regulations slashed towards the little azure dragon like a divine sword.
Yet the little azure dragon was completely unafraid. Though it was also a Spiritual Transformation Tier, it was one or two minor levels higher than Niu Tengfei.
Even when their cultivation levels were the same, Niu Tengfei was no match, what more when Niu Tengfei's cultivation level fell behind?
Sure enough, the little azure dragon was only using one hand. However, its terrifying power surged, and Regulations intertwined, forcefully suppressing Niu Tengfei.
This caused Niu Feixu's eyes to almost pop out of her head. Only now did she know that she had not lost no reason. The little azure dragon's strength was superior to hers.
Niu Tengfei tried his best to resist, yet he was under immense pressure. Every move he blocked was done with great difficulty.
However, a hundred moves passed in the blink of an eye, and he finally managed to block all of them.
