chapters.title: Chapter 4381 Identity Exposed.
paragraphs: "Hu!"
The little azure dragon stopped, and deliberately rubbed its forehead. "I underestimated you. You actually managed to block a hundred moves from Grandpa Dragon."
He had won?
Niu Tengfei didn't look happy at all, only feeling endless humiliation.
As a dignified Silver Generation elite, in a one-on-one situation, he could only barely block a hundred moves, and that was under the condition that the other had given him a handicap of one hand.
This was practically a great humiliation!
"Yi, Brother Niu?" At this moment, a voice was heard, causing everyone to turn around and look.

A group of seven people walked over from the left. The person who had spoken was tall and slender, with a dignified bearing. There were two snakes of light entwined around him, one silver and one gold, and they evolved into all kinds of mysterious manifestations.
Niu Tengfei glanced at him and nodded. "Brother Lian."
The young man with the golden and silver twin snakes was the Heavenly Sorrow Imperial Clan's Silver Generation, Lian Xiangjie.
Niu Tengfei forced himself to regain some vigor. He didn't want more people to know that he almost lost to the little azure dragon, so he hurriedly asked, "Why is Brother Lian here?"

"Oh, the Saint of our Clan is currently exploring in the demonic mist, so we have nothing to do, so we walked around in the vicinity. Unexpectedly, we just happened to encounter Brother Niu," Lian Xiangjie said. Then, he swept an eye over Ling Han and the others, "And these three are?"
"Oh, from the Nine Suns Holy Land," Niu Tengfei said casually.
Lian Xiangjie immediately looked disdainful. Holy Land?
Hehe, since when could the Holy Lands be on equal footing with the Imperial Clans?
"Brother Niu, you really have the leisure to chat with a few trash from a Holy Land?" he said without any reservations.
"Oi, oi, oi, who are you talking about, trash?" the large black dog immediately retorted.
Lian Xiangjie's eyes were baleful as he stared at the large black dog, "If it was not for the sake of Brother Niu, just because of these words from you, I, an Imperial Son, would kill you."
Ling Han humphed and said, "Oh, why don't you give it a try?"
"You think I don't dare?" Lian Xiangjie said proudly.

The other six members of the Lian Clan all smirked coldly. This was their Imperial Son, and a Silver Generation at that. In this world, only the Golden Generation could defeat him at the same cultivation level.
Obviously, Ling Han wasn't a Golden Generation.
"Brat, immediately kneel down and apologize to our Imperial Son!"
"If you want to live, you had best know who you are!"
"Imperial Clans are high and noble, revered by the Nine Heavens!"
They spoke one after another, their expressions filled with pride.

Meanwhile, the three members of the Niu Clan kept their mouths shut. They had no intention of stoking the flames, but also had no intention of interfering, looking like they would stay out of this matter.
They had suffered a loss, so they naturally would not mind having the Lian Clan suffer a loss as well. That way, neither side would laugh at the other.
"Kneel!" Lian Xiangjie shouted lightly. Weng, a small mountain appeared out of thin air, and pressed down on Ling Han, wanting to make him submit without a fight.
This was actually a mountain of Spiritual Power. As long as a person's willpower crumbled, no matter how strong you were, so what?
Ling Han stood proudly. The small mountain of Spiritual Power hovered above his head, yet it couldn't suppress him no matter what.
This caused those members of the Lian Clan to click their tongues in amazement. Hiss, this brat was a little strong, to actually be able to match the spiritual pressure of their Imperial Son.

Lian Xiangjie also looked slightly surprised. Though this was only the suppression of Spiritual Power, as a Imperial Son, his Spiritual Power was naturally astonishingly strong. Faced with those that were not Imperial Sons, he would usually be able to deal with his opponent with a spiritual attack.
And now, this opponent was actually capable of matching him. This really gave him a shock.

"Who would've thought that a prodigy would appear among the members of a Holy Land!" he said calmly. It could be said that he somewhat approved of Ling Han. "However, now that I, an Imperial Son, have moved, how many strikes can you block?"
Ling Han couldn't help but smile, "How about this? I'll give you a handicap of one hand, and if you can block three moves from me, it'll be considered your victory."
Pu!
Hearing these words, the first to splutter weren't the members of the Lian Clan, but rather Niu Tengfei and the others.
Hey, hey, hey, aren't you all a little too arrogant?
Just now, the little azure dragon said he would give him a handicap of one hand, and left him room for a hundred moves, and you actually only said three moves?
He was too arrogant!
The seven members of the Lian Clan were furious, especially Lian Xiangjie. A dignified Silver Generation cultivator was actually looked down on like this, so how could he not be furious?
"All right!" He stared at Ling Han, his eyes baleful. "If you can't block three moves from me, then just wait for death!"
He moved aggressively, launching an attack at Ling Han.
Pa!
A crisp sound rang out, and Ling Han very casually delivered a slap, which landed on Lian Xiangjie's face.
It was crisp and loud.
Heavens!
This time, the members of the Niu and Lian Imperial Clans were trembling, feeling an indescribable chill.
What do you mean by three moves? Just one move.
The dignified Silver Generation actually couldn't even withstand a single strike from him, and was directly slapped in the face.
This, this, this!
Lian Xiangjie covered his face with one hand, while his eyes were fixed on Ling Han. After a while, he gritted his teeth and exclaimed, "Ling, Han!"

Aside from Ling Han, there was no other person in the world that could be so freakish, especially when these three people had come from the Nine Suns Holy Land. If he still hadn't realized it by now, then he would really be too stupid.

"Little Han, how did your disguise collapse so quickly?" The little azure dragon immediately sneered. "Just look at Grandpa Dragon. He similarly beat up the Silver Generation, yet his identity hasn't been exposed!"

Ling Han sighed as well. He was really too impatient. Otherwise, he would be like the little azure dragon, dragging it out a few hundred moves before defeating the enemy. Then, there would naturally be no need for him to expose his identity.
However, this didn't matter. The Nine Mountains Saint was presently here, and he had the "Imperial Weapon" in his hands. Who would dare to mess around?
With a thought, he had already returned to his original appearance.
"It really is you!" Lian Xiangjie gritted his teeth, his hatred soaring sky-high.

Ling Han had already developed. Everyone knew that the Silver Generation was no longer a match for him. In fact, he had even defeated one of the Golden Generation, who was forced to break through to Sect Master-level in advance.

Thus, it wasn't embarrassing for the Silver Generation to lose to Ling Han. However, the problem was that he had actually been slapped by Ling Han. With such great humiliation, how could he face others in the future?
"Little Jiejie, you should feel honored," the large black dog said with a serious expression. "In the future, you can tell others that I'm someone who survived Ling Han's strike with my face!"
"That's right, that's right, that's enough to leave your name for eternity," the little azure dragon immediately nodded.
These two b@stards had extremely toxic mouths, and their words could drive anyone crazy.
Lian Xiangjie trembled with anger, and suddenly drew out a green gong and drum.

The large black dog couldn't help but say with a smile, "Little Jiejie, don't be so high-profile. After all, Little Han hasn't become a Great Emperor yet. It's still too early for you to beat a gong and drum and announce that you took a palm strike from the Great Emperor Ling Han with your face."
Kuang!
Lian Xiangjie suddenly struck the gong and drum, and instantly, soundwaves spread out, rippling out in multiple layers.
It wasn't long before the ripples transformed into swords and sabers that radiated with divine light as they slashed toward Ling Han and the others.
Ling Han was astonished. This attack had actually reached the level of Pseudo Sect Master.
By the looks of it, this drum and gong was a Sect Master-level Spirit Tool. It was stimulated by Lian Xiangjie, and could unleash the might of Pseudo Sect Master.
With a thought, Ling Han summoned the staff.
Who was afraid of who?

chapters.title: Chapter 4382 Battle spoils
paragraphs: This staff should continue to be called the Firebird Staff.

The Firebird Staff was a Saint-level weapon. Even if it was limited by Ling Han's cultivation level and could not unleash its full might, how difficult would it be to stand against a Pseudo Sect Master?

Ling Han brandished the staff, and instantly felt a large portion of power in his body being absorbed. Then, the Firebird Staff was activated, shooting out a blue-coloured light that slashed towards Lian Xiangjie.
Peng!
The blue light clashed with the sabers and swords, and both were destroyed.
In this exchange, the two of them were evenly matched.
It could not be helped. They both had the might of Pseudo Sect Master, so it was natural that neither was inferior to the other.
Lian Xiangjie was taken aback. He had not thought that Ling Han would also have a Sect Master-level Spirit Tool on him.

It should be known that he had only obtained this Celestial Tool from his clan after Lian Yutang had been lost in the lair of the True Phoenix. That was because it was possible that he would have to bear the banner of the Heavenly Sorrow Imperial Clan in future, so they naturally had to begin arming him.
But what basis did Ling Han have to possess this?
How could a mere Saint-level force have such deep roots?
"Come!" Ling Han stimulated the Firebird Staff, and struck out at Lian Xiangjie.
Multiple flashes of blue light slashed out, and at the same time, he also controlled the staff to smash towards Lian Xiangjie's head.
Peng! Peng! Peng!

The two of them battled fiercely. On the one hand, it was the clash of the might of the Spirit Tools, and on the other, it was a clash of their own strength. In terms of the former, Lian Xiangjie was not inferior, but in terms of the latter, he really could not compare to Ling Han.
After only a few moves, Lian Xiangjie evaded Ling Han, and did not dare to face him head-on at all. He merely stimulated the Spirit Tool with all his might.
He was extremely sullen. He similarly controlled a Spirit Tool, but why was he still at a great disadvantage?

Moreover, a Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator activating a Sect Master-level Spirit Tool would consume an astonishing amount of mystical power. Even though he was a Silver Generation cultivator who had perfected his cultivation level and broken through his limits time and time again, there was still a limit to his power.
At this rate, it would only take half an hour at most, and his mystical power would definitely be completely exhausted.
Competing in stamina with Ling Han?
Hehe, hadn't it already been tried out before? This guy's mystical power reserves were practically freakish, and there was absolutely no way they could outlast him.
He wanted to stop the battle; he would definitely be at a disadvantage and not at an advantage. What was the point of continuing the battle?
But how could Ling Han possibly let him do as he wished!
Oh, if you want to fight, just fight. If you don't want to fight, just leave?
You are deluding yourself!

Ling Han aggressively attacked, forcing Lian Xiangjie to have no choice but to resist with all his might. Furthermore, he had to continuously dodge left and right. He felt very sullen, but had nowhere to vent his frustration.

Half an hour later, Lian Xiangjie's mystical power was completely exhausted, and he was no longer able to control the Spirit Tool. He was smacked onto the ground by Ling Han. He was just about to get up, but a foot stepped on his head, making him unable to raise his head.
Pu, Lian Xiangjie instantly spluttered out a mouthful of blood.
He was a mighty Silver Generation, yet his head was actually being stepped on by someone else. Did he still have any future?
How was he supposed to face others!
Niu Tengfei secretly expressed thanks for his good fortune. Thankfully, he didn't provoke Ling Han. Otherwise, he would probably be one of the people being stepped on.
The members of the Lian Clan were also rendered speechless. Their Imperial Son had lost, and it was under the condition that he had used a deadly weapon.
Meanwhile, Ling Han forcefully snatched the gong and drum from him. Then, he tossed it over to the large black dog, "Take it and play with it."
"Alright." The large black dog naturally wouldn't be reserved, and he accepted the gong and drum.
"Ling Han, how dare you! That belongs to our clan!" a member of the Lian Clan hurriedly shouted.
"I won, so this is naturally my spoil of battle," Ling Han said with a smile. "Which of you from the Lian Clan can defeat me? Then come and take this Spirit Tool back."
When these words fell, the Lian Clan was speechless.

This was very common in the cultivation world. The losing party would leave behind a treasure or a cultivation technique or whatnot. Years later, the descendant of the losing party would come again to challenge them, and if they won, they would be able to retrieve the item.
But the Lian Clan was an Imperial Clan, and you even dare to seize something belonging to the Imperial Clan?
Thinking about it again, who was Ling Han?
The well-known Imperial Son Killer, who really lived up to his name. A good number of Imperial Sons had died by his hand, so what was the loss of a Spirit Tool worth?

Ling Han was just about to speak, when he suddenly felt a powerful chill. He moved, and grabbed the large black dog and little azure dragon. Using the Star Steps, they instantly disappeared without a trace.
Shua, a flash of sword light slashed out, and it was precisely where Ling Han had disappeared.
If Ling Han's reaction had been just the slightest bit slower, he would definitely have been struck by this sword strike, and if he had sustained this strike, he would definitely have died.
That was because the person who had made a move was Sect Master-level.
An assassin from the Battle God Palace.

The assassin had been patient enough. He was clearly at the level of Sect Master, yet he had remained hidden all this while. He had only drawn his sword when he had reached the most optimal position, intending to kill Ling Han with a single strike. However, he still hadn't imagined that Ling Han's divine sense would be so sharp.

Firstly, Ling Han could use the ley lines as eyes and ears, greatly increasing his senses, and secondly, he had also grasped the Strange Shadow Steps of the Battle God Palace, and someone else wanted to use it to get close and kill him? Wasn't that a joke?

This scene had really happened too suddenly, right until the sword swept past. Only then did the members of the Lian and Niu Clans come back to their senses, and they were all secretly exclaiming in pity.
Just a little bit more, and Ling Han would have been killed.

If there was any force in the world that was unafraid of the threat of a Saint and the Imperial Weapon, it would definitely be the Battle God Palace. That was because they had always appeared and disappeared mysteriously, and did not have a single disciple that travelled the world with their true identities. Thus, the Battle God Palace did not have to take the words of the Nine Mountains Saint to heart at all. They could still ambush Ling Han and kill him however they liked.
However, you guys are really too weak, aren't you?
The first time they attacked, what was Ling Han's cultivation level? And now?
'Are you guys really trying to assassinate Ling Han, and not just wanting to be his sparring partners?'

The Sect Master's attack missed, and he immediately fled into the darkness again. This was the habit of all the assassins in the Battle God Palace. Once they attacked, whether they hit their target or not, they would immediately leave.
After the assassin left, everyone breathed a sigh of relief. After all, this was a Sect Master-level existence, so killing them would be as easy as the turn of a palm.
Could you hope to reason with an assassin?
On the other side of the Demonic Mist Planet, the figures of Ling Han and the others appeared.

"F***, the Battle God Palace is really like a lingering ghost." The large black dog bared his teeth, "If Little Han had reacted slightly slower just now, he would have already become a corpse by now."
"With Grandpa Dragon here, the auspicious bringer of good fortune, everything can be turned into good luck," the little azure dragon shamelessly snatched the credit.

Ling Han pondered for a moment before saying, "I can't stay on the back foot forever. I need to think of some way to find the Battle God Palace and let them have a taste of being hunted by everyone in the world."
"Unfortunately, the secrecy of this organization is really too good." The large black dog shook his head.
Since ancient times, there were quite a few forces that wanted to destroy the Battle God Palace, but which of them had succeeded?

Ling Han was still a little confident. After all, he had stayed in the Battle God Palace before. If worse came to worst, he could investigate all the star charts in the future, and he would definitely be able to find some clues.
Boom!
At this moment, a huge commotion suddenly erupted in the area of the demonic mist. Bursts of fog surged, and the ground trembled madly.

Firstly, Ling Han could use the ley lines as eyes and ears, greatly increasing his senses, and secondly, he had also grasped the Strange Shadow Steps of the Battle God Palace, and someone else wanted to use it to get close and kill him?
Wasn't that a joke?
This scene had really happened too suddenly, right until the sword swept past.
Only then did the members of the Lian and Niu Clans come back to their senses, and they were all secretly exclaiming in pity.
Just a little bit more, and Ling Han would have been killed.
If there was any force in the world that was unafraid of the threat of a Saint and the Imperial Weapon, it would definitely be the Battle God Palace.
That was because they had always appeared and disappeared mysteriously, and did not have a single disciple that travelled the world with their true identities.
Thus, the Battle God Palace did not have to take the words of the Nine Mountains Saint to heart at all.
They could still ambush Ling Han and kill him however they liked.
However, you guys are really too weak, aren't you?
The first time they attacked, what was Ling Han's cultivation level?
And now?
'Are you guys really trying to assassinate Ling Han, and not just wanting to be his sparring partners?'
The Sect Master's attack missed, and he immediately fled into the darkness again.
This was the habit of all the assassins in the Battle God Palace.
Once they attacked, whether they hit their target or not, they would immediately leave.
After the assassin left, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
After all, this was a Sect Master-level existence, so killing them would be as easy as the turn of a palm.
Could you hope to reason with an assassin?
On the other side of the Demonic Mist Planet, the figures of Ling Han and the others appeared.

"F***, the Battle God Palace is really like a lingering ghost." The large black dog bared his teeth, "If Little Han had reacted slightly slower just now, he would have already become a corpse by now."
"With Grandpa Dragon here, the auspicious bringer of good fortune, everything can be turned into good luck," the little azure dragon shamelessly snatched the credit.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before saying, "I can't stay on the back foot forever.
I need to think of some way to find the Battle God Palace and let them have a taste of being hunted by everyone in the world."
"Unfortunately, the secrecy of this organization is really too good." The large black dog shook his head.
Since ancient times, there were quite a few forces that wanted to destroy the Battle God Palace, but which of them had succeeded?
Ling Han was still a little confident.
After all, he had stayed in the Battle God Palace before.
If worse came to worst, he could investigate all the star charts in the future, and he would definitely be able to find some clues.
Boom!
At this moment, a huge commotion suddenly erupted in the area of the demonic mist.
Bursts of fog surged, and the ground trembled madly.

chapters.title: Chapter 4383 A visitor from the demonic mist
paragraphs: The demonic mist boiled, but only after a while, it returned to calm.
It wasn't long before the Nine Mountains Saint contacted Ling Han and the others. The four of them reunited.
"Old man!" When the three of them saw the Nine Mountains Saint, they were all stunned.
This was because there were several black palm marks on the Nine Mountains Saint's exposed skin. His clothes were also torn and tattered, and he appeared especially disheveled.
"It's fine," the Nine Mountains Saint said with a wave of his hand. "I fought a few times with the being in the demonic mist, yet I wasn't wounded."

The old man had said that when they arrived at the central area of the demonic mist, there was actually a silver mountain there. However, they could not enter the mountain, because there were a great number of black shadows there, and they all had Saint-level battle prowess.
It didn't matter if there were one or two, but the scale was tens of millions, so how could they withstand it?

The Saints also teamed up, but in the demonic mist, even the Imperial Weapons were greatly affected, unable to unleash their full might. Furthermore, those black shadows were undying, and as soon as they were dispersed, they merged into the demonic mist, reappearing in the blink of an eye.
How could this be tolerated?
Thus, the Saints could only give up their plans of seizing the Saintly medicine, and retreat out of the area of the demonic mist.
Was this scene especially familiar?

That's right. It was completely the same as the Yin River and sea of blood.. There were a great many corpses of Saints or Saint Tier-level battle prowess within, and they could not be killed no matter what.
Hiss, in the demonic mist, could it be that there was another Pseudo-Emperor in the silver mountain?

It was also because of this consideration that all the Saints retreated without hesitation. If they really attracted the attention of a Pseudo-Emperor, they would probably become corpses, and remain inside forever.
However, the various great Imperial Clans had all suffered losses before. What if there really was a Pseudo-Emperor here, who, like the Yin River Master and the like, supported Yin souls?
If they left it unattended, it would definitely become a great calamity in future.

Hence, some people suggested that they seek out Buddha Doga, and have him be the main force. Coupled with Saints and Imperial Weapons like them, it should not be a problem for them to raze this place to the ground.
However, where were they supposed to find Buddha Doga?

After the battle of the Mountain Sea Heaven, the whereabouts of the Buddha Doga were unknown. Furthermore, as a dignified Pseudo-Emperor, if he did not want to be found, who would be able to discover his whereabouts?

There were also suggestions that if they couldn't find Buddha Doga, they could set up a Great Emperor-level killing formation here. In that way, even if you were a Pseudo-Emperor, so what? Could it be that it could resist the Great Emperor killing formation?

Of course, to set up such a great formation, not only would it take a very, very long time, it would also require an astonishing amount of natural treasures. It would definitely need the combined efforts of the various Imperial Clans to bear the burden together. Otherwise, no specific Imperial Clan could possibly possess such wealth.
Thus, after this suggestion was made, none of the Imperial Clans responded at the first instant.
If they agreed, that would be a huge loss.
However, the brutal battle of the Mountain Sea Heaven was still vivid in everyone's minds. If another Pseudo-Emperor appeared, the world would really be in chaos.
Thus, after some discussion, all the Imperial Clans agreed.

Next, it would be wrangling. Which clan was in charge of producing the ingredients, and every Imperial Clan wanted their own clan to contribute less. Thus, this naturally would take a lot of time and last longer.
But just as the Imperial Clans were wrangling, an old man suddenly walked out of the demonic mist.
This old man was dressed in a long grey robe. One look and one could tell that he was the type to serve others, but no one dared to underestimate him.
That was because he was shockingly a Saint!
A Saint... was actually a servant?
Hiss, everyone was shocked.
They had not guessed wrongly. Was there really a Pseudo-Emperor here? Otherwise, even a Nine-Star Saint would not be qualified to have a One-Star Saint become his servant.
All of a sudden, all the Saints present walked out.
"Dare I ask how I should address you, friend?" The Black Flames Saint was the first to speak.
"This old man's surname is Yue, and as for my name, it's been too long since I last used it. This old man has also forgotten," the grey-robed old man said calmly.
Hehe, who would forget their name because it had not been used for too long?
The Saints naturally didn't believe him. However, names didn't matter. This was only a code name.
"Friend Yue, have you come from that silver mountain inside?" the Divine Fluid Saint asked.

Saint Yue nodded, "My Master has said that he bears no malice towards all of you, so there is no need for all of you to be so nervous. Additionally, even if all of you really want to lay out some Great Emperor killing formation, it would not be able to withstand a single blow from my Master."

The first few words caused all the Saints to feel proud. So what if you are a Pseudo-Empero? Knowing that the Great Emperor killing formation would trap you to death, you immediately sent someone out to express goodwill, but the last few words caused their expressions to darken.
The Great Emperor killing formation was also unable to withstand a single blow?
What kind of arrogant words were these?
You are only a Pseudo-Emperor, and not a real Great Emperor.

However, since he already knew of their plans, wanting to complete the arrangements right under the nose of a Pseudo-Emperor, the chances of success were pitifully small — how could it be that this Pseudo-Emperor would watch just them set up the formations?
And when the Pseudo-Emperor appeared, who in the world could stop him?
But why had this powerful existence not appeared?

Not only him, but the Lord of the Blood Sea and the Lord of the Yin River also did the same. This meant that they could not possibly appear casually, or they would definitely have to pay a huge price.
With such thoughts, the Saints were naturally filled with courage.

The Saint Yue saw the reactions of the Saints, and he smiled faintly, "I have another mission for this trip, and that is to escort Young Master into the world, and meet the younger generation of the present era."

The demonic mist surged, and a young man strode out. He was dressed in a dark golden Battle Armor, and Regulations were interwoven all over his body. With a step, hong, it was as if the heavens and earth were trembling.
Everyone could clearly see that the young man's Battle Armor was actually already damaged, and it was also covered with spots of blood. Obviously, he had experienced countless battles.

"Spiritual Transformation Tier," a Saint replied. However, there was a strange look in his eyes, and this was because he felt as if this young man possessed a ferocious beast inside his body. Once it exploded, it would definitely be extremely terrifying.

Ling Han was also looking at this young man. He had a strange feeling. This young man looked young, yet had a feeling of having experienced vicissitudes. This was a contradiction, but it was very harmonious with this young man.

He couldn't help but think of the little azure dragon and the little red bird. These two guys were actually a little "old-fashioned", because they had been sealed by the Primordial Source Clay while they were still yet to be born, and an incredibly long time had passed.
Though in this state, their lifespans were practically not decreased, in truth, they had indeed existed for innumerable years. No matter what, they would still be tainted with some "age".
This young man... was precisely so.
So strange. Why did so many elites insist on squeezing into this era?
The Buddha Doga, the Lord of Yin River, and the Lord of the Blood Sea were all such beings. How could such elites do something with no goal?
Thus, since they were so determined to come to this lifetime, they must have an obvious goal in mind.
Becoming Emperor?

chapters.title: Chapter 4384 Yang Yihuan
paragraphs: Ling Han's thoughts wandered. Golden Generation, old monsters and little monsters from endless ages ago all appeared in this era. It shouldn't be a coincidence, right?
While he was thinking, the young man wearing the Battle Armor also walked out of the demonic mist. His lanky figure was exuding an unyielding killing intent, causing others to involuntarily tremble.
"I am Yang Yihuan." This young man smiled, appearing very gentle, "Greetings, seniors."

All the Saints nodded slightly. After all, there was a Saint standing right next to him. Furthermore, it was very possible that Yang Yihuan's elder was a Pseudo-Emperor. Thus, they still had to give him some face.
Yang Yihuan looked towards those youngsters, "I would like to issue a challenge to all the young prodigies. Is there anyone willing to bestow a move on me?"
The Imperial Sons exchanged looks, and for a moment, no one spoke.

They had all received a message through divine sense from the Saint of their clan, telling them not to be rash. This Yang Yihuan's abilities were still unfathomable, so they had best let others test out his abilities. If he was frighteningly strong, wouldn't they be embarrassed in public?
Yang Yihuan showed a hint of surprise, "No one?"
When these words fell, the Imperial Sons all looked slightly livid.
What kind of disdainful expression was this?
Did he think that no one could match him?
Just because you came out of the demonic mist, you are already awesome, and no one can match you?

"Let me experience it!" An Imperial Son stepped out. He was Yi Taiming of the Blood Flame Imperial Clan, and was not the Golden Generation, nor was he the Silver Generation, but rather an ordinary Imperial Son.
However, the title of Imperial Son was the most resounding title, representing an absolute prodigy.
Yang Yihuan was still smiling calmly, and raised his clasped hands in Yi Taiming's direction, "Please."
Yi Taiming shouted lightly, and charged towards Yang Yihuan.
Yang Yihuan attacked. It was just an ordinary punch, but this punch seemed to be capable of shattering heaven and earth. It was indescribably terrifying.
With a bang, Yi Taiming collapsed onto the ground, directly passing out.
Seeing this scene, everyone frowned.

In truth, Yi Taiming had only just advanced into the Spiritual Transformation Tier. Though he was the Imperial Son, even if he encountered a Dao Child prodigy at the Fourth Change or Fifth Change, he would still be outmatched.
But this punch from Yang Yihuan... it was too terrifying.
Not only power, but also that kind of aura. That kind of aura that carried supreme confidence, as if even the heaven and earth could collapse, causing one's scalp to go numb.
Just how broad-minded was he?
Yang Yihuan smiled faintly, "Is there anyone else that is willing to bestow a move on me?"
The members of the Silver Generation looked at each other. How could it be that after Ling Han, Ding Shu, and Origin, another freak was going to appear?
But to just let him continue acting arrogant like this?
The Silver Generation of the Ten Thousand Thunder Imperial Clan, Hang Weili, walked out. He also smiled, "I am Hang Weili, and would like to ask Brother Yang for some guidance."
"Please." Yang Yihuan was very polite, and was a little too gentle.
Hang Weili immediately charged out. At the first instant, he summoned his seven spiritual bodies, each using a powerful move, which blasted towards Yang Yihuan.
Clearly, he was very wary of this opponent, and had already gone all out in his first move.
Yang Yihuan still threw a punch. It was the same as before, but its might had increased by who knew how many times.
Peng, Hang Weili was sent flying, and fell heavily onto the ground, similarly unconscious.
Hiss, he had defeated two Imperial Sons with two punches.
Moreover, what was even more astonishing was the fact that the might of the second and first punches differed greatly, as if they had been adjusted according to the strength of the opponent.

Yang Yihuan smiled faintly, and said, "I'm Ninth Change, but I definitely won't suppress others with my cultivation level. Thus, I'll suppress my cultivation level to the corresponding level of my opponent."
Thus, the power of the second and first punches were so different.
Hearing these words, everyone became even more serious. In fact, they actually felt a kind of fear.

If you relied on the fact that your cultivation level was high, it would not be strange for you to defeat the Imperial Son with a single punch. There were too many Spiritual Transformation Tier elites that could do that. However, on the premise that their "cultivation level" was similar, it was terrifying that he could still defeat the Silver Generation with a single punch.
Could he do the same... to the Golden Generation?
At this time, everyone's eyes all turned towards Ling Han.
This guy had done it before, defeating the Silver Generation in a single go.
Heavens, another freak had really appeared.
Yang Yihuan was still nonchalant, "How about this? You guys can have a few more people attack at the same time. It doesn't matter even if there are ten or twenty of you."
His expression was gentle, and he appeared calm. However, his words were extremely forceful and haughty.
He actually asked for the Imperial Sons attack him at the same time, and it was not just two or three of them either. It did not matter even if there were ten or twenty of them.
Just how arrogant was he?

Such provocation caused those Saints of the Imperial Clans to feel slightly embarrassed. They represented the strongest in the world, yet now there was someone provoking their authority. If they did not counter harshly, wouldn't that become a joke to the whole world?
"Heh, since Young Friend Yang is so confident, just attack together," a Saint said with a chuckle.
F***, don't you have the nerve?
But upon further thought, in a one-on-one battle, who could be a match for this freak?
The Silver Generation was insta-killed with a single punch. In a one-on-one battle, wasn't that just delivering himself up to die?

Furthermore, firstly, the Golden Generation wasn't here, and secondly, the weakest of the Golden Generation had also advanced into the level of Sect Master. So what if they came? Were they going to pick on the weak?
Then what was the point of winning?
It would be better to gang up on him. Though this would also be embarrassing, it could at least dampen Yang Yihuan's spirit. Furthermore, wasn't this something that he had personally requested?
It wasn't long before Imperial Sons walked out one after another. Most of them were Silver Generation elites, and there were 22 of them.
"Come on then," Yang Yihuan said with a smile, appearing extremely gentle.
The Imperial Sons looked at each other. This was an unprecedented situation where more than twenty people joined forces.
But now that the arrow was nocked, they had no choice but to fire.
"Die!"
They all rushed out, unleashing their Imperial Techniques at the same time. They were indescribably terrifying.
However, Yang Yihuan strode forwards, his fists attacking at the same time, completely unafraid.

At this moment, his hair was flying, and his expression was also flying. He was no longer that gentle young man, like a treasured saber that had been unsheathed. In the end, he was still exuding a piercing fighting spirit that soared into the sky.
Arrogant, domineering, and completely unrestrained!
Peng! Peng! Peng!

One punch from him, one after another. So what if the Silver Generation elites joined forces? They were no match for a single punch from him. Figures flew everywhere, and after 22 punches, the whole world became silent.
Everyone was dumbfounded, completely unable to believe their eyes.
They had lost, they had lost. In just a few breaths' time, the 22 Imperial Sons had all lost.
Would anyone believe him if he told them?
This was too shocking!

Yang Yihuan retracted his fist, causing his fluttering hair to flow down his back. He returned to his previous gentle and aloof demeanor, and asked softly, "Is there anyone else who can bestow a move on me?"
When his words fell, no one answered.
If the Golden Generation didn't appear, who would be able to resist?
In fact, even if the Golden Generation appeared, would they really be a match for him?

But the Golden Generation was already comparable to the Great Emperors of the past. If this person was even more powerful than the Golden Generation, then wouldn't he have surpassed all the previous Great Emperors?

It doesn't matter even if there are ten or twenty of you."
His expression was gentle, and he appeared calm.
However, his words were extremely forceful and haughty.
He actually asked for the Imperial Sons attack him at the same time, and it was not just two or three of them either.
It did not matter even if there were ten or twenty of them.
Just how arrogant was he?
Such provocation caused those Saints of the Imperial Clans to feel slightly embarrassed.
They represented the strongest in the world, yet now there was someone provoking their authority.
If they did not counter harshly, wouldn't that become a joke to the whole world?
"Heh, since Young Friend Yang is so confident, just attack together," a Saint said with a chuckle.
F***, don't you have the nerve?
But upon further thought, in a one-on-one battle, who could be a match for this freak?
The Silver Generation was insta-killed with a single punch.
In a one-on-one battle, wasn't that just delivering himself up to die?
Furthermore, firstly, the Golden Generation wasn't here, and secondly, the weakest of the Golden Generation had also advanced into the level of Sect Master.
So what if they came?
Were they going to pick on the weak?
Then what was the point of winning?
It would be better to gang up on him.
Though this would also be embarrassing, it could at least dampen Yang Yihuan's spirit.
Furthermore, wasn't this something that he had personally requested?
It wasn't long before Imperial Sons walked out one after another.
Most of them were Silver Generation elites, and there were 22 of them.
"Come on then," Yang Yihuan said with a smile, appearing extremely gentle.
The Imperial Sons looked at each other.
This was an unprecedented situation where more than twenty people joined forces.
But now that the arrow was nocked, they had no choice but to fire.
"Die!"
They all rushed out, unleashing their Imperial Techniques at the same time.
They were indescribably terrifying.
However, Yang Yihuan strode forwards, his fists attacking at the same time, completely unafraid.
At this moment, his hair was flying, and his expression was also flying.
He was no longer that gentle young man, like a treasured saber that had been unsheathed.
In the end, he was still exuding a piercing fighting spirit that soared into the sky.
Arrogant, domineering, and completely unrestrained!
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
One punch from him, one after another.
So what if the Silver Generation elites joined forces?
They were no match for a single punch from him.
Figures flew everywhere, and after 22 punches, the whole world became silent.
Everyone was dumbfounded, completely unable to believe their eyes.
They had lost, they had lost.
In just a few breaths' time, the 22 Imperial Sons had all lost.
Would anyone believe him if he told them?
This was too shocking!
Yang Yihuan retracted his fist, causing his fluttering hair to flow down his back.
He returned to his previous gentle and aloof demeanor, and asked softly, "Is there anyone else who can bestow a move on me?"
When his words fell, no one answered.
If the Golden Generation didn't appear, who would be able to resist?
In fact, even if the Golden Generation appeared, would they really be a match for him?
But the Golden Generation was already comparable to the Great Emperors of the past.
If this person was even more powerful than the Golden Generation, then wouldn't he have surpassed all the previous Great Emperors?

chapters.title: Chapter 4385 Arrogance under a gentle demeanor
paragraphs: Ling Han also saw very clearly.

Yang Yihuan had indeed not won by depending on his power — indeed, his power far surpassed the corresponding cultivation level. In that case, he had definitely not gone all out. This was something that could be confirmed.

Most importantly, each of his attacks had an indescribable charm to them, as if they were secretly aligned with the Heavenly Dao. Thus, their might could be greatly increased, and naturally, battle prowess would also rise accordingly.
Ling Han couldn't help but feel his fists itch, wanting to fight with this rare opponent.
This person was very strong, so strong that Ling Han's fighting spirit blazed.
They may all be in Ninth Change, but this guy was much stronger than even Lian Yutang and Shi Ze. Even if he had already advanced into Seventh Change, he should still be no match for him.
Asking him to suppress his cultivation level?
Ling Han shook his head. What was the point of fighting like this? Only if he went all out could he truly unleash his full strength. Otherwise, he would be tied up.
"Grandpa Dragon will fight you." The little azure dragon couldn't hold back anymore and jumped out.

Seeing the little azure dragon, Yang Yihuan didn't look down on it as a four-legged snake like others had when they first saw it. Instead, he stared at it for a while longer before breaking into a smile. "Descendant of the True Dragon?"
His eyes were really sharp!
The little azure dragon said proudly, "That's right, it's your Grandpa Dragon! Since you know, why don't you kneel down and call me grandpa?"
Yang Yihuan was not angered. He did not seem to have that kind of emotion, and said calmly, "I once reared a dragon, and its bloodline is quite pure. Of course, it is still slightly inferior to you."
These words!
The little azure dragon's face immediately crumbled. 'What do you mean?'
Oh, you want to take me as your beast pet?
"Come battle!" He charged out. Boom, his battle prowess was fully unleashed.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
Yang Yihuan lowered his own cultivation level, clashing with the little azure dragon.

At this moment, the freakish nature of the little azure dragon could finally be seen. Previously, even when the Silver Generation elites had joined forces, they had still been defeated by Yang Yihuan with a single punch. However, the little azure dragon could still clash head-on with Yang Yihuan, and they were even exchanging blows.
The elites of the Imperial Clans were all stunned. This Four-Legged Snake was actually a descendant of the True Dragon?
According to legends, the physique of the True Dragon was unparalleled, and its power was number one in the world. From the look of things now, the legends weren't false.

Yet Ling Han's brow wrinkled into a frown. The little azure dragon was the most direct heir of the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique. Furthermore, he was the son of the True Dragon. Logically speaking, his cultivation of Body Art should be incredibly awesome.

If it was not for the fact that Ling Han had also mastered Destructive Energy and could use a higher level of energy to temper himself, his Body Art should not have been as awesome as the little azure dragon.
However, Yang Yihuan was able to fight head-on with him, not falling into a disadvantage at all. This was terrifying.

Of course, this guy's cultivation level was higher, and while this power could be suppressed, the toughness of his physique could not possibly be weakened as well, but being able to cultivate his physique to this extent in Spirit Transformation Tier, this was really an inconceivable thing.
"Interesting, quite interesting." Yang Yihuan broke into a smile. His hair began to fly again, and his gentle eyes shone, exuding a wildness. His whole aura changed immediately.
He became flamboyant and domineering, launching an aggressive offensive. Wonderful moves were used repeatedly, completely suppressing the little azure dragon.
Although the little azure dragon was fighting with all its might, it was still a hair's breadth away from being suppressed to a disadvantage.
"I'm done fighting." This guy wasn't stupid. Since he couldn't beat him, he naturally had to stop.

"Why don't you follow me so we can battle all around the world?" Yet Yang Yihuan did not stop fighting. Every move was powerful, forcing the little azure dragon to have no choice but to continue fighting.
This seemed to be a very tempting invitation, but the words "follow" spoke of Yang Yihuan's ambition — you can only follow in my footsteps, and become my right-hand man.

"F*** off!" How could the little azure dragon possibly agree? Just look at Little Han. Although his words could drive people to death sometimes, he truly treated him as a friend, unlike you—the pride hidden in your bones, the disdain!
Following you, heh, that would really be degrading oneself.
Yang Yihuan was still not angered, and merely attacked aggressively, as if he wanted to use his powerful strength to make the little azure dragon submit.
"He already said he doesn't want to fight you anymore, so why are you still being so overbearing?" Ling Han charged out and threw a punch at Yang Yihuan.
"Seventh Change?" Yang Yi smiled and replied with a punch of his own. His power suddenly soared by a significant amount.
Towards anyone, he would use the power corresponding to his cultivation level, which seemed very fair, and also showed his strong confidence.
Peng!
The two of them exchanged a blow, and a terrifying power reverberated. Teng, teng, teng! The two of them swayed, and then both retreated.
One step, two steps, three steps... seventeen steps!
When he reached the seventeenth step, Yang Yihuan was the first to steady his footing, while Ling Han took a total of 22 steps back.
Ling Han had lost?

However, Ling Han didn't think so. When the two of them exchanged blows, Yang Yihuan had indeed used the power of the Seventh Change. However, when he retreated, he couldn't help but use more than the power of the Seventh Change. Only then did he manage to stabilize his footing before Ling Han did.
Even so, it was enough to show how terrifying this guy was.
Taking advantage of this opening, the little azure dragon retreated, breaking away from Yang Yihuan.
Yang Yihuan did not pursue him relentlessly. Instead, he looked towards Ling Han, and asked with a smile, "Come and have a spar?"
"Not interested," Ling Han rejected directly. What was so interesting about fighting a battle, and eventually using power that surpassed his cultivation level?
Yang Yi smiled faintly, a hint of curiosity in his eyes. Who was this person that could actually stand against him?
Others might not know, but he naturally knew just how strong he was. That was a height that an Imperial Son could not reach through ordinary means.
Yet he had actually encountered a rival!
Others didn't know. They only thought that Ling Han had been at a disadvantage in their first exchange, and that was why he was afraid to fight.
As it turned out, Ling Han was also someone who would bully the weak but fear the strong.
What right did such a person have to attempt to aim for the imperial throne?
Yang Yihuan surveyed the surroundings again, and asked calmly, "Is there anyone else that would like to provide guidance?"
No one answered. Yang Yihuan was unreasonably strong, invincible among his peers.
This was truly tragic. There were so many Imperial Clan elites here, yet they actually couldn't find a single prodigy that could rival him.
The expressions of these Imperial Clan elites were all ugly. Were they really going to be humiliated?
'Hmm?'
All the Saints faltered upon hearing this. They then looked toward a certain direction.
In the blink of an eye, the space was forcefully torn apart by a large hand, and then a sturdy old man walked out.
Beside the old man, there was also a young man with a lanky figure. His appearance was ordinary, but there was a golden pattern on his forehead.
A Saint!

The elites were all very curious. Saints were not cabbages that could be found anywhere. There were only so many of them in this world, and they really could be counted on one hand. But they had never seen this Saint before, which naturally made them feel very curious.
"How should I address you, friend?" the Shattering Stars Saint asked immediately.
The burly old man smiled, "I am the Jade Drop Saint."
Jade Drop? Jade Drop Saint?
Everyone exchanged looks, all of them completely at a loss. It was as if they had never heard of this Saint with the title.
The Jade Drop Saint pointed at the golden-veined young man beside him, and said, "I went everywhere today because I wanted to broaden the horizons for this little guy."
Yi?

chapters.title: Chapter 4386 Era of crying Imperial Sons
paragraphs: Everyone wore strange expressions.

A Saint walked out of the demonic mist, bringing a young man with him. He said that he wanted to show him the prodigies of the world, and now? A Saint that they had never seen before had appeared, and he also brought a young man with him, saying that he wanted to broaden his horizons.
The two Saints had the same intention. They both wanted the youngsters with them to appear in this world.
What could be more famous than defeating the Imperial Clans?
This infuriated the Saints. F*ck! What did they think the Imperial Clans were? A stepping stone?
Yang Yihuan looked at the golden-veined young man, and smiled, "I am Yang Yihuan. How may I address you, brother?"
"Only those who can win my approval are qualified to know my name," the golden-veined young man declared proudly.
Everyone's expressions were strange. Yang Yihuan's strength had already been verified, and pummeling he Silver Generation was like child's play to him. Could you be as strong as that?
Without enough strength, yet looking down on everyone else, that was an extremely idiotic action.
They were also curious about the origins of this Jade Drop Saint. He was actually unafraid before the Imperial Clans.
No wonder; he hadn't even heard of Imperial Clans, had he?
"Such an arrogant tone!" An Imperial Son couldn't help but humph. He leaped out, and charged towards the golden-veined young man.
Arrogant, arrogant, arrogant. Did he really think that just because the Imperial Clans did not show their might, he could treat them like sick cats?
Peng!
A figure flashed past, and someone was sent flying.
This!
Everyone was gritting their teeth, because the one who had been sent flying was precisely the Imperial Son who had charged out just now.
Er... it must be that this golden-veined young man's cultivation level was high, and was just using his cultivation level to bully others.
Xiu, another Silver Generation attacked, but the result was the same. He was still sent flying with a punch from the golden-veined young man.
What was even more terrifying was the fact that the golden-veined young man's battle prowess had clearly soared several times over in this exchange.
What did this signify?
Like Yang Yihuan, he had also suppressed his cultivation level. He didn't use his cultivation level to overwhelm his opponent.
This was too terrifying, wasn't it? How could there be so many freaks!
The golden-veined young man shook his head, "Are there any more decent opponents?"
They were both freakishly strong, but he was completely different from Yang Yihuan. He was extremely arrogant, and his words did not leave any face for others at all.
Thus, this naturally incited everyone's anger.
However, what could they do? Could it be that they had to ask a Sect Master to make a move?
Meanwhile, Yang Yihuan showed a hint of fighting spirit, and said, "I will battle you."
Only then did the golden-veined young man look towards him. Then, his eyes focused, "Your strength is not weak."
"Being your opponent shouldn't be a problem for me." Yang Yihuan was still as lukewarm as before.
"All right, let's battle!"

The two of them immediately exchanged blows. Boom, in an instant, battle prowess was fully unleashed, and very soon, they were fighting from the ground all the way to the skies, and from the skies back to the ground, and then blasted into the ground.
Everyone was watching with captivated eyes.
Heavens, Spirit Transformation Tier could actually be so strong!
"Battle prowess on the level of Pseudo Sect Master!" All the Saints commented.
This was truly an astonishing battle prowess.
However, their power was stronger, far surpassing the normal Ninth Change, and that was how they could blast out battle prowess on the level of Pseudo Sect Master.
The Saints all looked livid. They knew that their Golden Generation had not possessed such strength when they had been at Spirit Transformation Tier Ninth Change.

For example, though Lian Yutang had also attained Pseudo Sect Master-level battle prowess before, that was because he had already advanced into Sect Master-level, and forcibly retreated. Then, he temporarily stepped in again.
However, these two people... were genuine Spirit Transformation Tiers.
However, their power was stronger, far surpassing the normal Ninth Change, and that was how they could blast out battle prowess on the level of Pseudo Sect Master.
The Saints all looked livid. They knew that their Golden Generation had not possessed such strength when they had been at Spirit Transformation Tier Ninth Change.
Perhaps the top three, such as Lin Xuan and the others, may have reached this kind of height, but as for the others... hoho, they really could not attain such heights.
What was wrong with this world?

There had never been so many prodigies gathered together in a single era. In the past, Lin Xuan and the others would all have the aptitude to become Great Emperor, and in an era, being able to produce two or three such outstanding figures could already be considered a golden age.
But now?
Ling Han, Ding Shu, Origin, which one of them was weaker than Lin Xuan and the others?
This wasn't the end yet. Yang Yihuan and the golden-veined young man seemed to be even stronger!
Heavens, what kind of era was this?

The two young prodigies unleashed their trump cards one after another. Both unleashed their nine spiritual bodies, and the ten "selves" all blasted out Imperial Techniques respectively. The battle was truly world-shaking. If it was not for the unique nature of this planet, it was probable that after this great battle, the Demonic Mist Planet would have been more than half destroyed.
They both unleashed their brilliance, causing others to exclaim in shock and despair. With such prodigies, others would only be mediocre in comparison. How could they possibly catch up?
...Were you born to deliver a blow to others?
After battling for over an hour, the two of them stopped at the same time.
"Hahaha, great! Great!" They all laughed loudly, appearing to be extremely pleased.
They were evenly matched!
"Right now, you're qualified to know my name!" the golden-veined young man said. "My name is... Myriad Dao!"
Pu!
These words caused everyone to gasp in astonishment.
What, he was Myriad Dao! The Myriad Dao that had created countless records on the Galaxy Network, and was on the same level as Origin, Heaven Crushing and Number One in the Galaxy?
Hiss, the members of the Imperial Clans all hissed.

The Galaxy Network didn't have any Imperial Clans, so no matter what kind of astonishing record they created on the Galaxy Network, the Imperial Clans wouldn't take it to heart. This was because without their participation, they could only be considered second grade.
However, reality slapped them heavily in the face.

At that time, Origin had blocked the entrance to the Ancestral King Academy. If it weren't for Ling Han's interference, the Imperial Clans would have been utterly humiliated. And now? Yang Yihuan had beaten them into submission, yet this Myriad Dao was able to fight him to a tie.
What else could they say?
Ling Han was also surprised. This was Myriad Dao?
Of the four people who had caused a stir in the Galaxy Network, only Heaven Crushing still hadn't appeared. Judging by the strength of Myriad Dao and Origin, this person definitely wasn't weak.
Hehe, this was really an era that would make the Imperial Sons weep.

In this battle, Yang Yihuan and Myriad Dao became renowned throughout the world, and correspondingly, Ling Han paled in comparison. In fact, he didn't even have the courage to battle, and was belittled by countless people.
Cultivators who didn't even have the courage to battle were naturally despicable.

Yet Ling Han did not take it to heart at all. He followed the Nine Mountains Saint back to the Nine Suns Holy Land. Afterwards, the Nine Suns Holy Land also temporarily disbanded, because the truth that the Nine Mountains Saint did not possess a real Imperial Weapon would probably be exposed very soon.
—When they were on the Demonic Mist Planet, the Nine Mountains Saint was only putting an act with the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and did not really awaken it.
How could it be revived?

This was naturally temporary. When Ling Han became Emperor, no, no, no, when Ling Han became a Saint, with his strength, he would have no need to fear any Imperial Clan. At that time, the Nine Suns Holy Land would be reestablished.
Calculating the time, Ling Han was already in Spirit Transformation Tier Seventh Change. Minor Advanced Tier kept him away from Saint Tier. It was only two major tiers of fourth pinnacle level.
Calculating the time, Ling Han was already in Spirit Transformation Tier Seventh Change. Minor Advanced Tier kept him away from Saint Tier. It was only two major tiers of fourth pinnacle level.
Of course, this "only" was very possibly tens of thousands of years.
The higher the cultivation level, the harder it was to cross over.
"They actually dare to look down on our Little Han!" The large black dog said angrily, "If it was a battle of equal cultivation levels, Ling Han would have no problem fighting the two of them alone!"
It paused, and looked towards Ling Han, but its expression was slightly uncertain, "Right, Little Han?"

Could it be that they had to ask a Sect Master to make a move?
Meanwhile, Yang Yihuan showed a hint of fighting spirit, and said, "I will battle you."
Only then did the golden-veined young man look towards him.
Then, his eyes focused, "Your strength is not weak."
"Being your opponent shouldn't be a problem for me." Yang Yihuan was still as lukewarm as before.
"All right, let's battle!"
The two of them immediately exchanged blows.

Boom, in an instant, battle prowess was fully unleashed, and very soon, they were fighting from the ground all the way to the skies, and from the skies back to the ground, and then blasted into the ground.
Everyone was watching with captivated eyes.
Heavens, Spirit Transformation Tier could actually be so strong!
"Battle prowess on the level of Pseudo Sect Master!" All the Saints commented.
This was truly an astonishing battle prowess.
However, their power was stronger, far surpassing the normal Ninth Change, and that was how they could blast out battle prowess on the level of Pseudo Sect Master.
The Saints all looked livid.
They knew that their Golden Generation had not possessed such strength when they had been at Spirit Transformation Tier Ninth Change.
For example, though Lian Yutang had also attained Pseudo Sect Master-level battle prowess before, that was because he had already advanced into Sect Master-level, and forcibly retreated.
Then, he temporarily stepped in again.
However, these two people... were genuine Spirit Transformation Tiers.
However, their power was stronger, far surpassing the normal Ninth Change, and that was how they could blast out battle prowess on the level of Pseudo Sect Master.
The Saints all looked livid.
They knew that their Golden Generation had not possessed such strength when they had been at Spirit Transformation Tier Ninth Change.
Perhaps the top three, such as Lin Xuan and the others, may have reached this kind of height, but as for the others... hoho, they really could not attain such heights.
What was wrong with this world?
There had never been so many prodigies gathered together in a single era.

In the past, Lin Xuan and the others would all have the aptitude to become Great Emperor, and in an era, being able to produce two or three such outstanding figures could already be considered a golden age.
But now?
Ling Han, Ding Shu, Origin, which one of them was weaker than Lin Xuan and the others?
This wasn't the end yet.
Yang Yihuan and the golden-veined young man seemed to be even stronger!
Heavens, what kind of era was this?
The two young prodigies unleashed their trump cards one after another.
Both unleashed their nine spiritual bodies, and the ten "selves" all blasted out Imperial Techniques respectively.
The battle was truly world-shaking.
If it was not for the unique nature of this planet, it was probable that after this great battle, the Demonic Mist Planet would have been more than half destroyed.
They both unleashed their brilliance, causing others to exclaim in shock and despair.
With such prodigies, others would only be mediocre in comparison.
How could they possibly catch up?
...Were you born to deliver a blow to others?
After battling for over an hour, the two of them stopped at the same time.
"Hahaha, great!
Great!" They all laughed loudly, appearing to be extremely pleased.
They were evenly matched!
"Right now, you're qualified to know my name!" the golden-veined young man said.
"My name is...
Myriad Dao!"
Pu!
These words caused everyone to gasp in astonishment.
What, he was Myriad Dao!
The Myriad Dao that had created countless records on the Galaxy Network, and was on the same level as Origin, Heaven Crushing and Number One in the Galaxy?
Hiss, the members of the Imperial Clans all hissed.
The Galaxy Network didn't have any Imperial Clans, so no matter what kind of astonishing record they created on the Galaxy Network, the Imperial Clans wouldn't take it to heart.
This was because without their participation, they could only be considered second grade.
However, reality slapped them heavily in the face.
At that time, Origin had blocked the entrance to the Ancestral King Academy.
If it weren't for Ling Han's interference, the Imperial Clans would have been utterly humiliated.
And now?
Yang Yihuan had beaten them into submission, yet this Myriad Dao was able to fight him to a tie.
What else could they say?
Ling Han was also surprised.
This was Myriad Dao?
Of the four people who had caused a stir in the Galaxy Network, only Heaven Crushing still hadn't appeared.
Judging by the strength of Myriad Dao and Origin, this person definitely wasn't weak.
Hehe, this was really an era that would make the Imperial Sons weep.
In this battle, Yang Yihuan and Myriad Dao became renowned throughout the world, and correspondingly, Ling Han paled in comparison.
In fact, he didn't even have the courage to battle, and was belittled by countless people.
Cultivators who didn't even have the courage to battle were naturally despicable.
Yet Ling Han did not take it to heart at all.
He followed the Nine Mountains Saint back to the Nine Suns Holy Land.
Afterwards, the Nine Suns Holy Land also temporarily disbanded, because the truth that the Nine Mountains Saint did not possess a real Imperial Weapon would probably be exposed very soon.
—When they were on the Demonic Mist Planet, the Nine Mountains Saint was only putting an act with the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and did not really awaken it.
How could it be revived?
This was naturally temporary.
When Ling Han became Emperor, no, no, no, when Ling Han became a Saint, with his strength, he would have no need to fear any Imperial Clan.
At that time, the Nine Suns Holy Land would be reestablished.
Calculating the time, Ling Han was already in Spirit Transformation Tier Seventh Change.
Minor Advanced Tier kept him away from Saint Tier.
It was only two major tiers of fourth pinnacle level.
Calculating the time, Ling Han was already in Spirit Transformation Tier Seventh Change.
Minor Advanced Tier kept him away from Saint Tier.
It was only two major tiers of fourth pinnacle level.
Of course, this "only" was very possibly tens of thousands of years.
The higher the cultivation level, the harder it was to cross over.
"They actually dare to look down on our Little Han!" The large black dog said angrily, "If it was a battle of equal cultivation levels, Ling Han would have no problem fighting the two of them alone!"
It paused, and looked towards Ling Han, but its expression was slightly uncertain, "Right, Little Han?"

chapters.title: Chapter 4387 The Imperial Path opens
paragraphs: Meanwhile, Ling Han showed a confident smile, "Of course!"

When he was at the peak stage of the True Self Tier, he already possessed the strength to match Spirit Transformation Tier, because he was an unprecedented Ten Forms! Then, when he completed the Spirit Transformation Tier Ninth Change, it would definitely not be something as simple as possessing the battle prowess of Pseudo Sect Master. Instead, he would truly be capable of matching Sect Master-level!
Even if it was only the weakest Sect Master-level.
Ten Forms, this was unprecedented. This foundation was solid.
Yang Yihuan and Myriad Dao were indeed strong, but in a battle of equal cultivation levels, Ling Han had 100% confidence that he could defeat them.

"Compared to Myriad Dao, I'm now 20 years behind," Ling Han murmured. If he didn't have enough supply of natural treasures, and only ate alchemical pills to increase his cultivation, it would take at least 20 years for him to reach the Spirit Transformation Tier Ninth Change.
Furthermore, this was still a relatively optimistic estimate.
He was now on a small planet, and the overall level of martial arts was only Spirit Transformation Tier. With his strength, that was enough to rule this place.
However, he wasn't here to be a boss, so he naturally kept a low profile.
"After all this, we still don't know who Yang Yihuan is." The large black dog's expression was filled with curiosity.

Ling Han felt the same. The Demonic Mist Planet suddenly appeared, and a huge commotion was caused because of a Saintly medicine. In the end, even Saints returned in defeat. However, a young man walked out from within, easily defeating the Silver Generation.

And this Yang Yihuan had made such a grand entrance. No one pursued the matter, and asked what was hidden in the depths of the demonic mist? And what kind of supreme elite was residing in that silver mountain?

If it had to be said that Yang Yihuan's origins could still be considered "clear", the Imperial Clans did not dare to touch him because they were wary of a possible Pseudo-Emperor backing him. Then, what about Myriad Dao?
Though there was a Saint behind him, in front of the Imperial Clans, Saints were only considered very strong.
No Imperial Clan was willing to trifle with a Saint for no reason, but if they wanted to kill a junior, what was there to be concerned about?

However, Myriad Dao was still alive and well. Moreover, he had also joined the Ancestral King Academy, and was considered Yang Yihuan's equal. As for Ling Han and Ding Shu, their glory had already been completely replaced.

"Myriad Dao should also have a powerful background. At least, he has the backing of an Imperial Clan, and the situation may be more or less the same as Origin," Ling Han estimated. Perhaps, Myriad Dao was the son-in-law of some reclusive Imperial Clan.
"Little Han, hurry up and marry Chi Menghan. That way, we'll also have an Imperial Clan as our backer," the large black dog suggested.
Right now, there were already Imperial Clans reopening hunting orders for Ling Han.
That was because when the Nine Suns Holy Land was disbanded, someone had seen the little red bird.

In order to obtain the inheritance of the Nine Suns Saint, some members of the Imperial Clans had joined the Nine Suns Holy Land. Thus, they naturally wouldn't consider themselves part of Nine Suns Holy Land and be inclined towards it. Instead, they leaked this information the moment they had the chance.
Thus, these Imperial Clans still wanted to obtain the inheritance of the True Phoenix, so they naturally wouldn't give up.

At the same time, the Golden Generation also announced that as long as Yang Yihuan, Myriad Dao and Origin advanced to the Sect Master level, they would let these people know just how terrifying the Golden Generation was.
These days, Ling Han's life was considerably peaceful.
There were no flashes of saber light or sword projections, only idle conversations with his lovers and friends. He was so bored that his b*lls hurt.
However, it wasn't like they had nothing to do. They were all cultivating Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
Even if Ling Han had already comprehended this Imperial Technique, he was still far from reaching Great Accomplishment level. He had only grasped a little bit of its profoundness.
After half a year of cultivation, Ling Han finally succeeded.
As for the others, whether it was the little azure dragon, the large black dog, the empress, and the others, they were all preliminary beginners.

"Come, Little Han, Grandpa Dog will spar with you." The large black dog howled. He had mastered another Imperial Technique, and it could be considered the top grade True Phoenix Technique among Imperial Techniques at that, so it was naturally very pleased with itself.
"All right." Ling Han nodded.
The large black dog immediately charged over. Boom! A brilliant flame was left behind behind him, and he suddenly sped up at an indescribable speed.
Pu, Ling Han immediately spluttered in laughter.

Two flaming wings sprouted from the large black dog's ribs. They were extremely gorgeous, but the large black dog himself was extremely vulgar, and the two auras were completely incompatible with each other.
Was this still called Phoenix Wings Divine Flight?
En, Dog Wings Divine Flight.

However, regardless of whether they were a good match or not, the large black dog's speed was astonishingly fast at this moment. Moreover, wherever he passed, the air around him would also start to burn, with his own martial intent mixed within, forming an extremely terrifying destructive power.
With a thought from Ling Han, he too used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and his figure instantly sped up.
His grasp of this movement technique far surpassed the large black dog's. A pair of giant flaming wings sprouted from his back, and with a flap, he was already hundreds of thousands of miles away.
Boom, fiery flames versus fiery flames, high speed versus high speed.
In just a few strikes, the large black dog howled. It couldn't hold on any longer.
The flames that Ling Han unleashed far surpassed the tolerance that it could endure. His tail was about to be burnt bald.
"Little Han, you're using your public office to avenge a private grudge!" the large black dog wailed in agony. This was truly a heavy loss.
"Grandpa Dragon is coming!" The little azure dragon also rushed out, charging towards Ling Han.
The little red bird, the empress, Hu Niu and the others also charged over. They all used the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, which was incredibly dazzling as they flapped their flaming wings.

However, even if they joined forces, they would still be no match for Ling Han. There was absolutely no need for him to use any other techniques. He only had to use Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and a terrifying wave of fire rolled out, giving everyone a great pressure.
After a few moves, everyone had no choice but to admit defeat.

They were all on the same side, so there was naturally nothing to be ashamed of. Everyone knew that Ling Han's strength was heaven-defying, and in terms of cultivation level, he was indeed in the lead. It was very normal for them to lose.

They were all overjoyed. The Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was indeed awesome. No wonder the True Phoenix had been able to stand side by side with the True Dragon in the past, and this movement technique had always been coveted by the Great Emperors of later generations.
After such boring days passed for a while, an astonishing piece of news spread out on the Galaxy Network.
The Imperial Path had opened!

"What Imperial Path?" Ling Han was very surprised. In his understanding, the Imperial Path was the path that a Great Emperor had to walk to become a Great Emperor, but that was an abstract concept. There was no real path to walk.
But now that the Imperial Path had opened... was there really such a path?

"Haha, you are ignorant and ill-informed, aren't you!" The large black dog laughed loudly, "The Imperial Path has existed since ancient times, and would open once every tens of millions of years, and after every time it opens, those who had become Emperor would definitely be among those who have walked the Imperial Path."
"They're basically in the top three, and occasionally top ten."
Ling Han sneered, "You just found it out on the Galaxy Network, right?"
"Hehe." The large black dog laughed drily. Ling Han had hit the nail on the head. He had indeed done his research at the last minute.
"However, is the Imperial Path really that amazing?" Ling Han was slightly disbelieving. Could it be that if he did not walk this path, he would not be able to become a Great Emperor in future?

"Unless the Imperial Path did not appear in the era when the Great Emperor achieved Dao. Otherwise, all Great Emperors have walked the Imperial Path before." The large black dog counted on his fingers. There was information on the Galaxy Network that could be found. Out of ten Great Emperors, about eight had walked the Imperial Path before, and were basically in the top three.
"Interesting," Ling Han murmured.
