chapters.title: Chapter 4388 Same Moon Planet
paragraphs: Practically all Emperors had walked the Imperial Path before.
Thus, the Imperial Path was extremely, extremely important. In the eyes of the world, if one wanted to become Emperor, they would have to walk the Imperial Path.
Ling Han didn't think that one could become Emperor just by walking any random path. It was probably because this "path" had some heaven-defying good fortune that allowed one to advance so rapidly.
"Is this a Mystery Realm?" he asked.
"Grandpa Dog hasn't had the time to investigate the exact details yet!" the large black dog said. The moment he saw the opening of the Imperial Path, he anxiously came to find Ling Han.

"The True Dragon Abyss has opened, which means that the conditions for becoming Emperor have already been met, and the appearance of the Imperial Path means that it will not take too long for a new Emperor to rise." The little azure dragon suddenly appeared, shaking its head.
Ling Han sighed. What was wrong with them? Why did they all like to show off?
Where had they learnt this from?
"Looks like you've done some research, so you're here to spread your knowledge," Ling Han said with a smile.

The little azure dragon coughed, and began to speak, "The Imperial Path is indeed a Mystery Realm, but unlike other Mystery Realms, it has a beginning and an end. One enters from the beginning, and exits from the end, forming a complete path. That's why it's called a 'path'."
"Please continue your performance." Ling Han made a gesture of invitation.

"There's practically no limit to the lower limit of one's cultivation level when entering the Imperial Path. Generally speaking, one only has to reach the Foundation Building Tier." The little azure dragon organized its thoughts. "However, there's a upper limit, and that's Saints can't enter."
If Saints couldn't enter, then there were still Venerate Tiers and Sect Masters below them.

Ling Han pondered for a moment. In this way, his opponents would no longer just be Yang Yihuan, Myriad Dao, and the others. He would also have to face the threat of Golden Generation. Those guys were now Sect Master-level, and the few people with the fastest cultivation level had even advanced into Venerate Tier-level.
No matter how confident he was, faced with a Sect Master, he could only flee, at best. When he encountered Venerate Tier, he naturally wouldn't have the power to face them head-on.
Thus, if one entered into the Imperial Path, there was still considerable risk.
"Is there any more detailed information about the Imperial Path?" Ling Han asked.
"The information can't be found on the Galaxy Network. Why don't you ask the old man?" the little azure dragon said.

The period that the Imperial Path would stay open was too long, which basically corresponded to the appearance of the Great Emperor. Thus, it was impossible for ordinary forces to maintain records for such a long time. They had long since disappeared in the long passage of history.
Only forces like the Imperial Clans and the Holy Lands would be able to preserve their information generation after generation.
Ling Han immediately stood up and went to look for the Nine Mountains Saint.
The Nine Mountains Saint would naturally try his best to satisfy his disciple's requests. He immediately found some information and stuffed it into Ling Han's hands.

Ling Han, the large black dog, the empress, and the others all studied it with great care. They separated and read different pieces of information, and then summarized them to piece together the full details of the Imperial Path.

The Imperial Path was very difficult to walk, and there were very few who succeeded. In all the generations of prodigies of the Nine Suns Holy Land, the Nine Suns Saint had successfully completed the Imperial Path. Furthermore, he was only second to Ancestral King Lingtian.

However, the Nine Suns Saint didn't explain much about his experiences in the Imperial Path. He really only talked about a few things. On the other hand, when the later generations walked the Imperial Path, they left behind a lot of information.
Actually, they were more complaining about how they had failed.
This information did not have much significance. It only allowed Ling Han and the others to know just how cruel the Imperial Path was, and outlined just the tip of the iceberg.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "I'll only know after I walk it."
"Even the Nine Suns Saint could complete it, what more us," the large black dog encouraged everyone.
Fortunately, the Nine Mountains Saint wasn't here. Otherwise, he would definitely beat up this unfilial disciple of his. He actually dared to look down on their ancestor like this.
Moreover, this wasn't the Nine Suns Planet, where the Nine Suns Saint's undying yin soul was located. If it was, perhaps he may visit the large black dog's dreams in the middle of the night.

Ling Han was naturally filled with confidence in taking the Imperial Path. He frowned, and said, "Most importantly, the Imperial Clans would definitely set up a barrier, and would not allow us to enter."
When everyone heard this, they couldn't help but nod in agreement.
Ling Han, Ding Shu, and Origin were all powerful competitors on the Imperial Path. Thus, the Imperial Clans naturally hoped to keep all of them out, cutting off their chances of becoming Emperor.

However, Origin and Yang Yihuan had the support of the Imperial Clans, so they couldn't stop them. Myriad Dao also seemed to have a powerful background, so the ones who would be stopped should be Ling Han and Ding Shu.
These Imperial Clan elites only needed to send out Saints in turn, bringing the Imperial Weapon to stand guard there. Even the Nine Mountains Saint would only watch helplessly.
Fight head-on?
The only fate was death. If one faced the Imperial Weapon head-on, even a Pseudo-Emperor would feel weak in the knees.

It was no secret that Ling Han could disguise himself, and could even change the fluctuation of his soul. Thus, the Imperial Clans would definitely be on high alert this time, and would not allow Ling Han to take advantage of any loopholes.
It would be as difficult as ascending the heavens to deceive them.
"Then what do we do?" The large black dog wanted nothing more than to scratch his face in anxiety. If the Imperial Clans were really so shameless, it would really be difficult to deal with them.
"Let's go take a look at the situation first." Ling Han thought for a moment.
Everyone immediately set out, heading towards Same Moon Planet.
This was the starting point of the Imperial Path. One could only enter from here, and begin the tumultuous journey on the Imperial Path.

The news of the Imperial Path had already spread out for a while. However, in truth, the Imperial Path had not officially opened yet. There was only a premonition. A boundless ancient stone door stood erect there, as if it was relating the secrets of time.
This stone door was too big. In fact, it was even larger than the Same Moon Planet.
Hence, if they were a planet away, the first thing that rushed into their vision was not that planet, but rather that massive stone door.
Perhaps, it should not be said that the Imperial Path began from Same Moon Planet, but rather that Same Moon Planet just happened to be at the starting point of the Imperial Path.
Seeing these stone doors, Ling Han couldn't help but feel his heart skip a beat.
He had seen this stone door before, or rather, he had seen a shrunken, incomplete version of this stone door.
—When he had leaped over the Celestial Gate, that fourth Celestial Gate he had encountered.

That was an ancient stone door, but it was incomplete, and he had to expend all his energy to push it open. It was also because of this that his strong foundation was established, allowing him to sweep aside all his peers.
Now, when he looked at this stone door, it gave him the same feeling.
Could it be that this Imperial Path was naturally formed by heaven and earth?
The Imperial Path was about to open, and those who wished to become Emperor would all come here. Who knows, they may be able to surpass their predecessors.
And though there were some that did not have the ambition to become Emperor, they hoped to pick up some fated opportunity on the Imperial Path, so that they could become stronger.
Thus, there were many, many people who came. Some were at the level of the Venerate Tier, while others were at the level of the Foundation Building Tier.

However, though there was practically no restriction on cultivation level for those who entered — aside from Saints, anyone with cultivation could enter. However, there was actually another implicit restriction, and that was age.

They were both 1000 years old, and a Core Formation Tier could enter, but a Cauldron Forging Tier couldn't. They were both 10,000 years old. The Minor Advanced Tier could enter, but the Spirit Transformation Tier couldn't.
In other words, only relatively young people would be qualified to walk the Imperial Path.

The moment he saw the opening of the Imperial Path, he anxiously came to find Ling Han.

"The True Dragon Abyss has opened, which means that the conditions for becoming Emperor have already been met, and the appearance of the Imperial Path means that it will not take too long for a new Emperor to rise." The little azure dragon suddenly appeared, shaking its head.
Ling Han sighed.
What was wrong with them?
Why did they all like to show off?
Where had they learnt this from?
"Looks like you've done some research, so you're here to spread your knowledge," Ling Han said with a smile.
The little azure dragon coughed, and began to speak, "The Imperial Path is indeed a Mystery Realm, but unlike other Mystery Realms, it has a beginning and an end.
One enters from the beginning, and exits from the end, forming a complete path.
That's why it's called a 'path'."
"Please continue your performance." Ling Han made a gesture of invitation.
"There's practically no limit to the lower limit of one's cultivation level when entering the Imperial Path.
Generally speaking, one only has to reach the Foundation Building Tier." The little azure dragon organized its thoughts.
"However, there's a upper limit, and that's Saints can't enter."
If Saints couldn't enter, then there were still Venerate Tiers and Sect Masters below them.
Ling Han pondered for a moment.
In this way, his opponents would no longer just be Yang Yihuan, Myriad Dao, and the others.
He would also have to face the threat of Golden Generation.
Those guys were now Sect Master-level, and the few people with the fastest cultivation level had even advanced into Venerate Tier-level.
No matter how confident he was, faced with a Sect Master, he could only flee, at best.
When he encountered Venerate Tier, he naturally wouldn't have the power to face them head-on.
Thus, if one entered into the Imperial Path, there was still considerable risk.
"Is there any more detailed information about the Imperial Path?" Ling Han asked.
"The information can't be found on the Galaxy Network.
Why don't you ask the old man?" the little azure dragon said.
The period that the Imperial Path would stay open was too long, which basically corresponded to the appearance of the Great Emperor.
Thus, it was impossible for ordinary forces to maintain records for such a long time.
They had long since disappeared in the long passage of history.
Only forces like the Imperial Clans and the Holy Lands would be able to preserve their information generation after generation.
Ling Han immediately stood up and went to look for the Nine Mountains Saint.
The Nine Mountains Saint would naturally try his best to satisfy his disciple's requests.
He immediately found some information and stuffed it into Ling Han's hands.
Ling Han, the large black dog, the empress, and the others all studied it with great care.
They separated and read different pieces of information, and then summarized them to piece together the full details of the Imperial Path.
The Imperial Path was very difficult to walk, and there were very few who succeeded.
In all the generations of prodigies of the Nine Suns Holy Land, the Nine Suns Saint had successfully completed the Imperial Path.
Furthermore, he was only second to Ancestral King Lingtian.
However, the Nine Suns Saint didn't explain much about his experiences in the Imperial Path.
He really only talked about a few things.
On the other hand, when the later generations walked the Imperial Path, they left behind a lot of information.
Actually, they were more complaining about how they had failed.
This information did not have much significance.
It only allowed Ling Han and the others to know just how cruel the Imperial Path was, and outlined just the tip of the iceberg.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "I'll only know after I walk it."
"Even the Nine Suns Saint could complete it, what more us," the large black dog encouraged everyone.
Fortunately, the Nine Mountains Saint wasn't here.
Otherwise, he would definitely beat up this unfilial disciple of his.
He actually dared to look down on their ancestor like this.
Moreover, this wasn't the Nine Suns Planet, where the Nine Suns Saint's undying yin soul was located.
If it was, perhaps he may visit the large black dog's dreams in the middle of the night.
Ling Han was naturally filled with confidence in taking the Imperial Path.
He frowned, and said, "Most importantly, the Imperial Clans would definitely set up a barrier, and would not allow us to enter."
When everyone heard this, they couldn't help but nod in agreement.
Ling Han, Ding Shu, and Origin were all powerful competitors on the Imperial Path.
Thus, the Imperial Clans naturally hoped to keep all of them out, cutting off their chances of becoming Emperor.
However, Origin and Yang Yihuan had the support of the Imperial Clans, so they couldn't stop them.
Myriad Dao also seemed to have a powerful background, so the ones who would be stopped should be Ling Han and Ding Shu.
These Imperial Clan elites only needed to send out Saints in turn, bringing the Imperial Weapon to stand guard there.
Even the Nine Mountains Saint would only watch helplessly.
Fight head-on?
The only fate was death.
If one faced the Imperial Weapon head-on, even a Pseudo-Emperor would feel weak in the knees.
It was no secret that Ling Han could disguise himself, and could even change the fluctuation of his soul.
Thus, the Imperial Clans would definitely be on high alert this time, and would not allow Ling Han to take advantage of any loopholes.
It would be as difficult as ascending the heavens to deceive them.
"Then what do we do?" The large black dog wanted nothing more than to scratch his face in anxiety.
If the Imperial Clans were really so shameless, it would really be difficult to deal with them.
"Let's go take a look at the situation first." Ling Han thought for a moment.
Everyone immediately set out, heading towards Same Moon Planet.
This was the starting point of the Imperial Path.
One could only enter from here, and begin the tumultuous journey on the Imperial Path.
The news of the Imperial Path had already spread out for a while.
However, in truth, the Imperial Path had not officially opened yet.
There was only a premonition.
A boundless ancient stone door stood erect there, as if it was relating the secrets of time.
This stone door was too big.
In fact, it was even larger than the Same Moon Planet.
Hence, if they were a planet away, the first thing that rushed into their vision was not that planet, but rather that massive stone door.
Perhaps, it should not be said that the Imperial Path began from Same Moon Planet, but rather that Same Moon Planet just happened to be at the starting point of the Imperial Path.
Seeing these stone doors, Ling Han couldn't help but feel his heart skip a beat.
He had seen this stone door before, or rather, he had seen a shrunken, incomplete version of this stone door.
—When he had leaped over the Celestial Gate, that fourth Celestial Gate he had encountered.
That was an ancient stone door, but it was incomplete, and he had to expend all his energy to push it open.
It was also because of this that his strong foundation was established, allowing him to sweep aside all his peers.
Now, when he looked at this stone door, it gave him the same feeling.
Could it be that this Imperial Path was naturally formed by heaven and earth?
The Imperial Path was about to open, and those who wished to become Emperor would all come here.
Who knows, they may be able to surpass their predecessors.
And though there were some that did not have the ambition to become Emperor, they hoped to pick up some fated opportunity on the Imperial Path, so that they could become stronger.
Thus, there were many, many people who came.
Some were at the level of the Venerate Tier, while others were at the level of the Foundation Building Tier.
However, though there was practically no restriction on cultivation level for those who entered — aside from Saints, anyone with cultivation could enter.
However, there was actually another implicit restriction, and that was age.
They were both 1000 years old, and a Core Formation Tier could enter, but a Cauldron Forging Tier couldn't.
They were both 10,000 years old.
The Minor Advanced Tier could enter, but the Spirit Transformation Tier couldn't.
In other words, only relatively young people would be qualified to walk the Imperial Path.

chapters.title: Chapter 4389: Another One
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
As the days passed, more and more people arrived at Same Moon Planet.
Just how many were there?
There were people everywhere, that it was difficult to set up even a tent.
It couldn’t be helped. Although the planet colossal, almost everyone in the universe was running over now, so how could it not be crowded?
The problem was, it was one thing for youngsters like you to come, but those white-bearded old geezers also came, so what kind of excitement were they getting themselves involved in?
‘You people definitely won’t be able to enter.’
But they didn’t care, not about age, or relative age. Tons of people came, forcefully stuffing themselves in.
“Imperial Son Ze!”
“Imperial Son Xuan!”
“Imperial Son Ming!”
Several more days passed, and the Golden Generation finally arrived one after another.

Right now, even the most powerful Golden Generation elite was only Venerate Tier. They were completely capable of stepping onto the Imperial Path and contending for supremacy. Moreover, the time was coincidentally so good. Coincidentally, they were Battle prowess, and could be regarded as the most powerful elites of the Imperial Path.
Then, who would be able to compete with them?

History had proved that those who could become Emperor were practically the first three people to complete the Imperial Path. At the very least, they would be in the top ten, and that was pitifully few.

Thus, if the Golden Generation dominated the top ten, it would be equivalent to seizing the fortune of heaven and earth. Then what about Yang Yihuan and Myriad Dao? So what if their natural talent was higher than theirs? The fortune of heaven and earth did not favor them!

Moreover, the Golden Generation was completely capable of committing murder on the Imperial Path. This was a Mystery Realm. In battles in a Mystery Realm, one was responsible for his own life and death. This was a rule that all forces tacitly agreed on.
Countless prodigies had come, but none of them was as dazzling as the Golden Generation.

That’s right. Although Yang Yihuan, Ding Shu, Origin and Myriad Dao had risen up strongly, it had only been a short while, after all. Furthermore, they had not confronted the Golden Generation head-on, so the public still thought that the Golden Generation was the most awesome.
Ling Han sat cross-legged at the side, watching as the Imperial Sons arrived, one after another. They were all incredibly domineering.

This time should be the most important selection on the path to becoming Emperor, because according to history, at most, only the top ten would be qualified to contest for the throne. Thus, after this time, the people with chances of becoming Emperor would become clear.

And this was also the last chance for anyone to take a turn and overtake them. If he obtained a great opportunity on the Imperial Path, perhaps a Silver Generation would be able to turn the tables and become the new leader.
Everyone was filled with ambition, and they all set their sights on the only position of Emperor.
Becoming Emperor, one’s name would be known for all eternity, and his might would suppress the heavens.
Who would remember a loser?

Day after day passed, and more and more prodigies came. Some of them had never been heard of before, but now, they had popped out from who knows where, causing people to exclaim in surprise. As it turned out, there were still so many low-key prodigies.
It wasn’t long before Yang Yihuan also arrived.
He was still calm and composed. Even when he faced the Imperial Path, there was not the slightest fluctuation in his emptions. This caused Ling Han to feel slightly surprised.
Because to be honest, Ling Han was still filled with imagination and longing for the Imperial Path, as well as a sliver of reverence towards the unknown.
However, wasn’t Yang Yihuan a little too calm? He was so calm that it was a little inexcusable.

He had naturally been escorted here by the Saint Yue, and that Saint was extremely low-key. He stood, arms crossed behind his back. If one had not witnessed it personally, who would have guessed that he was actually a Saint?

Space was torn apart, and a large green hand stretched out. Then, an elder in green robes walked out, while a young man followed behind him. He was dressed in a purple imperial robe, exuding an endless air of majesty.
Yi, who was this person?
The members of the Imperial Clans were also astonished. This was because this elder in black was a Saint. However, none of them recognized this elder.
“Heavens, what is going on here?”
Since when did Saints become so cheap? They were all popping out one after another?
“Brother Yang, you’re here!” Just as everyone was guessing the identity of this old man and young man, the young man in purple robes greeted Yang Yihuan.
What? This person actually knew Yang Yihuan?
Hiss, Yang Yi had walked out of the silver mountain in the demonic mist, so how could he possibly have old acquaintances?
“Brother He!” Yang Yihuan also smiled, and nodded at the purple-robed young man.
They really were old acquaintances!
This caused everyone to mumble. Who exactly was this purple-robed young man?
“Friend, how should I address you?” the Rainbow Light Saint asked the elder in green as he clasped his hands in greeting.
A hint of pride appeared on the elder’s face, yet he didn’t reply.
The Rainbow Light Saint couldn’t help but feel angry. He was also a Saint, and furthermore, he was a Saint of an Imperial Clan. Your attitude is really too arrogant, isn’t it?
“Friend, you have gone too far!” He stretched out a hand, which turned into a giant hand that blotted out the skies, grabbing out at the elder in green.

“Ignorant!” The elder in cyan humphed, and two black swords shot out of his eyes. Shua, shua, shua, shua, they slashed towards that giant hand. As the sword projections danced, that giant hand was very quickly destroyed.
“Wu!” The Rainbow Light Saint couldn’t help but let out a muffled groan as blood started to flow from his right hand.
The giant hand was destroyed, and he also suffered a backlash, suffering some light injuries.

Everyone was astonished upon seeing this. One had to realize that the Rainbow Light Saint was a three-star Saint. To wound him so easily, the elder in cyan had to be a five-star Saint, at the very least!
The Rainbow Light Saint, having suffered a loss, couldn’t help but fly into a rage out of humiliation.
I am a Saint of an Imperial Clan, and you dare to bully me?
Xiu, he took out the Imperial Weapon, a large golden cauldron.

Weng! The gigantic golden cauldron hovered above his head, branded with various weapons such as sabers, swords, axes, halberds, and so on. As it gently floated, these weapons all lit up, exuding an incredibly powerful aura.
The Imperial Weapon was about to awaken, and killing Saints was as easy as slaughtering chickens.

Yet the elder in cyan clothing was completely unmoved. A large blood-coloured umbrella was opened above his head, and there were white skulls drawn all over it. They were all flickering with a frightening baleful killing intent.
“What?!” The members of the Imperial Clans all wore expressions of shock, and they exclaimed, “Imperial Weapon!”
This was definitely an Imperial Weapon!
Who would’ve thought that a mysterious Saint would appear with an Imperial Weapon?
“Which Imperial Clan does this Saint belong to?”
“I’ve never heard of this kind of Imperial Weapon!”
“Heavens, there are actually hidden Imperial Clans?”
This stunned the Imperial Clan elites. As it turned out, aside from them, there were also other reclusive Imperial Clan.
Imperial Weapon against Imperial Weapon!

The Rainbow Light Saint instantly lost his anger. If the two Imperial Weapons clashed, the most likely result would be that both sides would be severely wounded. Moreover, he was only a Three Star Saint, so he definitely wouldn’t be able to last as long as his opponent. Thus, even if the two sides were evenly matched, the Rainbow Light Saint would still be the first to fall.
Then what was the point of fighting?

A great battle that could possibly break out had thus vanished without a trace. The Rainbow Light Saint was naturally completely humiliated. He sat down, his expression dark. If it was not for the fact that he still had the heavy responsibility of protecting the Imperial Son of his clan, he would definitely have left with a flourish of his sleeves.
—He could not afford to lose face like this!
Ling Han was also surprised. Where had this purple-robed young man popped out from?

It should be known that though Yang Yihuan had always been polite towards others, he was incredibly proud, but looking at his attitude towards the purple-robed young man, there was a sliver of wariness in his attitude.
This kind of expression would only appear on his face when he was facing a powerful opponent.
Another powerful opponent had appeared.
Ling Han thought internally, but did not feel the slightest bit of fear, only excitement.
“The Imperial Path has opened!” Someone suddenly called out.

chapters.title: Chapter 4390: Blocked
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Hong long long, a world-shaking sound rang out, and that stone door that was larger than the planet was slowly opening.
The Imperial Path had officially opened!
All of a sudden, the Imperial Sons were the first to move, and passed through the gap in the stone doors that had only been slightly opened.
The stone door was too big. Even if it was just a crack, it was enough for people to easily enter, and there was absolutely no need for them to fight over it.
However, it would not be so easy for others to enter.
The Saints of the Imperial Clans joined forces, and all those who were not members of Imperial Clans would have to undergo a strict examination from them.
‘F*ck! Are they targeting me?’

Ling Han knew that he had killed a few Imperial Sons, and had already formed a great enmity with a great many Imperial Clans. Previously, there was still the threat of the Nine Mountains Saint and the Imperial Weapon. Now, this balance of power no longer existed, so the Imperial Clans naturally wanted to get rid of him.

Even if the universe was too big, and the Imperial Clans couldn’t find him in a short while, they definitely couldn’t allow him to enter the Imperial Path. That would be giving him great fortune for no reason.
Ling Han could only watch helplessly as groups of people were examined by the Saints before stepping through the stone doors.
And this stone door was really too big, and the speed at which it was opened was too slow. A whole half day had passed, and the stone door was still not completely opened.
“The old man is here!” Ling Han faltered upon hearing this. He had received a message from the Nine Mountains Saint.
After announcing his location, the Nine Mountains Saint immediately arrived.
“I’ll send you in,” the Nine Mountains Saint said. There was fury on his face.
F***, they were actually so devious. They wanted to use this kind of method to cut off Ling Han’s path to becoming Emperor?
“Old man, don’t get too worked up,” Ling Han hurriedly said. “There’s a bunch of Saints over there, and quite a few of them are holding Imperial Weapons.”
The Nine Mountains Saint shook his head, and said, “It’s fine.”
He had to take a gamble. If he missed this opportunity, it was possible that Ling Han would have no chance of becoming Emperor.
Thus, no matter how dangerous it was ahead of him, he had to take a gamble.
He grabbed Ling Han and the others. Boom! His figure enlarged endlessly, and with a single step, he was heading towards the stone door.

These stone doors were even larger than the planet. Thus, the Nine Mountains Saint only had to approach slightly, and with a wave of his hand, he would be able to throw Ling Han and the others through the stone doors.
“Nine Mountains, I’ve been waiting for you for a long time!”
However, two Saints immediately stepped forward to greet him, launching an attack at the Nine Mountains Saint.
Peng!
The Regulations intertwined to form a terrifying divine light that was indestructible.
The Nine Mountains Saint had no choice but to retreat. He was only a One Star Saint, but the two people that were blasting towards him were both Three Star Saints.
It should be known that even if there was only a gap of a single star, there was a massive gap in strength between Saints, so how could one afford a gap of two stars?
If they clashed head-on, the only fate would be death.
“You should have come to escort that junior, Ling Han!” one of the Saints who had moved shouted, “Hand over that despicable brat, and we can spare your life!”
The Nine Mountains Saint naturally wouldn’t pay any heed to this. He simply continued to flee with all his might.
However, it was useless. The two three-star Saints were completely blocking his way, and even if the Nine Mountains Saint fought all out, it was still completely impossible for him to break through.
The gap in strength was really quite wide.
“Haha, don’t you have the Imperial Weapon? Why don’t you use it?” the two Saints continued to taunt.
The Nine Mountains Saint immediately turned around to flee.
—The other Saints were already reviving the Imperial Weapons, and were about to deliver a fatal blow to him.
Thus, he could only retreat now. He refused to believe that these Saints would stay here forever.
He couldn’t defend for too long, as there would eventually be flaws in his defenses.

Thankfully, the Nine Mountains Saint had left in the nick of time. If he had been a little later, the Saints would have surrounded him, and he really would have had no choice but to stay and fight to the death.
And if he fought to the death, his only fate would be death.
After the Nine Mountains Saint brought Ling Han and the others on a circle, he quietly returned to the Same Moon Planet, and prepared to wait for an opportunity to make a move.
He made a few attempts, but they all ended in failure. There were two times that he was in a perilous situation, and almost died.
Ling Han advised, “Forget it, old man, let’s not go! I don’t believe that if I don’t walk this Imperial Path, I won’t be able to become Emperor!”
He was filled with confidence. As long as his cultivation level advanced rapidly, he would definitely be able to become Emperor.
Meanwhile, the Nine Mountains Saint didn’t agree. History had already proven countless times that the Great Emperor had definitely stood out from those who had passed through the Imperial Path.
That was fine. He definitely had to create this kind of opportunity for Ling Han.
“Wait a few more days,” he said. If worse came to worst, he would just have to wait for a year and a half. Would Saints like them still stand guard here with Imperial Weapon in hand?

Because there were really too many people, even if there were Saints inspecting, this speed was still not fast enough. Same Moon Planet was still filled with people, but everyone was angry but did not dare to say anything. That was the Imperial Clan, so even if they were overbearing and unreasonable, so what?
In the blink of an eye, ten days had passed.

What surprised Ling Han was the fact that Yang Yihuan and the young man in purple were actually in no rush to step onto the Imperial Path. The two of them were whispering to each other, and it was unknown what they were talking about.
Weng, a terrifying aura suddenly appeared, making people feel as if their hearts were about to jump out of their chests.

Then, a figure appeared. It was a young monk who looked to be about fifteen or sixteen years old. He was dressed in a gray monastic robe. His small face was clearly handsome, but was filled with a murderous aura. He was showing his might without being angry.
Buddha Doga!
Why had he come?
A Pseudo-Emperor appeared, and instantly, everyone’s hearts beat like drums. Even the hands of the Saints from the Imperial Clans were covered with a layer of cold sweat.
In this world, without the appearance of a Great Emperor, Pseudo-Emperor was invincible.
In front of such an elite, the Imperial Clans could only save themselves.

Pu!

This?
How was this possible!

The Imperial Path had officially opened!
All of a sudden, the Imperial Sons were the first to move, and passed through the gap in the stone doors that had only been slightly opened.
The stone door was too big.
Even if it was just a crack, it was enough for people to easily enter, and there was absolutely no need for them to fight over it.
However, it would not be so easy for others to enter.
The Saints of the Imperial Clans joined forces, and all those who were not members of Imperial Clans would have to undergo a strict examination from them.
‘F*ck!
Are they targeting me?’
Ling Han knew that he had killed a few Imperial Sons, and had already formed a great enmity with a great many Imperial Clans.
Previously, there was still the threat of the Nine Mountains Saint and the Imperial Weapon.
Now, this balance of power no longer existed, so the Imperial Clans naturally wanted to get rid of him.
Even if the universe was too big, and the Imperial Clans couldn’t find him in a short while, they definitely couldn’t allow him to enter the Imperial Path.
That would be giving him great fortune for no reason.
Ling Han could only watch helplessly as groups of people were examined by the Saints before stepping through the stone doors.
And this stone door was really too big, and the speed at which it was opened was too slow.
A whole half day had passed, and the stone door was still not completely opened.
“The old man is here!” Ling Han faltered upon hearing this.
He had received a message from the Nine Mountains Saint.
After announcing his location, the Nine Mountains Saint immediately arrived.
“I’ll send you in,” the Nine Mountains Saint said.
There was fury on his face.
F***, they were actually so devious.
They wanted to use this kind of method to cut off Ling Han’s path to becoming Emperor?

The Nine Mountains Saint shook his head, and said, “It’s fine.”

If he missed this opportunity, it was possible that Ling Han would have no chance of becoming Emperor.

If they clashed head-on, the only fate would be death.

However, it was useless.
The two three-star Saints were completely blocking his way, and even if the Nine Mountains Saint fought all out, it was still completely impossible for him to break through.

chapters.title: Chapter 4391: Another door
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
As it turned out, the Imperial Path really could be walked more than once!
Ordinary people could not imagine this at all, and could only stare in dumbfounded shock, while in the case of the Imperial Clans, all of their expressions were solemn.
One had walked the Imperial Path nine times, while the other had walked the Imperial Path eleven times. Just how many great opportunities had they obtained on the Imperial Path?
Thus, how could they not be strong?

The killing intent of Buddha Doga surged, and it was as if he were about to attack. This shocked the Saint Yue and the other Saint in green, and they both looked as if they were about to face a powerful enemy.
Who wouldn’t be afraid of the might of a Pseudo-Emperor?
“Lord Doga, for the sake of Master, please don’t start a fight,” the Saint in green hurriedly said. His tone was extremely respectful, and there was no sign of arrogance in his voice.
Buddha Doga humphed, and said, “I disdain from attacking juniors!”
The two Saints breathed a sigh of relief upon hearing this.
The words of a Pseudo-Emperor were like the words of a law decree.
Buddha Doga looked at the Imperial Clan Saints and said, “You people have the nerve to pick on the weak with so many people!”
What did that mean?
Could it be that he was standing up for Ling Han?
Hiss, then the matter would become serious.

The fact that the Imperial Clans dared to do this was naturally because they thought that the Nine Mountains Saint was only a One Star Saint, the weakest among Saints. Furthermore, he did not have the Imperial Weapon in his possession, so naturally, he was completely unqualified to challenge the Imperial Clans.
However, Buddha Doga was different.
Pseudo-Emperor!
Right now, if Doga wanted to support Ling Han, who among them could afford to offend him?
They had not expected this. It turned out that Buddha Doga really had a high opinion of Ling Han.
However, right at this moment, Buddha Doga suddenly moved, grabbing Ling Han from afar. He then took a step, and a golden path spread out, heading directly into the boundless distance.
Yi?
To say nothing of the Imperial Clan elites, even the Nine Mountains Saint was stunned.
What was going on here?
Shouldn’t you have stood up for Ling Han? Why did you run away with him?
In the boundless distance, on a dark and cold planet.
Buddha Doga stopped, then tossed Ling Han aside.
“Greetings, Senior Doga.” Ling Han clasped his hands in greeting.

He did not dare to be impudent. This person had once been a bloodthirsty person, and the number of Saints that had died in his hands could be said to be frighteningly many. Though it was possible that he had optimistic expectations of him, he could not afford to take a gamble on the other party’s temperamental personality.
Buddha Doga stood with his hands clasped behind his back, and said calmly, “Are you very angry that you have been blocked from the Imperial Path?”

“Yes, a little.” Ling Han nodded honestly. In front of this Lord, it was best to be more honest. However, he immediately broke into a smile again, “However, even if I am unable to set foot on the Imperial Path, I do not think that I would be unable to become Emperor.”
Buddha Doga couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. “You’re quite confident.”
Ling Han snickered, and honestly and without reservation, accepted this compliment.

Buddha Doga pondered for a moment, then said, “I can send you back, and I guarantee that no one will dare to stop you again. However, I can also guide you to another door. You too can enter the Imperial Path from that door, but it is filled with danger. You may die at any time.”
“Which one do you choose?”
Ling Han didn’t hesitate at all, and he said, “I choose the second option!”
What accompanied danger was usually fated opportunities.
Buddha Doga couldn’t help but smile and say, “Very good. I wasn’t wrong about you.”
“I’ll bring you there now.”
Ling Han hurriedly asked, “Senior Doga, can I bring a few more people with me?”
There was still the empress, the large black dog and the others.
“No!” Buddha Doga refused coldly.
This person wasn’t a benevolent charity worker. Instead, he was a great demon who had killed Saints.
Ling Han didn’t say anything else. He definitely couldn’t make arbitrary requests just because Buddha Doga viewed him differently.
The latter wasn’t the Nine Mountains Saint.

Buddha Doga walked ahead, and Ling Han hurriedly followed behind him. As he sensed with his divine sense, he was surprised. This was because although this planet still had ley lines, they seemed to be on the verge of death.
This was completely unable to allow him to use Star Steps, because the Earth Qi was really too weak.
However, with Buddha Doga here, who in this world could hurt him?
However, Buddha Doga was really walking too fast, and Ling Han was gradually left behind.

Ling Han didn’t tell the Buddha Doga to slow down. Instead, he channeled Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and he instantly sped up. Not only was he no longer left behind by the Buddha Doga, but he even closed the distance between them.
Buddha Doga was slightly surprised, and he said, “Who would’ve thought? You actually obtained the inheritance of the True Phoenix.”
“It’s all luck, just luck,” Ling Han said very modestly.

Indeed, if it weren’t for the little red bird, he would have only trapped himself inside the lair of the True Phoenix. If it weren’t for the Flame Skin Race’s ancestor, the True Phoenix would have possessed the little red bird long ago. It wouldn’t have had anything to do with him either.
Unexpectedly, Buddha Doga continued, “Luck is also a part of strength.”
The corners of Ling Han’s mouth twitched, but he did not laugh out loud.
After walking for a while, Buddha Doga suddenly stopped.
He began to draw formations on the ground. They were incredibly mysterious, and even if Ling Han was a formation grandmaster, he still couldn’t understand them.
This was... Saint-level formation, or even in fact, Great Emperor-level formation.
“Senior Doga, I didn’t expect you to be so proficient in formation techniques!” Ling Han flattered.
“If you live long enough, you’ll naturally learn some other things as well,” Buddha Doga said calmly.

Ling Han thought internally. He didn’t need to live for too long, because his comprehension ability was too high. You see, in martial arts, formations, and alchemy, he was proficient in all of them. He only needed his Spiritual Power to improve further, and he would similarly be able to come into contact with Saint-level formations.
He didn’t say these words. He was showing off too much, and it was very likely that he would be beaten to death by Buddha Doga.
‘Yes, I won’t say.’
It wasn’t long before the formation was completed. Buddha Doga activated the formation, instantly forming a dark door of light that was slowly spinning.
“Come,” Buddha Doga said.
“This leads to the Imperial Path?” Ling Han asked.
“No,” Buddha Doga shook his head.
“Then where does it lead to?”
“Netherworld.”
Pu!
Ling Han instantly spluttered. Netherworld? Weren’t we looking for another route to Imperial Path? Why are you bringing me to Netherworld?
Moreover, Yin and Yang were separated, and there was the existence of the realm barrier. If you could draw a formation that led to the Netherworld, that seemed a little too casual, wasn’t it?
“This planet is one of the weakest locations in the barrier between the Yin and Yang Realms.” It was rare for Buddha Doga to be willing to explain.
Ling Han wasn’t stupid, and he immediately came to a realization. “The other path to the Imperial Path is in the Netherworld!”
It was no wonder that the ley lines of this planet seemed to have died. It must have been affected by the Netherworld.
This was a child that could be taught.

A smile appeared on Buddha Doga’s face, and he said, “That’s right. Because Yin and Yang correspond to each other, if you want to advance from the Netherworld to the Imperial Path, you’ll have to experience many obstacles.”
“I’m not afraid!” Ling Han immediately replied, appearing to be filled with confidence.

No wonder Buddha Doga didn’t allow him to bring other people with him. It was too dangerous to travel from the Netherworld. If he brought the empress and the others with him, it was very likely that they would be harmed.
Thus, it was better for him to be alone.
Buddha Doga led the way, entering the doorway of light. Ling Han hurriedly followed behind him.
After taking a few steps, a terrifying chill assaulted him, penetrating straight into his bones.
Netherworld!
A sense of familiarity rose up in Ling Han. How many times had he entered into the Netherworld?
Buddha Doga walked in front, and the Buddha Halo behind its head lit up. In this dim Netherworld, it appeared extremely dazzling.

chapters.title: Chapter 4392: Stepping on the Imperial Path
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Not long after, a large number of Yin souls appeared in the distance, pouncing madly towards them.
The aura of life of Buddha Doga was too strong, so this aggro was naturally very strong.

The strength of these Yin souls varied. There were Foundation Building Tier, Cauldron Forging Tier, Spirit Transformation Tier, and Minor Advanced Tier. They all rushed over like a swarm of bees. A Pseudo-Emperor’s life force was as vast as the sea, and for Yin souls, this was an irresistible temptation.

Faced with so many Yin souls, Buddha Doga did not make a move at all. He merely strode forwards, but any Yin soul that dared to barge within three hundred meters of him would immediately be turned into pieces, and completely return to the heaven and earth.
In the Netherworld, Buddha Doga advanced as easily as walking on flat ground.
A Yin Saint appeared, spying on them, but did not dare to make a move at all. In front of a Pseudo-Emperor, the Yin Saint was practically trash.
“You’ve watched for so long, isn’t that enough?” Buddha Doga asked calmly. The Buddha Halo behind his head suddenly lit up brightly, turning into a Skanda Staff that shot towards the Yin Saint.
Pu!
It was as if the Yin Saint’s body had been frozen in place. He was unable to dodge at all, and was directly turned into ashes.
Awesome, that was a Saint-level being. Even if the Yin Saint was not as strong as a Saint from the Living Realm, being insta-killed with a single strike was really enough to make one’s eyes pop out.
The might of Pseudo-Emperor was world-shaking.
Although this was the Netherworld, it was as if Buddha Doga was in his own backyard. He didn’t need to worry about anything at all.
After walking for a long time, a massive stone door appeared ahead of them.
Yi?
There was actually a corresponding stone door here as well?
Ling Han was surprised. This stone door was very similar to the stone door on Same Moon Planet. It was also ancient and majestic, but in terms of size, it was slightly smaller.
Now, these doors were completely open, revealing a passageway.
However, not a single Yin soul entered, as if for Yin souls, that was a Forbidden Land.
“Go on,” Buddha Doga said.
“Thank you, Senior.” Ling Han bowed respectfully. Without Buddha Doga, it was impossible for him to enter into Imperial Path.
Buddha Doga nodded, and was just about to turn around and leave.

“Senior, why are you helping me?” Ling Han couldn’t help but ask. Buddha Doga was already a Pseudo-Emperor, practically the strongest in the universe. Could it be that he wanted to ask him to repay him for his help?

“A great era is about to come, and there should be a few more talents like you. Step out to face the waves,” Buddha Doga said. Then, he took another step, and a golden path spread out, heading directly into the boundless distance.
He took another step, and instantly disappeared from sight.
‘F*ck! Why don’t you explain yourself?’
Ling Han naturally knew that a grand and expansive era was about to arrive. Just look, freaks like Origin, Myriad Dao, and Ding Shu were all appearing in batches. Wasn’t it obvious?
The question was, what was going on with this great era?
Yin soul, chaotic world, sea of blood boiling the skies, Saints as common as dogs?
Ling Han couldn’t ask any more questions. This was because with the departure of Buddha Doga, countless Yin souls had also begun to target him and were charging over.
He hurriedly broke into a run, and rushed into the stone door.
Ahead of him was a passageway with no end in sight. A cold chill assaulted him, ten times stronger than before.

Ling Han hurriedly activated his Starlight Screen to block the cold. He then strode forward, yet he didn’t unleash his movement technique or unleash his extreme speed. This was because the environment here was unclear, and there were unknown dangers hidden within. Thus, it was best to remain cautious.
Hehe, now Yang Yihuan, Myriad Dao, and the Golden Generation all thought that he had not set foot on the Imperial Path. If they suddenly came across him, would these people be shocked?
En.
With a thought from Ling Han, he changed his appearance. This kind of surprise was strong enough.
“I haven’t set foot on the Imperial Path yet, so no matter how many Imperial Sons die, it has nothing to do with me.”

He murmured to himself. At present, he was no match for the Golden Generation, but when he advanced into the level of Sect Master, he was sure that there would be a great many Golden Generations that would kneel down in front of him and proclaim their conquest.
This passage was really very long. After walking for about a day, it was finally no longer dark. Instead, there was a sliver of light. At the same time, the temperature also began to rise again.
“Yi?”
He saw a black shadow lying in front of him. It looked a little like a corpse.
Ling Han carefully walked over. It was possible that some dangerous creature was lying in ambush here. If he was careless, it was very likely that he would be caught off guard.
After a few steps, he arrived in front of the black shadow.
As expected, this was indeed a corpse. However, this corpse was different from all the corpses that Ling Han had seen.
There were many living beings in the world, so Ling Han had seen many strange corpses. However, this one was covered with red hair, and its body... was empty!

Strictly speaking, this was human skin. Red hair grew on the human skin, and other things like blood, flesh, and bones did not exist, but it had forcefully formed into the shape of a human body. Ling Han was amazed by this.
Where was his blood and flesh? Where were his bones?
Someone had removed them?
But who would be so bored as to peel off a person’s skin by force, and there was not the slightest bit of damage? Furthermore, what the hell was this red hair?
A terrifying pressure suddenly spread out, causing Ling Han to involuntarily turn pale. He retreated continuously, unable to catch his breath at all.
Hiss, how terrifying.

Ling Han was stunned. What kind of background did this red-haired human skin have? Why did he feel a Saint-level pressure? If it was not him, and if it was another person, his heart would probably have exploded from the shock.
Could it be that this was a Saint that had been skinned?
He couldn’t help but feel his heart clench. Then who was the murderer? Was it a Pseudo-Emperor like Buddha Doga, or... was it Buddha Doga himself?
This guy was really capable of doing such a thing. It wasn’t like he hadn’t seen it before.
Moreover, he had also been guided by Buddha Doga onto this path, so it was normal that there were Saints here that had been skinned by Buddha Doga.
But the problem was, why had Buddha Doga brought the Saint’s corpse here to be skinned?
That’s not right!
Ling Han looked at the human skin’s face. There was still a sliver of emotion on this face, but it was not fear or resentment. Instead, there was only a sliver of defiance.
If he had been skinned, he should have been filled with resentment and fear. Why was there only defiance?
Ling Han stayed here for quite a while, and only then did he set out again, walking forwards.
He had not walked too far, when he saw another black shadow.
Again?
He carefully approached. As expected, this was another human skin, and it was also covered with red hair.
Looking at this sheet of human skin, an indescribable chill rose up in Ling Han’s heart.
“Yi!”
He discovered a line of words carved beside the human skin.
Actually, there were only a few words written on it, “Defiant, I am really defiant...” Then, it came to an abrupt stop.
Defiant? Indeed, Ling Han could tell from his expression, but the question was, why are you defiant? Why don’t you explain clearly?
With such suspense, aren’t you afraid of having your corpse whipped by others in future generations?
Ling Han pondered for a moment before continuing to walk forward.
As expected, after another stretch of road, he saw the third red-furred corpse, and beside this corpse, there was a large number of words.
Ling Han’s eyes swept over them, and involuntarily, his mouth couldn’t help but gape.

chapters.title: Chapter 4393: Reincarnation Path
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
These words described an astonishing fact.
The general idea was that this “person” wanted to use this path to return to life, and obtain true life.
Obtaining true life?
Why was there such a saying?
Ling Han’s heart jolted. Then there was only one possibility, and that was the person who had died was a Yin soul.
But could a Yin soul still return to the Living Realm, and obtain true life?
This was what stunned Ling Han. No wonder these corpses only had skin and red hair, but did not have blood, flesh, or bones. As it turned out... they did not have these things in the first place.
In truth, the Yin soul was only a soul, and did not have a physical body at all. Now that it had grown skin, what did that mean?
They could indeed take physical form.
F***, what exactly was this path? It was so awesome, that it could allow a Yin soul to return to the Living Realm?
However, Ling Han was certain that the one who had died was a Yin Saint. Thus, even a Yin Saint had died on the way here, which showed how difficult this path was.
Why hadn’t he encountered any danger?
Ling Han thought again. Could it be that this danger only targeted Yin souls?
This was the only explanation. Otherwise, there was no reason that even the Yin Saint had collapsed, yet he was completely unscathed.
A thought suddenly arose in Ling Han’s mind, causing him to stop in his tracks.
Was this how Buddha Doga obtained his second life?
When a person died, it would be like how a fire was extinguished. This was irreversible. Thus, how exactly were they supposed to live a second life?
Enter the Netherworld, and then take this path?
Even the Yin Saint had fallen, which showed how difficult this path was to walk. However, a Pseudo-Emperor was not a Saint, but rather had the word “Emperor” in their name.
Thus, Ling Han was absolutely confident that Buddha Doga could walk this path.

“If that’s really the case, then wouldn’t elites be immortal and indestructible?” Ling Han murmured. After death, he would walk the “Reincarnation Path” once. In any case, if he could walk it once, walking it a second time would also be very easy.

“Hence, if this Yin Saint’s message was not false, and if he had walked this path, he would indeed be able to live a second life. Then, there would definitely be very great restrictions, and it would be impossible for him to walk this path a second time.”
“Otherwise, there would really be as many top-notch elites as carp crossing a river in this world.”
Ling Han continued to advance. In fact, instead of guessing on his own here, he might as well ask Buddha Doga. This guy would definitely know. The question was, would he answer him?
After walking for a while, Ling Han discovered a new corpse on the ground.
It was still a Yin Saint, who had similarly left behind endless regrets.
Some corpses should be endlessly old. Thus, even if it was a Yin Saint, so what? The corpses were already showing signs of corrosion, and was an extremely ghastly sight.

After travelling for another half a day, the number of Yin Saint corpses that Ling Han saw was already in the tens of thousands, and when he went on further, he shockingly discovered that some of the corpses actually showed white bone!
It was very strange. Some only had spines, some had skulls, and some had leg bones. None of the corpses had complete bones.

Ling Han finally understood. The farther the Yin Saint walked, the stronger their abilities would be, and the higher the level of their “return to the Living Realm” would be. Not only would they be able to grow skin, they would also be able to grow bones.
However, from Yin to Yang, living a second life was a heaven-defying action, after all. Thus, they had all fallen on this path.
“To walk the Reincarnation Path, one would at least have to be a Pseudo-Emperor, right?”

Ling Han murmured to himself. Perhaps it would be fine even if there was an incomparably powerful Yin Saint, but the living beings of the Living Realm had never heard of this kind of thing, so they naturally could not confirm it.

As he walked forwards, he finally could no longer see the corpses of the Yin Saints, and he had finally reached the end of the passage. A plain appeared ahead of him, but peng, peng, peng! Occasionally, he would see lava breaking through the ground, soaring into the skies.
How terrifying!

Even at such a far distance, Ling Han could still sense how terrifying this lava was. It was possible that even Saints could be insta-killed by this lava, and it was on the same level as the Heavenly Dao Flames.
There was no pattern to the lava gushing out. Thus, this plain was terrifying. It could insta-kill the Saint, so how was he supposed to pass through?
Ling Han gritted his teeth. Was this the danger that Buddha Doga spoke of?
Indeed, this was too terrifying. If he was the slightest bit careless, he would immediately die.
Ling Han didn’t advance recklessly. Even Saints could be insta-killed in this lava. He definitely couldn’t place his life on the line—although his luck had indeed always been very good.
He just stood there, observing, wanting to summarize the pattern.
No matter how chaotic it was, there should still be a pattern. Otherwise, this would be a dead end. Why would Buddha Doga do something so superfluous?
Ling Han had not thought to use the pearl which was a natural treasure. The upper limit was Saint-level, so it couldn’t protect him.
Thus, he could only depend on himself.
However, after observing for three days, he discovered that the lava gushing out was indeed random. There was no pattern to it at all.
F***, could it be that he was going to go back the way he came, and return home?
Yi?

He suddenly saw an ancient chariot slowly drive over from ahead of him. Boom, though lava was gushing out, and had landed solidly on the bottom of the chariot, the chariot was still stable, and did not look like it had been destroyed at all. Furthermore, it did not look like it was burning at all.
Ling Han’s eyes couldn’t help but widen a little. Wasn’t this chariot too awesome?
Was this a Great Emperor-level precious tool?
Otherwise, how could it resist the lava that could insta-kill a Saint?

In a short while, the chariot was already close enough. Ling Han could see very clearly that there was a fully armored person on the chariot, but not the slightest bit of skin was exposed. He couldn’t even see his eyes, as he was tightly suited in the Battle Armor.
This person... exuded a terrifying aura that could suppress the Nine Heavens and Ten Lands.
A Great Emperor?
Ling Han felt a little dizzy. On the path from the Netherworld to the Living Realm, there was actually a Great Emperor?
Impossible, impossible. There was definitely no Great Emperor that was so idle. Furthermore, if there were Great Emperors in this world, how could the True Dragon Abyss and Imperial Path be opened?
A Great Emperor’s soul?

However, the Great Emperor was far too powerful. In fact, he was so powerful that once he died, his soul would fuse with heaven and earth, becoming a part of heaven and earth. He wouldn’t even have the chance to enter the Netherworld.

Ling Han was completely baffled. He felt that his understanding of the Great Emperor was really too limited. All the deductions he could make were based on his limited knowledge of the Great Emperor, but how much understanding did he have about the Great Emperor?
While he was lost in thought, the chariot gradually drew closer, and was only about 30 meters away from him.
This was astonishing. With the chariot’s speed, it would have taken at least half a day to reach him from afar. However, in the blink of an eye, the chariot had already appeared.
Ground Shrinking Technique?
Ling Han clasped his hands respectfully, and said to the humanoid figure in Battle Armor, “Senior, can you give me a ride?”
The man in Battle Armor didn’t reply, and only slowly turned the chariot around.
‘Then I’ll take that as a yes.’
Ling Han hurriedly leaped toward the chariot. This was because if the chariot turned around, it would immediately flee from him.
He was betting that Buddha Doga wouldn’t harm him.
He landed steadily on the chariot, and the man in armor didn’t pay any attention to him at all. It was as if he didn’t know that he had boarded the chariot.
‘Fine, you’re at the level of a Great Emperor, so you can indeed view me as an ant.’
The chariot advanced slowly, heading into the depths of the plains.

chapters.title: Chapter 4394: Imperial Armor?
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
The chariot seemed to be moving very slowly, but in truth, it was astonishingly fast. It was clearly just a revolution of its wheels, but boundless distance had been left behind.
Ling Han remained silent. Since this elite didn’t like to talk, it was best that he didn’t disturb him.
Villains usually died from speaking too much. Though he was not a villain, he still had some self-awareness.
After walking for half a day, they had reached the end of the plain. A bare mountain appeared ahead of them, with only strangely shaped rocks. As for plants, they did not exist at all.
Ling Han leaped onto the ground, then turned around, and bowed respectfully towards the man in armour, “Thank you, Senior.”
The chariot slowly stopped, and the man in armour didn’t respond.
Ling Han bowed again before turning around to leave.

After taking a few steps, he suddenly heard a loud clang. He hurriedly turned around, only to see that the Battle Armor had actually fallen all over the ground. There was a helmet, wrist guard, knee guards, and so on. It had fallen all over the chariot.
However, not a single elite appeared.
Ling Han’s heart involuntarily clenched. Could it be that it was that Battle Armor that had been moving on its own previously?
Because the Battle Armor was seamlessly fitted, and not the slightest gap was revealed, it was really hard to tell if there was anyone inside.
Had it really been a Battle Armor that had brought him here?
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel his heart palpitate. Then, this Battle Armor was definitely an Imperial Weapon.

When it came to the Imperial Weapon, most people would be thinking of weapons. Moreover, why was the Imperial Weapon called the Imperial Weapon instead of Imperial Tool? It could also be seen that most of them were in the form of weapons, not armor.
If he could obtain this armor, then with the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower as offence, and the Imperial Armor as defence, just how awesome would that be?
However, this thought only flashed through Ling Han’s mind. He shook his head, and did not make a move.
Why?
Throughout history, he was definitely not the first person to come here, but why had this chariot and Battle Armor always been here?
How could it be that others would not be interested in the Imperial Armor?
It definitely wasn’t, so it probably couldn’t be taken.
This was indeed an alluring temptation, but this Battle Armor and chariot were still here. What did this mean?
It was not that no one had designs on it, but rather that no one could do it.
And those who had failed?
They had probably all died.
Ling Han guessed that the dangers mentioned by the Buddha Doga probably also contained a test of the human heart.
He took a deep breath, turned around and left without hesitation.
The Imperial Armor was indeed tempting, but Ling Han was filled with confidence in himself.
He was invincible, and didn’t need any external items!
Yi?
Ling Han had just stepped onto the withered mountain, when he felt a power taking effect inside his body, wanting to tear him to shreds.
He hurriedly channeled his mystical power to suppress this power, and his tough physique was also as steady as a boulder.
One step after another, he resolutely forged onwards.

This power was changing. At one moment, it was acting on his entire body, but at another moment, it was only acting on a certain part of his body. This was terrifying. With such a powerful force exploding at a single point, Ling Han’s reaction was only slightly slower. Pa, blood immediately spurted from that part of his body.
Ling Han frowned upon seeing this. A bloody hole had already appeared on his left forearm, and his blood was as crystalline as agate. It hadn’t dripped down at all.
And this was still because his physique was tough. Otherwise, this bloody hole would have enlarged several times over, and in fact, even his whole forearm would have been split apart.
Alarm bells rang in Ling Han’s mind. He definitely couldn’t be careless. He definitely had to react in time. Otherwise, what if this power exploded in his mind?
This was really a godforsaken place, and was incredibly dangerous.
Ling Han’s reaction speed was raised to the extreme. The moment that power moved, he moved as well.
Thankfully, though this power was strong, it was only about the same level as his. As long as he reacted in time, he would not be injured.
However, Ling Han didn’t just have to resist this power. He also had to walk and observe the situation of this withered mountain. If there was an even greater danger, he naturally had to avoid it.

The withered mountain wasn’t tall, and there was only a strange power that was acting everywhere, yearning to tear people apart. Thus, Ling Han’s speed naturally couldn’t be any faster. He had to focus his full attention on resisting this power.
Thus, after a very long time, he finally reached the summit.
Yi?

Ling Han was startled. He had actually seen a vine at the summit, coiled on a crimson red rock. This vine should be close to death, and more than half of its leaves had wilted, but there was actually a fruit borne on it.
This fruit was only the size of a longan. It was pink in colour, and there were mysterious veined patterns on its skin, making one focus immediately on it at first sight.
“Wu!” Ling Han groaned, and spat out a mouthful of blood.
How could he be distracted at this time?
Thankfully, that power was acting on his entire body this time. Thus, it only made him spit out a mouthful of blood. Otherwise, it was really possible that he would die on the spot.
Ling Han hurriedly averted his gaze, strode over, and plucked the fruit. Who cares what it was? To be born in such a strange place and not be damaged, it must be a Treasured Fruit!
Then, he descended the mountain.

This was another half day’s journey, and Ling Han finally arrived at the foot of the mountain. Ahead of him was another plain, yet it was covered with snow and ice. An endless chill assaulted him, causing him to involuntarily shiver.
This was truly a world of ice and fire.
This side of the mountain was covered in ice and snow, but the other side was gushing with lava, which could easily burn a Saint to death.
The strange power had already disappeared, but Ling Han didn’t dare to be careless. The lava could burn Saints to death, so this place definitely wouldn’t be any safer.
Ling Han wasn’t in a hurry to advance. Instead, he first healed his injuries.

Though it had only been a short day, under the ravaging of that power, he was covered with injuries. Furthermore, he was constantly in a state of high alert, so the pressure on his spirit was also very great.
He indeed needed to rest.
After three days, his injuries had basically recovered completely, and his spiritual power was already full and flawless.
He finally took out the fruit that he had harvested at the top of the withered mountain, and examined it carefully.
That mountain was filled with tearing force, and even he was having a hard time dealing with it. How had that vine survived, and why had this fruit not exploded?

He examined it carefully. The surface of the fruit was covered with mysterious veined patterns, as if it contained some kind of true meaning of great dao. His eyes were instantly drawn to it, and he was immersed in it.

After a long while, Ling Han finally withdrew his gaze. With a slight hook of his finger, the Regulations took form, and appeared between his fingers like the strings of a qin. He fiddled with them, and weng, weng, weng, great dao sang.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel surprised. This was a technique that used great dao, and could be used in secret techniques to increase the might of the celestial technique.
Hiss, the veined patterns on the skin of the fruit were already so amazing, then what level of Great Herb was the fruit?
Ling Han didn’t hesitate and immediately threw it into his mouth. He chewed lightly, and immediately, juices filled his mouth. It was incredibly sweet, causing every pore on his body to open up.
Beautiful, truly delicious.
He was still unsatisfied, but the whole fruit had already turned into juice that flowed into his mouth, leaving behind only a layer of skin.

chapters.title: Chapter 4395: Feng Miaoling
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han didn’t waste it. He put away the skin of the fruit. The veined patterns on it were mysterious and could be comprehended. Moreover, he also wanted to know the origins of this fruit.
“So hot!”

He suddenly gritted his teeth, and a wave of heat surged through his limbs and veins. Visibly, heat rose from his body. Boom, it even started to burn, and his clothes were instantly turned into ashes.

It should be known that the clothes he was wearing were knitted from Celestial Material. Even if his figure enlarged and shrank, the fabric could also enlarge and shrink accordingly, completely fitting him.
But now, it had actually been burnt into ashes. Hiss, these flames were really shocking.
However, Ling Han only felt an extraordinary heat, and there was not the slightest bit of burn marks on his skin, which was extremely strange.
This heat must have originated from the fruit he had just eaten. It seemed to be the case as well. He only felt the heat, but for the time being, there was no damage caused to him.
At the same time, waves of energy surged in his body, as if they wanted to fill him up.
Ling Han’s cultivation level began to increase, and his seventh spiritual body was rapidly growing.

As expected, this was a Great Herb. The medicinal effects were really too shocking, but the problem was this heat was too high. Though it temporarily did not cause him any injury, Ling Han could feel that the water in his body was rapidly evaporating.
He couldn’t take it, he couldn’t take it at all!
Ling Han dove into the world of ice and snow ahead of him, hoping that he could use this ice to cool himself down.
Zi, he was too hot. The moment he rushed into the snowy ground, the snow and ice began to melt, and steam soared into the sky.
It wasn’t enough; it was still too hot.

At this moment, Ling Han’s eyes were only filled with ice and snow. He was running around like a headless fly, but he still had a sliver of reason. All this while, he was only running around in the proximity, and did not venture deep into this snowy plain.

After who knew how long, this wave of heat finally passed. Ling Han forcibly pulled himself together, and retreated back to the foot of the withered mountain. Then, he collapsed, and fell into a deep slumber.
At the same time.
A black-robed figure also shockingly appeared at the foot of the withered mountain, but it was on the other side of the mountain.

This person’s face was covered with a black gauze, and her features could not be seen clearly, but judging from her shapely and beautiful figure, this should be a woman. Her slender waist could be grasped in a single hand, her buttocks were shapely, and her chest was round and full, appearing very proud.
She turned around to look at the chariot, and a tempted expression appeared on her face. However, in the end, she didn’t make a move.
If she couldn’t suppress this kind of greed, then what awaited her would only be death.
She turned around, and walked towards the withered mountain, her beautiful eyes flickering.

She knew that there was an Extreme Fire Earth Spiritual Vine on the mountain, and the fruit it bore was a rare Great Herb. Not only could it increase her cultivation level, it could also help her cultivate a technique that could draw on the Dao of heaven and earth.
With this as the foundation, she could even develop an Imperial Technique!
This was the fated opportunity that she could see and touch.

“Everyone thinks that there is only one entrance to the Imperial Path, but the Imperial Path is actually in between the two realms of Yin and Yang, and there is naturally an entrance to the Netherworld. Furthermore, this is the Reincarnation Path of the Netherworld. As long as one can successfully walk out of it, he would be able to live a second life.”
“Unfortunately, throughout history, how many people have managed to succeed?”
She murmured softly, as if she was giving a commentary, but also seemed to be remembering.
“Throughout history, there are only two Empresses!”
“However, there will soon be a third Empress!”
She declared proudly, exuding a strong confidence.
“That would be me, Feng Miaoling!”

This woman walked slowly, but there was a frightening tearing force on the withered mountain. Because of the change in cultivation level, though she was a Sect Master, she still appeared to be very strained, blood continuously spurting from her delicate body.
“What a terrifying place. With my strength, I am actually still in such a sorry state. Is there a second person in this world that can pass?”
Feng Miaoling cried out, but her tone was more of an affirmation of her own strength.
“Wu!” She coughed up blood, dyeing the black cloth covering her face bright red.
At this moment, a silvery light flickered on her body, forming a shield. The tearing power was instantly blocked outside.
“No, I can do it!” the woman said stubbornly. She did something, and the shield instantly disappeared.
She advanced with great difficulty, and after spending close to a day’s time, she finally reached the summit.
“I’m here!” A smile spread across her face, but the smile on her face instantly froze.
Where were the celestial fruit?
Where was the Extreme Fire Earth Spiritual Fruit?
She stared dumbly at that withered old vine, her face filled with disbelief. She really could spit out a mouthful of blood.

However, there was no time for her to be in a daze here. The terrifying tearing force was taking effect almost at all times, causing her to feel a sharp pain, and she suddenly came back to her senses.
She could clearly see that there were obvious signs of harvesting on the old vine, and it was very “fresh”.
In other words, it wasn’t that the information was wrong, but that someone had rushed ahead of her and plucked the Extreme Fire Earth Spiritual Fruit.
When this realization arose, she suddenly felt a burning sensation on her face.
—Just now, she had even boasted that there was no other person that could pass aside from her, and what was the result?
She couldn’t help but feel a strong fighting spirit rise up in her, as well as a deep animosity.
They had yet to meet, yet this person had already slapped her across the face.
This was intolerable!
She pulled herself together and headed down the mountain.
If she caught up to that guy, even if she couldn’t snatch back the celestial fruit, she would still give him a harsh beating. He actually dared to slap her face.
Another day passed, and she finally arrived at the foot of the mountain.
‘Hmm?’
Her beautiful eyes swept over, and she had already spotted Ling Han. Then, her pretty face flushed red like fire.
What had she seen?
A naked man!
This was too demeaning to her worldview.
What was this place?
This was the most dangerous place in the world, yet there was a naked man lying here. This was simply inconceivable, and absolutely unbelievable.
However, she immediately realized that this must be the person who had harvested the Extreme Fire Earth Spiritual Fruit before her.
That’s right. He must have ingested the celestial fruit. The medicinal effects took effect, and even his clothes were burnt to ashes.
She turned her head, but her hand waved out, condensing into a flash of Sword Qi, its might terrifying.
Just as the Sword Qi was about to strike him, Ling Han suddenly flew up, narrowly dodging this attack.

He had already refined the celestial fruit, but because the medicinal effects were too powerful, he was still in a coma. However, how sensitive was a cultivator like him to danger? His body instinctively reacted at the first instant.
At this moment, his consciousness finally returned.
Yi, what was going on?
He looked at Feng Miaoling, and there was a hint of confusion in his gaze. At the same time, there was also a sliver of killing intent.
To make a move on him for no reason, this was really too despicable.
“Who are you?” Ling Han asked coldly.
“Damn guy!” Feng Miaoling was about to spit fire. ‘You’re already awake, so why didn’t you put on some clothes?’
He was clearly naked, but there was not the slightest bit of shame on his face. He was still crossing his arms behind his back and pretending to be a poser!
Ling Han finally came to his senses after being scolded by her.
‘F*ck! Where’s my clothes?’
He hurriedly took out some clothes and put them on, shaking his head as he did so. This time, he had really been taken advantage of.
As he thought this, his face naturally revealed his thoughts.
When Feng Miaoling saw this, she almost went mad with anger.
