To make a move on him for no reason, this was really too despicable.
“Who are you?” Ling Han asked coldly.
“Damn guy!” Feng Miaoling was about to spit fire.
‘You’re already awake, so why didn’t you put on some clothes?’
He was clearly naked, but there was not the slightest bit of shame on his face.
He was still crossing his arms behind his back and pretending to be a poser!
Ling Han finally came to his senses after being scolded by her.
‘F*ck!
Where’s my clothes?’
He hurriedly took out some clothes and put them on, shaking his head as he did so.
This time, he had really been taken advantage of.
As he thought this, his face naturally revealed his thoughts.
When Feng Miaoling saw this, she almost went mad with anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 4396: Enemy
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
“Madman, you are courting death!” Feng Miaoling charged out.
Since Ling Han was already dressed, she naturally had no more reservations.
What a shameless person. He was completely naked in front of her, and looked like it was him that had suffered a loss.
Too despicable, too shameless, too detestable!
Boom, a Sect Master’s strength completely burst forth. A great river actually appeared behind her, emitting a turbulent and majestic sound.
It was clearly a river, yet it seemed to be even more majestic than the sea. Endless Regulations surged.
Ling Han gritted his teeth. This was a Sect Master opponent.
As he retreated, he continued to unleash murderous aura attacks.
However, what surprised him was that the other was completely unaffected.

It should be known that even if her abilities were stronger than his, the barrage of murderous aura could still be effective. This was an attack aimed at the soul, and the difference lay in the extent of its effects.
Completely unaffected?
Imperial Daughter?
Unless she was wearing armor that had been personally forged by the Great Emperor, a Sect Master should not be able to be completely unaffected by the barrage of murderous aura.
Only now did Ling Han suddenly come to his senses. This woman had actually also walked the Imperial Path from the Netherworld?
‘Strange. Are you also being hunted, so you couldn’t go through the main doors?’
Hong, Feng Miaoling’s attack missed, and she couldn’t help but reveal a hint of surprise, because Ling Han was only a Spirit Transformation Tier.
However, her fury made her not have the interest to speak at all, and ask Ling Han about his background.
It was too piercing to the eyes. That unkempt appearance kept swaying in front of her eyes. Now, she only had one thought, and that was to kill Ling Han.
How difficult would it be for a Sect Master elite to kill a Spirit Transformation Tier True Lord?
Moreover, she was such an outstanding prodigy.
Boom, the great river behind her surged violently, pouring towards Ling Han.
Ling Han suddenly had a feeling that even if just a drop of the river water touched him, he would be consigned to eternal damnation.
This woman was actually so strong?
It was very normal for the Imperial Daughter to be in possession of treasures.
Ling Han didn’t hesitate and immediately used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
Run!

He didn’t linger in battle. A Spirit Transformation True Lord was already at a disadvantage when battling against a Sect Master, what more when this Sect Master was the Golden Generation, and was far more powerful than the conventional Minor Advanced Tier.
Boom, two fiery wings spread out, and he headed towards the snowy plains.

Feng Miaoling’s fury soared sky-high. When she saw Ling Han’s “naked body”, her heart was already filled with anger, and Ling Han still looked like it was him who had been taken advantage of. This naturally caused her fury to burn even hotter.
Kill, no matter what, she had to kill this brat.
Hu!

But at this moment, the whole sky was filled with snowy winds. The strong winds whistled fiercely, and the cold winds penetrated straight into her bones, causing even the circulation of mystical power to become sluggish.
Feng Miaoling couldn’t help but drop down from the skies. This cold wind was like blades, not only slicing her whole body painfully, even her clothes were about to disintegrate.
This naturally could not be allowed to happen.

She had seen Ling Han’s body, and she had suffered a disadvantage because of that. If she allowed Ling Han to see her body, it would definitely not be a tie between the two of them, but she would be at an even greater disadvantage.
However, she shockingly discovered that Ling Han was actually still running. Though his speed had decreased slightly, he was still faster than her.
How was this possible?

Ling Han didn’t know, but she knew very well that the environment here would exert a different kind of pressure on people of different cultivation levels. Thus, whether it was the Spirit Transformation Tier or the Minor Advanced Tier, the pressure they endured could be said to be equal, and were both around their own respective limits.
It could be said that the best display of one’s natural talent was in this place. The stronger one’s strength at the same cultivation level, the more relaxed one’s performance would be.
She was actually inferior to Ling Han?
How, could, this, be!
She could not believe it, and could not accept it. With her aptitude, she was completely capable of taking the throne by force, but she was actually inferior to this naked man in front of her?
But the truth was indeed so. The gap between her and Ling Han was presently widening, causing her to be shocked, angered, and speechless.
At this moment, Ling Han suddenly stopped in his tracks. He turned around, and called out loudly, “Crazy woman, you spied on me, and still want to kill me to keep the secret. This is not over!”
Feng Miaoling almost spat out a mouthful of blood. You still have the face to make false accusations?
However, Ling Han had already turned around and left. She couldn’t vent her anger.
In the distance, Ling Han gritted his teeth. He knew that it was understandable that Feng Miaoling would be so furious, but how could he tolerate being sneak attacked in his “sleep” and hunted down?
Just wait, he would definitely come back for revenge. No matter what, he had to spank this little girl’s behind.
Yi?
He suddenly discovered that his seventh spiritual body had already reached a state of perfection.
The effect of that celestial fruit.

Ling Han immediately came to his senses. While he had fallen into a deep slumber due to the medicinal effects, his cultivation level had also rapidly increased, advancing all the way to the peak stage of the Seventh Change.
“It’s too cold here, so it’s not suitable to break through.”
“I’ll walk out of the ice plain first, then consider breaking through to the Eighth Change.”

He walked through the blizzard, and in order to avoid the blizzard that was as cold as blades, he descended, and walked on the snowy plains. One foot deep, one foot shallow. The accumulated snow was as thick as two feet, and with each step, practically the whole lower half of his body was buried within.

However, even if he was on the ground, where he could avoid the icy winds and snow, when he came into direct contact with the accumulated snow, a powerful chill still seeped out, causing Ling Han to waver continuously. Any kind of defense would be useless at this moment.
Thankfully, Ling Han’s physique was tough enough. Otherwise, he would definitely have frozen to death.
He sighed ruefully. There should be very few people that could pass through this snowy plain.
If he could only set out from here to reach the Imperial Path, then if one surveyed the whole world, would the number of people that could pass be more than can be counted on two hands?
Three days later, Ling Han finally walked out of the snowy plains.
A canyon appeared ahead of him. It wasn’t too long, and he could see the end of it with a single glance.
Should he pass first, or break through first?
Ling Han thought for a moment, then decided to break through first. He really yearned for abilities too much.
He took out the Void Beast hide and put it on. Then, he sat down in a cross-legged position, and began to break through to Eighth Change.
The eighth spiritual body gradually took form, slowly forming.
At this moment, Feng Miaoling appeared. When she passed by Ling Han, she paused slightly, as if she had discovered something, but after a sweep of her beautiful eyes, she continued onwards.
She could vaguely sense something off, but did not discover anything. She only thought that she had been overly suspicious.
Danger lay ahead!
She stopped in her tracks and sat down in a cross-legged position. After recovering to her prime condition, she stood up.
She rushed into the canyon, and instantly, multiple sharp golden swords descended from the skies, slashing down on her.
Feng Miaoling used her movement technique, dodging and evading, not daring to be touched by the golden swords.
She knew that this golden sword possessed incomparably terrifying destructive power. She definitely could not allow it to touch her, or her life would be in danger.
Dodging all the way, it was very dangerous, but she still managed to pass successfully.
“That scoundrel actually passed as well!” she muttered. Though there was still killing intent in her tone, there was also a sliver of admiration.
She knew very well just how difficult it was to pass through this canyon. If she was the slightest bit careless, she would die and be destroyed.
However, what she didn’t know was that the guy she wanted nothing more than to kill actually hadn’t passed through the canyon at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 4397: The Other Side
paragraphs: Editor: Henyee Translations
Three days later, Ling Han successfully broke through to Eighth Change.

“Eighth Change, and I’m closer to the Minor Advanced Tier.” Ling Han broke into a grin. “As expected, a horse cannot grow fat without night grass. To rapidly improve my cultivation level, I still have to enter into this kind of Mystery Realm.”
Ordinarily, it would take him at least four to five years to advance into Eighth Change, but now? It had only been a few days.
“However, the dangers of this canyon are beyond my imagination.”

Ling Han murmured. Previously, though he had been in a state of seclusion, there was still a sliver of divine sense circulating, and he had “seen” the scene of Feng Miaoling passing through the canyon.
“A rain of swords will fall from the sky, and the slightest carelessness would mean eternal damnation!”

He didn’t move at the first instant. Firstly, he had to be careful, and it was possible that Feng Miaoling would be guarding against him on the other side. Secondly, he also had to stabilize his cultivation level.
Another two days later, Ling Han finally stood up.
“Let’s give it a try.”
He walked into the canyon, and instantly, a golden sword suddenly flew out of the originally peaceful canyon, shooting madly towards him.
Ling Han activated his movement technique, dodging with all his might.
He couldn’t charge forward in a single breath. This was because the entire canyon was raining swords. If he rashly charged forward, he would only lose his life.
His spirit was maintained in a state of high-speed reaction, while his mind was clear. Any slightest change was within his grasp.
In a short while, he had already passed through one third of the canyon.
‘Soon.’
However, his expression remained unchanged as he continued to walk forward.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Sword Rays slashed down.
He was already halfway there.
Cold sweat appeared on Ling Han’s forehead. His brain was constantly in a state of high-speed, causing him to feel great pressure.
This tested his reaction speed too much. As long as he was the slightest bit careless, it was guaranteed that he would immediately die.
Two-thirds.
Ling Han’s eyes burned. Phoenix Wings Divine Flight was used, and his speed was not only fast, but also extraordinarily steady.
Xiu, Ling Han leaped again, and finally exited the canyon.
He turned around, and a strong feeling of relief rose up in his heart.
So close, he had finally passed.
Though it was not too long, only half an hour, he felt as if he had experienced a terrifying great battle, causing his whole body to be covered in sweat.
Ling Han sat down to recover.
Half a day later, he stood up and walked forwards.
Thankfully, Feng Miaoling was not guarding against him here. She probably thought that he had long since passed.
True, who would have thought that he would suddenly break through?
This journey took four days. From afar, Ling Han heard the turbulent sound of the great river.
Yi, was it that fierce woman that was fighting?
Ling Han instinctively thought that when Feng Miaoling battled, a large river would be reflected behind her, and the sound of the waves would roll out.
However, after walking for a while longer, he discovered that it was not Feng Miaoling, but was indeed a turbulent great river.
This river was extraordinarily long, and the end could not be seen from either direction, and its width was about 5km. With Ling Han’s vision, he could see the other side with a single glance.
But the problem was, he could not see what lay on the other side of the river at all. It was only a blur.
Strange.
Ling Han looked at the river water, and couldn’t help but reveal a shocked expression.
That was because along with the roaring river waters, there were also multiple human faces. They were either malevolent, furious, or terrified, and there were all kinds of expressions.
They weren’t corpses, but rather faces.
F***, what kind of river was this?
Ling Han didn’t take the risk to cross the river. Instinctively, he thought that there was something very strange about this river.
Sigh, since Buddha Doga had sent him here, why couldn’t he be a good person to the end and tell him more information?
Er... could this person be considered a good person?

He had killed countless people, and he had even tortured countless Saints to death. From this aspect, he was definitely not a good person. However, he had forced the Masters of the Yin River and the Blood Sea to retreat, and single-handedly blocked the invasion of the Yin souls. It could only be described as an extraordinary merit.
Merely this point was enough to erase all his previous crimes.
“I have benefited from his help, so I am not qualified to give a commentary.”
“This... I’ll leave it for future generations to evaluate.”
Ling Han walked along the river, wanting to find out more.
After walking upstream for ten days, Ling Han came up empty-handed. Ling Han returned to the starting point, then headed downstream.
This time, it was only seven days, and he saw a stone tablet.
Stone tablet?
There were words on it, and Ling Han walked over to read them.

These were incredibly ancient characters, and had long since fallen out of use. Thankfully, Ling Han had deliberately learnt various ancient languages for the sake of ancient pill recipes. Thus, it was not too straining for him.
“The other shore.”
He read that this river was called “Other Side”, and was also the final stage that Yin souls who wanted to return to the Living Realm had to pass.
After reaching the Other Side, his blood and flesh would regrow, and he would live a second life.
However, there were countless vengeful spirits in the river, and they would not be easily passed over. They would drag everything into the river, to become a part of the vengeful spirits.
At the very least, if a Saint fell into the river just like that, it was guaranteed that he would not be spared.
What was to be done?
“With the Immortality Leaf as raft, one can avoid being entwined by vengeful spirits, and use faith as motivation to urge the raft to cross the river.”

Ling Han followed the stone tablet’s guidance, and soon found a towering tree. However, amidst the leaves that filled the skies, there were multiple hideous heads. Now, they were all staring at Ling Han, revealing baleful expressions.
It was like if if Ling Han were to leap up to pluck the leaves, these heads would gnaw at him.
That was indeed the case. There was a clear hint on the stone tablet. One definitely could not climb up the tree to pluck leaves, and could only wait for the leaves to fall on their own.
This tree leaf was very big, about three feet long, and about two feet wide. It was thick and fat, but to use it as a raft would always make people feel that it was unreliable.
All of a sudden, a beautiful song rang out, causing Ling Han to be overjoyed, his eyes intoxicated. This formed a powerful attraction, causing Ling Han to want to move in the direction of the sound.
And the source of this beautiful sound was this great tree.

Ling Han’s powerful willpower took effect. He forcefully stopped his raised foot, and when he raised his head, he saw that it was one of the hideous heads that was singing an incredibly beautiful and melodious song.
It was really dangerous.
Ling Han gritted his teeth. He couldn’t leave and return when the leaves fell, because once the leaves fell onto the ground, they would immediately dissipate.
Thus, he needed a strong willpower.

How could it be so easy to live a second life? And this was still because Ling Han himself had a physical body, which lowered the difficulty level by at least tens of thousands of times. If his soul had walked this path, he would have long since died.
These heads had all kinds of enticing techniques. They would either attract by singing, or release murmurs that would cause one’s heart to throb wildly, stimulating the most primitive desires.
Ling Han sat down cross-legged, using his powerful willpower to suppress himself, ignoring all temptations or effects.

Weng, in the dimensions inside his body, the willpower of living beings all surged, turning into millions and millions of streaks of willpower. Though every single streak of will was extremely subtle, when they were combined, they gave Ling Han a strong support.
After about two days, a leaf quietly floated down.
Ling Han reached over and grabbed the leaf.
He could leave now, but he did not move.

“With the Immortality Leaf as raft, one can avoid being entwined by vengeful spirits, and use faith as motivation to urge the raft to cross the river.”
Ling Han followed the stone tablet’s guidance, and soon found a towering tree.
However, amidst the leaves that filled the skies, there were multiple hideous heads.
Now, they were all staring at Ling Han, revealing baleful expressions.
It was like if if Ling Han were to leap up to pluck the leaves, these heads would gnaw at him.
That was indeed the case.
There was a clear hint on the stone tablet.
One definitely could not climb up the tree to pluck leaves, and could only wait for the leaves to fall on their own.
This tree leaf was very big, about three feet long, and about two feet wide.
It was thick and fat, but to use it as a raft would always make people feel that it was unreliable.
All of a sudden, a beautiful song rang out, causing Ling Han to be overjoyed, his eyes intoxicated.
This formed a powerful attraction, causing Ling Han to want to move in the direction of the sound.
And the source of this beautiful sound was this great tree.
Ling Han’s powerful willpower took effect.
He forcefully stopped his raised foot, and when he raised his head, he saw that it was one of the hideous heads that was singing an incredibly beautiful and melodious song.
It was really dangerous.
Ling Han gritted his teeth.
He couldn’t leave and return when the leaves fell, because once the leaves fell onto the ground, they would immediately dissipate.
Thus, he needed a strong willpower.
How could it be so easy to live a second life?
And this was still because Ling Han himself had a physical body, which lowered the difficulty level by at least tens of thousands of times.
If his soul had walked this path, he would have long since died.
These heads had all kinds of enticing techniques.
They would either attract by singing, or release murmurs that would cause one’s heart to throb wildly, stimulating the most primitive desires.
Ling Han sat down cross-legged, using his powerful willpower to suppress himself, ignoring all temptations or effects.
Weng, in the dimensions inside his body, the willpower of living beings all surged, turning into millions and millions of streaks of willpower.
Though every single streak of will was extremely subtle, when they were combined, they gave Ling Han a strong support.
After about two days, a leaf quietly floated down.
Ling Han reached over and grabbed the leaf.
He could leave now, but he did not move.

chapters.title: Chapter 4398 A perfect soul
paragraphs: Ling Han suddenly discovered that in the two days that he had been here, his willpower had clearly improved.

Spiritual power was very difficult to cultivate. Even if there were corresponding cultivation techniques, the power of heaven and earth could only transform into mystical power, and could not increase one's spiritual power. Thus, one could only grind it bit by bit, and slowly improve it.
However, in this place, those human heads continued to tempt him. In the process of resisting, his willpower had also been extremely tempered, and his improvement was extremely obvious.
"If my previous willpower was made of clay, it has now been tempered and turned into brick. It has clearly become stronger."
Ling Han was very pleased. This kind of improvement was not an increase in quantity, but rather a qualitative change.
"I'll stay here for a few more days."
"I have never believed that a single path can decide one's fate."
"Even if I am not the first to complete the Imperial Path, or even the thousandth or ten thousandth, as long as I have gained something, this trip will not be wasted."
"Being strong yourself is the path of the strongest."
"This can't decide my fate!"
Ling Han continued to sit in a cross-legged position, not bothering about which place he would be to complete the Imperial Path.
What was the point of walking quickly? He had to become stronger on this path. That was the true way to go.

The head continued to release seductive sounds, and Ling Han resisted with all his might. In this kind of contest, he continuously toughened his willpower, and his Spiritual Power was becoming more and more tenacious.
From clay to brick, from brick to rock, from rock to iron, from iron... he had polished its sharpness, and was capable of striking the heaven and earth.
At this moment, those human heads no longer spoke, and no longer stared at him. All of them closed their eyes, as if they had suddenly lost interest in him.
Yi, continue!
Ling Han looked at the tree, and began to provoke them, "Hey, hey, hey, you guys better not sleep. How can you have the nerve to sleep when you're so ugly?"
If this was a normal person, they would probably roll their eyes at him even if they didn't scold him back, right?
However, these heads weren't real living beings, so they didn't have any emotions. It was as if they were all dead, and they ignored him completely.
Ling Han provoked them for a while longer. Even with his ability to insult others, he was actually unable to anger these heads in the slightest, which made him feel deeply frustrated.
"My skill is still not up to scratch. If it was Old Black..."
Unfortunately, the large black dog was not here.
Ling Han shook his head, and stretched out a hand to grab a falling leaf. He strode forwards, and arrived at the riverbank.
He threw the tree leaf into the river, then with a leap, landed on the tree leaf.

Ordinarily, with his cultivation level, he was completely capable of making his body as light as a feather, and completely weightless. However, when he stepped on the leaf, the leaf suddenly sank a bit, and the river water instantly reached Ling Han's ankle.
Thankfully, it did not go any higher.
The problem was that the river was surging, bringing Ling Han straight down, but there was no sign of crossing at all.
Ling Han suddenly recalled the message left on the stone tablet. He had to use his faith as motivation.
He immediately activated his willpower, pushing the tree leaf to cross the river.

His willpower was strong to begin with, and he had also been tempering his willpower these past few days, reaching an astonishing strength. Even in this strange river, it was effective, pushing the tree leaf to begin crossing.

All around him, when the faces were washed over by the river waters, they were filled with yearning. They were all staring at Ling Han with hatred in their eyes, as if they were saying, 'Why don't you have to be dragged into the river and suffer that eternal torture?'
They wanted to drag Ling Han down with them, but the Immortality Leaf was exuding a faint light. This light had a powerful intimidating effect on the faces, making them not dare to cross the line.
Ling Han was determined, and ignored these faces. He didn't consider at all whether he would be torn to pieces by these faces if his "ship" capsized.
He only had one thought, and that was to cross the river.
His journey was the universe, and he was a man who was going to become Emperor in the future. How could he die here?
The river waters surged, and the demonic faces howled. However, Ling Han completely ignored them. In the past few days of tempering his willpower, it was as if he had obtained a new life.
Close, close, the other shore was right in front of his eyes.
At this moment, a faint light suddenly flickered on Ling Han's body.

Ling Han felt as if his body was undergoing an earth-shattering change. His cultivation level clearly hadn't increased at all, yet it was as if he had been reborn. It was as if heaven and earth had changed color.

He saw the Regulations of heaven and earth, manifested in front of his eyes. It was as if he only had to stretch out a hand, and he would be able to channel a Regulation or even a few Regulations at will, turning them into an indestructible spear, or an incredibly sturdy shield.
"Yi?"
He felt an itch on his face. With a rub, he had actually scraped off a layer of his old skin!
At the same time, he also felt an extraordinary itch in his bones, and bone scraps were actually expelling from the pores on his skin.
Heavens, he was really undergoing a complete transformation!

Ling Han was stunned. He had cultivated every cultivation level to perfection, and had even broken through his limits time and time again. Added with the fact that he had cultivated the Heavenly Dragon Emperor Technique, no matter which cultivation level he was at, he should still have a perfect body.
However, he could actually undergo a complete transformation, and evolve to an even more perfect state.
This!
Ling Han finally understood. This was a qualitative change on the spiritual level. His spirit had become perfect, and it had affected his physical body, making him even more perfect.
Other Side, Return to Living Realm, his second life.

Realization dawned on Ling Han. After the Yin soul crossed this river, it would be able to obtain a body of flesh and blood, and begin its second life. Furthermore, he had not died in the first place, so he naturally could not begin his second life. Thus, it only allowed his soul to approach near perfection.
He couldn't help but grin. This path was indeed dangerous, but the opportunities were also astonishing. Otherwise, what kind of Great Herb would he need to cultivate his soul to such perfection?
He had arrived at the other shore.

Ling Han leaped down and landed on the bank of the river. When he turned around, those faces all revealed expressions of defiance, as if they were all about to rush out of the river and drag Ling Han back.
However, they were completely unable to break free from the restraints of the river waters. Amidst the sound of surging waves, they were mercilessly washed downstream.
Ling Han retracted his gaze. Ahead of him was a plain, and there was presently a large number of people running and flying around, but not a single person gave him a second look.
Yi, why don't you guys find it strange?
Hold on, where was the sound of the river?
Ling Han was astonished. He turned around again, and this time, he was stunned.
Where was the river?
There was also a plain behind him. Where was the river?
No wonder no one cared about him. Though he had appeared out of thin air, there were really too many people here, and everyone was scrambling to rush forwards, so who would care about him?
Alright, so be it if no one cared. In any case, he did not care either.
Ling Han followed them, and looking at everyone's cultivation level and aptitude, he was sure that those who entered now were inferior to even Dao Child-level.
It was clear that the Imperial Son, the Dao Child, and the others had all left before it was these people's turn.
Ling Han had already changed his appearance. In reality, his soul had undergone a perfect evolution. Even if it didn't change, it was very likely that few people would be able to recognize him.
Very soon, a canyon appeared ahead of them, and in the canyon, multiple massive axes were slashing horizontally, covering the whole canyon.

chapters.title: Chapter 4399 Saber and Axe Canyon
paragraphs: Sabers and axes danced, covering the entire canyon.
If they barged in rashly, they would be instantly slashed into pieces.
Ling Han couldn't help but stop in his tracks and start to observe.

These axes and sabers were extraordinarily huge, as if they were multiple small mountains, and though they were brandishing together, they were definitely not uniform in pattern. They were separated from one another, yet seemed to have some kind of rhythm to them.
Ling Han had just grasped it, when he suddenly realized that there was something off about the pattern.
Yi?
It had changed, and became another pattern.
In a short while, he had figured it out. There was indeed a pattern to the movements of the axes and sabers, but it would change about every minute.
He advanced again, and after walking for quite a while, he finally arrived at the foot of the canyon.
Only after arriving here did he discover that this canyon was astonishingly huge. If one stood at the foot and looked up, they would only feel extremely tiny.
There were a great many people standing at the entrance to the canyon, and as they deduced the pattern, they all looked terrified.
That was because someone had entered into the canyon, yet had been sliced into mush by blades and axes!
Why couldn't he pass through from another direction?
Someone had indeed made an attempt, but they had only arrived at half the height of the canyon before they were suppressed.
The paths were blocked, so they could only walk through the canyon.

A great many people had summarized the pattern, and confidently entered into the canyon, but halfway, two thirds of the way, they were sliced in half by the giant axes. Both their body and soul were destroyed, and they did not even have the chance for their souls to enter into the Netherworld.
Why? Hadn't they already found a pattern?
Ling Han immediately came to a realization.
That was because the Regulations here would change every minute.

Thus, you spent half a minute to find a pattern, but if passing through the canyon required 40 seconds, then you would definitely not be able to pass through, because after one minute had passed, the pattern had already changed.

To pass through the canyon, not only did he have to find a pattern, he also had to calculate how long it would take to pass through the canyon according to this pattern, how much time he had used, and whether there was enough time left.

Ling Han could see very clearly that there were some patterns that were traps in the first place. Observing them once would take more than half a minute, and if he entered at this time, it would only mean death.
Of course, there were also a considerable number of smart people. Very soon, they moved according to the correct pattern, and just barely managed to pass.
Ling Han naturally wouldn't care about others. After watching for a while, xiu, his figure darted out and began to pass.
However, even if he had grasped the pattern, it was still not an easy thing to pass through.
Shua, as the saber and axe swept past, a sharp Qi swept out. Its destructive power was incredibly frightening, and even Venerate Tier elites could be easily killed.

Ling Han was not the only one who had grasped the pattern of this time. There were a great many others with him, but there was a difference in speed. The majority had fallen behind Ling Han, but there were also a few that were about his speed, and there were even some that were ahead of him.

That was a Sect Master-level elite, who was probably a few thousand years old. However, with Minor Advanced Tier's lifespan of 40,000 years, he was naturally very young. Thus, he looked to be only in his twenties, his flame of life blazing.
Boom!
As the saber and axe swept over, booming sounds rang out.
"Scram!" Behind him, a person rushed over.
Ling Han frowned upon hearing this. 'Scram to let you go ahead? Then where am I going?'

In this place, one's own speed actually could not be of much use, because there was a pattern to the movements of the axe and saber. You could not be fast, nor could you be slow. The changes that you could make were extremely limited.
If he stepped aside, he would have to face the blade head-on.
Was there something wrong with him?
Ling Han ignored him. This person only had to be slightly slower, and not rush forwards. It was not like he would die.
But the problem was, that person charged over without any regard for anything else. Brandishing the Divine Sword in his hand, he slashed it towards Ling Han.
He was a Spirit Transformation Tier, but it was clear that he didn't dare to use his spiritual body here. That would be a suicidal action.
A killing intent surged in Ling Han's heart. Since you don't care about the life or death of others, why should he care?
He raised his hand, and merely threw a light punch.
Peng!
As the force surged, it forcibly stopped that person.
He had only used a sliver of power, and had not caused any damage to that person. The problem was, the environment here was extremely dangerous.
Shua, the axe and saber slashed over, easily slicing that person into two.

Immediately, a fountain of blood exploded, and that person was sliced into two halves. His internal organs fell out noisily, and his mind had also been forcefully shattered. Both his body and spirit had been destroyed.
"Disciple!" Ahead of them, the Sect Master elite released an enraged roar, his eyes practically spitting fire.
However, he did not dare to stop at all, and could only continue onwards.
To linger here was completely courting death.
Ling Han raised a brow. No wonder that person was so arrogant. As it turned out, he had a Sect Master elite to back him up.
His expression did not change, and he continued onwards.
Shua, shua, shua! The saber and axe moved in an extremely rhythmic manner.
It wasn't long before the Sect Master elite had already rushed out of the canyon. He immediately turned around and glared at Ling Han, a hint of cruelty in his eyes.
There was no other way here. The moment Ling Han walked out, he would send Ling Han back, so that the latter would also be struck by blades and axes, and experience the same despair.
Ling Han was getting closer and closer. Xiu, he rushed out of the canyon.
The Sect Master sneered, and sent out a palm strike.
Instantly, the Regulations turned into a net, blocking the exit of the canyon.
'You can just die inside.'
Ling Han gave a loud shout, and the Saint Tool staff was already in his hand. He shot out an attack.
Peng, the web of Regulations was immediately shattered.
Ling Han scuttled out, a smile appearing on his face.

His Spiritual Power had not improved, but the quality had been completely transformed. Thus, the attack launched by the Saint Tool that he had activated was naturally a bit stronger. Though it was still Pseudo Sect Master level, if its might was concentrated at one point, it was enough to break through the web of Regulations.
"What!" The Sect Master was stunned for a moment. He had not thought that Ling Han would be so strong.

In his eyes, Ling Han's punch had only blocked his younger brother, and Ling Han's battle prowess was no more than his younger brother's. However, now that he had activated his Spirit Tool, it was actually able to penetrate his web of Regulations. This astonished him, and he was even unable to accept it.
What was going on?
However, he immediately tossed this question to one side. He pressed down with his hand, and struck out at Ling Han again.
He definitely had to avenge his brother's death.
Ling Han humphed as he activated Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. He immediately sped up, so fast that even the elite was dumbfounded.
"Wu!" That elite gave a muffled humph, and couldn't help but take a few steps back. The scorching flames made him feel slightly uncomfortable.
This stunned him even more. A mere Spirit Transformation Tier could actually pose a threat to him?
This was the biggest joke in the world!
His expression became stern. 'Who cares who you are? This is the Mystery Realm. If he wants to kill someone, who can stop him?'
He also used his movement technique, and set off in pursuit of Ling Han.
This battle was really a little unjust.
Ling Han was walking around peacefully, and when he had been rebuked, he definitely had to make a move for the sake of his own safety. And now, he had gotten himself into trouble.
He shook his head. Since he had already provoked them, he was not the type to be afraid of trouble.
Weng, the murderous aura activated, and he began his counterattack.

"Disciple!" Ahead of them, the Sect Master elite released an enraged roar, his eyes practically spitting fire.
However, he did not dare to stop at all, and could only continue onwards.
To linger here was completely courting death.
Ling Han raised a brow.
No wonder that person was so arrogant.
As it turned out, he had a Sect Master elite to back him up.
His expression did not change, and he continued onwards.
Shua, shua, shua!
The saber and axe moved in an extremely rhythmic manner.
It wasn't long before the Sect Master elite had already rushed out of the canyon.
He immediately turned around and glared at Ling Han, a hint of cruelty in his eyes.
There was no other way here.
The moment Ling Han walked out, he would send Ling Han back, so that the latter would also be struck by blades and axes, and experience the same despair.
Ling Han was getting closer and closer.
Xiu, he rushed out of the canyon.
The Sect Master sneered, and sent out a palm strike.
Instantly, the Regulations turned into a net, blocking the exit of the canyon.
'You can just die inside.'
Ling Han gave a loud shout, and the Saint Tool staff was already in his hand.
He shot out an attack.
Peng, the web of Regulations was immediately shattered.
Ling Han scuttled out, a smile appearing on his face.
His Spiritual Power had not improved, but the quality had been completely transformed.
Thus, the attack launched by the Saint Tool that he had activated was naturally a bit stronger.
Though it was still Pseudo Sect Master level, if its might was concentrated at one point, it was enough to break through the web of Regulations.
"What!" The Sect Master was stunned for a moment.
He had not thought that Ling Han would be so strong.
In his eyes, Ling Han's punch had only blocked his younger brother, and Ling Han's battle prowess was no more than his younger brother's.
However, now that he had activated his Spirit Tool, it was actually able to penetrate his web of Regulations.
This astonished him, and he was even unable to accept it.
What was going on?
However, he immediately tossed this question to one side.
He pressed down with his hand, and struck out at Ling Han again.
He definitely had to avenge his brother's death.
Ling Han humphed as he activated Phoenix Wings Divine Flight.
He immediately sped up, so fast that even the elite was dumbfounded.
"Wu!" That elite gave a muffled humph, and couldn't help but take a few steps back.
The scorching flames made him feel slightly uncomfortable.
This stunned him even more.
A mere Spirit Transformation Tier could actually pose a threat to him?
This was the biggest joke in the world!
His expression became stern. 'Who cares who you are?
This is the Mystery Realm.
If he wants to kill someone, who can stop him?'
He also used his movement technique, and set off in pursuit of Ling Han.
This battle was really a little unjust.
Ling Han was walking around peacefully, and when he had been rebuked, he definitely had to make a move for the sake of his own safety.
And now, he had gotten himself into trouble.
He shook his head.
Since he had already provoked them, he was not the type to be afraid of trouble.
Weng, the murderous aura activated, and he began his counterattack.

chapters.title: Chapter 4400 Slightly inferior
paragraphs: Could a Spirit Transformation True Lord rival a Sect Master?
If he asked anyone, it was guaranteed that everyone would shake their heads, and reprimand him as dreaming.

Ling Han had advanced into the Eighth Change, and his battle prowess had increased greatly again. Furthermore, his spirit had undergone a complete transformation. It could be said that his whole person had reached the limit of his current cultivation level, and could no longer be improved in the slightest.
However, compared to the Sect Master-level battle prowess, he was still slightly inferior.
Though the gap was already not too far.

Ling Han activated the murderous aura, which affected his opponent. Meanwhile, he activated the Imperial Technique, which further boosted his battle prowess. Although he was still at a disadvantage, if they fought for ten moves, he could still counter with one or even two moves.
This caused the spectators to be dumbfounded.
What was going on?
Was this really a Spirit Transformation Tier
"I know that Sect Master. He's the prodigy of the Wenren Clan, Wenren Liangping!"
"That's right, that's right. Wenren Liangping is only 4000 years old, yet he's already advanced to the Minor Advanced Tier. He's terrifyingly freakish."
"But his opponent?"
"Spirit Transformation True Lord?"
"A Spirit Transformation True Lord can actually rival a Sect Master, and he's only at a disadvantage?"
"Though it hasn't been long since Wenren Liangping broke through to Sect Master-level, no matter what, that is still battle prowess of Sect Master-level!"
Everyone was in disbelief. This was practically too unbelievable. Even if they had seen it with their own eyes, it was still very hard to believe.
Yet Ling Han felt that this was very normal.

He was a Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator who had broken through to Ten Forms. Theoretically speaking, when he reached Ninth Change, he should be able to match a Minor Advanced Tier cultivator. Now, however, his soul had received a great baptism, which naturally further increased his battle prowess.
Eighth Change, just barely enough to match the weakest Sect Master.
Wenren Liangping was about to go crazy. What kind of luck did he and his brother have to actually encounter such an opponent?
Even so, his killing intent became even more intense.
He definitely could not let Ling Han off the hook. That was because if Ling Han advanced another step further, would he still be a match for Ling Han?
Hence, since he had already formed an enmity with this kind of prodigy, he definitely had to kill him. He could not leave behind any future troubles, and lay a trap for himself.
He unleashed his full power, instantly suppressing Ling Han.
After all, he was a Sect Master. His explosive might was definitely not just for show. It was too terrifying.
However, Ling Han was extremely slippery as he unleashed Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. His speed was no slower than Wenren Liangping. In fact, it was even faster than Wenren Liangping.
Thus, even though Wenren Liangping had the upper hand, he was completely unable to kill Ling Han.
Seeing this, everyone gritted their teeth again, feeling their scalps go numb.
Heavens, was this really a Spirit Transformation Tier?
Monster, freak!
"I can't let you live!" Wenren Liangping said in a baleful voice. He gritted his teeth, retrieved a green toad, and furiously swallowed it.
"Ah!" A twisted expression immediately appeared on his face, and the veins on his face throbbed violently, as if his blood was about to gush out.
'F*ck! Have you been possessed?'

Ling Han grumbled. However, he knew very well that this person wasn't bewitched. Instead, he had used some forbidden technique to forcefully increase his battle prowess. His body couldn't withstand it for the moment, and that was why he had such a twisted expression.
He was done playing. Retreat.

Though Ling Han had always been confident in himself, he was definitely not blind. This opponent was stronger than him in the first place, and it was not just by a little bit either. And now, he had used a forbidden technique to increase his battle prowess. If he continued to fight head-on, that would only be making things difficult for himself.
Xiu, he used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. He ran into the distance at an astonishing speed, and Wenren Liangping wasn't able to stop him at all.

"Don't even think about running!" Wenren Liangping roared. He had paid a huge price to obtain the toad that he had ingested. It could greatly increase his battle prowess for a short period of time. However, he still had to sacrifice a certain amount of his lifespan.
If he could kill Ling Han, then he would have no choice but to accept it. He would have gotten rid of a future threat, and he would have gotten his revenge for his younger brother.
However... Ling Han had fled.
He had ran, he had ran, he had ran... He was extremely depressed.
In the distance, Ling Han stopped, turned around and said, "You're too disgusting. You even eat toads. Fighting with someone like you will make me throw up."
After saying this, he strode off.
Wenren Liangping was enraged upon hearing this. 'You actually dare to mock me?'
He gave chase with all his might, but in terms of speed, he had not surpassed Ling Han. Instead, he was slightly inferior, so how could he possibly catch up to Ling Han?
Thus, he could only watch helplessly as Ling Han became farther and farther away, and was about to disappear from his sight.
Ling Han turned around and added, "Just you wait. The next time we meet, I'll chop off your head and kick it around like a ball."
Wenren Liangping stopped in his tracks. He knew that it was impossible for him to catch up to Ling Han.
Damn it, he had killed his younger brother, and caused him to waste a treasure for nothing!
"I'll definitely find you and kill you with my own hands!" he said balefully. He definitely couldn't allow Ling Han to take another step forward and break through to the Minor Advanced Tier.
—He only thought that Ling Han was already Ninth Change, and this was very normal. If this wasn't the end of Spiritual Transformation Tier, then what kind of monster are you?

Ling Han rapidly sped forwards. Very soon, he stopped channelling the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. This movement technique was indeed fast, but firstly, it was too eye-catching, and secondly, it expended a lot of mystical power. Unless absolutely necessary, it was best not to use it.
He stopped, and summarized the previous battle.
It could be said that this was the first real confrontation between him and a Sect Master. He didn't need the Spirit Tool, and he could deal with it with his own strength.
"I'm just a sliver away," Ling Han murmured. When he advanced into the Ninth Change, he would definitely be able to match the Minor Advanced Tier. In fact, he might even be able to win.

Of course, this kind of Minor Advanced Tier was definitely the weakest level. He had just advanced into this cultivation level, and he couldn't be Imperial Son-level either. Otherwise, he probably wouldn't be able to defeat him.
After all, he was only in the Spirit Transformation Tier. It was already inconceivable that he could stand against a Sect Master.
He continued to advance. He really wanted to see what was so amazing about this Imperial Path.
After a few days, the crowds ahead of him became denser again.
Clearly, a barrier had appeared ahead of them, and those who had come here first were all stuck here — at least, a great many of them were stuck here.
Ling Han looked into the distance, but he couldn't see anything from here.
After walking forward for a while, he arrived at a massive plaza.
The tiles on the floor weren't laid out, but rather it was a single tile. It was as if they had been carved out of a massive rock.

The plaza was completely white in colour, and the stones were slightly exuding a gentle light. However, there was not a single person on the plaza, because there were presently two great elites exchanging blows, and the strong winds they created whistled. Regulations surged violently; this was too terrifying.
Upon a closer look, one of these two great elites was a clay figure, while the other was a fiery figure. From east to west, and from south to north, the whole plaza was their territory.
Some people wanted to sneak in, but they had only walked one third of the way, when they were swept by the shockwaves of the battle, and were instantly killed.
And this person who wanted to "sneak in" was shockingly a Spirit Transformation Tier elite.
A Spirit Transformation Tier was actually killed by the shockwaves caused by the aftermath of the battle!
Hence, everyone watched, frowning deeply.
